Original Text: 【伝説：でんせつ】のおんせんに　【入：はい】ってみました
Translated Text: I Tried Out the Legendary Hot Spring

Original Text: 【伝説：でんせつ】のおんせんに　【入：はい】ってみました
Translated Text: I Tried Out the Legendary Hot Spring

Original Text: ゲームオーバーですよ
Translated Text: It's game over.

Original Text: いざ、【出陣：しゅつじん】ですよ！
Translated Text: Let's get going!

Original Text: おや、ここを【守：まも】っている【妖怪：ようかい】は\nだれもいないようです
Translated Text: Hmm, it looks like there aren't\nany Yo-kai guarding this place.

Original Text: われわれが　さくっと\nいただいてしまいましょう！
Translated Text: Let's just go ahead and eat it!

Original Text: ぺらっぺらな　【守：まも】りですねぇ…\n【Base1.strBaseName】に【妖怪：ようかい】をはいちしましょう
Translated Text:
What flimsy defenses...
Let's station Yo-kai at
【Base1.strBaseName】!

Original Text: あーっと！【誰：だれ】もいない【施設：しせつ】を【発見：はっけん】！\n【Base1.strBaseName】を　いただいちゃいましょう
Translated Text:
Oh! An undefended facility!
Let's take 【Base1.strBaseName】!

Original Text: 【我：わ】が【軍：ぐん】に【敵：てき】は【無：な】し！\n【Base1.strBaseName】に　【攻：せ】めこみましょう！
Translated Text:
No enemy can stand against our army!
Let's storm 【Base1.strBaseName】!

Original Text: 【今：いま】はトレーニングや　クエストで\n【強：つよ】くなったほうが　いいですねー…。
Translated Text: Right now, I guess it's better to get\nstronger through training and quests...

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】はもう【遅：おそ】いです\nまた【明日：あした】にしましょう
Translated Text: It's already late today. Let's\ndo it tomorrow instead.

Original Text: さて　どのトレーニングをしますか？
Translated Text: So, which workout should we do?

Original Text: 【普通：ふつう】の　トレーニングです
Translated Text: It's just a regular workout.

Original Text: すごい　トレーニングです
Translated Text: That's some intense training!

Original Text: こ、これは…！\nスペシャルな　トレーニングです
Translated Text:
W-Wow...!
This is... a special training session!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】と　おわかれしようとするなんて\n【何：なに】を【考：かんが】えてるんですかー！
Translated Text: What are you thinking, trying\nto break up with me like this?!

Original Text: さんかく【公園：こうえん】で　バトルをしましょう！
Translated Text: Let's have a battle at Sankaku Park!

Original Text: さんかく【公園：こうえん】で　【仲間：なかま】を【増：ふ】やしましょう！
Translated Text: Let's make new friends at Sankaku Park!

Original Text: STARTを【押：お】してターン【終了：しゅうりょう】しましょう！
Translated Text: Press START to end the turn!

Original Text: ヨロズマートに　【攻：せ】めこみましょう！
Translated Text: Let's storm Yorozu Mart!

Original Text: 【自由：じゆう】に　バトルしてください
Translated Text: Feel free to battle!

Original Text: ゲームオーバーズラ！
Translated Text: Game over!

Original Text: 【出陣：しゅつじん】ズラ～！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん、ここを【守：まも】っている【妖怪：ようかい】は\nいないズラ！
Translated Text: Bro, there aren't any Yo-kai\nguarding this place, you know!

Original Text: ここはもう　【兄：にい】ちゃんのもんズラ！
Translated Text: This place is all mine now, big bro!

Original Text: 【Base1.strBaseName】に　だれもいないズラ！\nこのままだと【危：あぶ】ないズラ！
Translated Text:
There's nobody at
【Base1.strBaseName】, zura!
It's dangerous to leave it like this, zura!

Original Text: 【Base1.strBaseName】に　【誰：だれ】もいないズラ\n【兄：にい】ちゃん、もらっちゃうといいズラ
Translated Text:
There's nobody at
【Base1.strBaseName】, zura!
You should take it, big bro, zura!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんに【敵：てき】は【無：な】いズラ！\n【Base1.strBaseName】に　【攻：せ】めこむズラ！
Translated Text:
Nobody can beat big bro, zura!
Let's storm
【Base1.strBaseName】, zura!

Original Text: 【都会：とかい】の【妖怪：ようかい】は【強：つよ】いズラ…\nもうちょっと【強：つよ】くなってから【行：い】くズラ…
Translated Text:
Urban Yo-kai are tough, I
guess… I’ll go once I get
a little stronger, I guess…

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん…　オラ【眠：ねむ】いズラ…\nお【家：うち】に【帰：かえ】るズラ…
Translated Text:
Big bro… I'm sleepy…
I'm going home…

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんはどんな\nトレーニングをするズラ？
Translated Text: What kind of training does my big bro do?

Original Text: 【基本：きほん】のトレーニング　ズラ
Translated Text: Basic Training: Zura

Original Text: なかなかのトレーニング　ズラ
Translated Text: Quite the Workout, Zura

Original Text: もんげートレーニング　ズラ！
Translated Text: Monge Training: Zura!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん…オラ…\nおわかれしたくないズラ…
Translated Text:
Big bro… I… I don’t wanna
say goodbye…

Original Text: さんかく【公園：こうえん】で　バトルするズラ！
Translated Text: Let's battle at Sankaku Park!

Original Text: さんかく【公園：こうえん】で　【仲間：なかま】を【増：ふ】やすズラ！
Translated Text: Let's make some new friends at Sankaku Park!

Original Text: ターンを【終了：しゅうりょう】するズラ！
Translated Text: Time to end this turn!

Original Text: よろずマートで　バトルするズラ！
Translated Text: Let's battle at Yorozu Mart!

Original Text: 【自由：じゆう】に　バトルするズラ！
Translated Text: Let's battle freely, Zura!

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし…【妖怪：ようかい】よ…
Translated Text: O chosen... Yo-kai...

Original Text: 【真：しん】の【英雄：えいゆう】よ…！
Translated Text: O true hero…!

Original Text: ほんを…\nさがせ…
Translated Text: Find the book...

Original Text: ジバニャン！　【起：お】きてください！\nちょっとー！　ちょっとー！！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan! Wake up!
Hey! Hey!!

Original Text: うーん…
Translated Text: Hmm…

Original Text: オレっち\nエーユーになりたいニャン…
Translated Text: I wanna be an AU, meow…

Original Text: 【何：なに】わけのわかんないことを\n【言：い】ってるんですか！
Translated Text: What on earth are you talking about?!

Original Text: …はっ！
Translated Text: …Huh!

Original Text: オレっち\nいつの【間：ま】にか【寝：ね】てたニャン…？
Translated Text: When did I fall asleep, meow...?

Original Text: ええ！\nそりゃもう　ぐっすりと！
Translated Text:
Really?!
I slept like a log!

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】の【本：ほん】の【上：うえ】で…
Translated Text: On top of Keita's book...

Original Text: ニャハハハ…この【本：ほん】\nまくらにちょうどいいニャンよ
Translated Text: Meow ha ha ha… This book\nmakes a perfect pillow, meow!

Original Text: この【厚：あつ】さがオレっちの【頭：あたま】に\nジャストフィットだったニャン！
Translated Text: This thickness was a perfect\nfit for my head, meow!
…… Hmm?

Original Text: ようやく【気：き】づきましたか…\nおのれのあやまちに…
Translated Text:
Have you finally realized it…
your own mistake…

Original Text: この【本：ほん】…\nオレっちのヨダレまみれニャン！
Translated Text:
This book… it's covered in
my drool!

Original Text: しかも　チョコボーの【食：た】べカスまで！\nバ　バッチィー…
Translated Text:
And even Chocobo food scraps!
Yuck...

Original Text: ど　どーするニャン…？\nこのままじゃケータに【怒：おこ】られちゃうニャン！
Translated Text:
W-what should I do, meow…?
If this keeps up, Keita’s going
to get mad at me, meow!

Original Text: どうするも【何：なに】も\n【素直：すなお】に　あやまるしか【無：な】いのでは…
Translated Text: There's nothing else\nto do but just admit it...

Original Text: ケータが【帰：かえ】ってくる【前：まえ】に\nどこかに　かくすニャン！
Translated Text: Let's hide it somewhere\nbefore Keita gets home, meow!

Original Text: って…\nどこ【行：い】くんでうぃす～！？
Translated Text:
Wait... where
are you going, huh~!?

Original Text: 【公園：こうえん】の【砂場：すなば】に　【本：ほん】をかくすニャン…\nそれならバレないニャン！
Translated Text:
Hiding a book in the
sandbox at the park... That
way, no one will find out!

Original Text: ますます\n【汚：よご】れちゃいそうな【気：き】がしますけど…
Translated Text: I have a feeling it's just going\nto get even dirtier, though...

Original Text: あれ？　ジバニャン！\nオレの【本持：ほんも】って　なにしてんの？
Translated Text:
Huh? Jibanyan!
What are you doing with my book?

Original Text: ニャニャニャ！！\nケ　ケータ！？
Translated Text:
Meow, meow, meow!!
Ke... Keeta!?

Original Text: えーっと…　ポカポカしてたから\n【外：そと】で【本：ほん】でも【読：よ】もうかニャ～みたいな…
Translated Text: Um... It was nice and warm out,\nso I thought, "Maybe I'll read a\nbook outside, meow~"...

Original Text: お　【面白：おもしろ】いニャンね…\nこの『さんくにナントカ』って【本：ほん】！
Translated Text:
Oh,
this book, *"San-kun-i
Something-or-other,"* is
really interesting, isn't it?

Original Text: …『【三国志：さんごくし】』！\nさ・ん・ご・く・し！！
Translated Text:
…*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*!
T-h-r-e-e-k-i-n-g-d-o-m-s!!

Original Text: そ　そうニャン！\n『さんごくし』！
Translated Text:
That's right, meow!
"Sangokushi"!

Original Text: でしょー？
Translated Text: Right?

Original Text: 【明日：あした】の【宿題：しゅくだい】\n【読書感想文：どくしょかんそうぶん】なんだけど…
Translated Text: It's about the book report I have to\ndo for homework tomorrow, but...

Original Text: どうせなら【面白：おもしろ】い【本：ほん】がいいと【思：おも】って\n【学校：がっこう】の【図書室：としょしつ】から【借：か】りてきたんだ！
Translated Text: I figured I might as well read\nsomething interesting, so I borrowed\nthis from the school library!

Original Text: ニャ！？　こ　この【本：ほん】…\n【借：か】り【物：もの】だったのニャン…！？
Translated Text:
Meow!? T-this book… was
borrowed, meow…!?

Original Text: ますます　あやまりづらく\nなっちゃいましたねえ…
Translated Text: It's getting harder and\nharder to apologize, isn't it...

Original Text: でも　ジバニャン…\nやっぱり【素直：すなお】に　あやまったほうが…
Translated Text:
But, Jibanyan… I
guess you should just
apologize honestly…

Original Text: そ　そうニャンね…\nケータ…　【実：じつ】は…！
Translated Text:
"Oh, right, meow... Keita...
Actually...!"

Original Text: あ　でも…　その【本：ほん】　\nジバニャンが【持：も】ってていいよ
Translated Text: Oh, but... Jibanyan can keep that book.

Original Text: …ニャ？　【明日：あした】の【宿題：しゅくだい】をするために\nこの【本：ほん】がいるんじゃないのニャン？
Translated Text: …Meow? Don't you need this book\nto do tomorrow's homework, meow?

Original Text: のるか！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: そるか！
Translated Text: I see!

Original Text: …？　ウィスパー…\n「のるかそるか」ってなんニャン？
Translated Text:
…? Whisper…
What does “all or nothing” mean, meow?

Original Text: 「【成功：せいこう】するか【失敗：しっぱい】するかはわからないが\nとにかくやってみる！」
Translated Text: "I don't know if it'll work or not, but\nI'm going to give it a try anyway!"

Original Text: という【意味：いみ】でうぃす！
Translated Text: That's what I mean!

Original Text: ニャるほど…
Translated Text: I see...

Original Text: で　ケータ！\nのるかそるか…　なんニャン？
Translated Text:
So, Keita!
It's do or die... What do you say?

Original Text: 【本：ほん】を【見：み】ないで\n【感想文：かんそうぶん】を【書：か】いてみようと【思：おも】うんだ！
Translated Text: I'm going to try writing a book\nreport without looking at the book!

Original Text: ニャニャッ！？
Translated Text: Meow-meow!?

Original Text: なんですってー！？
Translated Text: What did you say!?

Original Text: よーし！\nオレ【流三国志：りゅうさんごくし】　【書：か】くぞ～！
Translated Text:
All right!
I'm going to write my own version of
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*!

Original Text: オレ【流三国志：りゅうさんごくし】…ですって？
Translated Text: "My Take on the Three Kingdoms"... is that right?

Original Text: しかし　それでは\n【読書感想文：どくしょかんそうぶん】にならないよーな…
Translated Text: But that doesn't really count\nas a book report, does it...

Original Text: ぜったい\n【先生：せんせい】に【怒：おこ】られるニャン…
Translated Text: The teacher is definitely going\nto get mad at me, meow…

Original Text: まあ　とにかく\nピンチは【切：き】りぬけましたが…
Translated Text: Well, anyway, we managed to\nget through that tough spot…

Original Text: どうするんです？
Translated Text: What are we going to do?

Original Text: …【借：か】り【物：もの】なら\nかくすワケには　いかないニャンね
Translated Text: …If it’s something I borrowed, I\ncan’t very well hide it, can I, meow?

Original Text: できるだけ　【本：ほん】をキレイにして\n【学校：がっこう】へ　あやまりに【行：い】くニャン…
Translated Text: I'm going to clean up the book as best I\ncan and go to school to apologize, meow...

Original Text: じゃあ　コンビニで\n【何：なに】かふくものでも【買：か】って【行：い】きましょうか
Translated Text: Well then, shall we stop by a convenience\nstore and pick up something to eat?

Original Text: あ　でも…　その【本：ほん】　\nジバニャンが【持：も】ってていいよ
Translated Text: Oh, but... Jibanyan can keep that book.

Original Text: …ニャ？　【明日：あした】の【宿題：しゅくだい】をするために\nこの【本：ほん】がいるんじゃないのニャン？

Original Text: のるか！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: そるか！
Translated Text: I see!

Original Text: …？　ウィスパー…\n「のるかそるか」ってなんニャン？
Translated Text:
…? Whisper…
What does “all or nothing” mean, meow?

Original Text: 「【成功：せいこう】するか【失敗：しっぱい】するかはわからないが\nとにかくやってみる！」
Translated Text: "I don't know if it'll work or not, but\nI'm going to give it a try anyway!"

Original Text: という【意味：いみ】でうぃす！
Translated Text: That's what I mean!

Original Text: ニャるほど…
Translated Text: I see...

Original Text: で　ケータ！\nのるかそるか…　なんニャン？
Translated Text:
So, Keita!
It's do or die... What do you say?

Original Text: ぜったい\n【先生：せんせい】に【怒：おこ】られるニャン…

Original Text: まあ　とにかく\nピンチは【切：き】りぬけましたが…
Translated Text: Well, anyway, we managed to\nget through that tough spot…

Original Text: どうするんです？
Translated Text: What are we going to do?

Original Text: …【借：か】り【物：もの】なら\nかくすワケには　いかないニャンね
Translated Text: …If it’s something I borrowed, I\ncan’t very well hide it, can I, meow?

Original Text: できるだけ　【本：ほん】をキレイにして\n【学校：がっこう】へ　あやまりに【行：い】くニャン…
Translated Text: I'm going to clean up the book as best I\ncan and go to school to apologize, meow...

Original Text: じゃあ　コンビニで\n【何：なに】かふくものでも【買：か】って【行：い】きましょうか
Translated Text: Well then, shall we stop by a convenience\nstore and pick up something to eat?

Original Text: おや？　あそこにいるのは…\nコマさんとケータ【君：くん】のおともだちでは？
Translated Text:
Huh? Isn't that... Komasan and Keita's
friend over there?

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: オレ　このソフトクリームを\nコーンのほうから【食：た】べるんだ！
Translated Text: I'm going to eat this soft-serve ice\ncream starting from the cone end!

Original Text: クリームがたれる？　たれない？\nドキドキするねぇ！
Translated Text:
Will the cream drip? Or won't it? It's so
nerve-wracking!

Original Text: ボクも\nのるかそるか！
Translated Text: It's all or nothing for me, too!

Original Text: ２【個：こ】のソフトクリームを\nジャグリングしながら【食：た】べる！
Translated Text: Eating two soft-serve ice\ncreams while juggling them!

Original Text: 【落：お】とすなよ！？　【落：お】とすなよ！？
Translated Text: Don't drop it! Don't drop it!

Original Text: はぁ～！\n【都会：とかい】の【人間：にんげん】は　もんげーズラね～！
Translated Text:
Whew!
City folks sure are something else!

Original Text: あんなソフトクリームの【食：た】べ【方：かた】\n【田舎：いなか】では【見：み】たことないズラ…！
Translated Text: I've never seen anyone eat soft-serve ice\ncream like that out in the countryside...!

Original Text: いやいやいや\nあんな【食：た】べ【方：かた】　だれもしないニャンよ…
Translated Text: No, no, no—nobody eats like that, meow…

Original Text: そういえば　「のるかそるか」って\nどういう【意味：いみ】ズラ？
Translated Text: Come to think of it, what does\n“all or nothing” mean, anyway?

Original Text: 「【成功：せいこう】するか【失敗：しっぱい】するかはわからないが\nとにかくやってみる！」
Translated Text: "I don't know if it'll work or not, but\nI'm going to give it a try anyway!"

Original Text: という【意味：いみ】でうぃす！
Translated Text: That's what I mean!

Original Text: さっきのケータもそうだけど\nみんな　ちょっと【変：へん】ニャン…
Translated Text: Just like Keita a little while ago,\neveryone’s a little weird, meow…

Original Text: もしかして…\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン？
Translated Text:
Could it be... the work of a
Yo-kai, meow?

Original Text: 【何：なに】をおっしゃいます！　こんなの\nごくごくフツーの【日常風景：にちじょうふうけい】でうぃす～！
Translated Text: What are you talking about!\nThis is just a totally ordinary\neveryday scene, you know!

Original Text: 【男：おとこ】の【子：こ】はくだらな～いことで\nスリルを【楽：たの】しむモンなんです！
Translated Text: Boys just love getting a\nthrill out of silly little things!

Original Text: ホントに　そうニャンか…？
Translated Text: Is that really true, meow…?

Original Text: でも…　【今朝：けさ】…\nオラの【弟：おとうと】のコマじろうも【変：へん】だったズラ…
Translated Text:
But… this morning…
my little brother, Komajiro,
was acting weird, too…

Original Text: 「のるかそるか！」
Translated Text: "It's do or die!"

Original Text: 「ここに【生：は】えてる\n【草：くさ】を【食：た】べてみるズラ！」
Translated Text: "Let's try eating the grass growing here!"

Original Text: と【叫：さけ】んでいたズラ！
Translated Text: That's what Zura was shouting!

Original Text: それは【止：と】めてあげましょうよ…
Translated Text: Let's stop that, shall we…

Original Text: やっぱりおかしいニャン…\nきっと　【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン！
Translated Text:
Something's
definitely off, meow... It must
be the work of a Yo-kai, meow!

Original Text: んなわけないですって！　ん？
Translated Text: "No way!" Huh?

Original Text: ん～？　んーっ！！
Translated Text: Hmm? Hmm!!

Original Text: なんか　【私：わたくし】たちのまわり\n【光：ひか】ってませんかー！
Translated Text: Hey, isn't there some\nkind of glow around us?!

Original Text: もんげー！　まぶしいズラー！
Translated Text: Whoa! That's blinding!

Original Text: ニャニ～！
Translated Text: Meow~!

Original Text: あわわわ…　いったい【何：なに】が…！
Translated Text: Oh no... What on earth is going on...!

Original Text: そうだ…\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざだ…
Translated Text:
That's right... It must
be the work of a Yo-kai
...

Original Text: おそるべき【妖気：ようき】が\nお【前：まえ】の【世界：せかい】に…えいきょうを…
Translated Text: A terrifying demonic aura is about\nto... influence... your world...

Original Text: （この【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】で【聞：き】こえた【声：こえ】！？）
Translated Text: (That voice... Is it the voice I heard in my dream!?)

Original Text: （あれ…\nこの【声：こえ】…　【聞：き】いたことあるズラ…）
Translated Text:
(Huh... this voice...
I think I've heard it before...)

Original Text: 【図書室：としょしつ】へ…
Translated Text: To the library…

Original Text: さんご…　という【本：ほん】を…　さがせ…
Translated Text: Find the book called *Sango*...

Original Text: …【消：き】えたニャン！
Translated Text: …He's gone, meow!

Original Text: これは…　まさか…
Translated Text: This is... Could it be...

Original Text: もんげー！　【都会人：とかいじん】のすることは\nやっぱり　ひと【味：あじ】ちがうズラね～！
Translated Text: Wow! City folks really do things\na little differently, don't they~!

Original Text: んなわけないでしょうが！
Translated Text: There's no way that's true!

Original Text: 【不可思議：ふかしぎ】な【現象：げんしょう】の【数々：かずかず】！\nそして　ナゾの【人物：じんぶつ】からの【ＳＯＳ：エスオーエス】！
Translated Text:
A series of mysterious phenomena!
And an SOS from a mysterious figure!

Original Text: これは　【大冒険：だいぼうけん】の【予感：よかん】が\nプンプンしますね！
Translated Text: This definitely feels like the\nstart of a great adventure!

Original Text: ウィスパー…　さっきは【日常風景：にちじょうふうけい】って\n【言：い】ってたくせに…
Translated Text: Whisper… Just a moment ago you were\nsaying it was just an everyday scene…

Original Text: シャラーップ！\nおだまりなさい！　このジバ【野郎：やろう】が！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!
Be quiet! You little brat!

Original Text: さあ　【物語：ものがたり】のカギは【図書室：としょしつ】にアリ！\nみなさん　【参：まい】りますよ！
Translated Text:
Well then, the key to the
story is in the library!
Everyone, let's go!

Original Text: ズラ！　オラもなんだか\nもんげーワクワクしてきたズラ！
Translated Text: Wow! I'm starting to get super excited, too!

Original Text: イヤな【予感：よかん】しか　しないニャン…\nでも…　あの【声：こえ】…
Translated Text:
I've got a bad feeling about this, meow...
But... that voice...

Original Text: オレっちも　【行：い】ってみるニャンよ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna check it out, too, meow!

Original Text: あわわわ…　いったい【何：なに】が…！
Translated Text: Oh no... What on earth is going on...!

Original Text: そうだ…\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざだ…
Translated Text:
That's right... It must
be the work of a Yo-kai
...

Original Text: おそるべき【妖気：ようき】が\nお【前：まえ】の【世界：せかい】に…えいきょうを…
Translated Text: A terrifying demonic aura is about\nto... influence... your world...

Original Text: （この【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】で【聞：き】こえた【声：こえ】！？）
Translated Text: (That voice... Is it the voice I heard in my dream!?)

Original Text: （あれ…\nこの【声：こえ】…　【聞：き】いたことあるズラ…）
Translated Text:
(Huh... this voice...
I think I've heard it before...)

Original Text: 【図書室：としょしつ】へ…
Translated Text: To the library…

Original Text: さんご…　という【本：ほん】を…　さがせ…
Translated Text: Find the book called *Sango*...

Original Text: …【消：き】えたニャン！
Translated Text: …He's gone, meow!

Original Text: これは…　まさか…
Translated Text: This is... Could it be...

Original Text: もんげー！　【都会人：とかいじん】のすることは\nやっぱり　ひと【味：あじ】ちがうズラね～！
Translated Text: Wow! City folks really do things\na little differently, don't they~!

Original Text: んなわけないでしょうが！
Translated Text: There's no way that's true!

Original Text: 【不可思議：ふかしぎ】な【現象：げんしょう】の【数：かずかず】々！\nそして　ナゾの【人物：じんぶつ】からの【ＳＯＳ：エスオーエス】！
Translated Text:
A series of mysterious phenomena!
And an SOS from a mysterious figure!

Original Text: これは　【大冒険：だいぼうけん】の【予感：よかん】が\nプンプンしますね！
Translated Text: This definitely feels like the\nstart of a great adventure!

Original Text: ウィスパー…　さっきは【日常風景：にちじょうふうけい】って\n【言：い】ってたくせに…
Translated Text: Whisper… Just a moment ago you were\nsaying it was just an everyday scene…

Original Text: シャラーップ！\nおだまりなさい！　このジバ【野郎：やろう】が！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!
Be quiet! You little brat!

Original Text: さあ　【物語：ものがたり】のカギは【図書室：としょしつ】にアリ！\nみなさん　【参：まい】りますよ！
Translated Text:
Well then, the key to the
story is in the library!
Everyone, let's go!

Original Text: ズラ！　オラもなんだか\nもんげーワクワクしてきたズラ！
Translated Text: Wow! I'm starting to get super excited, too!

Original Text: イヤな【予感：よかん】しか　しないニャン…\nでも…　あの【声：こえ】…
Translated Text:
I've got a bad feeling about this, meow...
But... that voice...

Original Text: オレっちも　【行：い】ってみるニャンよ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna check it out, too, meow!

Original Text: もんげ～！\n【図書室：としょしつ】って【広：ひろ】いズラね～
Translated Text:
Wow!
The library sure is big, isn't it?

Original Text: よく【考：かんが】えたら…\nどの【本：ほん】をさがせば　いいのニャン？
Translated Text:
Come to think of it…
which book should I look for, meow?

Original Text: あの【天：てん】の【声：こえ】…\n「さんご」という【言葉：ことば】を【残：のこ】していました…
Translated Text:
That voice from the heavens…
It left behind the word “sango”…

Original Text: さんご…　サンゴ…\nということは　【海：うみ】の【本：ほん】にちがいありません！
Translated Text:
Coral… Coral…
That means it must be a
book about the ocean!

Original Text: う～ん\nウィスパーの【直感：ちょっかん】はあてにならないニャン
Translated Text: Hmm... You can't trust\nWhisper's intuition, meow.

Original Text: オレっちたちは\n【別：べつ】のところをさがすニャン
Translated Text: We're gonna look for\nsomewhere else, meow.

Original Text: フッ　いいでしょう
Translated Text: Huh... That's pretty good, isn't it?

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の【直感：ちょっかん】が【勝：か】つか…\nジバニャンの【思：おも】いつきが【勝：か】つか！
Translated Text:
Will my intuition win out… or will
Jibanyan’s idea win out!

Original Text: 【楽：たの】しみでうぃす！\nでは　【私：わたくし】は　【海：うみ】の【図鑑：ずかん】コーナーへ！
Translated Text:
I'm so excited!
Well then, I'm off to the
ocean encyclopedia section!

Original Text: じゃあ　はりきって\nさがすズラよ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get\nexcited and start looking!

Original Text: 【本：ほん】は\nもんげーいっぱいあるズラが…
Translated Text: There are a ton of books here...

Original Text: 【手分：てわ】けすれば\n【夜：よる】までには【終：お】わるズラ！
Translated Text: If we split up the work,\nwe'll be done by nightfall!

Original Text: 【夜：よる】…！？　ま　まあ\nぼちぼち　がんばるニャン…
Translated Text: Night…!? W-well, I'll just take it one\nstep at a time and do my best, meow…

Original Text: い　【痛：いた】いニャン…\n……ん？
Translated Text:
Ow... that hurts, meow... Hmm
?

Original Text: もんげー！\nお　オシリぶつけちゃったズラ…
Translated Text:
Whoa!
I just... bumped my butt...

Original Text: なっ
Translated Text: Nah...

Original Text: ズラ…？
Translated Text: A wig…?

Original Text: 【何：なん】じゃ　こりゃあああああ！
Translated Text: What the heck is this?!

Original Text: ズララララーーーッ
Translated Text: Zura-ra-ra-raaaaaa!

Original Text: オレっち　【時代劇：じだいげき】に【出：で】てきそうな\n【格好：かっこう】になってるニャン！！
Translated Text: I'm dressed like I'm straight\nout of a period drama, meow!!

Original Text: お　オラ\nもんげ～～～～カッコになってるズラッッ
Translated Text: Oh my gosh~~~~ They look\nso cool, all lined up like that!

Original Text: ……\nこのカッコ………
Translated Text:
……These
parentheses………

Original Text: もんげ～カッコいいズラね～♪
Translated Text: Wow~ That wig is so cool~♪

Original Text: ウィスパー！　コマさん！\nオレっちの【格好：かっこう】…
Translated Text:
Whisper! Komasan!
My outfit...

Original Text: ちょっと　ジバニャン\n【今：いま】のオラ　カッコよくないズラ？
Translated Text: Hey, Jibanyan, don't I look\npretty cool right now?

Original Text: ニャー…？\n【２人：ふたり】ともいないニャン…？
Translated Text:
Meow…?
Neither of them is here, meow…?

Original Text: ……？\nズラ…？　ジバニャン？
Translated Text:
……?
A wig…? Jibanyan?

Original Text: っていうか　ここはどこニャン…！？\nオレっちは【図書室：としょしつ】にいたはずニャン…
Translated Text:
Wait, where am I, meow…!?
I thought I was in the library, meow…

Original Text: あれ…？　そういえば\nここは【図書室：としょしつ】…　じゃないズラ？
Translated Text: Huh...? Come to think of it, isn't\nthis the library... or is it not?

Original Text: まままままさか…\nこれって【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン！？
Translated Text:
No, no, no, no way… Could
this be the work of a Yo-kai, meow!?

Original Text: ビクトリアーーーーンッ！
Translated Text: Victoriaaaaaaa!

Original Text: ビクトリアアアアアンッ！
Translated Text: Victoriaaaaaaah!

Original Text: ニャニャ～！！？
Translated Text: Meow-meow~!!?

Original Text: もんげ～！？\n【何：なん】ズラ？　【何：なん】ズラ～？
Translated Text:
Whoa~!?
What's that? What's that~?

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラッ！\n（そこの【通：とお】りすがりの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(Hey, you passing-by warrior Yo-kai!)

Original Text: グッドタイミイイイイイイングッ！
Translated Text: Good timingggggg!

Original Text: ニャッ！？\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】？　オレっちが？
Translated Text:
Meow!?
A warrior Yo-kai? Me?

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: 【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】？　ミーのことダニか？
Translated Text: A warrior-Yo-kai? Are you calling Mee a tick?

Original Text: そう　どう【見：み】ても\nその【格好：かっこう】は　【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】なのだ
Translated Text: Yeah, no matter how you look at it, that\noutfit is definitely that of a warrior Yo-kai.

Original Text: ズラじゃないのだ\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】なのだ
Translated Text: It's not a wig—it's a warrior Yo-kai.

Original Text: メラメ～ラッ！\n（オレたちに【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera-me-ra!
(Give us your strength!)

Original Text: ？　えっと…\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】せって　いったい【何：なに】するズラ？
Translated Text:
? Um... "
Give me a hand"? What exactly
are we supposed to do?

Original Text: …えーっと　とりあえず【落：お】ち【着：つ】いて\n【話：はなし】を【整理：せいり】するニャン
Translated Text: …Um… First, let’s calm down and\nget our thoughts in order, meow.

Original Text: もしケンカとかだったら\nオラはニガテ…ズラよ？
Translated Text: If it's a fight or something, I'm\nnot really good at that... right?

Original Text: …えーっと　とりあえず【落：お】ち【着：つ】いて\n【話：はなし】を【整理：せいり】するダニ
Translated Text: …Um… Anyway, let’s calm down\nand get our thoughts in order, Dani.

Original Text: オレっちはケータの【本：ほん】を【汚：よご】して\nコマさんに【会：あ】って【図書室：としょしつ】に【来：き】て…
Translated Text: I messed up Keita's book, ran into\nKomasan, and ended up in the library...

Original Text: あ　そういえばジバニャンと\nウィスパー　【見：み】なかったズラ？
Translated Text: Oh, come to think of it, didn't\nyou see Jibanyan and Whisper?

Original Text: ミーは【変：へん】な【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】て\nイナホが【交信：こうしん】して【図書室：としょしつ】に【来：き】て…
Translated Text: Mee had a weird dream, and Inaho\ncontacted her and came to the library...

Original Text: それなのに…なんで【今：いま】\nこんなことになってるニャーーンッ！？
Translated Text: And yet… why is this happening\nright now, meowww!?

Original Text: それなのに…なんで【今：いま】\nこんなことになってるダニーー！？
Translated Text: And yet… why is this\nhappening right now, Dan?!

Original Text: はははははは　ここは【通：とお】さーん！\n【覚悟：かくご】しろ！
Translated Text:
Hahahahahaha! You're
not getting past here!
Brace yourself!

Original Text: ニャーッ\n【今度：こんど】は【何：なん】ニャン？
Translated Text: Meow! What's up this time, meow?

Original Text: 【何：なん】ズラ？　【何：なん】ズラ？\nいったい【何：なに】がおこってるズラ？
Translated Text:
What's going on? What's going on? What
on earth is happening?

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】はなんダニー！
Translated Text: What's up now, Danny!

Original Text: そうこう【言：い】ってる【間：あいだ】に\n【敵：てき】さんは　ハイテンション！
Translated Text: While we were talking about this and that,\nthe enemy was getting really hyped up!

Original Text: ここは【二手：ふたて】に【分：わ】かれてバトルだ！
Translated Text: Here, we split into two groups and battle it out!

Original Text: メラメラ～ッ　メラメ～ラ！\n（オレと【隊長：たいちょう】はあっちで【敵：てき】を【食：く】い【止：と】める！）
Translated Text:
Blaze~! Blaze~!
(The captain and I will hold
off the enemies over there!)

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（お【前：まえ】は　りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】と【戦：たたか】ってくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(You go fight Ryu-kun, Liu Yu!)

Original Text: えぇ～！？\n【何：なん】じゃ　そりゃーーーー！？
Translated Text:
What?!
What on earth is that?!

Original Text: もんげーーー！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: えぇ～！？\nそりゃ　なんダニーーー！？
Translated Text:
What?!
What kind of mite is that?!

Original Text: いい【戦：たたか】いぶりだった！\nなかなかの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だな！
Translated Text:
That was a great fight! You're
quite the warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: はあ…　はあ…\nまあこっちも【必死：ひっし】だったからニャ…
Translated Text:
Haa... Haa... Well, I was trying my best
too, meow...

Original Text: ズラ～\nそれほどでも～
Translated Text: Zura~ Not really~

Original Text: はあ…　はあ…\nまあこっちも【必死：ひっし】だったダニよ…
Translated Text:
Haa… Haa…
Well, I was doing my best too, you know…

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ？\n（お【前：まえ】　どこの【国：くに】から【来：き】たんだ？）
Translated Text:
Mera... Mera Mera?
(Where are you from?)

Original Text: オ　オレっちはジバニャン！\nケータんちから【来：き】たニャン！
Translated Text:
I—I'm Jibanyan!
I'm from Keita's house, meow!

Original Text: オラ　コマさんズラ！\n【田舎：いなか】から【出：で】てきたばっかりズラ～
Translated Text:
Hey, Komasan! I just got here from the
countryside~

Original Text: ミーは【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！\n【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】から【来：き】たダニ！
Translated Text:
"I'm from the USA!
I'm a tick from the USA!"

Original Text: ケータんち？\nなんだかフツーっぽい【名前：なまえ】の【国：くに】だな！
Translated Text:
Keta's country?
That sounds like a pretty
ordinary name for a country!

Original Text: 【田舎：いなか】？\nなんだかフツーっぽい【名前：なまえ】の【国：くに】だな！
Translated Text:
The countryside?
That's a pretty ordinary-sounding
name for a country!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】？\nほう！　【強：つよ】そうな【名前：なまえ】の【国：くに】だな！
Translated Text:
The USA?
Wow! That's a country with a
name that sounds powerful!

Original Text: メラ　メ～ラ！\n（ここは　さくら【国：こく】！）
Translated Text:
Mera~ Mera!
(This is Sakura Country!)

Original Text: えっ！\nさくらニュータウン？
Translated Text:
Huh!
Sakura New Town?

Original Text: ああ　やっぱりここは\nさくらニュータウンなんズラね
Translated Text: Ah, so this really is\nSakura New Town, isn't it?

Original Text: えっ！\nさくらニュータウン？
Translated Text:
Huh!
Sakura New Town?

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ\n（いや　さくら【国：こく】だ）
Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera (No, it's Sakura Country)

Original Text: さくらニュータウン？
Translated Text: Sakura New Town?

Original Text: メラメラ\n（さくら【国：こく】）
Translated Text: Mera Mera (Sakura Kingdom)

Original Text: ど　どこニャン…それ…
Translated Text: W-where, Meow… Is that…

Original Text: さくらこく？？？
Translated Text: Sakura Country???

Original Text: ど　どこダニ…それ…
Translated Text: W-where's the tick... that...

Original Text: …ようこそ　さくら【国：こく】へ
Translated Text: …Welcome to the Land of Cherry Blossoms

Original Text: ニャアアンッ！？\nお【前：まえ】は　あの【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】っ！？
Translated Text:
Meowww!?
Are you... that voice from my dream!?

Original Text: ズラ…？
Translated Text: A wig…?

Original Text: ダニー！？\nユーは　あの【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】っ！？
Translated Text:
Danny!?
Are you the voice from that dream!?

Original Text: どうやら【無事：ぶじ】\n【本：ほん】を【見：み】つけたようだな
Translated Text: Looks like you found the book after all.

Original Text: ゆ　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】！\nここは…　いったいどこニャン！
Translated Text:
Yu... The voice of a dream!
This place... Where on earth is this, meow!

Original Text: どこかで【聞：き】いたような【声：こえ】ズラ…
Translated Text: That voice sounds familiar...

Original Text: ゆ　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】！\nここは…　いったいどこダニ！
Translated Text:
Yu: The voice of a dream!
This place… Where on earth is this?!

Original Text: もんげー！\nコンビニの【前：まえ】で【聞：き】いた【声：こえ】ズラ！

Whoa!
That's the voice I heard in front
of the convenience store!

Original Text: 【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の…せかい？？

That's right—you're the
Yo-kai chosen for this book...
*Yo-kai Sangokushi*...!

Original Text: ようかい…\nさんごくし…！？
Translated Text:
Youkai…
Sango-kishi…!?

Original Text: もんげー…\nたまげたズラー
Translated Text:
Whoa... I'm totally
blown away!

Original Text: ようかい…\nさんごくし…！？
Translated Text:
Youkai…
Sango-kishi…!?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】は　この【本：ほん】の【呼：よ】びかけに【答：こた】えた\nそして　【英雄：えいゆう】になりたいと【言：い】った

Original Text: オレっち　そんなこと【言：い】ったかニャン…？\nっていうか【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【閉：と】じ【込：こ】められたら…
Translated Text:
"Did I really say that, meow...?
" I mean, if I got trapped inside a book...

Original Text: ズラ…？\nあ　そうズラ！
Translated Text:
A wig…?
Oh, right—a wig!

Original Text: オラ　エーユーになりたいズラ！\n【兄：にい】ちゃんカッコイイって【言：い】われたいズラ！
Translated Text:
I wanna be an AU!
I wanna have people tell me I'm cool, bro!

Original Text: そんなこと【一言：ひとこと】も【言：い】ってないダニ！
Translated Text: I never said anything like that, Dani!

Original Text: ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】のライブには【行：い】けないニャンか？\nそんなの　ひどいニャァァァン！！
Translated Text:
Meow... I can't go to the KB concert?
Meowww, that's sooo mean!!

Original Text: オラ　エーユーになりたいズラ！\n【兄：にい】ちゃんカッコイイって【言：い】われたいズラ！
Translated Text:
I wanna be an AU!
I wanna have people tell me I'm cool, bro!

Original Text: むしろミーは【巻：ま】き【込：こ】まれただけダニ！\n【今：いま】すぐ【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にもどしてくれダニ！
Translated Text:
Actually, I just got dragged
into this, you know!
Send me back to my original
world right now, you know!

Original Text: どうせなら　ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】の\n【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】の【中：なか】に【行：い】きたかったニャ～～ン！
Translated Text: If I had to choose, I would’ve wanted to\ngo inside Nya-KB’s photo book, meow~~!

Original Text: ん？\nそれじゃあ　オラは【今：いま】…

Huh?
So that means I'm...

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】よ\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【英雄：えいゆう】・【劉備：りゅうび】となれ

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】よ\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【英雄：えいゆう】・【孫策：そんさく】となれ
Translated Text: O Chosen Yo-kai, become\nSun Ce, the hero of this book.

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】よ\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【英雄：えいゆう】・【仲達：ちゅうたつ】となれ

Original Text: 【人：ひと】の【話：はなし】を【聞：き】けニャン！
Translated Text: Listen to what people have to say, meow!

Original Text: エーユーなんズラ…！\nほんとに　ほんとの　エーユーなんズラ！
Translated Text:
What the heck is AU...!
It really, really is AU!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】よ
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: コマさん…　そんさく…！\nもんげー　カッコイイひびきズラ…！
Translated Text:
Komasan… That’s awesome…!
Man, that Hibi-zura is so cool…!

Original Text: この【本：ほん】の【中：なか】と【外：そと】…\nふたつの【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うのだ

Inside and outside this book… I must save
both worlds.

Original Text: 【人：ひと】の【話：はなし】を【聞：き】けダニ！
Translated Text: Listen to what people have to say, you jerk!

Original Text: そして　この【本：ほん】の【中：なか】と【外：そと】…\nふたつの【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うのだ

And I will save
both worlds—the one inside this
book and the one outside it…

Original Text: だーかーらー…！　オレっちの【話：はなし】を…
Translated Text: Sooo...! Listen to what I'm saying...

Original Text: もんげーっ\nお　オラがせかいをっ
Translated Text: Whoa! I'm gonna take over the world!

Original Text: テメー…！　ミーの【話：はなし】を…
Translated Text: You...! You're ignoring what I'm saying...

Original Text: もう　【声：こえ】が【届：とど】くことはない\n【私：わたし】の【力：ちから】は　【限界：げんかい】だ…
Translated Text: My voice will never reach you\nagain. I've reached my limit...

Original Text: えっ…？\nど　どーいうことニャン？
Translated Text:
Huh…?
W-what do you mean, meow?

Translated Text: "Wait—at least let me thank\nyou! Let me thank you, please!"

Original Text: えっ…？\nど　どーいうことダニ？
Translated Text:
Huh…?
W-what do you mean, Dani?

Original Text: 【頼：たの】んだぞ…\n【選：えら】ばれし【英雄：えいゆう】・ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】…
Translated Text:
I'm counting on you…
Chosen Hero Jibanyan Liu Bei…

Original Text: 【頼：たの】んだぞ…\n【選：えら】ばれし【英雄：えいゆう】・コマさん【孫策：そんさく】…
Translated Text:
I'm counting on you…
Chosen Hero Komasan Sun Ce…

Original Text: 【頼：たの】んだぞ…\n【選：えら】ばれし【英雄：えいゆう】・【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…
Translated Text:
I'm counting on you…
Chosene Hero, Usapyon Zhongda…

Original Text: ま　【待：ま】ってニャン！　【夢：ゆめ】のこ…
Translated Text: W-Wait a minute, meow! My dream...

Original Text: ……あ\n…【行：い】っちゃったズラ
Translated Text: ……Oh… he's gone.

Original Text: ま　【待：ま】ってダニ！　【夢：ゆめ】のこ…
Translated Text: W-Wait, Dani! My dream...

Original Text: もう　【聞：き】こえないニャン…
Translated Text: I can't hear you anymore, meow...

Original Text: もう　【聞：き】こえないダニ…
Translated Text: The tick I can't hear anymore...

Translated Text:
Oh, really!
So you're that Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: ほほう！\nお【前：まえ】　あの【孫策：そんさく】だったのか！
Translated Text:
Oh, really! So
you're that Sun Ce!

Translated Text:
Oh, really! So
you're one of those USA Pyon guys!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】は　【強：つよ】くて【優：やさ】しくて\nこのあたりで【一番：いちばん】の…
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei is strong, kind,\nand the best around here…

Translated Text: Sun Ce is a kind and cool older brother.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】は　【強：つよ】くてかしこい\nこのあたりで【一番：いちばん】の…
Translated Text: The USA Pyon gang is strong and\nsmart—the best around here…

Original Text: お【兄：にい】ちゃん…
Translated Text: Big brother…

Blaze, blaze~!
(He's a popular warrior-Yo-kai, you know!)

Mera, Meraa, Mera-me-ra, Mera!
(Hey, you—Koma-jiro, you have a younger
brother named Sun Quan, right?)

Translated Text: Wow, that's such an honor, meow~♪

Translated Text: Wow, that's an honor, Dani!

Translated Text: "Danny, this isn't the time\nto be getting carried away!"

Translated Text: Things have been moving way too\nfast lately—I just can't keep up, meow!

Ryubi? AU?
I'm totally confused, meow!!

Keta! Whisper!

Inaho! Haku-kun!
Someone help me, Daniii!

Translated Text:
So that's how it is... I guess
I have a little brother in this
world, too.

Man
... I just feel like this book is my destiny...!

Meow...?
Hojo...?

A wig…?
A headband…?

Translated Text:
Mites…?
Hojo…?

Hey, hey—don't you know

Eight Precious Gems?

Eight instead of seven?
That sounds familiar, meow…

Translated Text:
Wow!
What a generous story...

Translated Text:
Seven, or is it eight?
That sounds familiar...

Original Text: てことはきっと【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にも【戻：もど】れるニャン！\nどこに【行：い】けばゲットできるニャン？

That means I’m sure I can go
back to my original world, meow!
Where can I go to get it, meow?

Translated Text: Where can I go to get one?

Original Text: てことはきっと【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にも【戻：もど】れるダニ！\nどこに【行：い】けばゲットできるダニ？

That means I’m sure I can go
back to my original world, Dani!
Where can I go to get it, Dani?

Translated Text: Ryu-kun (Liu Yu) has\none, so I'll give it to you.

Translated Text: Meow♪ Lucky!

A wig!? Is it really a good one?

Translated Text: Lucky Tick!

Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…

Translated Text:
Mera... Mera-mera... Me~ra!
(This country is truly in a
time of turmoil right now!)

Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera, Mera~raa (All the\nkings are after each other's jewels.)

Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…
(In other words, to get all the orbs…)

Original Text: 【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【挑：いど】んでビクトリアーン！\n【勝：か】ちとって【行：い】かなきゃならん！！

Take on bosses across the country

winning!!

Translated Text: I'm feeling kind of sluggish, though...

Whoa... Monge's changing
the subject again... Oh

Translated Text: Those incredibly annoying mites…

Translated Text: Komasan Sun Ce is a kind and cool hero.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】は\n【強：つよ】くてかしこいヒーローなのだ
Translated Text: The USA Pyon gang are\nstrong and smart heroes.

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】が【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【勝：か】てば\nきっとさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】がおとずれるのだ
Translated Text: If Jibanyan Liu Bei defeats all the\nbosses across the country, peace will\nsurely come to the Land of Sakura.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】が【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【勝：か】てば\nきっと　さくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】がおとずれるのだ
Translated Text: If Komasan Sun Ce defeats the\nbosses across the country, peace\nwill surely come to Sakura Country.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】が【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【勝：か】てば\nきっとさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】がおとずれるのだ
Translated Text: If the USA Pyon gang defeats the\nbosses across the country, peace\nwill surely come to Sakura Country.

Original Text: う～ん\nそんな【都合：つごう】よく　いくニャンか？
Translated Text: Hmm... Do you think it'll\ngo that smoothly, meow?

Original Text: そ　そうズラか…？\nう　うん　オラがんばってみるズラ
Translated Text:
"So... is that how it is...?
" "Uh, yeah. I'll give it my best shot."

Original Text: う～ん\nそんな【都合：つごう】よく　いくダニか？
Translated Text: Hmm... Do things ever go that smoothly?

Original Text: （でもオレっちが　この【本：ほん】のエーユーなら…\nあんがい　【楽：らく】チンに【集：あつ】められるかも…？）
Translated Text:
(But if I were the AU in this
book... maybe it wouldn't be that
hard to collect them after all...?)

Original Text: （でもミーが　この【本：ほん】のエーユーなら…\nあんがい　【楽：らく】に　【集：あつ】められるかも…？）
Translated Text:
(But if I were the AU in this
book… maybe it wouldn’t be
that hard to collect them after all…?)

Original Text: やるニャン…\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るにはやるっきゃないニャン！
Translated Text:
I'm gonna do it, meow... I've got no
choice but to do this to get back to my
original world, meow!

Original Text: オラ　もんげー\nカッコイイ　エーユーになってみせるズラ！
Translated Text: Man, this is so cool! I'm gonna\nbecome an AU, you hear me!

Original Text: やるダニ…\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るには　やるっきゃないダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm gonna do it, Dani… If
I want to go back to my
original world, I've got no
choice but to do it, Dani!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\nオレたちは【一緒：いっしょ】には【行：い】けないが…
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei!
We can't go together, but...

Original Text: その【意気：いき】だコマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nオレたちは【一緒：いっしょ】には【行：い】けないが…
Translated Text:
Way to go, Komasan Sun Ce!
We can't go with you, but...

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\nオレたちは【一緒：いっしょ】には【行：い】けないが…
Translated Text:
USA, Pyong and Nakata!
We can't go with you, but...

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【旅：たび】の【無事：ぶじ】を　いのっている！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(I'm praying for a safe journey!)

Original Text: ありがとニャン！
Translated Text: Thanks, meow!

Original Text: サンキュー　ダニ！
Translated Text: Thanks, Dani!

Original Text: ありがとズラー！
Translated Text: Thanks a bunch!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: じゃあ　【何：なに】をしたらいいのか\n【手：て】っ【取：と】りばやく【教：おし】えてくれニャン！
Translated Text: So, just tell me the quickest\nway to do this, meow!

Original Text: じゃあ　【何：なに】をしたらいいのか\n【教：おし】えてくれダニ！
Translated Text: So tell me what I'm supposed to do, Dani!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】とは\nだれにも【優：やさ】しい　【人気者：にんきもの】なのだ！
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei is kind to\neveryone—he's a real crowd-pleaser!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】とは\nかしこい　【人気者：にんきもの】なのだ！
Translated Text: Usapyon Zhongda is smart and popular!

Original Text: それは　さっき【聞：き】いたニャン…
Translated Text: I heard that just a moment ago, meow...

Original Text: それは　さっき【聞：き】いたダニ…
Translated Text: That's the tick I heard about a moment ago...

Original Text: そして　このさくら【国：こく】を【治：おさ】めるのに\nふさわしい　【強：つよ】い【男：おとこ】なのだ！
Translated Text: And he is a strong man—the right man\nto rule this Land of Cherry Blossoms!

Original Text: だから…\nきたえなきゃ　ダメなのだ
Translated Text:
That's why... I have to train
.
Huh...?
Huh...?

Original Text: では　トレーニング【開始：かいし】　なのだ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get this training started!

Original Text: す　【少：すこ】しはデキるみたいっスね\nまあ　ともだちになってやっても…
Translated Text: Hmm... Looks like you're kind of good at\nthis. Well, I guess I'll let you be my friend...

Original Text: って\nそ　それは…　ほ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】っ！？
Translated Text: Wait, that's... a... a magic orb!?

Original Text: はっ！　ははーっ！\nご【無礼：ぶれい】　お【許：ゆる】しっスーっ！
Translated Text:
Whoa! Haha!
My apologies—please
forgive me! Whoosh!

Original Text: げっ…\nこの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】ってそんなにすごいニャン？
Translated Text:
Yikes… Is
this gem really that amazing, meow?

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】って\nそんなに　スゴいんダニ？
Translated Text: Is this gem really that amazing?

Original Text: そうなのだ　だから\n【使：つか】い【方：かた】をまちがえちゃダメなのだ
Translated Text: That's right. That's why you\nmustn't use it the wrong way.

Original Text: でも　そんなすごいもの\nもらってもいいのかニャン？
Translated Text: But is it really okay for me to get\nsomething so amazing, meow?

Original Text: でも　そんなすごいもの\nもらってもいいダニか？
Translated Text: But is it really okay for a tick\nto get something so amazing?

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】が【優：やさ】しくて\n【強：つよ】いのは　よくわかったのだ
Translated Text: I’ve come to fully understand that\nJibanyan Liu Bei is both kind and strong.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】がかしこくて\n【強：つよ】いのは　よくわかったのだ
Translated Text: I’ve come to fully understand that Usapyon\nZhongda is both smart and strong.

Original Text: だから　【早：はや】く【集：あつ】めて\n【願：ねが】いをかなえるといいのだ
Translated Text: So you should gather them quickly\nand make your wish come true.

Original Text: わかったニャン…\nオレっちがんばるニャン！
Translated Text:
Got it, meow…
I'll do my best, meow!

Original Text: サンキューダニ！\nミーは　がんばるダニ！
Translated Text:
Thanks, Dani!
I'll do my best, Dani!

Original Text: オレも　【主人公妖怪名】さんの\n【力：ちから】になりたいっス！
Translated Text:
I want to help out
【主人公妖怪名】 too!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【見：み】て\n【態度：たいど】がコロっと【変：か】わったニャン…
Translated Text: As soon as he saw the gem, his\nattitude did a complete 180...

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【見：み】て\n【態度：たいど】がコロっと【変：か】わったダニ…
Translated Text: Dani, whose attitude changed completely\nthe moment he saw the jewel…

Original Text: まあ　いいニャン\nみんなで　【宝珠集：ほうじゅあつ】めに【出発：しゅっぱつ】ニャン！
Translated Text: Well, okay, everyone! Let's\nhead out to collect some orbs!

Original Text: まあ　いいダニ\nみんなで　【宝珠集：ほうじゅあつ】めに【出発：しゅっぱつ】ダニー！
Translated Text: Well, okay, everyone—let's head\nout to collect some orbs, Danny!

Original Text: 【早：はや】くも【壁：かべ】にぶち【当：あ】たったニャン\nどこに【行：い】けばいいのかニャン…
Translated Text: I've already hit a wall, meow.\nWhere should I go, meow...

Original Text: 【今：いま】は　【乱世：らんせ】なのだ\n【困：こま】っている【人：ひと】も【多：おお】いのだ
Translated Text: These are turbulent times, and\nmany people are struggling.

Original Text: そういう【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けてあげるのだ\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】は【優：やさ】しいのだ
Translated Text: "That's why we help people like\nthat. Jibanyan Liu Bei is kind."

Original Text: なんか　そればっかニャン…
Translated Text: It's like all I ever do, meow...

Original Text: だれか　【助：たす】けてええええ！
Translated Text: Someone, help meeeee!

Original Text: おっ！\nわかりやすい【感：かん】じできたニャン！
Translated Text:
Whoa! That turned out pretty
easy to understand, meow!

Original Text: お【願：ねが】い！\nふたりのケンカを【止：と】めて！
Translated Text:
Please!
Stop them from fighting!

Original Text: おともだちのワカメくん【関索：かんさく】と\nコンブさん【関興：かんこう】がケンカしてるの
Translated Text: My friends Wakame-kun (Guan Suo) and\nKombu-san (Guan Xing) are fighting.

Original Text: ふたりとも【我：われ】を【忘：わす】れちゃって…\n【私：わたし】には　【止：と】められない！
Translated Text:
They've both lost control...
and there's nothing
I can do to stop them!

Original Text: ま　ケンカするほど【仲：なか】がいい\nって【言：い】うしニャ～…
Translated Text: Well, they say that if you fight, it\nmeans you're close, right? Meow...

Original Text: きっと\nそのうち【友情：ゆうじょう】がめばえるニャンよ！
Translated Text: I'm sure friendship will\nblossom before long, meow!

Original Text: じゃ　オレっちは【宝珠：ほうじゅ】さがしで\nいそがしいから　これで…
Translated Text: Well, I'm busy looking for the\njewel, so I'll have to go now...

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】は\n【優：やさ】しくて　【強：つよ】いのだ！
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei is both kind and strong!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】は\n【優：やさ】しくて　【強：つよ】いのだ！
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei is both kind and strong!

Original Text: わ　わかったニャン！\nやればいいニャン？　やれば！
Translated Text:
O-okay, meow!
Should I just do it, meow? I'll do it!

Original Text: ああ…ふたりが【仲：なか】よしに\nもどってくれて　うれしい！
Translated Text: Ah... I'm so glad they're\ngetting along again!

Original Text: 【大好：だいす】きなメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】のナミダは\nもう【見：み】たくないぜ！　フォー！
Translated Text: I don't want to see any more tears\nfrom my favorite Mekabu-chan,\nAbalone Sanjo! Four!

Original Text: ええ　メカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】に【似合：にあ】うのは\nそのまぶしい【笑顔：えがお】です！
Translated Text: Yeah, Mekabu-chan, what\nreally suits you, Abalone Sanjo,\nis that dazzling smile of yours!

Original Text: …なんとなく　ケンカした【理由：りゆう】が\nわかったニャンね
Translated Text: …I think I kind of get why\nwe got into a fight, meow.

Original Text: べ　べつに【三角関係：さんかくかんけい】とかではありませんよ！\nいや　そうかもしれないですけど…
Translated Text:
It's—it's not like there's a
love triangle or anything!
Well, maybe there is...

Original Text: なんでケンカを【始：はじ】めたのか\nボクたちぜんぜん【覚：おぼ】えてないのさ…
Translated Text: We don't remember at all why we\nstarted fighting in the first place...

Original Text: これは…　【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン！
Translated Text: This must be... the work of a Yo-kai, meow!

Original Text: （って　ケータなら【言：い】うニャンね…\n【今：いま】ごろ　なにしてるかニャン…）
Translated Text:
(That’s what Keita would say, meow…
I wonder what he’s up
to right now, meow…)

Original Text: この【近：ちか】くにキンギン【党：とう】という\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちがいるのだ
Translated Text: There's a group of warrior Yo-kai\ncalled the Kingin Party around here.

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】！？\nそれ　なんニャン！？
Translated Text:
The Kingin Party!? What on earth is
that!?

Original Text: え？　キンギン【党：とう】のことを\nもっと【知：し】りたいクマ？
Translated Text: Huh? Do you want to know more\nabout the Kingin Party, Kuma?

Original Text: ニャニャ！？
Translated Text: Meow, meow!?

Original Text: だったら\nボクのうんちくを【聞：き】くクマ！
Translated Text: Well then, listen to my\nlittle bit of trivia, Bear!

Original Text: …この【世界：せかい】\nいろいろ【突然：とつぜん】すぎるニャン…
Translated Text: …This world is just full\nof surprises, meow…

Original Text: …おっと\n【話：はなし】をもとにもどすニャン！
Translated Text: …Oops, let's get back on track, meow!

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】は【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をあやつる【術：じゅつ】を\n【使：つか】うおそろしい【集団：しゅうだん】っス！
Translated Text: The Kingin Party is a terrifying group that\nuses magic to control warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】すのだ！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei!
Let's defeat the Kingin Party!

Original Text: ええ～…
Translated Text: Hmm...

Original Text: ああ！　ジバニャン【劉備様：りゅうびさま】が\nごきげんナナメみたいだぜ…！
Translated Text: Oh no! It looks like Lord Liu Bei,\na.k.a. Jibanyan, is in a bad mood…!

Original Text: きっと　お【礼：れい】をしてないからです\nあなたの【活躍：かつやく】をたたえまして…
Translated Text: It must be because I haven't thanked\nyou yet. To honor your achievements…

Original Text: われら【数々：かずかず】のお【礼：れい】の【品：しな】をご【用意：ようい】しております\nどうぞお【受：う】け【取：と】りください！
Translated Text: We have prepared a variety of thank-you\ngifts for you—please accept them!

Original Text: い　いや　オレっちは\n【別：べつ】にそんなつもりは…
Translated Text: "No, no, I didn't really mean it like that..."

Original Text: まだ　【満足：まんぞく】されていないようですね…\nメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】　ならば　あれです！
Translated Text:
It seems you're still not satisfied... Well, if
it's Mekabu-chan and
Abalone Sanjo, then it's that!

Original Text: え…　もしかして…\nお【礼：れい】は　このわ・た・し…？（ポッ）
Translated Text:
Huh... Could it be... that the "
thank you" is for me...? (blush)

Original Text: こ　こっちをもらっておくニャン！\nじゃあ　またニャーン！
Translated Text:
I'll take this one, meow!
See you later, meow!

Original Text: フフ…\n【術：じゅつ】の【効果：こうか】はバッチリじゃ
Translated Text:
Hehe… The
spell worked like a charm.

Original Text: 【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】どもは\n【我：われ】らの【思：おも】いどおりに【争：あらそ】っておる
Translated Text: Those Yo-kai are fighting\njust as we intended.

Original Text: このスキに　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば…\n【野望：やぼう】を【果：は】たせようぞ
Translated Text:
If I gather the orbs while
they're distracted... I'll be
able to fulfill my ambition
.

Original Text: じゃが…いまいましい\nジャマ【者：もの】がおるようじゃな…
Translated Text: Well... looks like there's some\npesky meddler around...

Original Text: ドウと【言：い】うことはない　【幻術：げんじゅつ】の【霧：きり】を\n【大量：たいりょう】にまいておけば　【問題：もんだい】あるまいて！
Translated Text: There's nothing to worry about—as\nlong as we spread a ton of illusory\nmist, there won't be any problems!

Original Text: え？　ちょっと　【待：ま】て！
Translated Text: Huh? Wait a minute!

Original Text: そおーれ！　これでドウじゃ～？
Translated Text: There you go! How's that?

Original Text: こ　このアホウ！\nこれじゃ【我：われ】らも【身動：みうご】きとれん！
Translated Text:
Y-You idiot!
We can't move a muscle like this!

Original Text: どうやって\n【残：のこ】りの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をさがすんじゃ！？
Translated Text: How am I supposed to\nfind the rest of the orbs!?

Original Text: …ドウもすみません
Translated Text: …I'm really sorry

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】のアジトは\nここかニャン？
Translated Text: Is this where the Kingin\nParty has its hideout, meow?

Original Text: …って\n【霧：きり】で【見：み】えないニャン…
Translated Text: …But I can’t see anything\nbecause of the fog, meow…

Original Text: これじゃ　アジトがどこにあるか\nわからないっス
Translated Text: At this rate, I won't be able to\nfigure out where the hideout is.

Original Text: これもきっと\nキンギン【党：とう】の【幻術：げんじゅつ】なのだ
Translated Text: This must surely be another illusion\ncreated by the Kingin Party.

Original Text: だが　【安心：あんしん】するのだ\n【水晶玉：すいしょうだま】にすすむべき【道：みち】が【見：み】えるのだ
Translated Text: But don't worry—you can see the path\nyou should take in the crystal ball.

Original Text: このシルエット…　まさか…
Translated Text: That silhouette… Could it be…

Original Text: それは【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のお【姿：すがた】なのだ
Translated Text: That is the figure of a genius military strategist.

Original Text: テンサイグンシ？
Translated Text: Tensai Gunshi?

Original Text: その【知性：ちせい】で【風：かぜ】を【読：よ】み【天：てん】をも【動：うご】かす\nとっても【頭：あたま】のいいお【方：かた】のことっス
Translated Text: I'm talking about that incredibly smart\nperson who can read the winds and even\nmove the heavens with their intellect.

Original Text: なんとなく…　あんまり【期待：きたい】しなくても\nいい【気：き】がするニャン…
Translated Text: I just have a feeling... maybe I shouldn't\nget my hopes up too much, meow...

Original Text: お【告：つ】げに【従：したが】い　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】に【会：あ】いにいくのだ\nでも…　【道：みち】はきっとけわしいのだ！
Translated Text: Following the revelation, I’m off to\nmeet the genius strategist—but…\nthe path ahead is sure to be rugged!

Original Text: だから　ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】には\nいろんなアイテムをあげるのだ！
Translated Text: That's why I give Jibanyan\nLiu Bei all kinds of items!

Original Text: まずは【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】！
Translated Text: First【g】 up: the Yo-kai Gacha【e】!

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】?

Original Text: この【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】を【引：ひ】くと\n【心強：こころづよ】い【仲間：なかま】が【手：て】に【入：はい】ることがあるのだ！
Translated Text: If you spin this【g】 Yo-kai gacha【e】,\nyou might just get a reliable ally!

Original Text: ちなみに　ガシャを【引：ひ】くには\nガシャコインなど　コインが【必要：ひつよう】なのだ！
Translated Text: By the way, you need coins—like\nGacha Coins—to play the gacha!

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】に【g】【妖怪：ようかい】メダルアプリ【e】！
Translated Text: Next【g】 up: the Yo-kai Medal app【e】!
