Original Text: ん～\n【空気：くうき】キレイキレイマシーンでも…
Translated Text: Hmm... even with an air purifier...

Original Text: 【晴：は】れない【霧：きり】となりますとねえ～
Translated Text: When it comes to fog that just won't clear up, well...

Original Text: 【今回：こんかい】はまさにこの【私：わたくし】の【風：かぜ】を【読：よ】み\n【天：てん】を【分：わ】かつ【知性：ちせい】をもってしても…
Translated Text: This time, even with my\nintellect—which can read the winds\nand part the heavens—I still…

Original Text: きびしい【死闘：しとう】というほかないのでは
Translated Text: I suppose there's no other way to describe it than as a fierce, life-and-death battle.

Original Text: あれ？　このマシーン\n【最大出力：さいだいしゅつりょく】ボタンがオフになってるっスよ？
Translated Text: Huh? The "Max Power" button on\nthis machine is turned off, isn't it?

Original Text: えっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【最大出力：さいだいしゅつりょく】　ポチッ　なのだ
Translated Text: Maximum Power—Click!—That's it.

Original Text: ポチッ　なのだ
Translated Text: Click! That's it.

Original Text: あ　【霧：きり】がキレーに【晴：は】れて\n【銀行：ぎんこう】が【見：み】えたっスよ
Translated Text: Oh, the fog cleared up nicely,\nand I could see the bank.

Original Text: まさか\n【最大出力：さいだいしゅつりょく】ボタンの【存在：そんざい】を【知：し】らな…
Translated Text: I can't believe I didn't know\nthere was a "Max Power" button...

Original Text: いざ【参：まい】りますよ　【決戦：けっせん】へ！
Translated Text: Here we go—on to the decisive battle!

Original Text: おほほほほほほほ！\nいざ【参：まい】りますよ　【決戦：けっせん】へ！
Translated Text:
Ho ho ho ho ho ho ho!
Here we go—off to the final battle!

Original Text: いい【加減：かげん】にするニャン！
Translated Text: Enough already, meow!

Original Text: ぎゃああ！
Translated Text: Aaaargh!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】のかつやくによって\nキンギン【党：とう】は【滅：ほろ】びました…
Translated Text: Because of my actions, the\nKingin Party was destroyed…

Original Text: ですが　まだ【序：じょ】の【口：くち】！\n【私：わたくし】の【実力：じつりょく】はこんなものでは…！
Translated Text:
But that's just the tip of the iceberg!
This is nothing compared to
what I'm really capable of...!

Original Text: これが\nキンギン【党：とう】が【持：も】っていた【宝珠：ほうじゅ】なのだ
Translated Text: This is the jewel that the\nKingin Party possessed.

Original Text: わー！　きれいニャン！
Translated Text: Wow! That's pretty, meow!

Original Text: わ～\nきれいズラね～
Translated Text: Wow, that's a pretty face!

Original Text: おらあ！\nふたりとも【話：はなし】を【聞：き】けー！
Translated Text:
Hey!
You two, listen up!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】つ【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】　【狙：ねら】う【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】は\nまだまだたくさんいます！
Translated Text: Warrior Yo-kai with Jewels: There are\nstill plenty of warrior yo-kai to target!

Original Text: いいですか　【今：いま】からこの【私：わたくし】が\n【現在：げんざい】のさくら【国：こく】の【情勢：じょうせい】を【解説：かいせつ】いたしますから
Translated Text: All right? I'm going to explain\nthe current situation in the Land\nof Sakura starting now, so—

Original Text: よーく\n【頭：あたま】にたたきこんでくださいね！
Translated Text: Make sure you really\nget that into your head!

Original Text: はー\nまた　おなかすいてきたニャン…
Translated Text: Ugh, I'm getting hungry again, meow...

Original Text: ＺＺＺ…ＺＺＺ…
Translated Text: Zzz... Zzz...

Original Text: この…　ジバ【野郎：やろう】！\n【話：はなし】　【聞：き】けってのー！
Translated Text:
You... you jerk!
Listen to me, will you?!

Original Text: 【聞：き】く【気：き】なし！
Translated Text: I'm not interested in listening!

Original Text: イカーッカッカッカ！
Translated Text: Ika-ka-ka-ka!

Original Text: どんな【願：ねが】いもかなうという【宝珠：ほうじゅ】…\n【私：わたし】が【集：あつ】めてやろうじゃなイカ！
Translated Text:
A magical gem that grants any wish…
I’m going to collect them all, aren’t I?!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓様：ぎちょうとうたくさま】～！
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, Lord Dong Zhuo~!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らがブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】に\n【手：て】こずっていたうちに…
Translated Text: While our Captain Bree was\nhaving a hard time with Guan Yu...

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が\n【何者：なにもの】かに【奪：うば】われたようです　トホホ
Translated Text: It looks like someone stole the\nKingin Party's jewel. Oh well...

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】　ぶようじん！
Translated Text: Kingin Party: Be Strong!

Original Text: きわめてイカんである！
Translated Text: That's totally messed up!

Original Text: で　その【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【奪：うば】ったヤツって\nまさか…　キミか！？
Translated Text: So... the one who stole that\njewel—could it be... you!?

Original Text: なんば【言：い】いよっとね\n【主人公妖怪名】ばい　だるか～
Translated Text: I'm just saying, Namba... Man,\nthis is tough【主人公妖怪名】~

Original Text: ほう…　あの【主人公妖怪名】
Translated Text: Hmm... Well, that...【主人公妖怪名】

Original Text: 【私：わたし】のジャマをするとは\nナカナカの【器：うつわ】…
Translated Text: To think you'd get in my\nway—you've got some nerve…

Original Text: だが　それだけでは【私：わたし】は【倒：たお】せんぞ！\n【私：わたし】には【四天王：してんのう】がいるのだからな！
Translated Text:
But that alone won't be
enough to defeat me!
After all, I have my Four Heavenly Kings!

Original Text: そして【何：なに】より\nこの【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】がいるではなイカ！
Translated Text: And best of all, isn't this the\nRed Demon Lu Bu right here?!

Original Text: あっかあああ～ん！
Translated Text: Aaaahhh!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】がすべて【集：あつ】まるのも\n【時間：じかん】の【問題：もんだい】ではなイカ！
Translated Text: It's only a matter of time before\nall the orbs are gathered, isn't it!

Original Text: イカーッカッカッカ！
Translated Text: Ika-ka-ka-ka!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】と【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】！\n【強：つよ】そうクマ…　【怖：こわ】そうクマ…
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone, Dong
Zhuo, and the Red Demon Lü Bu!
They look so strong... They look so scary...

Original Text: このふたりのうんちくを【聞：き】きたい【人：ひと】は\nこちらクマ…！
Translated Text: If you want to hear these two's\ninsights, click here, Bear…!

Original Text: ねえ～　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】～！
Translated Text: Hey there, genius strategist!

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【場所：ばしょ】がわかる\n【道具：どうぐ】を【出：だ】してくれニャ～ン！
Translated Text: Give me the item that'll show me\nwhere the next gem is, meow~!

Original Text: そんな【都合：つごう】よく\nポンポン【出：だ】せるわけないでしょ！
Translated Text: There's no way I can just whip them\nup one after another like that!

Original Text: さがしたぞ\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】
Translated Text: I found you, Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: なるほど…\nウワサどおり　いい【面：つら】してんじゃねーか
Translated Text:
I see... Just like the rumors
say, he's actually quite handsome.

Original Text: ニャ？　\nお【前：まえ】ら　だれニャン？
Translated Text:
Meow
? Who are you guys, meow?

Original Text: ！！　シャラーップ！\nこの【無礼者：ぶれいもの】がぁー！！
Translated Text:
!! Shut up!
You insolent jerk!!

Original Text: この【方々：かたがた】をどなたと【心得：こころえ】る！
Translated Text: Who do you think these people are?!

Original Text: さくら【国団々坂出身：こくだんだんざかしゅっしん】の【名家：めいか】・【袁家：えんけ】の\n【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】と【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】ですぞ！
Translated Text:
Meet Lord Yuan Shao, the Earth
Spider from the prestigious Yuan
family of Dandan-zaka in Sakura
Country, and Lord Oogama En Jutsu!

Original Text: で　その【名家：めいか】とやらが\nなんの【用：よう】ニャン？
Translated Text: So... what does that so-called\ndistinguished family want, meow?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】ら　あのキンギン【党：とう】を\n【倒：たお】したらしいな
Translated Text: I hear you guys took\ndown that Kingin Party.

Original Text: その【力：ちから】を【見：み】こんで【頼：たの】みがある\n…イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】さねえか？
Translated Text: I believe in your strength, so I have a\nfavor to ask… Chairman Ikakamone,\nwould you take down Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】？
Translated Text: Is Chairman Ikakamone actually Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】とは…！　その…\nあの…　えーと…　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】です！
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone,
Dong Zhuo is…! Um…
well… er… he’s the head of the villains!

Original Text: 【時間：じかん】がかかったわりには\nざっくりすぎる【説明：せつめい】だニャン…
Translated Text: For all the time it took, that\nexplanation is way too vague, meow…

Original Text: このさくら【国：こく】さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】で\nヤツは【急成長：きゅうせいちょう】しておってな…
Translated Text: That guy’s been growing like\ncrazy here in the Sakura Housing\nDistrict of Sakura Country…

Original Text: ま　オレたちは【隣：となり】の【街：まち】のもんだが\nちょっと【見過：みす】ごせなくなってよ
Translated Text: Well, we're from the next town over,\nbut we just couldn't ignore it anymore.

Original Text: ニャ～…\nめんどくさいんですけど…
Translated Text:
Meow... This is such a hassle
...

Original Text: おお…　【相手：あいて】が【大物：おおもの】であっても\nイヤなものはきっぱりと【断：ことわ】る…！
Translated Text: Wow… Even if the other\nperson is a big shot, I’ll flat-out\nrefuse anything I don’t like…!

Original Text: なんと【堂：　　どうどう】々とした【態度：たいど】！\nさすがは　【我：わ】が【主：あるじ】でございます！
Translated Text:
What a dignified demeanor!
Just as I’d expect from my master!

Original Text: ということで…\n【残念：ざんねん】ながらジバニャン【劉備殿：りゅうびどの】は…
Translated Text:
So…
unfortunately, Lord Liu Bei, a Jibanyan…

Original Text: ま　オレっち【優：やさ】しくて【強：つよ】いから\nべつに【味方：みかた】になってもいいニャンよ
Translated Text: Well, since I'm kind and strong, I guess it's\nokay if you want me on your side, meow.

Original Text: …よろこんで【協力：きょうりょく】するとのことです
Translated Text: …They said they’d be happy to help.

Original Text: でも…　【袁家：えんけ】に\nどう【協力：きょうりょく】すればいいのニャン？
Translated Text: But… how am I supposed to\nhelp the Yuan family, meow?

Original Text: でも…　【袁家：えんけ】に\nどう【協力：きょうりょく】すればいいダニ？
Translated Text: But… how should I help\nthe Yuan family, Dani?

Original Text: もんげーエーユー　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nいざ　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】をやっつけるズラ！
Translated Text:
Mongee AU, Komasan Sun Ce!
Let's go take down the big bad boss!

Original Text: ん？　お【待：ま】ちください！\nあれは…
Translated Text:
Huh? Wait a minute! That's
...

Original Text: メラメラ～！\n（【主人公妖怪名】！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze~!
(【主人公妖怪名】!)

Original Text: アナタはたしか…えっと…その…
Translated Text: You're definitely... um... well...

Original Text: メラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！\n【前：まえ】は　【世話：せわ】になったニャンね！
Translated Text:
Mera Mera Lion Zhang Fei!
You really helped me out
back then, didn't you, Nyan!

Original Text: メラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！\n【前：まえ】は　【世話：せわ】になったダニ！
Translated Text:
Fiery Lion Zhang Fei!
Thanks for everything back then, Dani!

Original Text: メラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！\n【前：まえ】は　お【世話：せわ】になったズラ！
Translated Text:
Mera Mera Lion Zhang Fei!
Thanks for everything back then, Zura!

Original Text: そう！　【今：いま】そう【言：い】おうと【思：おも】っていたんです！\nで　【何：なに】かご【用：よう】ですか？
Translated Text:
That's right! I was just about to say that!
So, is there something you need?

Original Text: メラメラメラ…\n（オレたちのすみかが…）
Translated Text:
Flame, flame, flame…
(Our home is…)

Original Text: メラメラ！　メ～ラ！\n（イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】におそわれて…）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze! Me~ra!
(Chairman Ikakamone has been
attacked by Dong Zhuo's army...)

Original Text: ヤツら　ますます\nつけあがっておるようだな…
Translated Text: Those guys seem to be getting\nmore and more cocky...

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメラッ！\n（どうか　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, mera!
(Please, lend me your strength!)

Original Text: ちょうど　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】すと【決：き】めたとこニャン！
Translated Text: I just decided to take down Chairman\nIkakamone, Dong Zhuo! Meow!

Original Text: ちょうど　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】すと【決：き】めたとこダニ！
Translated Text: I just decided to take down\nChairman Ikakamone, Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: もちろんズラ！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】にお【任：まか】せズラよ！
Translated Text:
Of course, Zura! Leave it to
Komasan Sun Ce, Zura!

Original Text: 【我：われ】ら　イカカモネ【議長董卓討伐：ぎちょうとうたくとうばつ】の　【志：こころざし】のもと\n【今：いま】まさに【一：ひと】つになっていたところでうぃす！
Translated Text: We—the Ikakamone Council—have\njust united under our shared resolve\nto defeat Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: メラメラ！\n（ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Whoosh!
(Thank you!)

Original Text: これで　【役者：やくしゃ】はそろったな…
Translated Text: Well, it looks like we've got all the players here now...

Original Text: さっそくイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】しに【行：い】こうぜ！
Translated Text: Let's go defeat Chairman Dong\nZhuo right away, Ikakamone!

Original Text: オホン！　その【前：まえ】にみなさん！
Translated Text: Ahem! But first, everyone!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らにふさわしい\nチーム【名：めい】を【決：き】めませんか？
Translated Text: Why don't we come up with\na team name that suits us?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】とゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たち\n…なんて　いかがです？
Translated Text: "Whisper Kongming and His\nFun-Loving Friends"... How about that?

Original Text: ハァァァ～？\nナメてるクマ！？
Translated Text:
Huhhh~?
Are you messing with me, Bear!?

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: 【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】がいいクマ！\n【説明：せつめい】はこちらクマ！
Translated Text:
The Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition is
awesome! Click here for more
info!

Original Text: ……\n【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】か　【悪：わる】くない
Translated Text:
……The Coalition
Against Dong Zhuo? Not bad.

Original Text: では　この【軍：ぐん】は【吾輩：わがはい】が【率：ひき】いる！\n【皆：みな】の【者：もの】　ついて【参：まい】れ！！
Translated Text:
"Very well, then—I shall lead this army!
Everyone, follow me!!"

Original Text: ありゃ　リーダーの【役：やく】とられちまった\nまあいいや　【今回：こんかい】はゆずってやるよ
Translated Text: Oh no, someone took my spot as\nleader. Oh well, I'll let it slide this time.

Original Text: 【行：ゆ】くぞ　【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】！\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【成敗：せいばい】するのだ！
Translated Text:
Let's go, Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition!
Chairman Ikakamone, let's
bring Dong Zhuo to justice!

Original Text: おおおー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: おおおー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: おおおー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: おい　【戦：たたか】いの【前：まえ】にひとつ\n【忠告：ちゅうこく】しといてやるぜ
Translated Text: Hey, I'll give you one piece\nof advice before the fight.

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【四天王：してんのう】に【気：き】をつけろ
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, watch out for Dong Zhuo's Four Heavenly Kings.

Original Text: ニャン…？\n【四天王：してんのう】…？
Translated Text:
Meow…?
The Four Heavenly Kings…?

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】…？
Translated Text: Les quatre généraux célestes... ?

Original Text: ズラ…？\n【四天王：してんのう】…？
Translated Text:
A wig…?
The Four Heavenly Kings…?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】を【支：ささ】える\n【四将軍：よんしょうぐん】のことさ　ヤツらは　ズルがしこい
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, you mean the four\ngenerals who support Dong Zhuo’s\narmy, right? Those guys are really crafty.

Original Text: 【主人公妖怪名】の【領地：りょうち】にも\n【攻：せ】めてくるかもしれねえ
Translated Text:
They might attack
【主人公妖怪名】's territory, too.

Original Text: りょうち？　オレっち\nいつの【間：ま】にか【国：くに】を【持：も】ってたニャン？
Translated Text: Ryo-chi? When did I end\nup ruling a country, meow?

Original Text: りょうち？　ミーは\nいつの【間：ま】にか【国：くに】を【持：も】ってたダニ？
Translated Text: Ryochi? Did Mee end up with a\ncountry without me even realizing it?

Original Text: りょうち…？
Translated Text: Ryochi…?

Original Text: ええ　【困：こま】った【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けたり\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】したりしたので…
Translated Text: Yeah, well, I helped some people in\ntrouble and defeated the Kingin Party, so...

Original Text: さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】のしせつを\nいくつか【持：も】っておりますよ！
Translated Text: We have a few facilities in\nthe Sakura residential area!

Original Text: せっかく\n【勝：か】ち【取：と】った【領地：りょうち】だ
Translated Text: We worked so hard to win this territory

Original Text: 【守：まも】りのメンバーをきっちり\n【置：お】いておいたほうがいいぜ！
Translated Text: You'd better make sure to have\nyour defensive players in position!

Original Text: なんだか【大変：たいへん】そうニャンねー\nよし　わかったニャン！
Translated Text: That sounds like a lot of work,\nmeow. Okay, got it, meow!

Original Text: なんだか【大変：たいへん】そうダニね…\nよし　わかったダニ！
Translated Text:
That sounds like a lot of
work, doesn't it, Dani... Okay
, got it, Dani!

Original Text: 【数多：あまた】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【率：ひき】い　【土地：とち】を【治：おさ】める\nお【主：ぬし】ももう　【一国：いっこく】の【主：あるじ】よな
Translated Text: Leading countless Yo-kai and\ngoverning the land, you, too, are\nnow the ruler of a nation, aren't you?

Original Text: イヨッ　さくら【国：こく】の　【小覇王：しょうはおう】！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text:
Yay! The Little Conqueror of
the Land of Cherry Blossoms!
Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: しょうっ　【覇王：はおう】…！\nもんげー！　もんげーズラー！
Translated Text:
Whoa, the Overlord…! That’s
crazy! That’s so crazy!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち\nいい【戦：たたか】いぶりだったぞ！
Translated Text: You guys put up a great fight!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】　ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze~!
(Thank you, Jibanyan Liu Bei!)

Original Text: 【当然：とうぜん】のことをしたまでニャン！
Translated Text: I just did what anyone would do, meow!

Original Text: え～【浮：う】かれるのはまだ【早：はや】いかと…\n【四天王：してんのう】は【残：のこ】り３【人：にん】もいますし
Translated Text:
Well... I guess it's still too early to
get carried away... There are still
three of the Four Heavenly Kings
left, after all.

Original Text: うるさいぞ！　【白：しろ】いの！\nフヨフヨしやがって！！
Translated Text:
Shut up! You white thing! Stop
wiggling around!!

Original Text: ぼへっー！　【頭：あたま】たたかない！\n【私：わたくし】のチャームポイントがぁ～！
Translated Text:
Ugh! Don't hit my head!
That's my best feature!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】からオレたちは\nえいえんの　ともだちだ！
Translated Text: Starting today, we're friends forever!

Original Text: メラッ　メラメラ！\n（【熱：あつ】い【誓：ちか】いを【結：むす】ぼう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze away!
(Let's make a fiery vow!)

Original Text: ニャ？　どーいうことニャン？
Translated Text: Meow? What's going on, meow?

Original Text: 【何：なに】　【言：い】ってるんですか　アナタ！\nこれはまさしく【三国志一：さんごくしいち】の【名場面：めいばめん】…
Translated Text:
What are you talking about?!
This is truly the greatest scene in
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*…

Original Text: 『【公園：こうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』ー！
Translated Text: "The Park Oath"—!

Original Text: ちがーう！　『【桃園：とうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』クマ！\nこっちで【説明：せつめい】するクマ！
Translated Text:
No way! "The Oath of the
Peach Garden," Bear!
I'll explain it over here, Bear!

Original Text: （ニャンだか　よくわかんないけど…）
Translated Text: (I'm not really sure why, but...)

Original Text: （おもしろそうだから\nま　いっかニャ～ン♪）
Translated Text: (It looks fun, so I guess\nI'll go for it, meow~♪)

Original Text: よーし！　【覚悟：かくご】はできたな？\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！
Translated Text:
All right! Are you ready?
Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【我：われ】ら３【人：にん】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(The three of us!)

Original Text: 【生：う】まれた【時：とき】…いや【場所：ばしょ】も【違：ちが】うけど！
Translated Text: When I was born… well, actually, the place was different too!

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: We'll die together! Victorian!

Original Text: どさくさにまぎれて\n【私：わたくし】もビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: Taking advantage of the\ncommotion, I'm a Victorian too!

Original Text: 【白：しろ】いのは　【引：ひ】っこんでろ！
Translated Text: You white guy, get lost!

Original Text: ぐへっ…！\nどさくさにまぎれて…
Translated Text:
Guh...! While everyone was distracted
...

Original Text: こちらが…\n【入手：にゅうしゅ】できたでうぃす…　バタリ…
Translated Text:
Here it is… I managed to
get it… *thud*…

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「チャレンジバトル」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "Challenge Battle"app for the Yo-kai Pad.

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "【g】Yo-kai Pad"【e】 app, "Yo-kai Online Store."

Original Text: おお　ぶようじん【坊金旋：ぼうきんせん】よ！\n【負：ま】けてしまうとは【情：なさ】けないではなイカ
Translated Text:
Oh, you good-for-nothing Kin-sen!
How pathetic of you to
lose, don't you think?

Original Text: だがヤツは【四天王：してんのう】の【中：なか】では【最弱：さいじゃく】！
Translated Text: But he's the weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち３【人：にん】が【残：のこ】っていれば\nなんの【心配：しんぱい】もいらないではなイカ！
Translated Text: If the three of you are still here,\nthere’s nothing to worry about, right?

Original Text: そして…　【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】！
Translated Text: And… Red Demon Lu Bu!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】に　ジャングルハンターを\nまかせようではなイカ！
Translated Text: How about I let you handle\nthe Jungle Hunter, huh?

Original Text: あっか～ん！\nワシの【力：ちから】　【思：おも】い【知：し】らせてくれる！
Translated Text:
Oh no!
You're really showing
me what I'm made of!

Original Text: みんな　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】に\nとどめを【刺：さ】すニャン！
Translated Text: Everyone, let’s finish off Chairman\nDong Zhuo, Ika Kamone! Meow!

Original Text: みんな　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】に\nとどめを【刺：さ】すダニ！
Translated Text: Everyone, check this out—the\ntick that delivers the final\nblow to Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: ズラーッ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】にとどめをさすズラ！
Translated Text: Zura! Chairman Kakamone delivers\nthe final blow to Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】ったああああ！
Translated Text: Wait a minute!

Original Text: ニャ？　どーしたニャン？
Translated Text: Meow? What's up, kitty?

Original Text: ダニ？　どーしたダニ？
Translated Text: Dani? What's up, Dani?

Original Text: な　【何：なん】ズラ！？
Translated Text: W-What the heck is that!?

Original Text: あ　あたしぃ　【第一印象：だいいちいんしょう】から\nアナタに【決：き】めてましたあ…
Translated Text: "I... I knew you were the one from\nthe very first moment I saw you..."

Original Text: って　ちがーう！
Translated Text: Wait—no way!

Original Text: りょ　りょ　りょ　【呂布：りょふ】ですっ！\n【呂布：りょふ】ですよおおおお！
Translated Text:
Ryō, Ryō, Ryō—it's Lü Bu!
It's Lü Buuuuu!

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】　さいきょう！\nとっても【恐：おそ】ろしい　【赤：あか】いヤツです！
Translated Text:
Sakura Kingdom—Saikyo! This is that
really scary red guy!

Original Text: ひとまず【逃：に】げましょう！
Translated Text: Let's get out of here for now!

Original Text: メラメラ！　メラッ！\n（オレが【食：く】い【止：と】める！　【行：い】け！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze!
(I'll hold them off! Go!)

Original Text: おいおい　オレもブラザーを【置：お】いて\n【逃：に】げるような　ヘタレじゃないぞ！
Translated Text: Hey, hey—I'm no wimp who'd just run\naway and leave my brother behind!

Original Text: いや　オレっちにまかせるニャン！\n【劉備：りゅうび】らしいとこ　【見：み】せてやるニャン
Translated Text:
Nope—leave it to me, meow!
I'll show you what Liu
Bei is all about, meow.

Original Text: いや　ミーにまかせるダニ！\n【仲達：ちゅうたつ】の【知恵：ちえ】を【見：み】せてやるダニ！
Translated Text:
No way—leave it to me, Dan!
I'll show you what I'm made of, Dan!

Original Text: オラにまかせるズラ！\nもんげーエーユーは　あきらめないズラ！
Translated Text:
Leave it to me!
Mongee AU never gives up!

Original Text: いや　ならばここは【私：わたくし】が！\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のかつやく　ごらんあれ！
Translated Text:
No—in that case, I'll take care of this!
Watch the genius strategist in action!

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ
Translated Text: Please, go ahead

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ
Translated Text: Please, go ahead

Original Text: メ～ラメ～ラ
Translated Text: Mee-ra Mee-ra

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ
Translated Text: Please, go ahead

Original Text: って　【止：と】めないのかよ！？
Translated Text: "What, you're not going to stop him!?"

Original Text: いやー！\n【私：わたくし】も【逃：に】げるでうぃすー！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
I'm running away too!

Original Text: …って　【誰：だれ】もいねえ！\nなんで【私：わたくし】のときは【誰：だれ】も【止：と】めないんじゃーいっ
Translated Text:
…Wait, there’s no one here!
Why doesn’t anyone stop
me when it’s my turn?!

Original Text: ま　【待：ま】ってー！\n【私：わたくし】も【逃：に】げるでうぃすー！
Translated Text:
W-Wait!
I'm running away too!

Original Text: ふうー\nここまでくれば【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】です…
Translated Text: Phew... Now that I've made\nit this far, I'll be fine...

Original Text: 【退：ひ】くことにはなったが…\n【主人公妖怪名】【軍：ぐん】の【戦：たたか】いぶりは【実：じつ】に【見事：みごと】
Translated Text:
Although we ended up retreating… the
【主人公妖怪名】army’s performance
in battle was truly magnificent.

Original Text: ああ　たいしたもんだ\nおかげでイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】たちは【弱：よわ】ってる
Translated Text: Wow, that's impressive. Thanks to\nthat, Chairman Ikakamone and\nDong Zhuo's forces are weakened.

Original Text: そこで…　【最後：さいご】の【仕上：しあ】げは\nお【主：ぬし】らに【任：まか】せたいのだが…
Translated Text: So… I’d like to leave the finishing\ntouches up to you guys…

Original Text: 【団々坂：だんだんざか】でトラブル【発生：はっせい】ってヤツだ\n【袁家：えんけ】の【連中：れんちゅう】は【帰：かえ】らなきゃなんねえ
Translated Text: So there's been some trouble\nat Dandan-zaka. The Yuan\nfamily folks have to head home.

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっと　【待：ま】った！\nリーダーがいないとまずいニャン！
Translated Text:
Wait—wait a minute! We're
in trouble without our
leader, meow!

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっと　【待：ま】った！\nリーダーがいないとまずいダニ！
Translated Text:
Wait—wait a minute! We're
in trouble without our
leader, Dani!

Original Text: でも　それだとオラたちの\nリーダーがいなくなってしまうズラ…
Translated Text: But then we'd be left without\na leader, wouldn't we...

Original Text: おおっと　これはゆゆしき【事態：じたい】っ\nならば【次：つぎ】のリーダーはこの【私：わたくし】が…
Translated Text: Whoa—this is a serious situation! In\nthat case, I’ll be the next leader…

Original Text: おまかせください！\nこういう【時：とき】に【頼：たよ】りになるのが　【私：わたくし】！
Translated Text:
Leave it to me! I'm the one
you can count on in times like
these!

Original Text: うむ\nリーダーはお【主：ぬし】がやれ
Translated Text: Hmm, you take the lead.

Original Text: うぃすー！　おまかせくだ…
Translated Text: Hey there! Leave it to me…

Original Text: 【主人公妖怪名】！\nあとは　お【前：まえ】にまかせたぜ？
Translated Text:
【主人公妖怪名】!
I'll leave the rest up to you, okay?

Original Text: なんですとーーーー！
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: オ　オレっちがリーダー？\nそんなの　【無理：むり】だニャン…
Translated Text:
Me... me as the leader?
No way, meow...

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】【生：う】まれのミーがリーダー？\nそんなの　むりダニ！
Translated Text:
Me, born in the USA, as the leader?
No way, that's impossible!

Original Text: もんげー…！\nお　オラがリーダー…？
Translated Text:
Whoa…!
M-Me, the leader…?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】は【強：つよ】い\nそして　いい【仲間：なかま】にも【恵：めぐ】まれておる
Translated Text: You're strong, and you're\nblessed with great companions.

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: ヤツらがいっしょなら\n【無敵：むてき】だろ？
Translated Text: If they're all together,\nthey're invincible, right?

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっとお【待：ま】ちを…\nだれか　【忘：わす】れちゃいませんかー？
Translated Text:
Hey, wait a sec… Isn't
someone forgetting something?

Original Text: では　【頼：たの】んだぞ
Translated Text: All right, count on me.

Original Text: また【会：あ】おうぜ！
Translated Text: See you later!

Original Text: はあ…なんか\nどんどん【責任重大：せきにんじゅうだい】になっていくニャン
Translated Text: Sigh... It feels like my responsibilities are\njust getting heavier and heavier, meow.

Original Text: オレっち…いつになったら\nケータのとこに　もどれるニャン？
Translated Text: Me... when am I gonna be able to\ngo back to Keita's place, meow?

Original Text: はあ…なんか\nどんどん【責任重大：せきにんじゅうだい】になっていくダニ
Translated Text: Sigh... It feels like my responsibilities are\njust getting heavier and heavier, Dani.

Original Text: ミー…　いつイナホのとこに\nもどれるダニ？
Translated Text: Me... When can I go back\nto Inaho's place, Dani?

Original Text: お　オラが…\nもんげー【軍：ぐん】の　リーダー…！
Translated Text:
I'm... the
leader of the Monge Army...!

Original Text: 【待：ま】ってー！　【袁家：えんけ】の【皆様：みなさま】ー！
Translated Text: Wait! Everyone from the Yuan family!

Original Text: いいかげん　【私：わたくし】の【名前：なまえ】くらい\n【覚：おぼ】えてくださいよ～！
Translated Text: For heaven's sake, just\nremember my name already!

Original Text: い　【行：い】ってしまいました…
Translated Text: He... he's gone...

Original Text: せっかく　【袁家：えんけ】と【名刺交換：めいしこうかん】…\nいや　【g】メダル【交換：こうかん】【e】するために…
Translated Text:
Since I went to the trouble of exchanging
business cards with the Yuan family… 【g】no【e】
, to exchange medals…

Original Text: 【g】メダル【交換：こうかん】アプリ【e】を【作：つく】ったのにぃ～…
Translated Text: 【g】I went to all that trouble to make【e】 a medal exchange app, and yet...

Original Text: …あ　そうだ！\nそうです！　そうですとも！
Translated Text:
…Oh, that’s right!
That’s right! That’s exactly right!

Original Text: あの～アナタの【妖怪：ようかい】パッドに\n【g】メダル【交換：こうかん】アプリ【e】を【入：い】れておきますんでぇ…
Translated Text: Um... I'll install the 【g】medal exchange【e】\n【g】app on【e】 your Yo-kai Pad for you...

Original Text: あとで【袁家：えんけ】の【方：　かたがた】々に【私：わたくし】の【名前：なまえ】…\n【売：う】りこんでくれます？
Translated Text:
Could you...
put in a good word for me
with the Yuan family later?

Original Text: へっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: はっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: リーダーの【頼：たの】みなら\n【袁家：えんけ】の【方：かたがた】々も【無視：むし】できませんもんね！？
Translated Text: If it’s a request from the leader, even the\nYuan family can’t just ignore it, right!?

Original Text: はいっ！　インストール【完了：かんりょう】！\nでは　よろしくお【願：ねが】いしまーすっ！
Translated Text:
Okay! Installation complete!
Well then, I look forward
to working with you!

Original Text: （オラ…　この【世界：せかい】に【来：き】てから\nカッコイイ【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】になれてるズラ）
Translated Text: (Hey... ever since I came to this\nworld, I've become a pretty\ncool warrior-Yo-kai, haven't I?)

Original Text: （【夢：ゆめ】に【見：み】た　エーユーになれてるズラ\n【理想：りそう】の【兄：にい】ちゃんになれてるズラ）
Translated Text: (I’m finally the AU I dreamed of\nbecoming. I’m finally the ideal older\nbrother I’ve always wanted to be.)

Original Text: どうしたブラザー！　【元気：げんき】ないな！\nエクササイズでもするか？
Translated Text:
What's up, bro! You seem down!
Want to work out or something?

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（オレたちが　いつもついているぞ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(We're always by your side!)

Original Text: …オレっち\nこの【世界：せかい】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃないニャン
Translated Text: …I'm not one of this world's military\ncommanders or Yo-kai, meow.

Original Text: いつかは　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るニャン\nそれでも　ともだちでいてくれるニャン？
Translated Text: Someday, I'll go back to my\nold world, meow. Even so, will\nyou still be my friend, meow?

Original Text: …ミーは\nこの【世界：せかい】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃないダニ
Translated Text: …Mee isn't a military commander-type\nYo-kai in this world, is she?

Original Text: いつかは　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るダニ\nそれでも　ともだちでいてくれるダニ？
Translated Text: Someday, I'll go back to my old world, Dan.\nEven so, will you still be my friend, Dan?

Original Text: じいん…\nううん　なんでもないズラ…
Translated Text:
Hmm...
No, never mind...

Original Text: オラきっと　いつかは【田舎：いなか】に【帰：かえ】るズラ\nそれでも　ともだちズラか？
Translated Text: I'm sure I'll go back to the countryside\nsomeday. But will you still be my friend?

Original Text: 【当：あ】たり【前：まえ】だ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Of course, bro!

Original Text: メラメラメラメーラ！\n（【友情：ゆうじょう】に【場所：ばしょ】は【関係：かんけい】ないぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera Mera Mera-me-ra!
(Friendship knows no bounds!)

Original Text: そうニャンか…
Translated Text: I guess so, meow…

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】\nノガッパ【姜維：きょうい】…
Translated Text: Ryu-kun, Liu Yu, Walkappa, Jiang Wei…

Original Text: そして　ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】に\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】…
Translated Text: And then there's Captain Bree, Guan\nYu, and Melamelion Zhang Fei…

Original Text: オレっち　ここに【来：き】て\n【困：こま】ってばっかりだったけど…
Translated Text: Man, ever since I got here, I've\nbeen in one bind after another...

Original Text: オレっちには　みんなが…\n【頼：たよ】りになる　ともだちがいるニャンね！
Translated Text:
I’ve got some… really
dependable friends, haven’t I, meow!

Original Text: そうダニか…
Translated Text: So, it's a tick, huh...

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】\nノガッパ【姜維：きょうい】…
Translated Text: Ryu-kun, Liu Yu, Walkappa, Jiang Wei…

Original Text: そして　ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】に\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】…
Translated Text: And then there's Captain Bree, Guan\nYu, and Melamelion Zhang Fei…

Original Text: ミーは　ここに【来：き】て\n【困：こま】ってばっかりだったけど…
Translated Text: Ever since I came here, I've been\nhaving nothing but trouble...

Original Text: ミーには　みんなが…\n【頼：たよ】りになる　ともだちがいるダニ！
Translated Text:
Mee has... friends she can always
count on, Dani!

Original Text: ううう…\nオラ　【涙：なみだ】が【止：と】まらないズラ
Translated Text:
Ugh... Man
, I just can't stop crying.

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】は　ほんとにいい【世界：せかい】ズラ\nオラ　この【世界：せかい】のみんなが【大好：だいす】きズラ！
Translated Text: This world is really a great world, Zuraora!\nI love everyone in this world, Zura!

Original Text: いつか\nコマじろうとお【母：かあ】ちゃんもつれてくるズラ！
Translated Text: Someday I'm gonna bring\nKomajiro and Mom along, too!

Original Text: メラメラ！　メラメラ！\n（【元気：げんき】になったな！　【主人公妖怪名】！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze!
(You're feeling better now【主人公妖怪名】! )

Original Text: よーし！\nその【調子：ちょうし】だ　ブラザー！
Translated Text:
All right!
Keep it up, bro!

Original Text: そして　オレたちには\nまだ【大事：だいじ】なミッションが【残：のこ】ってるぞ！
Translated Text: And we still have an important\nmission left to complete!

Original Text: そうニャン！　【今度：こんど】こそ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】すニャンよ！
Translated Text: That's right, meow! This time,\nwe're definitely going to take\ndown Chairman Dong Zhuo, meow!

Original Text: そうダニ！　【今度：こんど】こそ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】すダニー！
Translated Text: That's right, Danny! This time, Danny will\ndefinitely defeat Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: ズラ！　【今度：こんど】こそ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】すズラ！
Translated Text: Zura! This time, we're definitely going\nto take down Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: メラメラメラ　メラ！\n（【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】を　【先：さき】に【倒：たお】そう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze, blaze!
(Let's take down the Red Ogre Lu Bu first!)

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】があると\nヤツはそこに【逃：に】げこむぞ！
Translated Text: If one of the Four Heavenly Kings has\na territory, that guy will run off to it!

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】をすべて【制圧：せいあつ】しろ！\nそうすれば　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text:
Conquer all of the Four
Heavenly Kings' territories!
Then—Victorian!

Original Text: オッケー！\nビクトリニャーン！
Translated Text:
Okay!
Victorina!

Original Text: ＯＫ！\nまかせるダニー！！
Translated Text:
OK!
Leave it to me, Danny!!

Original Text: わかったズラ！\nビクトリアーン！　ズラ！
Translated Text:
Got it, wig!
Victorian! Wig!

Original Text: みなさん！　お【疲：つか】れ【様：さま】です！\nジャングルハンターは　すぐそこですよ！
Translated Text:
Hey, everyone! Great job today!
Jungle Hunter is just around the corner!

Original Text: ジャングルハンター？\nそれって　なんニャン？
Translated Text:
Jungle Hunter?
What's that, meow?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】のアジトですが…\nまさか　それを【知：し】らないで【今：いま】まで？
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone, this
is Dong Zhuo’s hideout…
You’ve actually had no
idea about this until now?

Original Text: だって　オレっちには\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】がついてるからニャ～
Translated Text: After all, I've got a genius\nstrategist on my side, meow~

Original Text: いつも　オレっちが【戦：たたか】いに【集中：しゅうちゅう】できるよう\nお【前：まえ】は　がんばってくれてるニャン？
Translated Text: You're always doing your best so I can\nfocus on the battle, aren't you, meow?

Original Text: ジーーーン…\nも　もちろんでございます！
Translated Text:
Zzzzz... Of
course!

Original Text: （ニャハ♪　うまくいったニャン♪）
Translated Text: (Meow-ha♪ That worked out great, meow♪)

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】は　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】との【最終決戦：さいしゅうけっせん】！\n【準備：じゅんび】をととのえて【挑：いど】んでください！
Translated Text:
Next up is the final showdown with
Chairman Ikakamone, Dong Zhuo! Get
ready and take him on!

Original Text: この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】も\n【全力：ぜんりょく】で【支：ささ】えますからねー！
Translated Text: This genius strategist will be there to\nsupport you with everything I’ve got!

Original Text: いつの【間：ま】にか\n【追：お】いつめられているではなイカ…
Translated Text: Before I knew it, I found myself\nbacked into a corner, didn't I…

Original Text: ここの【守：まも】りは\nお【前：まえ】に【任：まか】せてもいイカ？
Translated Text: Is it okay if I leave the\ndefense of this place to you?

Original Text: なにぃ？　どこに【行：い】く？
Translated Text: What? Where are you going?

Original Text: イカカカカ…\n【大事：だいじ】な【使命：しめい】を【果：は】たさねばイカんのだ
Translated Text:
Ika-ka-ka-ka… I simply must fulfill this
important mission.

Original Text: ンーーーーーッ！\nビクトリアーーーーーーン！
Translated Text:
Huuuuuuu!
Victoriaaaaaaa!

Original Text: メラ！　メラアアア！\n（この【勝利：しょうり】！　【熱：あつ】いぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera! Meraaaaa!
(This victory! It's so exciting!)

Original Text: いや…！\n【喜：よろこ】ぶのは　まだ【早：はや】いでうぃす！
Translated Text:
No...!
It's too soon to celebrate!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓勢力：ぎちょうとうたくせいりょく】の【残党：ざんとう】が\nこちらに【向：む】かってきていますー！
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, the remnants of\nDong Zhuo's forces are heading this way!

Original Text: ニャンと！？　こっちはもう\nこれ【以上：いじょう】　【戦：たたか】えないニャンよ！？
Translated Text: What?! I can't fight anymore, meow!

Original Text: ピンチ　ダニ！　こっちは\nこれ【以上：いじょう】　【戦：たたか】えないダニよ！？
Translated Text: We're in a tight spot, Mite!\nI can't fight any more, Mite!

Original Text: メラ！\n（【先：さき】に【逃：に】げろ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(Run away first!)

Original Text: ここはオレたちが【食：く】いとめる！\n【行：い】け！　【主人公妖怪名】！
Translated Text:
We'll hold them off here!
Go【主人公妖怪名】! !!

Original Text: なに【言：い】ってるニャン！？\nふたりを【置：お】いて【行：い】けるわけないニャンよ！
Translated Text:
What are you talking about, meow!?
There's no way I'm leaving
the two of you behind, meow!

Original Text: どうせなら　ふたりの【代：か】わりに\nこの【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】を【置：お】いてくニャン！
Translated Text: Since we're at it, let's leave this\ngenius strategist here instead\nof the two of them, meow!

Original Text: なに【言：い】ってるダニ！\nふたりを【置：お】いていけるわけないダニ！
Translated Text:
What are you talking about, Dani!
There's no way I could leave
the two of you behind, Dani!

Original Text: どうせなら　ふたりの【代：か】わりに\nこの【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】を【置：お】いてくダニ！
Translated Text: If we're going to do this anyway,\nlet's leave this genius strategist\nbehind instead of those two, Dani!

Original Text: アナタね～！　いくらなんでも\nそりゃないんじゃ　ござんせ～ん！？
Translated Text: Hey, you! Come on—that’s just\ntoo much, don’t you think?!

Original Text: ピーピーうるさいぞ！\nふたりとも！
Translated Text:
Stop making all that noise, you
two!

Original Text: ニャアアアア！
Translated Text: Meowwwww!

Original Text: ダニイイイイ！
Translated Text: Daniiiii!

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: あのふたり…\n【無事：ぶじ】だといいニャンが…
Translated Text:
Those two... I hope they're
okay, meow...

Original Text: あのふたり…\nオラたちを【助：たす】けてくれたズラ…
Translated Text:
Those two... the ones who helped us
...

Original Text: あのふたり…\n【無事：ぶじ】だといいダニが…
Translated Text:
Those two... I hope they're
okay...

Original Text: 【残党：ざんとう】は　すごい【数：かず】だったそうです\nきっとバラバラのメチャクチャに…
Translated Text: I hear there were a huge number of\nstragglers. They must have been scattered\nall over the place in total disarray…

Original Text: 【残党：ざんとう】は\nすごい【数：かず】だったそうです…
Translated Text: I hear there were a huge\nnumber of stragglers…

Original Text: ううう　【今頃：いまごろ】きっと\n【二人：ふたり】はバラバラのめちゃくちゃに…！
Translated Text: Ugh... By now, they're probably\ncompletely torn apart...!

Original Text: そんニャ…！\nうえ～ん！　オレっちのせいだニャ～ン！
Translated Text:
Oh no…!
Waaah! It's all my fault, meow~!

Original Text: オレっちが　もっと【強：つよ】くて\nもっと　しっかりしていたら…！
Translated Text: If only I were stronger and more reliable…!

Original Text: オラの　せいズラ…\nともだちを【助：たす】けられなかったズラ…
Translated Text:
It's my fault... I couldn't save my
friend...

Original Text: ぐすん　オラやっぱり　エーユーでも\nカッコイイ【兄：にい】ちゃんでもなかったズラ…！
Translated Text: Sniff... So he wasn't an AU character\nor a cool older guy after all...!

Original Text: うわーーん…！\nミーのせいダニ～！
Translated Text:
Waaah…! It's all
my fault, Dani~!

Original Text: ミーが　もっと【強：つよ】くて\nもっと　しっかりしていたら…！
Translated Text: If only I were stronger\nand more resilient…!

Original Text: 【泣：な】くのは【早：はや】いぜ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Don't cry just yet, bro!

Original Text: ぎゃあああああ！\nお　おばけ～！！！
Translated Text:
Aaaaaaah!
A ghost~!!!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（おばけじゃない　【妖怪：ようかい】だ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(I'm not a ghost—I'm a Yo-kai!)

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: メラメラメ～ラ！\n（【生：う】まれた【時：とき】は　ちがっても！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze~!
(Even if we were born different!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーーン！！\n…だろ！？
Translated Text:
We'll die together! Victoriaaa!!
… Right!?

Original Text: よ　よかったニャン！\n【本当：ほんとう】に　【無事：ぶじ】でよかったニャーン！！
Translated Text:
Yay!
Phew! I'm so glad you're safe!!

Original Text: よ　よかったズラ！\nほんとの　ほんとによかったズラー！！
Translated Text:
Whew, that was close!
I'm really, really glad that's over!!

Original Text: よ　よかったダニ！\n【本当：ほんとう】に　【無事：ぶじ】でよかったダニー！！
Translated Text:
Whew... I'm so glad, Danny!
I'm really glad you're safe, Danny!!

Original Text: もうひとつ！\nブラザーにビッグなプレゼントだ！
Translated Text:
One more thing!
It's a big present for my brother!

Original Text: メラ！\n（【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(It's a gem!)

Original Text: ニャニャー！？
Translated Text: Meow-meow!?

Original Text: げげっ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: ズズラッ
Translated Text: Zuzuraa

Original Text: 【残党相手：ざんとうあいて】にバトルしてる【時：とき】に\n【井戸：いど】で　【見：み】つけたんだ！
Translated Text: I found it in a well while I was\nbattling some stragglers!

Original Text: メラメラ\n（【持：も】っていってくれ）
Translated Text: Mera Mera (Take this with you)

Original Text: いいのかニャン？
Translated Text: Is that okay, meow?

Original Text: いいダニか？
Translated Text: Is it a good tick?

Original Text: いつも　オラはもらってばっかりで…\nいいズラ？
Translated Text:
I'm always the one
getting stuff... Is that okay
?

Original Text: いいも【悪：わる】いもないぞ！\nブラザー！
Translated Text:
There's no such thing as good or bad,
bro!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（【熱：あつ】き【友情：ゆうじょう】のあかしだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(A testament to our fiery friendship!)

Original Text: う…　【泣：な】けるニャン！\nみんな…　ありがとニャン！
Translated Text:
Ugh... This is making me cry, meow!
Everyone... thank you, meow!

Original Text: う…　【泣：な】けるダニ！\nみんな…　ありがとダニ！
Translated Text:
Ugh... This is so touching!
Everyone... thank you so much!

Original Text: ゆうじょうの　あかし…！\nじいん…！
Translated Text:
A sign of friendship…!
A tingle…!

Original Text: みんなも【無事：ぶじ】で　おまけに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】も【手：て】に【入：はい】って\nパーティーでもしたい【気分：きぶん】ニャン！
Translated Text: Everyone's safe, and on top of\nthat, we got the magic orb—I'm in\nthe mood to throw a party, meow!

Original Text: みんなも【無事：ぶじ】で　おまけに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】も【手：て】に【入：はい】って\nパーティーでもしたい【気分：きぶん】ダニ！
Translated Text: Everyone's safe, and on top of that, we got\nthe gem—I'm in the mood to throw a party!

Original Text: メラメラッ！\n（さあ　みんなで【勝利：しょうり】のお【祝：いわ】いだ！）
Translated Text:
Whoosh!
(Come on, let's all celebrate our victory!)

Original Text: そうおっしゃると【思：おも】っていました\n【準備：じゅんび】はバッチリできておりますよ～！
Translated Text: I knew you'd say that. I'm all set!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！　グレイトだ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming! That's great!

Original Text: グレイト？　いえいえ…ここは\nビクトリアーン！　…と【言：い】ってくださいな！
Translated Text: Great? No, no… This is\nVictorian! …Please say that!

Original Text: さあ　チョコボーでも【食：た】べて\nみんなで　さわぎまくるニャーン！
Translated Text: Alright, let's eat some Chocobo and\nhave a wild time together, Meow!

Original Text: さあ\nみんなで　さわぎまくるダニー！
Translated Text: Come on, everyone—let's\nget Danny all riled up!

Original Text: （ズラ…　みんなとの【思：おも】い【出：で】…\nたくさん　できていくズラ！）
Translated Text:
(Zura… Memories with everyone…
I’m making so many of them, Zura!)

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】～　お【茶：ちゃ】くれニャ～ン
Translated Text: The Genius Strategist—Give me some tea, meow~

Original Text: あーはいはい\n【熱：あつ】いのでお【気：き】をつけて…
Translated Text: Oh, yeah, yeah—it's hot, so be careful...

Original Text: ついでに　リモコン【取：と】ってニャ～ン
Translated Text: While I'm at it, pass me the remote, meow~

Original Text: はいはい\nあまり【近：ちか】くで【見：み】ないでねって…
Translated Text: "Okay, okay, don't look too closely..."

Original Text: こらーっ！　なにしてるんすか！
Translated Text: Hey! What are you doing?!

Original Text: だって　ヒマすぎて　ヒマすぎて…\nふニャああああ…
Translated Text:
I mean, I'm so bored, so
bored... Meowwwww...

Original Text: さっき　トイレに【行：い】ったら\n【太：ふと】ももがタプンタプンだったニャン
Translated Text: When I went to the bathroom a little while\nago, my thighs were all flabby, meow.

Original Text: 【食：く】っちゃ【寝：ね】してるからですよ！\nさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】の【英雄：えいゆう】が【情：なさ】けない
Translated Text:
It's because all he does is eat
and sleep! The hero of the
Sakura residential district
is such a disappointment.

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めて【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るって【話：はなし】\nどうなったんですか！
Translated Text: What ever happened to that\nstory about collecting the jewels\nto return to our original world?!

Original Text: …はっ！　そうだったニャン！
Translated Text: …Oh! That’s right, meow!

Original Text: あまりの【居心地：いごこち】のよさに\nすっかり　【忘：わす】れてたニャン！
Translated Text: It was so cozy I completely forgot, meow!

Original Text: ん？　お【客：きゃく】さんかニャン？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】～　【見：み】にいって～
Translated Text:
Huh? Is that a customer, meow?
"Genius Strategist"—go check it out!

Original Text: はいはい～　どちら【様：さま】～\nってオイ！
Translated Text: "Okay, okay~ Who's\nthere~?" Hey, wait a minute!

Original Text: あの…　えっと…\n【団々坂：だんだんざか】のしどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】…
Translated Text:
Um... well... that stammering
Tōken from Dandan-zaka...

Original Text: その…　お【願：ねが】いが　あの…\nあるんだけど…　えっと…
Translated Text:
Well... I have a favor to ask...
um...

Original Text: あ～　【話：はなし】がまったくすすみません！\nならば　【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った…
Translated Text:
Ugh... This conversation
isn't going anywhere!
Well then, I bought this from
the Yo-kai Online Store...

Original Text: モテる【聞：き】き【上手：じょうず】マシーン！\nこれで【私：わたくし】が　【代弁：だいべん】します！
Translated Text:
The Ultimate "Good Listener" Machine!
Let me speak for you!

Original Text: （その【道具：どうぐ】　いったい\nなんに【使：つか】うつもりだったニャン…？）
Translated Text: (What on earth was he planning\nto use that tool for, meow…?)

Original Text: （その【道具：どうぐ】　いったい\nなんに【使：つか】うつもりだったダニ…）
Translated Text: (What on earth was Dani\nplanning to use that tool for…?)

Original Text: えっと…　【団々坂：だんだんざか】の【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】と\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】がいきなりケンカを？
Translated Text: Um... Did Yuan Shao, the Earth Spider\nof Dandan Slope, and Yuan Shu, the\nGiant Toad, suddenly get into a fight?

Original Text: 【大：おお】きな【家同士：いえどうし】が【争：あらそ】い　【自分：じぶん】をはじめ\n【住民：じゅうみん】たちも【困：こま】っている…

That’s exactly what I’d
say! I can’t deal with you
anymore!

Translated Text:
If you have no intention of
following me… then I’ll just keep
fighting.

Original Text: なんかめっちゃ【険悪：けんあく】ニャン…

Original Text: なんかめっちゃ【険悪：けんあく】ダニ…
Translated Text: The vibe is super tense...

Original Text: ん？

Original Text: ん？

Translated Text:
Whoa!
It’s been a while, hasn’t it…?

Original Text: ヒッ！\nお　お【久：ひさ】しぶりダニ…？
Translated Text:
Whoa!
It's been a while, hasn't it...?

Whoa! I'm so glad you came!
Join me in dealing with
this stubborn fool…

What are you saying?! 【主人公妖怪名】
came here just for me!

Original Text: ま　まあまあ　ふたりとも…\nオレっちは【別：べつ】にどっちの【味方：みかた】とか…

W-Well, well... both of them...
I'm not really on either side or anything...

Translated Text:
Well... well, well... both of them...
I'm not really on either side or anything...

If you're going to decide,
at least do it smartly, okay?
So, which side are you on?

Eek…
Um, well, that’s, uh…

Hey, wait a sec! Give us a chance to
talk!

Translated Text: Me? I don't really want to fight, meow...

After all, I'm Jibanyan Liu Bei! I'm a
peace-loving AU, meow!!

You... are going to get beaten up by
both of them, aren't you?

…Genius strategist!
Let’s get ready for
battle right away, meow!

So you really are on my side after all!
I feel as if I’ve gained an army of a
million!

Original Text: まあ　がんばるダニ\nでも　ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいダニ
Translated Text: Well, I'll do my best, but\ncould you tell me one thing?

Original Text: …ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいズラ
Translated Text: …Let me ask you one thing, Zura

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】は\nなんニャン？
Translated Text: What was the reason they\ngot into a fight, meow?

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】は\nなんダニ？
Translated Text: What caused the two of them to fight?

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】はなんズラ？
Translated Text: What do you think caused the two of them to fight?

Translated Text: Well... I can't say that.

Translated Text: You should ask him about\nit after we win the battle…

Translated Text: You're kind of stumbling over your words, aren't you...

Translated Text: "【g】Co-op【e】 Battles are now available."

Heh, heh, heh... I knew you would!
Just like I expected from my partner!

Translated Text: That's true... It seems we weren't\nquite seeing the bigger picture.

Translated Text: Ah... Up until just now, all I\ncould think about was manju.

Eek!
Why are you yelling all of a sudden!?

Original Text: もし　だれかがワザと…
Translated Text: If someone were to deliberately...

Original Text: お【二方：ふたかた】の【目：め】を　まんじゅうに\n【向：む】けさせていたとすると…
Translated Text: If we assume that both of them had\ntheir eyes fixed on the manju…

Original Text: た　【大変：たいへん】ニャン！
Translated Text: Oh, man! Meow!

Original Text: た　【大変：たいへん】ダニ！
Translated Text: Oh, man, mites!

Original Text: ！！\nイヤな【予感：よかん】がするズラ！
Translated Text:
!! I've got a
bad feeling about this!

Original Text: しどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】！\nすぐに【怪物：かいぶつ】の【様子：ようす】を【見：み】てくるのだ！
Translated Text:
Touken, you're all flustered!
Go check on the monster
right away!

Original Text: え　その　あ　はい…
Translated Text: Uh... well... uh... yeah...

Original Text: オ　オレっちたちも【急：いそ】ぐニャン！
Translated Text: W-We've got to hurry, too, meow!

Original Text: ミーたちも【急：いそ】ぐダニ！
Translated Text: We're in a hurry, too, Dani!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】たちも　【急：いそ】ぎましょっ
Translated Text: Let's hurry, too!

Original Text: 【礼：れい】を【言：い】わせてくれ\nもし　お【主：ぬし】たちがいなければ【今頃：いまごろ】…
Translated Text: Let me just say thank you—if it\nweren't for you guys, by now I'd be...

Original Text: 【団々坂：だんだんざか】は\nどんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】のものになっていた
Translated Text: Dandan-zaka had become the\nproperty of Dondoro Ri Ju.

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】に【助：たす】かった！　【礼：れい】は【何：なに】がいい？\nなんでも【言：い】ってくれ！
Translated Text:
That really helped! What
would you like as a thank-you?
Just let me know!

Original Text: …じゃあ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をくれニャン！
Translated Text: …Well then, give me the gem, meow!

Original Text: …じゃあ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をくれダニ！
Translated Text: …Well then, give me the gem, you louse!

Original Text: アナタ！\n【袁家：えんけ】の【秘宝：ひほう】をそんなあっさりと…
Translated Text:
Hey, you! How could you just give away
the Yuan family's treasure so easily…

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】か…　よかろう
Translated Text: A jewel, huh... All right, then.

Original Text: あっさり…
Translated Text: That was quick…

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】は【倒：たお】したしな\nそれに…
Translated Text: We've already taken down Li\nRu, after all. And besides...

Original Text: 【故郷：こきょう】に【帰：かえ】るのに【必要：ひつよう】なんだろ？\nえんりょしないで　【持：も】ってけよ
Translated Text:
You need this to go back home, right?
Don't be shy—just take it.

Original Text: 【助：たす】かるニャン！
Translated Text: That's a relief, meow!

Original Text: 【助：たす】かるダニ！
Translated Text: Thanks, Tani!

Original Text: 【袁家：えんけ】は【仲：なか】なおりしたし\nこれで　みんな【解決：かいけつ】ニャンね！
Translated Text: The Yuan family has made up, so\neverything’s all settled now, meow!

Original Text: 【袁家：えんけ】は【仲：なか】なおりしたし\nこれで　みんな【解決：かいけつ】ダニ！
Translated Text: The Yuan family has made up, so\neverything’s all sorted out now!

Original Text: いえ…\nそうとも【限：かぎ】りません…
Translated Text:
Well... that's
not necessarily true...

Original Text: 【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】をして…\nどうしたニャン？
Translated Text:
You're looking so serious...
What's wrong, kitty?

Original Text: 【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】をして…\nどうしたダニ？
Translated Text:
You're looking so serious... What's
wrong, Dani?

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の【後頭部：こうとうぶ】が\nなぜだか　じんわり【熱：あつ】いんです…
Translated Text: For some reason, the back\nof my head feels warm...

Original Text: これは…\n【不吉：ふきつ】なことが【起：お】こる【前触：まえぶ】れかも…！
Translated Text:
This might be... a sign that something
bad is about to happen...!

Original Text: あー　それはきっと\nホカホカあんこのせいニャン！
Translated Text: Ah, that must be because of the\npiping-hot red bean paste, meow!

Original Text: あー　それはきっと\nホカホカあんこのせいダニ！
Translated Text: Ah, that must be because of the\npiping-hot red bean paste, Dani!

Original Text: さっき　まんじゅうを【食：た】べた【時：とき】に\n【手：て】が　あんこまみれになって…
Translated Text: A little while ago, when I was\neating a manju, my hands got\ncovered in red bean paste…

Original Text: さっき　まんじゅうを【食：た】べた【時：とき】に\n【手：て】が　あんこまみれになって…
Translated Text: A little while ago, when I was\neating a manju, my hands got\ncovered in red bean paste…

Original Text: テメェ…　【人：ひと】の【頭：あたま】を\nハンカチ【代：が】わりに【使：つか】うんじゃねえ！
Translated Text: You... Don't use people's\nheads as handkerchiefs!

Original Text: いやー　【袁家：えんけ】の【人：ひと】たちは\n【本当：ほんとう】に【太：ふと】っ【腹：ぱら】ですね！
Translated Text: Wow, the Yuan family sure is generous!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だけでなく　【団々坂：だんだんざか】も\n【自由：じゆう】に【使：つか】っていいらしいです！
Translated Text: It seems you're free to use not only the\nJewel but also Dandan-zaka as well!

Original Text: これで　ジバニャン【劉備軍：りゅうびぐん】は\nさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】と【団々坂：だんだんざか】をゲット！
Translated Text: With this, Jibanyan's Liu Bei Army has\ntaken over the Sakura Residential\nDistrict and Dandan Slope!

Original Text: このまま【行：い】けば\nさくら【国：こく】の【統一：とういつ】も【夢：ゆめ】では…
Translated Text: If things keep going this way,\nthe unification of Sakura Country\nmight not be just a dream...

Original Text: どうしたニャン？\nいきなり【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】で【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【見：み】つめて…
Translated Text:
What's up, kitty? Why are you
suddenly staring at the jewel with
such a scary look on your face...

Original Text: おなかでも【痛：いた】いニャン？
Translated Text: Does your tummy hurt, too, kitty?

Original Text: ちがいます！\nこの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】のチカラについて【考：かんが】えてたんです！
Translated Text:
No, that's not it!
I was thinking about
the power of this gem!

Original Text: 【怪物：かいぶつ】を【封：ふう】じこめ…　アナタたちを\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【戻：もど】せる　このチカラが…
Translated Text: Seal away the monster… This power can\nsend you all back to your original world…

Original Text: 【少：すこ】しだけ…\n【恐：おそ】ろしくなってきたんでうぃす…
Translated Text:
I'm starting to get a little...
scared, you know...

Original Text: でも\nみんなこころよく　くれたニャン！
Translated Text: But everyone was so kind\nand gave me some, meow!

Original Text: うーん…
Translated Text: Hmm…

Original Text: そんなことで【悩：なや】むより\n【次：つぎ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】のことを【教：おし】えてくれニャン！
Translated Text: Instead of worrying about that, just\ntell me about the next gem, meow!

Original Text: そうでうぃすね…
Translated Text: I guess so…

Original Text: 【残：のこ】りの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】はおそらく…\nふたりの【英雄：えいゆう】のもとにあります
Translated Text:
The remaining orbs are probably...
in the possession of the
two heroes.

Original Text: ふたりのエーユー？
Translated Text: Two AUs?

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】その１！　\n【心優：こころやさ】しき　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！
Translated Text:
Hero No. 1
! A kind-hearted, awesome warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】その２！\nガッツあふれる　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！
Translated Text:
Hero No. 2!
The Blue Warrior Yo-kai, Full of Guts!

Original Text: 【残念：ざんねん】ですが　【情報：じょうほう】は【以上：いじょう】です…
Translated Text: Unfortunately, that's all the information we have...

Original Text: （もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】に　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…\nなーんか【聞：き】き【覚：おぼ】えがあるニャンね…）
Translated Text:
(A "Monge" Yo-kai... a
blue Yo-kai... That sounds
kind of familiar, meow...)

Original Text: ですが　【彼：かれ】らは【袁家：えんけ】と【同：おな】じく\n【地域：ちいき】のボスであることは【確認：かくにん】ずみ！
Translated Text: However, it has been confirmed that they,\nlike the Yuan family, are local bosses!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】ってる【可能性：かのうせい】が\n【高：たか】いでうぃすー！
Translated Text: There's a good chance\nthey have the jewel!

Original Text: （そういえば　コマさんはオレっちと【一緒：いっしょ】に\n【本：ほん】に【吸：す】い【込：こ】まれたっぽかったニャン）
Translated Text: (Come to think of it, it looks like Komasan\ngot sucked into the book with me, meow.)

Original Text: （もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】って　もしかして\nあのコマさんのことかニャン…？）
Translated Text: (Wow, a warrior Yo-kai... could\nthat be Komasan, meow...?)

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】…\nまた【戦：たたか】わないとダメなのニャン？
Translated Text:
Genius Strategist… Do I have to fight
again, meow?

Original Text: イエス！　オフコース！\nトーゼンですとも！！
Translated Text:
Yes! Of course!
That goes without saying!!

Original Text: もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！\nそして　ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！
Translated Text:
Awesome Warrior Yo-kai! The Blue Yo-kai!
And Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: 【三：み】つどもえのはげしい【国：くに】とりバトルが\n【今：いま】　【始：はじ】まろうとしているのです！
Translated Text: A fierce three-way battle for control\nof the country is about to begin!

Original Text: ニャンか\nひとりで【盛：も】り【上：あ】がってるニャン…
Translated Text: I'm having a blast all by myself, meow...

Original Text: ノンノンノン！
Translated Text: No, no, no!

Original Text: ボクも【盛：も】り【上：あ】がってるクマ！\nいよいよ【三国：さんごく】の【時代：じだい】が【到来：とうらい】ー！
Translated Text:
I'm super excited, Bear!
The Age of the Three
Kingdoms is finally here!

Original Text: 【三国志：さんごくし】のクライマックスについて…\nうんちく　【聞：き】きたいクマ？
Translated Text:
About the climax of *Romance of the
Three Kingdoms*… Want to hear some
trivia, Bear?

Original Text: お　お【願：ねが】いするニャン…
Translated Text: Please... meow...

Original Text: オホン！　では…【気：き】を【取：と】り【直：なお】して\nいざいざ　【戦：たたか】いの【準備：じゅんび】をー！
Translated Text: Ahem! Well then… Let’s pull ourselves\ntogether and get ready for battle!

Original Text: 「【g】「【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「くにとりバトル」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました」
Translated Text: "【g】I've downloaded the 'Yo-kai Pad' app, 'Kunitori Battle.'【e】"

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: 【主人公妖怪名】【軍：ぐん】…\nその【勢：いきお】いは【本物：ほんもの】みたいだねぇ
Translated Text:
【主人公妖怪名】The military...
It really does seem like
they've got some real
momentum, doesn't it?

Original Text: でも　ボクたちは\nキンギン【党：とう】や【袁家：えんけ】とは【違：ちが】うのさ
Translated Text: But we're different from the\nKingin Party and the Yuan family.

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】をきっちり【治：おさ】められるのは\nボクが【守：まも】る　フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】のみ
Translated Text: The only one who can govern the\nLand of Sakura properly is me—Fu\nNyang Cao Cao—and I will protect it.

Original Text: はあーー！
Translated Text: Waaah!

Original Text: このカンペキな【結界：けっかい】を\nはたして　やぶれるかな…？
Translated Text: Will this perfect barrier\nactually be broken...?

Original Text: このいかにも【切：き】れ【者：もの】な【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】は\nキュウビ【荀彧：じゅんいく】！
Translated Text: This sharp-witted\nwarrior-Yo-kai is Kyuubi Jun Iku!

Original Text: 【荀彧：じゅんいく】は【曹操：そうそう】の【側近：そっきん】で\n「【王佐：おうさ】の【才：さい】」と【呼：よ】ばれた【人：ひと】クマ！
Translated Text: Xun Yu was a close advisor to\nCao Cao and was known as a man\nwith "the talent to assist a king"!

Original Text: そんな【曹操：そうそう】や【荀彧：じゅんいく】のことを\n【知：し】りたい【人：ひと】はこちらクマ！
Translated Text: If you want to learn more about\nCao Cao and Xun Yu, click here!

Original Text: 【領地：りょうち】と【宝珠：ほうじゅ】…\nだれにも　【渡：わた】さないよ
Translated Text:
My territory and my
gem... I won't let anyone
take them from me.

Original Text: おかしいニャン\nなんか【見：み】えない【壁：かべ】が【現：あらわ】れたニャン？
Translated Text: That's weird, Meow. Did some kind\nof invisible wall just appear, Meow?

Original Text: おかしいダニ\nなんか【見：み】えない【壁：かべ】が【現：あらわ】れたダニ？
Translated Text: "Weird—a wall that's invisible to\nmites has appeared? A mite?"

Original Text: あれは…【結界：けっかい】です！\n【敵：てき】もなかなかやりますね…
Translated Text:
That's... a barrier!
The enemy's pretty tough, isn't it...

Original Text: ですが　おまかせください\nこんなこともあろうかと…
Translated Text: But don't worry—I've got this. I figured\nsomething like this might happen...

Original Text: スーパーデラックスドリル！\n【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】のレビューも【高評価：こうひょうか】！
Translated Text:
Super Deluxe Drill!
It’s getting rave reviews on
the Yo-kai Online Store!

Original Text: では　【行：い】ってきます！
Translated Text: Well then, I'm off!

Original Text: うわあああん！\n２【秒：びょう】で【壊：こわ】れやがったー！
Translated Text:
Waaah!
It broke in two seconds!

Original Text: あ　お【客：きゃく】さんニャン？
Translated Text: Oh, a customer, meow?

Original Text: あ　お【客：きゃく】さんダニ？
Translated Text: Oh, is that a customer, Dani?
…Huh?

Original Text: アナタは…オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】！\nたしか　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【軍師：ぐんし】では！？
Translated Text:
You're... Orochi Zhou Yu!
Aren't you that military strategist from
*Monge* who's a warrior-Yo-kai!?

Original Text: ててて　【敵：てき】！？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】　なんとかするニャン！！
Translated Text:
Wait, wait, wait... An enemy!?
Genius strategist—I'll figure
something out, meow!!

Original Text: ててて　【敵：てき】！？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】　なんとかするダニ！！
Translated Text:
Wait, wait, wait... An enemy!?
Genius Strategist—I'll
figure something out, Dani!!

Original Text: こ　コラ！　このジバ【野郎：やろう】！\n【私：わたくし】を【盾：たて】にするんじゃなーい！！
Translated Text:
Hey—you! You jerk! Don't use
me as a human shield!!

Original Text: こ　コラー！\n【私：わたくし】を【盾：たて】にするんじゃなーい！！
Translated Text:
Hey—hey! Don't use
me as a human shield!!

Original Text: フッ…　あわてるな\n【今日：きょう】は　【戦：たたか】いにきたのではない
Translated Text: Hmph… Don’t panic. I didn’t\ncome here to fight today.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】たちと　【協力：きょうりょく】して\nあの【結界：けっかい】をやぶらないか？
Translated Text: Why don't you work with us to\nbreak through that barrier?

Original Text: （この【声：こえ】…！！！　もしかして…！？）
Translated Text: (That voice…!!! Could it be…!?)

Original Text: （この【声：こえ】…！！！　もしかして…！？）
Translated Text: (That voice…!!! Could it be…!?)

Original Text: いい【返事：へんじ】を【待：ま】っている
Translated Text: I'm waiting for a positive response.

Original Text: さて　どうするニャン…
Translated Text: Well, what should I do, meow…

Original Text: さて　どうするダニ…
Translated Text: So, what are you going to do, Dani…

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】いわく…\nオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【提案：ていあん】に【乗：の】りましょう
Translated Text:
According to Whisper
Kongming… Let’s go along with
Orochi Zhou Yu’s proposal.

Original Text: 【三：み】つどもえの【戦：たたか】いの【必勝法：ひっしょうほう】は\n「【高：たか】みの【見物：けんぶつ】」です！
Translated Text: The surefire way to win a three-way\nbattle is to “watch from the sidelines”!

Original Text: ふたつの【国：くに】がつぶしあうのを【待：ま】ち\nおいしいところをいただく！
Translated Text: Wait for the two countries to destroy each\nother, then take the best parts for myself!

Original Text: 【結界：けっかい】を【張：は】った　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪軍：ぶしょうようかいぐん】は\n【今：いま】まさに「【高：たか】みの【見物：けんぶつ】」【状態：じょうたい】！
Translated Text: The blue warrior-Yo-kai army, having\nset up a barrier, is now simply sitting\nback and watching from above!

Original Text: これを【許：ゆる】してはなりません！
Translated Text: We must not allow this!

Original Text: ？\nどうかしましたか？
Translated Text:
?
Is something wrong?

Original Text: すごいダニ！\n【今：いま】はじめて【天才：てんさい】と【思：おも】ったダニ！
Translated Text:
What an amazing tick! This is the
first time I've ever thought
a tick was a genius!

Original Text: すごいニャン！\n【今：いま】の【感：かん】じ　めっちゃ【軍師：ぐんし】っぽいニャン！
Translated Text:
Wow, meow!
Right now, you look just like
a military strategist, meow!

Original Text: …はじめてっすか…\nずっと【前：まえ】から【天才：てんさい】なんですけど…
Translated Text:
…Is this your first time?
…You’ve been a genius for a
long time now…

Original Text: …いや…\nずっと【前：まえ】から【軍師：ぐんし】ですけど…
Translated Text:
…Well… I’ve been a military strategist for a
long time now…

Original Text: じゃあ　さっそく\nもんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】に【会：あ】いにいくニャン！
Translated Text: Well then, let's go meet those awesome\nwarrior Yo-kai right away, meow!

Original Text: じゃあ　さっそく\nもんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】に【会：あ】いにいくダニ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's go meet those\nawesome warrior Yo-kai right away!

Original Text: ああ　そんな【気軽：きがる】に…\nいちおう　【敵地：てきち】は【敵地：てきち】なんですから！
Translated Text:
Oh, come on—don't be
so casual about it... After
all, enemy territory is enemy territory!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】もおともいたしますー！
Translated Text: I'll come along, too!

Original Text: （オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…！）
Translated Text: (Orochi Zhou Yu…!)

Original Text: （オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…！）
Translated Text: (Orochi Zhou Yu…!)

Original Text: （まちがいないニャン！\nあの【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】で【聞：き】いた【声：こえ】…！）
Translated Text:
(No doubt about it, meow!
That voice is... the voice
I heard in my dream...!)

Original Text: （まちがいないダニ！\nあの【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】で【聞：き】いた【声：こえ】…！）
Translated Text:
(It's definitely Dani!
That voice... the voice
I heard in my dream...!)

Original Text: （きっと　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】は\n【力：ちから】になってくれるニャン！）
Translated Text: (I'm sure Orochi Zhou Yu\nwill be a big help, meow!)

Original Text: （きっと　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】は\n【力：ちから】になってくれるダニ！）
Translated Text: (I'm sure Orochi Zhou\nYu will be a big help!)

Original Text: さて　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【国：くに】に\nやってきたニャン！
Translated Text: Well then, I've arrived in the\nland of the Monge military\ncommanders and Yo-kai, meow!

Original Text: よく【来：き】たな　と【言：い】いたいところだが\nそれどころでは　なくなってしまった
Translated Text: I'd like to say, "Glad you came," but\nthings have gotten way beyond that.

Original Text: くわしくは　【我：わ】が【主：あるじ】の【弟：おとうと】\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】から【聞：き】いてほしい
Translated Text: For more details, please ask my lord’s\nyounger brother, Komajiro Sun Quan.

Original Text: オラ　コマじろう【孫権：そんけん】ズラ！\nよろズラ！！
Translated Text:
Hey, Komajiro Sun Quan
wig! How's it going,
wig?!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんといっしょに\nかんげいしたかったズラが…
Translated Text: I wanted to celebrate\nwith my big brother, but...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんがふらっと\nどっかに【行：い】っちまったズラ！
Translated Text: My big brother just wandered\noff somewhere, man!

Original Text: ずいぶん\n【自由：じゆう】な【君主：くんしゅ】さまですね…
Translated Text: You're quite a free-spirited\nmonarch, aren't you…

Original Text: 【頼：たの】むズラ！\n【兄：にい】ちゃんをさがしてほしいズラ！
Translated Text:
Please, Zura! I want you to find my big
brother, Zura!

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をあげるから\n【協力：きょうりょく】してほしいズラ！
Translated Text: I'll give you this gem,\nso please help me out!

Original Text: ええ！？\nいいのかニャン？
Translated Text:
Really!?
Is that okay, meow?

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんが【無事：ぶじ】なら\nそれでいいズラ！
Translated Text: As long as my big bro's\nokay, that's all that matters!

Original Text: わかったニャン！\nオレっちにまかせるニャン！
Translated Text:
Got it, meow! Leave it to
me, meow!

Original Text: （コマさんのことニャン\nきっと【迷子：まいご】にでもなってるニャン）
Translated Text: (I bet Komasan must have\ngotten lost or something.)

Original Text: （すぐに【見：み】つけて　【一緒：いっしょ】に\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るニャン！）
Translated Text: (Let's find it right away and go\nback to our world together, meow!)

Original Text: 【協力：きょうりょく】　【感謝：かんしゃ】する\nお【礼：れい】に【一曲：いっきょく】　【贈：おく】ろう…
Translated Text: To show my gratitude for\nyour cooperation, let me\ndedicate a song to you…

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【音楽：おんがく】センスは\nこの【国一：くにいち】といわれてるズラ！
Translated Text: They say Orochi Zhou Yu has the best\nmusical taste in the whole country!

Original Text: そ　そうニャン？
Translated Text: Is that... right, Meow?

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんも　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【曲：きょく】を\nいつも【楽：たの】しく【聴：き】いてたズラ…
Translated Text: My older brother always enjoyed\nlistening to Orochi Zhou Yu's songs, too...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんとオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】は\n【最高：さいこう】の…　ともだちズラ！
Translated Text: My brother and Orochi Zhou Yu are\nthe best… *pretending to be friends*!

Original Text: そう！　そのとおりだクマ！
Translated Text: That's right! You're absolutely right, Bear!

Original Text: も　もんげー！？
Translated Text: What the...!?

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】らの【友情：ゆうじょう】は\n【断金：だんきん】の【交：まじ】わりって【言：い】われてるクマ！
Translated Text: People say their friendship is as\nstrong as a bond of gold, Bear!

Original Text: そして　【劉備：りゅうび】と【孔明：こうめい】は\n【水魚：すいぎょ】の【交：まじ】わりと【言：い】われてるクマ！
Translated Text: And Liu Bei and Kongming are said to\nbe as inseparable as fish and water!

Original Text: 【断金：だんきん】の【交：まじ】わり…\nなんか　すごく【頼：たの】もしい【感：かん】じニャン…
Translated Text:
A bond as strong as unbroken gold…
It feels really reassuring, meow…

Original Text: それに【比：くら】べて　【水魚：すいぎょ】の【交：まじ】わり…\nなんか【弱：よわ】そうだし…　【頼：たよ】りなさそうだし…
Translated Text:
Compared to that, the "fish-and-water"
relationship... seems kind of weak
... and unreliable...

Original Text: しかも　オレっちが　【魚：さかな】らしいニャン！\n【魚：さかな】はおいしく【食：た】べるものニャン！
Translated Text:
Plus, it looks like I'm a fish, meow!
Fish are meant to be eaten, meow!

Original Text: あのねえ…　あくまでも　たとえです！\n【魚：さかな】は【水：みず】がないと【生：い】きられないでしょ！
Translated Text:
Listen... I'm just using this as an example!
Fish can't live without water, right?

Original Text: それだけこっちも\nかたい【結：むす】びつきってことなの！
Translated Text: That just goes to show\nhow strong our bond is!

Original Text: 「【g】「【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【音楽：おんがく】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: "【g】I got the 'Yo-kai Pad:【e】 Music' app."

Original Text: よくここまで【無事：ぶじ】だったな\n…【英雄：えいゆう】
Translated Text: It's a miracle you made it\nthis far unscathed… Hero

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…！\nお【前：まえ】はやっぱり　あの【時：とき】の…！
Translated Text:
Orochi Zhou Yu…!
So you really are the
one from back then…!

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…！\nユーはやっぱり　あの【時：とき】の…！
Translated Text:
Orochi Zhou Yu…! So
you really were the one back then…!

Original Text: そうだ
Translated Text: That's right.

Original Text: なんで…　オレっちを\nこの【世界：せかい】に【呼：よ】んだニャン？
Translated Text: Why... did you call me to this world, meow?

Original Text: なんで…　ミーを\nこの【世界：せかい】に【呼：よ】んだダニ？
Translated Text: Why... did you bring\nme to this world, Dani?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】ならば　この【危機：きき】を\n【救：すく】ってくれると【思：おも】ったからだ
Translated Text: It's because I thought you were the\none who could save us from this crisis.

Original Text: ゆえに　この【国：くに】の【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】せ…\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【呼：よ】び【寄：よ】せた
Translated Text:
And so, I showed them the dreams
of this country… and drew them into
this book.

Original Text: 【危機：きき】って…\n【国同士：くにどうし】の【戦争：せんそう】のことニャン？
Translated Text:
A crisis... is that when
countries go to war
with each other, meow?

Original Text: 【危機：きき】って…\n【国同士：くにどうし】の【戦争：せんそう】のことダニ？
Translated Text:
A crisis... is that like a war between
countries, Dani?

Original Text: ちがう　もっと【大：おお】きな…\nいや　【今言：いまい】うのはやめておこう
Translated Text:
No, something bigger... No,
I'd better not say that right now.

Original Text: 【思：おも】わせぶりニャン…
Translated Text: Teasing me, aren't you, kitty...

Original Text: 【思：おも】わせぶりダニ…
Translated Text: That teasing tick…

Original Text: フツーの【妖怪：ようかい】なら\nここに【来：く】るまでに　【倒：たお】れていた
Translated Text: Any ordinary Yo-kai would have been\ndefeated by the time they got here.

Original Text: だが　お【前：まえ】は【私：わたし】のそうぞう【以上：いじょう】の\nかつやくを【見：み】せてくれた
Translated Text: But you performed even\nbetter than I had imagined.

Original Text: この【調子：ちょうし】で　これからも【頼：たの】む…\n【私：わたし】も　【協力：きょうりょく】はおしまない
Translated Text:
Keep it up... I'll keep doing
my part, too.

Original Text: オレっち…　いまだに\nいろいろ【納得：なっとく】できないニャン…
Translated Text: Me... I still can't quite wrap my head\naround a lot of things, meow...

Original Text: ミーは…　いまだに\nいろいろ【納得：なっとく】できないダニ…
Translated Text: Me... I'm still a tick who can't quite\nwrap my head around a lot of things...

Original Text: でも…\nここまできたら【退：ひ】けないニャン！
Translated Text:
But…
now that I've come this far,
there's no turning back, meow!

Original Text: でも…\nここまできたら【退：ひ】けないダニ！
Translated Text:
But… there’s no turning back
now, Dani!

Original Text: 【協力：きょうりょく】するニャン！\nこの【国：くに】のためにがんばるニャン！
Translated Text:
Let's work together, meow!
Let's do our best for this country, meow!

Original Text: 【協力：きょうりょく】するダニ！\nこの【国：くに】のためにがんばるダニ！
Translated Text:
Ticks that help out!
Ticks that work hard for this country!

Original Text: さすが【英雄：えいゆう】　だな
Translated Text: He really is a hero.

Original Text: でも…！\n【今度：こんど】　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【呼：よ】ぶ【時：とき】は…
Translated Text:
But…!
Next time I call you into the book…

Original Text: でも　もう【本：ほん】の【中：なか】は\nノーサンキュー　ダニ！
Translated Text: But no thanks to the book anymore, Dani!

Original Text: ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】の【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】の【中：なか】に\nしてほしいニャン！！！
Translated Text: Meow! I want this to be in\nthe Nya-KB photo book!!!

Original Text: もし　【今度願：こんどねが】いをかなえてくれるのなら…\n【宇宙：うちゅう】に【行：い】ってみたいダニ！
Translated Text:
If you're going to grant me a
wish this time... I'd love to go to
space, Dani!

Original Text: フッ…　【考：かんが】えておこう
Translated Text: Hmm... I'll have to think about that.

Original Text: 【先：さき】ほど【住民：じゅうみん】から【連絡：れんらく】が【入：はい】った
Translated Text: I just received a call from a resident.

Original Text: 【小学校：しょうがっこう】で【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【見：み】たという\n【行：い】ってくれるか？
Translated Text: Can you believe someone said\nthey saw a white warrior-like\nYo-kai at an elementary school?

Original Text: もちろんニャン！
Translated Text: Of course, meow!

Original Text: 【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】といえば…\nコマさんニャン！
Translated Text:
Speaking of white warrior Yo-kai…
Komasan Nyan!

Original Text: だれに【聞：き】いても\nそれ【以外：いがい】は【思：おも】いつかないニャン！
Translated Text: No matter who you ask, that's the\nonly thing they can think of, meow!

Original Text: ……あの～　お【言葉：ことば】ですが\nほらほら　すぐ【近：ちか】くにも【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】が…
Translated Text: ……Um… with all due respect,\nlook, look—there’s a white\nwarrior Yo-kai right nearby…

Original Text: ？　なんニャン？
Translated Text: ? What's up, kitty?

Original Text: い　いえ　なんでもありません！\nさあ　【小学校：しょうがっこう】へ【向：む】かいましょう！
Translated Text:
"No, no, it's nothing!
Come on, let's head to
elementary school!"

Original Text: 【見：み】てください！\n【武将妖怪同士：ぶしょうようかいどうし】が　もめているようです！
Translated Text:
Look!
It looks like some warrior
Yo-kai are having a fight!

Original Text: このよくわからん【木：き】のゴミを\n【池：いけ】に【投：な】げたのは　お【主：ぬし】かー！
Translated Text: So it was you who threw this weird\npiece of wood into the pond, was it?!

Original Text: あ　あれは…　【私：わたくし】の【木像：もくぞう】ー！？
Translated Text: W-Wait... Is that... my wooden statue!?

Original Text: そして　こちらからは…　\nまた　あのクマがー！？
Translated Text:
And from this side… That
bear again—!?

Original Text: 【孔明：こうめい】の【木像：もくぞう】の【話：はなし】…\n【聞：き】きたいクマね？
Translated Text:
The story about the wooden
statue of Kongming…
You want to hear it, don’t you, Bear?

Original Text: とにかく　この【木像：もくぞう】を【池：いけ】に【投：な】げこめば\n【願：ねが】いがかなうって【聞：き】いたダニ！
Translated Text: Anyway, I heard that if you throw\nthis wooden figurine into the pond,\nyour wish will come true, Dani!

Original Text: だから　どんどん【投：な】げるダニ！\nミーは【早：はや】く【帰：かえ】りたいダニ！
Translated Text:
So keep throwing, Dani!
I wanna go home soon, Dani!

Original Text: や　やめてー！\nそんなにドボドボ【落：お】とさないでー！
Translated Text:
No, stop it! Don't let it drip all over
like that!

Original Text: （あれは…！\n【図書室：としょしつ】で【見：み】た【妖怪：ようかい】ニャン！）
Translated Text:
(That's...! It's the Yo-kai I saw
in the library!)

Original Text: おのれ～！\nいい【加減：かげん】にせんかー！
Translated Text:
Damn it! Give it
a rest already!

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nあの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をやっつけるニャン！
Translated Text:
Genius Strategist! Let's take down
that warrior Yo-kai, meow!

Original Text: わかってます！
Translated Text: I know!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の　かわいい【像：ぞう】を【池：いけ】に【捨：す】てる\n【不良妖怪：ふりょうようかい】なんて【成敗：せいばい】してやりますよ！
Translated Text: I'm going to teach that delinquent\nYo-kai a lesson for throwing my\ncute statue into the pond!

Original Text: ちがうニャン！　あの【大：おお】きなほうを\nやっつけるニャン！
Translated Text: No way, meow! I'm gonna take\ndown the bigger one, meow!

Original Text: えええー？
Translated Text: Whaaaat?

Original Text: おかげで【助：たす】かったダニ…\nありがとうダニ…
Translated Text:
Thanks to you, I'm saved,
Danni... Thank you, Danni...

Original Text: よくわからないうちに\n【変：へん】な【世界：せかい】に【連：つ】れてこられて…
Translated Text: Before I knew it, I was whisked\naway to a strange world…

Original Text: 【何：なに】をしていいかわからなくて\nちょっとパニックになってたダニ
Translated Text: Dani was a little panicked because\nshe didn't know what to do.

Original Text: その【気持：きも】ち…\nよくわかるニャン…
Translated Text:
I
totally get how you feel, meow...

Original Text: オレっちの【場合：ばあい】\nラッキーなことに…
Translated Text: In my case, luckily…

Original Text: 【最初：さいしょ】に【会：あ】った【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちが\nみんな【親切：しんせつ】だったニャン！
Translated Text: All the warrior Yo-kai I met\nat first were so nice, meow!

Original Text: その【後：あと】も　いい【仲間：なかま】に【出会：であ】えて\nなんとか　がんばってるニャン！
Translated Text: Since then, I've met some great\nfriends, and I'm doing my best, meow!

Original Text: ひとりで【心細：こころぼそ】いんだったら\nオレっちと　いっしょに【来：く】るニャン？
Translated Text: If you're feeling a little lonely on your\nown, why don't you come with me, meow?

Original Text: いいダニか！？
Translated Text: Is that a good tick!?

Original Text: もちろんニャン！\nえっと…　【名前：なまえ】は…？
Translated Text:
Of course, meow!
Um... what's your name...?

Original Text: ここでは\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】って【呼：よ】ばれてるダニ
Translated Text: Here, he's called "Usapyon\nZhongda"—a tick.

Original Text: わけわかんない【名前：なまえ】ダニ…
Translated Text: What a weird name, Dani…

Original Text: オレっちはジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\nよろしくニャン！
Translated Text:
I'm Jibanyan Liu Bei!
Nice to meet you, meow!

Original Text: オレっちも\n【最初：さいしょ】はわけわかんなかったけど…
Translated Text: I didn't get it at first either, but...

Original Text: この【名前：なまえ】\nだんだん【好：す】きになってきたニャン！
Translated Text: I'm starting to really like this name, meow!

Original Text: あのーおふたりとも\nお【取：と】りこみ【中：ちゅう】すいません
Translated Text: Um, I'm sorry to bother you\nboth while you're busy.

Original Text: つられたろう【丸甘寧殿：まるかんねいどの】の\n【怒：いか】りが【収：おさ】まらないんですが…
Translated Text: Tsurataroumaru—Lord Gan\nNing’s anger just won’t subside…

Original Text: なぜワシが【池：いけ】にゴミを【捨：す】てたヤツに\n【負：ま】けねばならんのじゃー！
Translated Text: Why the heck do I have to lose to the\nguy who threw trash in the pond?!

Original Text: ごめんダニ！\nどうか　ゆるしてほしいダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm sorry, Danni!
Please forgive me, Danni!

Original Text: オレっちからも　お【願：ねが】いニャン！\nこいつ　めちゃくちゃ【反省：はんせい】してるニャン！
Translated Text:
I’m asking you, too, meow!
This guy is really, really sorry, meow!

Original Text: しょうがない　ゆるしてやろう\nワシも【少々：しょうしょう】　【気：き】が【立：た】っとったからの
Translated Text: Oh well, I'll let it slide. I was a\nlittle on edge myself, after all.

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】たちの【前：まえ】にも\n【池：いけ】に【物：もの】を【捨：す】てるヤツがおったんじゃ…
Translated Text: There were people who threw\nthings into the pond even\nbefore you guys came along…

Original Text: たしか【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃったが…\n【燃：も】えかけのぶっそうな【物：もの】を【捨：す】ておってのう…
Translated Text:
I'm pretty sure he was a white
warrior-Yo-kai... but he just tossed
away something that was still
smoldering and looked like
it was about to explode...

Original Text: 【投：な】げ【返：かえ】して　【池：いけ】をキレイにした【瞬間：しゅんかん】に\nお【主：ぬし】たちに【木像：もくぞう】を【投：な】げこまれて…
Translated Text: Just as I threw it back and\ncleaned up the pond, you guys\nthrew wooden statues at me…

Original Text: 【頭：あたま】にきてしまった
Translated Text: I got really mad.

Original Text: 【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！？\nそいつはどこに【行：い】ったニャン？
Translated Text:
A white warrior Yo-kai!?
Where'd that guy go, meow?

Original Text: たしか\n【正天寺：しょうてんじ】のほうに【向：む】かっていったぞ
Translated Text: I'm pretty sure he\nheaded toward Shoten-ji.

Original Text: 【急：いそ】ぎましょう！\nきっと　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】さんです！
Translated Text:
Let's hurry!
It's definitely a super-awesome
warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: 【待：ま】て！　【行：い】く【前：まえ】にバツとして\n【池：いけ】のゴミをひとつ【持：も】っていけ！
Translated Text: Wait! Before you go, as a penalty, pick\nup one piece of trash from the pond!

Original Text: その【玉：たま】が　【池：いけ】の【底：そこ】でずっとチカチカ\n【光：ひか】るせいで　【少：すこ】しも【眠：ねむ】れやしない
Translated Text: Because that orb keeps flickering at the\nbottom of the pond, I can't sleep a wink.

Original Text: こ　これはー！
Translated Text: W-Wow!

Original Text: ラッキー！　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だニャン！\nやったニャーン♪
Translated Text:
Lucky! It's a gem, meow!
Yay, meow♪

Original Text: 【見：み】てください！\n【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】が　ふたりいます！
Translated Text:
Look! There are two
white warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: あ　ジバニャン！\nもんげー【会：あ】いたかったズラよ～！
Translated Text:
Ah, Jibanyan!
Man, I’ve really missed you!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: （オレっちのことを【知：し】ってるから\nあれは【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】のコマさん…）
Translated Text: (Since she knows who I am, that must\nbe Komasan from my original world...)

Original Text: （ということは　【行方不明：ゆくえふめい】の\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：にい】ちゃんってのは！）
Translated Text: (So that means the missing\nKoma-jiro—Sun Quan’s\nolder brother—is…!)

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: もんげー！？\nでっけぇ【犬：いぬ】に　【食：く】われちまうズラー！
Translated Text:
Whoa! I'm gonna get eaten
by that huge dog!

Original Text: コマさんは　オレっちたちと【同：おな】じ…！\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】から【来：き】た【妖怪：ようかい】ニャン！
Translated Text:
Komasan is just like us…!
A Yo-kai who came from
our world!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\n【力：ちから】を【合：あ】わせて【助：たす】けるニャンよ！
Translated Text:
USA, Pyon and Nakata! Let's
work together to save them, meow!

Original Text: ＯＫダニ！
Translated Text: OK, Danni!

Original Text: あいつ…\nま　まだ【立：た】ち【上：あ】がってくるニャン！
Translated Text:
That guy…
he’s… he’s still getting back up, meow!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: ひゃああああ！\n【特大：とくだい】のドクロ【爆弾：ばくだん】をかかえてます！
Translated Text:
Yaaaaaah! I'm holding a
giant skull bomb!

Original Text: ミーのレーザーガンで\n【撃：う】ち【落：お】とすダニ！
Translated Text: Shoot down the mites with Mii's laser gun!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: オラが【火：ひ】をつけるズラ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna light this thing on fire!

Original Text: もんげ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】はオレっちの\nひゃくれつ【肉球：にくきゅう】！
Translated Text: And finally, here are my\nsuper-fast paw pads!

Original Text: ニャニャニャニャニャ！
Translated Text: Meow, meow, meow, meow, meow!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: やりましたね！\nお【三方：さんかた】　すばらしい【戦：たたか】いぶりです！
Translated Text:
Way to go!
All three of you put up a fantastic fight!

Original Text: いやあ　それほどでもないズラ
Translated Text: Nah, it's not really that big of a deal.

Original Text: ミーにかかれば　こんなの【楽勝：らくしょう】ダニ！
Translated Text: With me on the case, this is a piece of cake!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】もゲットできたし\nこれでめでたし　めでたし…
Translated Text: I got the jewel, too, so\nall's well that ends well...

Original Text: じゃニャーーーい！
Translated Text: See ya later!

Original Text: ど　どうしました？
Translated Text: Wh—what's wrong?

Original Text: もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nうっかり【倒：たお】してしまったニャン…
Translated Text: Oops, I accidentally defeated a\nsuper-powerful Yo-kai, meow...

Original Text: …？　ああああっ！
Translated Text: …? Aaaah!

Original Text: それが【何：なに】か【問題：もんだい】ダニ？
Translated Text: Is that a problem or something?

Original Text: オレっちたちは　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【連：つ】れて【帰：かえ】る【約束：やくそく】をしたニャン…
Translated Text: We promised to bring back a\nsuper-awesome warrior Yo-kai, meow…

Original Text: もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【勢力：せいりょく】は\nきっと　【我：われ】らをゆるさないでしょう
Translated Text: The forces of those crazy warrior\nYo-kai will surely never forgive us.

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nこういう【時：とき】こそ【考：かんが】えるニャン！
Translated Text:
Genius Strategist!
This is exactly the time to think, meow!

Original Text: ここは…　のるかそるか！\nすり【替：か】わりの【計：けい】しかございません！
Translated Text:
This is... do or die! Our only option is
a switch!

Original Text: そこのアナタ！
Translated Text: Hey, you over there!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】からアナタは【孫策：そんさく】！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】です！
Translated Text:
Starting today, you're Sun Ce!
Komasan Sun Ce!

Original Text: もんげー！？
Translated Text: No way!?

Original Text: 【見：み】た【目：め】が【全然：ぜんぜん】ちがうニャン！
Translated Text: They look totally different, meow!

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】！　【白：しろ】ければ　\nきっと　わかりませんって！
Translated Text: It's okay! If it's white, they\ndefinitely won't notice!

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: ひええええっ！\nまたよみがえったニャン！？
Translated Text:
Eeeeeek!
It came back to life again, meow!?

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: コマさん！\nあいつ　なんて【言：い】ってるニャン？
Translated Text:
Komasan!
What's that guy saying, meow?

Original Text: 「そんなことで　ごまかせるか\n　ドあほう【軍師：ぐんし】…」
Translated Text: "Do you really think you can pull\nthat off, you total idiot strategist…?"

Original Text: 「【自分：じぶん】の【国：くに】に【帰：かえ】るズラ！」\nと【言：い】ってるズラ！
Translated Text:
"Go back to your own country, Zura!" he's
saying, Zura!

Original Text: ドあほう…？\nひどい【言：い】われようでうぃす…
Translated Text:
What a moron…? That’s a pretty
harsh thing to say…

Original Text: ま　まあまあ…\nとりあえず　【目的：もくてき】は【達成：たっせい】できたニャン
Translated Text:
W-Well, I guess... Anyway
, I achieved my goal, meow.

Original Text: マイティードッグ【孫策：そんさく】を\n【救：すく】ってくれて【感謝：かんしゃ】する
Translated Text: Thank you, Mighty Dog, for saving Sun Ce.

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】は　【急：きゅう】に「のるかそるか」と\n【思：おも】い【立：た】ち…
Translated Text: Suddenly, he decided it was "do or die"...

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【本拠地：ほんきょち】にひとりで\n【乗：の】りこみたくなったらしい
Translated Text: It seems he felt like storming the\nenemy's stronghold all by himself.

Original Text: もともと【勇：ゆう】かんな【将：しょう】だったが…\nちょっと【無謀：むぼう】すぎたな…
Translated Text:
He was a brave general to
begin with… but he was a
little too reckless…

Original Text: （こっちの【世界：せかい】でも「のるかそるか」が\n【流行：はや】ってるニャン？）
Translated Text: (Is "all or nothing" a thing\nin this world, too, meow?)

Original Text: （ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】もそんなこと【言：い】ってたし\nなんだか　【気：き】になるニャン…）
Translated Text: (Whisper Kongming said\nsomething like that, too, so I\ncan't help but wonder, meow...)

Original Text: さて…　それでは\nお【前：まえ】たちの【言：い】う　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪軍：ぶしょうようかいぐん】…
Translated Text: Well then… So, this “Blue General\nYo-kai Army” you’re talking about…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【結界：けっかい】を　やぶるため\nさくせんを【考：かんが】えよう
Translated Text: Let's come up with a strategy\nto break through the Cao Cao\narmy's barrier at Fuyunyan.

Original Text: さて　【結界：けっかい】をやぶるには…　\nウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】　どうするべきか？
Translated Text:
So, to break through the barrier… Whisper
Kongming, what should we do?

Original Text: へっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: あの【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせん…　\n【私：わたし】はすでに　この【紙：かみ】に【書：か】いてある
Translated Text:
A strategy to break through that barrier...
I've already written it down
on this piece of paper.
