Original Text: お【前：まえ】と【同：おな】じ【意見：いけん】なのか\n【確：たし】かめたいのだ
Translated Text: I just want to make sure you agree with me.

Original Text: よよよよよ　よいでしょう！\nさらさらっと…！
Translated Text:
Yoyoyoyo—That's great!
Just like that...!

Original Text: それ　さっきオレっちが【鼻：はな】をかんだ\nチリ【紙：がみ】ニャンよ…？
Translated Text: Hey... isn't that the tissue I\njust used to blow my nose...?

Original Text: シャラーーップ！
Translated Text: Shut up!

Original Text: では　ふたり【同時：どうじ】に【見：み】せよう
Translated Text: Well then, let's show them both at the same time.

Original Text: そう…　【火：ひ】だ！
Translated Text: Yeah... Fire!

Original Text: （よかったー！\n【本当：ほんとう】によかったー！）
Translated Text:
(Phew!
That's a relief! I'm so glad!)

Original Text: （【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った\n【透：す】けるコンタクトをつけておいて…！）
Translated Text: (I’ll make sure to wear the\nsee-through contacts I bought\nfrom the Yo-kai online store…!)

Original Text: （だーかーらー…\n【何：なに】に【使：つか】うつもりだったダニ…？）
Translated Text:
(So... what were you planning to
use that tick for...?)

Original Text: …だが　【今：いま】　【火：ひ】を【使：つか】っても\n【私：わたし】たちが　【燃：も】えるだけ
Translated Text: …But even if we used fire\nnow, it would only burn us.

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【方角：ほうがく】…
Translated Text: Fu Nyang, in the direction of Cao Cao's army…

Original Text: 【東南：とうなん】の【方向：ほうこう】に【風：かぜ】をふかせ　\n【火：ひ】の【玉：たま】を【飛：と】ばす【必要：ひつよう】がある
Translated Text: You need to make the wind blow toward\nthe southeast and launch a fireball.

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…お【前：まえ】は\n【不可能：ふかのう】を【可能：かのう】にする【男：おとこ】と【聞：き】いた
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming… I’ve heard you’re the\nman who makes the impossible possible.

Original Text: いや～　やっと　【私：わたくし】のことを\nわかってくれる【方：かた】に【出会：であ】えましたね！
Translated Text: Wow—I finally met someone\nwho really understands me!

Original Text: このジバ【野郎：やろう】　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】って【呼：よ】ぶわりには\n【私：わたくし】をまったく【尊敬：そんけい】していないんです
Translated Text: That jerk—for someone who calls\nhimself a "genius strategist," he\ndoesn't respect me at all.

Original Text: うるさいニャン！
Translated Text: Shut up, kitty!

Original Text: ならば\n【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】をふかせてくれるな？
Translated Text: In that case, why don't you\nlet the southeast wind blow?

Original Text: 【当然：とうぜん】です！\nそんなの【簡単：かんたん】…　え？　えええー？
Translated Text:
Of course!
That's easy... Huh? What?!

Original Text: どーしましょ～！？\nもし【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】が　ふかなかったら…
Translated Text:
What should we do~!?
What if the southeast wind doesn't blow…

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】は　【処刑：しょけい】だそうです～！
Translated Text: Apparently, I'm going to be executed!

Original Text: ま…　【妖怪：ようかい】だから\n【処刑：しょけい】されても【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】ニャン？
Translated Text: Well... since I'm a Yo-kai, it's okay\nif I get executed, right, meow?

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】じゃありませんってば！\nこうなりゃ【意地：いじ】でも【風：かぜ】をふかせますよ！
Translated Text:
I'm telling you, it's not okay!
At this point, I'll make the
wind blow no matter what!

Original Text: でも　どうするダニ？\n【風向：かぜむ】きを【変：か】えるなんて【無理：むり】ダニ…
Translated Text:
But what are we going to do, Dani?
There's no way we can change
the wind direction, Dani…

Original Text: お【待：ま】ちください…\nめいそうに【入：はい】ります…
Translated Text: Please wait... I'm going to meditate...

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】が【目：め】をつぶって\nなんか　ぶつぶつ【言：い】ってるズラ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming has his\neyes closed and is muttering\nsomething under his breath!

Original Text: ポクポクポク…\nチーーン！　ひらめいた！
Translated Text:
Tap, tap, tap…
Ding! I’ve got it!

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】に【関係：かんけい】する【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の\n【力：ちから】を【借：か】りるんです！
Translated Text: We'll enlist the help of\na wind-related Yo-kai!

Original Text: ふぁあああ～　ニャるほど～\nそりゃあ　いい【考：かんが】えニャ～ン
Translated Text: Faaaaah~ I see~ That's\na great idea, meow~

Original Text: …あくびをしなーい！\nアナタたちにも【手伝：てつだ】ってもらいますよ
Translated Text:
…Don't yawn!
I'm counting on you guys to help out, too.

Original Text: えーー　なんでオレっちがー？\nこれを【頼：たの】まれたのは　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ニャンよ？
Translated Text:
"Whaaaat? Why me?
This was supposed to be for
Genius Strategist Nyan, right?"

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】たちはもう　きってもきれない【仲：なか】！\n【私：わたくし】は【水：みず】　アナタは【魚：さかな】　って【言：い】ったでしょ！
Translated Text:
We're inseparable now!
I told you—I'm water, and you're a fish!

Original Text: オレっち　【魚：さかな】は【好：す】きだけど\n【水：みず】は　にがてニャン…
Translated Text: Meow... I like fish, but\nI'm not a fan of water...

Original Text: そんなこたぁ　\nどうでもいいんですってば！
Translated Text: I'm telling you, that doesn't matter at all!

Original Text: さあ！　【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nさがしに【行：い】きますよ！
Translated Text: All right! Let's go find the\nwind-controlling warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: やあやあ　どうもどうも
Translated Text: Hey there, hey there. Thanks, thanks.

Original Text: そこにいるのは\n【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さんではないですか？
Translated Text: Isn't that Tengu Ma Su over there?

Original Text: そうだが…\n【貴様：きさま】　いったい【何者：なにもの】だ？
Translated Text:
That's true... but who the hell are you
?

Original Text: あやしい【者：もの】じゃございません！\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text:
I'm not a suspicious character!
I'm just looking for a
warrior-Yo-kai who can control
the wind…

Original Text: 【断：ことわ】る
Translated Text: Decline

Original Text: ほんのちょっとだけ！\nちょっと【手伝：てつだ】ってもらうだけですから…
Translated Text:
Just a little bit!
I just need you to help me out a little…

Original Text: お【断：ことわ】りだ
Translated Text: No way.

Original Text: こまったズラね…
Translated Text: That's a tough one...

Original Text: それにしても【態度：たいど】がデカいダニ！\nさすがは【天狗：てんぐ】！！
Translated Text:
Still, that tick sure is cocky!
Just like a tengu!!

Original Text: なんだと？
Translated Text: What?

Original Text: わーー！　【今：いま】のなし！\n【今言：いまい】ったことは　【忘：わす】れてくださ…
Translated Text:
Whoa! Never mind that!
Please forget what I just said…

Original Text: あーーもう　じれったいニャン！
Translated Text: Aaaah, this is so frustrating, meow!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！\nここは【力：ちから】ずくでいくしかないニャン！
Translated Text:
Whisper, Kongming! We've
got no choice but to take
this by force, meow!

Original Text: ほう　このオレとやろうってか？\n【面白：おもしろ】い…　かかってこい！
Translated Text:
Oh, so you want to take me on?
That's interesting... Bring it on!

Original Text: フン　なかなかやるな…\n【仕方：しかた】ない　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもいいぞ
Translated Text:
Hmph... Not bad...
I guess I have no choice.
I'll lend you a hand.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございますー！\nおかげで　【結界：けっかい】もなんとかできそうですー！
Translated Text:
Oh, thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I think I'll be able
to set up the barrier after all!

Original Text: ただ　そんな【大風：おおかぜ】…\nオレだけじゃ【力不足：ちからぶそく】だ
Translated Text:
But with winds that
strong… I can't handle it on
my own.

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【力：ちから】…\nもっと【集：あつ】めたほうがいいかもな
Translated Text:
The power of the wind-controlling
warrior-Yo-kai… Maybe I should gather
more of it.

Original Text: でも　まったく\n【手：て】がかりがないニャン…
Translated Text: But I don't have a single clue, meow...

Original Text: だったら　ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】に\n【会：あ】いにいけ
Translated Text: In that case, go see the immortal Zaci.

Original Text: 【仙人：せんにん】！\nなんだか【物知：ものし】りそうダニ！
Translated Text:
Sage!
You seem like you know a lot, don't you!

Original Text: あの【仙人：せんにん】なら　【貴様：きさま】らに\nきっと【道：みち】を【示：しめ】してくれるはずだ
Translated Text: That hermit will surely show you the way.

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さん　ありがとズラ！
Translated Text: Tengu Ba Su, thanks a bunch!

Original Text: よーし　そうと【決：き】まれば…
Translated Text: All right, now that it's decided...

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】のとこへ\nレッツゴーだニャン！
Translated Text: Let's go see the immortal Zaci, Meow!

Original Text: みなさん…　【私：わたくし】のためにそこまで…\nやはり【持：も】つべき【者：もの】は　ともだち…！
Translated Text:
Everyone… Going to such
lengths for me… Friends
really are the best thing in life…!

Original Text: って　あれ？　ちょっとー！\n【私：わたくし】を【置：お】いていかないでー！
Translated Text:
Wait... Huh? Hey! Don't leave
me behind!

Original Text: フフフ…　お【主：ぬし】たちの【願：ねが】いは\nすでに　もうわかっておる
Translated Text: Heh heh heh… I already know\nwhat you’re wishing for.

Original Text: そこの【白：しろ】いの…\nお【主：ぬし】の【命：いのち】が　かかっておるのじゃろ？
Translated Text:
That white thing over there…
Your life depends on it, doesn't it?

Original Text: さっすが【仙人様：せんにんさま】！\nそれでは【私：わたくし】を【助：たす】けてくださ…
Translated Text:
As expected of you, Sage!
Well then, please help me…

Original Text: ダル～～～ん\nめんどうくさそうだから　お【断：ことわ】りじゃ
Translated Text: Ugh... that sounds like\na hassle, so I'll pass.

Original Text: え…！？　そんなーーっ！
Translated Text: Huh…!? No wayyyy!

Original Text: ただ…ワシを【楽：たの】しませることができたら\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもよいぞ
Translated Text: But… if you can entertain me,\nI might just lend you a hand.

Original Text: さて　どうする？
Translated Text: So, what should we do?

Original Text: やります！　【楽：たの】しませます！\nおもに　このジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】が！
Translated Text:
We're going to do it! We'll entertain you!
Mainly this Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: ニャニー！？
Translated Text: What the...!?

Original Text: ほっほっほ\nでは…　【楽：たの】しませてもらおうかのう！
Translated Text: Ho ho ho... Well then... I\nsuppose I'll have some fun!

Original Text: なんじゃ　ワシみたいに　【首：くび】を【飛：と】ばしたり\nツルやヒツジに【化：ば】けたりはできんのか
Translated Text: What's the deal? Can't you do stuff\nlike me—like making your head fly off\nor turning into a crane or a sheep?

Original Text: ！！　そんなことができるのは\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】だけでうぃすー！
Translated Text: !! Only a sage can do\nsomething like that, you know!

Original Text: …まあ　お【主：ぬし】らの【必死：ひっし】なさまは\n【面白：おもしろ】かった
Translated Text: …Well, it was funny to see\nyou guys trying so hard.

Original Text: 【願：ねが】いをかなえてやろう
Translated Text: I'll make your wish come true.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございます！
Translated Text: Oh, thank you!

Original Text: じつは　【我：われわれ】々\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text: Actually, we're looking for a\nmilitary commander-type Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind…

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さん【以外：いがい】に\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】は　ご【存知：ぞんじ】ないかと…
Translated Text: I was wondering if you knew of any\nother immortals besides Tengu Ba Su...

Original Text: …かぜカモ【劉琦：りゅうき】に\n【会：あ】いにいくがいい
Translated Text: …Go on, go see Liu Qi, the “Wind Duck.”

Original Text: おお！　ではその【方：かた】が\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…！？
Translated Text: Wow! So that person is a warrior-Yo-kai\nwho controls the wind…!?

Original Text: ほっほっほ…\nそれは【行：い】けば　わかるじゃろうて
Translated Text:
Ho ho ho… Well, you’ll
find out once you get
there, won’t you?

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈様：せんにんさじさま】！\nこのご【恩：おん】は【一生：いっしょう】　【忘：わす】れません！
Translated Text:
Master Zici, the One-Eyed
Immortal! I will never forget
this kindness for the rest of my life!

Original Text: かぜカモ【劉琦殿：りゅうきどの】！\nお【願：ねが】いがあって【参：まい】りました！
Translated Text:
Lord Liu Qi of Kazekamo!
I’ve come to ask you for a favor!

Original Text: かぜカモ…\n【手：て】みじかに　お【願：ねが】いね
Translated Text:
A cold, maybe...
Just a quick favor, okay?

Original Text: …というわけで
Translated Text: …So,

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】をあやつる【強力：きょうりょく】な【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nさがしてます！
Translated Text: I'm looking for a powerful warrior-Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind!

Original Text: アナタ　【知：し】ってますよね？
Translated Text: You know that, right?

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る？　ボクはみんなを\n【風邪：かぜ】っぽくするだけカモ
Translated Text: Control the wind? Maybe I just\nmake everyone feel like they're\ncoming down with a cold.

Original Text: ニャンと…！　\nそれって　まさか…
Translated Text:
Wow...
! Could it be...

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】じゃなくて\n「【風邪：かぜ】」を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】ってことダニ？
Translated Text: So he's a military\ncommander-Yo-kai who controls\n"colds" rather than the wind, right?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】さん…\nかわいそうズラ…
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming... Poor guy...

Original Text: あ　あ　あのジジイーーーーっ！\nテキトーなこと【教：おし】えやがって～！！
Translated Text:
"Hey... hey... you old geezer!!!
How dare you teach me such
nonsense~!!"

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nしょうがないニャン！
Translated Text:
You're such a genius strategist!
Oh well, meow!

Original Text: とりあえず\n【今：いま】の【戦力：せんりょく】でなんとかするニャン！
Translated Text: For now, let's just make do\nwith what we've got, meow!

Original Text: 【人：ひと】ごとだと【思：おも】って！　このままだと…\n【私：わたくし】　【処刑：しょけい】ですよ　しょ・け・い！
Translated Text:
Don't act like this has nothing to
do with you! If things keep going
like this... I'm going to be
executed. E-x-e-c-u-t-i-o-n!

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】の【力：ちから】を【借：か】りれば\n【風：かぜ】は【起：お】こせるダニ！
Translated Text: If I get some help from Tengu Ba\nSu, I can make the wind blow, Dani!

Original Text: そうズラ！\n【後：あと】はオラたちがなんとかするズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right! We'll take care of
the rest!

Original Text: そんなこと【言：い】ったって\nどうにもなりませーん！　うわーん！
Translated Text: Saying that won't change a thing! Waaah!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！
Translated Text: Whisper, Kongming!

Original Text: 【天才：てんさい】なら…　どんなピンチも\nその【頭：あたま】で【切：き】りぬけるニャン！
Translated Text: If you're a genius... you can use your\nbrain to get out of any tight spot, meow!

Original Text: はっ
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【思：おも】わず　【取：と】り【乱：みだ】してしまいました…\nお【見苦：みぐる】しい【限：かぎ】りでうぃす…
Translated Text:
I lost my cool without meaning to… I’m
so embarrassed…

Original Text: では　さっそく　【帰：かえ】って\n【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせんをねりましょう！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get right to it and come up\nwith a plan to break through the barrier!

Original Text: あの～
Translated Text: Um...

Original Text: アナタはお【呼：よ】びじゃありません！
Translated Text: You're not invited!

Original Text: …【一応：いちおう】　ついていくカモ
Translated Text: …I guess I'll go along with it.

Original Text: ボクの【結界：けっかい】をやぶるなんて…\n【少：すこ】しは　デキる【連中：れんちゅう】みたいだね
Translated Text:
To break through my barrier...
Looks like you guys are pretty
capable, don't you?

Original Text: でも　まだまださくせんはある\n【安心：あんしん】してよ　フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】
Translated Text: But I still have plenty of strategies up my\nsleeve, so don't worry, Fu Nyang Cao Cao.

Original Text: ばっふぅぅう～～～ん…！
Translated Text: Baaaaaahhh~~~!…!

Original Text: なっ！？\nフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！？
Translated Text:
What!?
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【動：うご】きが\n【活発：かっぱつ】になってきた
Translated Text: Fu Nyang: Cao Cao's army\nhas become more active.

Original Text: …【主人公妖怪名】\nヤツらの【狙：ねら】いは　お【前：まえ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ
Translated Text: 【主人公妖怪名】…They're after your gem.

Original Text: ニャン？
Translated Text: Meow?

Original Text: まさか…！？
Translated Text: No way…!?

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】は【今：いま】まで\nそんな【野心：やしん】を【見：み】せていなかった
Translated Text: Fuyunian Cao Cao had never\nshown such ambition before.

Original Text: だが　【宝珠狩：ほうじゅが】りに【反対：はんたい】した\nキュウビ【荀彧：じゅんいく】を【牢：ろう】に【入：い】れたらしい
Translated Text: However, it seems he had\nKyuubi Jun Iku, who opposed the\njewel hunt, thrown into prison.

Original Text: ヤツは【本気：ほんき】だ\nこれは【全面戦争：ぜんめんせんそう】になる…
Translated Text: He's serious. This is\ngoing to be all-out war...

Original Text: ここは\nオレっちにまかせるニャン！
Translated Text: Leave this to me, meow!

Original Text: どこに【行：い】くつもりだ？
Translated Text: Where are you going?

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【目的：もくてき】がオレっちの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】なら\nひとりで【会：あ】いにいくニャン！
Translated Text: If the enemy's after my gem, I'll\ngo face them all by myself, meow!

Original Text: ……【何：なに】をカッコつけている
Translated Text: ……Why are you trying to act so cool?

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】に【今：いま】\nくたばってもらっては【困：こま】るんだ
Translated Text: I can't have the hero dying right now.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】たちも【協力：きょうりょく】する
Translated Text: We'll help, too.

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…
Translated Text: Orochi Zhou Yu…

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】たちも\n【忘：わす】れてもらっちゃ【困：こま】るのだ！
Translated Text: You can't just forget about\nRyu-kun, Liu Yu, and the others!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメラ！\n（オレたちも【当然：とうぜん】　【行：い】くぜ！）
Translated Text:
Fire, fire!
(Of course we're going too!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は…　【一緒：いっしょ】だぜ！
Translated Text: When we die… we'll be together!

Original Text: みんな…
Translated Text: Everyone…

Original Text: 【前：まえ】にも【言：い】いました\n【私：わたくし】たちは【水：みず】と【魚：さかな】の【関係：かんけい】だと！
Translated Text: As I've said before,\nwe're like water and fish!

Original Text: どんなにウザがられても…\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】について【行：い】くでうぃすー！
Translated Text:
No matter how much people get
annoyed with me… I’m sticking with
Jibanyan Liu Bei, y’all!

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】…
Translated Text: Stratège de génie…

Original Text: こっちのともだちも\nいいもんダニね！
Translated Text: My friends over here are pretty great, too!

Original Text: もんげー\nステキな【関係：かんけい】ズラ！
Translated Text: What an awesome relationship!

Original Text: …みんな　ありがとニャン！\nもう【少：すこ】しだけ【力：ちから】を【借：か】りるニャン！
Translated Text:
…Thanks, everyone, meow!
I’ll need a little more help, meow!

Original Text: じゃあ　【行：い】くニャンよ！\n【目指：めざ】すはフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】ニャン！
Translated Text:
Well then, let's go, meow! Our target
is Fu-nyan Cao Cao, meow!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\n【決着：けっちゃく】をつけるニャン！
Translated Text:
Fuyunyan Cao Cao!
Let's settle this, meow!

Original Text: フフフ…でふー！
Translated Text: Hehehe… Phew!

Original Text: ニャ！\nいきなりゲップとは　【失礼：しつれい】ニャン！
Translated Text:
Meow!
Burping out of the blue
like that—how rude, meow!

Original Text: ち　ちがうダニ！
Translated Text: No, that's a different kind of mite!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】の【体：からだ】…\nみるみる【大：おお】きくなってるダニ！
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang, Cao Cao's body...
The tick is getting bigger right
before our eyes!

Original Text: ニャ？　ニャニャニャー！！
Translated Text: Meow? Meow-meow-meow!!

Original Text: でふ～！\nデカニャン【曹操：そうそう】でふ～！
Translated Text:
Defu~!
It's Big Cat Cao Cao, defu~!

Original Text: もんげーー！　オラのお【母：かあ】ちゃんみたいに\nデッカくなっちまったズラ～！！
Translated Text: Whoa! This wig's gotten\nas huge as my mom!!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】～！\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【全部：ぜんぶ】くれでふ～！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei~! Give me all the
orbs, please~!

Original Text: や　やったニャン…
Translated Text: Y-Yay, meow…

Original Text: デカニャン【曹操：そうそう】が\nしぼんでいくダニ！
Translated Text: Dekanyan Cao Cao is shrinking like a tick!

Original Text: …\nオレはいったい【何：なに】を…
Translated Text:
…What on earth
am I…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\nどうやら【正気：しょうき】に【戻：もど】ったみたいだね
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!
Looks like he's come to his senses.

Original Text: これで【一件落着：いっけんらくちゃく】ズラ！
Translated Text: That settles it, then!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: ついに　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が【全部集：ぜんぶあつ】まったダニ！\nさっそく【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るダニー！
Translated Text:
Danny has finally collected all the orbs!
Now he's heading right
back to his original world!

Original Text: そうズラね！\nきっと　みんな【心配：しんぱい】してるズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right!
I'm sure everyone's worried!

Original Text: でも…　いざ【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【使：つか】うとなると\nニャンか　ちょっと…
Translated Text: But… when it actually comes time\nto use the jewel, I feel a little…

Original Text: わかります！　わかりますとも！\n【私：わたくし】との【別：わか】れが　【心苦：こころぐる】しいのですね！？
Translated Text:
I get it! I totally get it!
It’s hard for you to say
goodbye to me, isn’t it!?

Original Text: ご【心配：しんぱい】なく！　【必要：ひつよう】とあらば\n【私：わたくし】も【一緒：いっしょ】に　そちらの【世界：せかい】へ…！！
Translated Text: Don't worry! If necessary, I'll\ngo with you to that world...!!

Original Text: それは　ごめんだニャン…
Translated Text: No way, meow…

Original Text: なんで～！
Translated Text: Why~!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\n【体：からだ】には　【気：き】をつけるのだ！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei!
Take care of yourself!

Original Text: さよならは【言：い】わないっス！\nきっと　また【会：あ】えるっスから！
Translated Text:
I'm not saying goodbye!
I'm sure we'll meet again!

Original Text: うん…　そうニャンね！
Translated Text: Hmm... Yeah, meow!

Original Text: オレっち…　あっちでも\n【優：やさ】しくて【強：つよ】い【男：おとこ】になるニャン！
Translated Text: Me... I'm gonna be a kind and\nstrong guy over there, too, meow!

Original Text: メラメラ…　メラメラ！\n（どこに【行：い】っても…　ともだちだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze... Blaze!
(No matter where I go... you're my friend!)

Original Text: ブラザー！\nオレたちのこと　【忘：わす】れんなよ！
Translated Text:
Bro!
Don't forget about us!

Original Text: わかってるニャン！\n【三人：さんにん】の【誓：ちか】いは　えいえんニャン！
Translated Text:
I know, meow!
Our trio's vow is eternal, meow!

Original Text: 【結局：けっきょく】　お【主：ぬし】への【借：か】り\n【返：かえ】すことができなんだな…
Translated Text: So, in the end, I wasn't\nable to pay you back...

Original Text: もうケンカしねえから\nそれで【勘弁：かんべん】してくれ
Translated Text: I won't fight anymore, so\nplease cut me some slack.

Original Text: そうニャン！
Translated Text: That's right, meow!

Original Text: まんじゅうは　つぶあんも\nこしあんも　どっちでも【最高：さいこう】ニャン！
Translated Text: Manju—whether it's with chunky red\nbean paste or smooth red bean\npaste—is the best either way, meow!

Original Text: じゃあ…みんな！\nオレっちたち　そろそろ【行：い】くニャン！
Translated Text:
Well then… everyone!
We're about to head out, meow!

Original Text: コマさん！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！
Translated Text: Komasan! USA!

Original Text: ズラ！　いよいよ\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】にお【祈：いの】りをするズラね！
Translated Text: Zura! It's finally time to\npray to the jewel, Zura!

Original Text: ふたりとも　どうやって【祈：いの】るか　\nちゃんと　おぼえてるダニ？
Translated Text: Do you two still remember\nexactly how to pray, Dani?

Original Text: えーっと…\nいでよ　【神様：かみさま】！
Translated Text:
Um... Come
forth, God!

Original Text: ミーたちの【願：ねが】い…
Translated Text: Our wishes…

Original Text: かなえたまえ！　ズラーー！！
Translated Text: Make it happen! Zuuuuu!!

Original Text: も　もんげー…
Translated Text: Wow...

Original Text: そ　【空：そら】に【島：しま】が…\n【浮：う】かんでるニャン……！
Translated Text:
Wha—there's an island...
floating in the sky, meow...!

Original Text: あははははは！
Translated Text: Hahahahahaha!

Original Text: 【見：み】るダニ！\nあいつら　【戻：もど】ってきたダニッ
Translated Text:
Look at those ticks!
They're back, man!

Original Text: キミたち　ぽかーんとしてるね…\nま　ムリもないか…
Translated Text:
You guys look kind of dumbfounded…
Well, I guess I can’t blame you…

Original Text: 【説明：せつめい】してやるしかないっしょ\nよーく【聞：き】いておけよ！
Translated Text: I guess I'll just have to explain\nit to you. Listen carefully!

Original Text: この『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』は\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】が【作：つく】り【出：だ】した【本：ほん】！
Translated Text: This *Yo-kai Sangokushi* is a\nbook created by King Enma!

Original Text: もんげー！！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: 【強大：きょうだい】な【力：ちから】を【持：も】ちすぎた　ボクら【兄弟：きょうだい】を\n【封：ふう】じ【込：こ】めるためにね
Translated Text: To seal away us brothers, who\nhad become far too powerful...

Original Text: 【自力：じりき】で【出：で】たいと【思：おも】ってたんだけど　さすがは\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】の【本：ほん】　そう【簡単：かんたん】にはいかなかった
Translated Text: I was hoping to get out on my own,\nbut—as you’d expect from a book\nby King Enma—it wasn’t that easy.

Original Text: でもよ　【長：なが】～い【時間：じかん】がたったせいか\n【最近：さいきん】　【封印：ふういん】の【力：ちから】が【弱：よわ】まってるんだ！
Translated Text: But you know what? Maybe because so\nmuch time has passed, the power of the\nseal has been getting weaker lately!

Original Text: その【証拠：しょうこ】に…\nオレたちの【妖気：ようき】　【本：ほん】の【外：そと】に【出：で】てたっしょ？
Translated Text:
As proof of that…
our demonic energy was
leaking out of the book, right?

Original Text: まさか…　それで\nケータたちが　【変：へん】になったのかニャン！？
Translated Text: No way... Is that why Keita and the\nothers turned out so weird, meow!?

Original Text: ご【名答：めいとう】！
Translated Text: That's the right answer!

Original Text: もう　この【本：ほん】に\nボクらを【抑：おさ】え【続：つづ】ける【力：ちから】はないんだ
Translated Text: This book no longer has\nthe power to hold us back.

Original Text: そんな【今：いま】なら…\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めて【祈：いの】れば…
Translated Text:
If I do it now… if I gather the
orbs and pray…

Original Text: 【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】に\n【出：で】られると【思：おも】ってね
Translated Text: I thought I'd be able to go\nout into the world, you see

Original Text: あわわ…\nそうなったら　【大変：たいへん】ダニ…！
Translated Text:
Oh no... If
that happens, it'll be a real disaster...!

Original Text: なんとか１【個集：こあつ】めたんだけど\nだれかさんに　ジャマされてねえ…
Translated Text: I managed to collect one, but\nsomeone got in the way...

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】…\n【知：し】ってるっしょ？
Translated Text:
Chairman Dong Zhuo of the Ikakamone...
You know who he is, right?

Original Text: あいつに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めてもらおうと\n【思：おも】ったのに…　くそっ…
Translated Text: I was counting on him to collect\nthe orbs for me... Damn it...

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【時：とき】も\nやってくれたね…
Translated Text: They did that for Li Ru in\n"Dondoro" too, didn't they…

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【妖気：ようき】で【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【力：ちから】が\n【弱：よわ】まって　いけると【思：おも】ったら…
Translated Text: Li Ru's demonic aura was gradually\nweakening the power of the jewel, and\njust when I thought I was about to make it...

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をかっさらわれた…
Translated Text: The jewel was stolen...

Original Text: だから　ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】…
Translated Text: So, Jibanyan Liu Bei…

Original Text: キミたちが【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めるのを【待：ま】って\nまとめてうばおうと【思：おも】ってさ
Translated Text: I was planning to wait for you\nguys to collect the orbs so I\ncould steal them all at once.

Original Text: さあ　のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nもちろん　するっしょ？
Translated Text:
Alright, it's a do-or-die showdown!
Of course you're in, right?

Original Text: ニャンで　そうなるニャ～ン！？
Translated Text: Why on earth would that happen, meow~!?

Original Text: やっぱり　そうだよね…　でも…\nこの【勝負：しょうぶ】…
Translated Text:
I guess that’s how it is… But…
this match…

Original Text: へへっ\n【強制的：きょうせいてき】に　【受：う】けてもらうからな
Translated Text: Heh heh... I'm going to\nmake you take it, you know.

Original Text: じゃあ　おたがい　がんばろう\nはあ…　【早：はや】く【終：お】わるといいな…
Translated Text: Well then, let's both do our best.\nSigh... I hope this ends soon...

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】にビッグボスが【出現：しゅつげん】し\n【暴：あば】れまわっているようです！
Translated Text: It looks like Big Bosses are appearing\nall over the place and running amok!

Original Text: ノルカ【軍：ぐん】がさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】と【団々坂：だんだんざか】を\n【攻：せ】めており…
Translated Text: The Norka Army is attacking the Sakura\nResidential District and Dandan-zaka…

Original Text: ソルカ【軍：ぐん】がおつかい【横丁：よこちょう】と\nさくら【中央：ちゅうおう】シティをこうげき【中：ちゅう】です
Translated Text: The Solka Army is currently attacking\nOtsukai Yokocho and Sakura Central City.

Original Text: まず　そいつらを【倒：たお】すニャン！
Translated Text: First, let's take those guys down, meow!

Original Text: せっかくここまで\nみんなで【戦：たたか】ってきたニャン！
Translated Text: We've all fought our way\nthis far, after all, meow!

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】の【最後：さいご】に　この【国：くに】を\n【見捨：みす】てるわけにはいかないニャン！
Translated Text: At the very last moment, I just\ncan't abandon this country, meow!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】…
Translated Text: Jibanyan Liu Bei…

Original Text: ニャハハハ！　オレっちはエーユー！\nみんなのために【戦：たたか】うニャンよ！！
Translated Text:
Meow ha ha ha! I'm AU!
I'm fighting for all of you, meow!!

Original Text: それに　ノルカやソルカが\n【外：そと】に【出：で】たら【大変：たいへん】ニャン！
Translated Text: Besides, it would be a disaster\nif Norka or Solka got out!

Original Text: さあ　もう【一回：いっかい】\nさくら【国：こく】の【平和：へいわ】を【取：と】りもどすニャン！
Translated Text: Alright, let's restore peace to\nSakura Country once again, meow!

Original Text: なんニャン？\nもう【戦：たたか】いは【始：はじ】まってるニャンよ！
Translated Text:
What's up, meow? The battle has
already begun, meow!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】…\n【今度：こんど】の【相手：あいて】はきびしすぎるダニ…
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei…
This opponent is way too tough, Dani…

Original Text: ニャン！？
Translated Text: Meow!?

Original Text: オラも　おっかねぇズラ…\n【戦：たたか】う【勇気：ゆうき】が【出：で】ないズラ…
Translated Text:
Man, this is scary... I just
can't find the courage to
fight...

Original Text: ニャニャ！？
Translated Text: Meow, meow!?

Original Text: ミーたちは\nこの【世界：せかい】の【妖怪：ようかい】じゃないダニ
Translated Text: We're not Yo-kai from this world, Dani.

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】は\nどうしてそこまで　がんばれるダニ？
Translated Text: How does Jibanyan Liu Bei\nmanage to work so hard, Dan?

Original Text: たしかに【最初：さいしょ】は　オレっちも\nどーでもいいと【思：おも】ったニャン
Translated Text: It's true—at first, even I\ndidn't really care, meow.

Original Text: あの【時：とき】は　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にもどることで\n【頭：あたま】が　いっぱいだったからニャン…
Translated Text: Back then, all I could think about was\ngetting back to my original world, meow…

Original Text: でも…
Translated Text: But…

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】にいっぱい【会：あ】って\nいっぱい【助：たす】けられて…
Translated Text: I've met so many military\ncommanders and Yo-kai in this world,\nand they've helped me so much...

Original Text: オレっち…　この【国：くに】のみんなのこと\n【大好：だいす】きになったニャン！
Translated Text: Me... I've come to love\neveryone in this country, meow!

Original Text: そして　この【国：くに】のエーユーになりたいと\n【本気：ほんき】で【思：おも】ったニャン！
Translated Text: And I seriously thought, “I want to\nbe an AU in this country!” Meow!

Original Text: でも…　ここでオラたちが\n【倒：たお】れちまったら…
Translated Text: But… if we were to go down right here…

Original Text: もう　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】には【帰：かえ】れない…\nケータには【会：あ】えないズラよ？
Translated Text:
I can't go back to my old world
anymore... I won't be able to see
Keita, will I?

Original Text: ケータ…
Translated Text: Keta…

Original Text: でも…！　きっとケータも\nオレっちと【同：おな】じことをするはずニャン！
Translated Text: But…! I'm sure Keita would do\nthe same thing as me, meow!

Original Text: ケータは　パッと【見：み】フツーだけど…\n【優：やさ】しくて【強：つよ】い【心：こころ】を【持：も】ってるニャン！
Translated Text:
At first glance, Keita seems like
an ordinary guy… but he’s actually
kind and has a strong heart, meow!

Original Text: わかったダニ\nミーも【一緒：いっしょ】に【戦：たたか】うダニ！
Translated Text: Got it, Danimi! I'll fight alongside you, Dan!

Original Text: あきらめず　【前：まえ】にすすむ！\nそうすれば　きっと【道：みち】は【開：ひら】けるダニ！
Translated Text:
Don't give up—keep moving forward!
If you do, the path will
surely open up, Dani!

Original Text: オラも…\nせいいっぱい　やるズラ！
Translated Text:
I'm gonna... give it my all
, too!

Original Text: コマじろうもきっと…
Translated Text: Komajiro must surely...

Original Text: 「【兄：にい】ちゃん　もんげー！」って\nよろこんでくれるズラよ！
Translated Text: "Big bro, this is awesome!"—that's\nthe kind of reaction I get!

Original Text: みんな！　【行：い】くニャンよ！
Translated Text: Hey, everyone! Let's go, meow!

Original Text: ミーたちのすごさ　ノルカとソルカに\nわからせてやるダニ！
Translated Text: We're gonna show Norka and Solka\njust how awesome we are, Dani!

Original Text: ズラズラー！
Translated Text: Whoosh!

Original Text: ビッグボス…\n【全員：ぜんいん】　やっつけたニャン！
Translated Text:
Big Boss…
I took them all down, meow!

Original Text: みなさん　お【見事：みごと】です！
Translated Text: Way to go, everyone!

Original Text: ノルカソルカの【封印境：ふういんきょう】への【道：みち】が\n【開：ひら】けましたよー！
Translated Text: The path to the Sealed Realm\nof Norukasoruka has opened!

Original Text: ニャー！\n【今：いま】こそ【突：つ】っこむニャーン！
Translated Text:
Meow!
Now's the time to jump in, meow!

Original Text: あいつら\nふっかつしてるニャン！？
Translated Text: Are those guys back, meow!?

Original Text: ええ！\nノルカソルカは【双子：ふたご】…
Translated Text:
Really?!
Norka and Sorka are twins…

Original Text: 【一方：いっぽう】だけを【倒：たお】しても\n【片方：かたほう】さえ【無事：ぶじ】なら　ふっかつするのです！
Translated Text: Even if you defeat just one of\nthem, as long as the other\none is still alive, it will revive!

Original Text: そういうことは【早：はや】く【言：い】えニャン！
Translated Text: You should've said that sooner, meow!

Original Text: いでえーー！
Translated Text: Ouch!

Original Text: で　でも　ご【安心：あんしん】を…\nさくせんがあります…
Translated Text:
But... don't worry... I have a
plan...

Original Text: ヤツらは【倒：たお】された【日：ひ】の\n【二日後：ふつかご】にふっかつします
Translated Text: They'll come back to life two\ndays after they're defeated.

Original Text: つまり！　【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】した【次：つぎ】の【日：ひ】に\nもう【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】せば…
Translated Text: In other words! If you defeat one and\nthen defeat the other the very next day…

Original Text: ふっかつしないニャン？
Translated Text: Won't you come back, kitty?

Original Text: そのとおりでうぃすー！
Translated Text: That's right, y'all!

Original Text: のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nオレっちたちの【勝：か】ちニャン！
Translated Text:
It's a do-or-die showdown!
We're gonna win, meow!

Original Text: やったダニ！\n【今度：こんど】こそ【本当：ほんとう】に【終：お】わりダニ！
Translated Text:
Yes, mites!
This time it's really over, mites!

Original Text: これで　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】れるズラね～！
Translated Text: So I guess I can go back to my original world now~!

Original Text: ん…？\nニャニャニャニャー！？
Translated Text:
Hmm…?
Meow, meow, meow, meow!?

Original Text: じ　【地震：じしん】ダニー！
Translated Text: Oh, an earthquake, Danny!

Original Text: もんげー！\nし　【島：しま】がー　【島：しま】がー！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
The island—the island!

Original Text: お　【驚：おどろ】いてるヒマはないニャン！\nヤツらが【逃：に】げてしまうニャン！
Translated Text:
There's no time to be surprised, meow!
They're going to get away, meow!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: どうやら　ふたりは【合体：がったい】し\nノルカソルカとなったようです！
Translated Text: It looks like the two of them have\nmerged to become Norukasoruka!

Original Text: どんなヤツが【相手：あいて】でも\nオレっちたちは【怖：こわ】くないニャン！
Translated Text: No matter who we're up against,\nwe're not scared, meow!

Original Text: そうダニ！　ミーたちには\n【頼：たよ】れる【仲間：なかま】がいっぱいいるダニ！
Translated Text: That's right, Dani! We've got lots\nof friends we can count on, Dani!

Original Text: チーム『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』ズラ！
Translated Text: Team "Yo-kai Sangokushi"—Here We Go!

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】こそ　【最後：さいご】の【戦：たたか】いニャン！\nみんな　【気合：きあい】いれていくニャンよ！
Translated Text:
This time, it's the final battle, meow!
Everyone, let's give it our all, meow!

Original Text: まかせるダニ！
Translated Text: Leave it to me, Danni!

Original Text: いくズラよ～！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: ちょっと　ウィスパー…\nこの【結末：けつまつ】　どういうことなの？
Translated Text:
Hey, Whisper... What's the deal with this
ending?

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】たちは\n【本：ほん】の【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うことを【選：えら】んだようです…
Translated Text: It seems that Jibanyan, Liu Bei,\nand the others have chosen to\nsave the world of the book…

Original Text: つまり…\nもうこちらにはもどってこないと…
Translated Text:
So... you're not coming back here anymore
...

Original Text: ウィスパー…\nジバニャンがこの【本：ほん】に【入：はい】ったって…
Translated Text:
Whisper… I heard
Jibanyan went inside this book…

Original Text: ウソだよね？
Translated Text: You're kidding, right?

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】…
Translated Text: Keta...

Original Text: このジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】が\nジバニャンだなんて…　ウソだよね？
Translated Text: This Jibanyan Liu Bei is actually\nJibanyan… You’re kidding, right?

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】…\n【残念：ざんねん】ながら…
Translated Text:
Keta... Unfortunately
...

Original Text: そんなのイヤだよ！\nジバニャン！　ジバニャーン！
Translated Text:
I don't want that!
Jibanyan! Jibanyan!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】も【悲：かな】しいです！\nですが　それが【彼：かれ】の【決断：けつだん】！
Translated Text:
I'm sad too!
But that's his decision!

Original Text: 【納得：なっとく】できないよ…\nそうだ…！　【今：いま】こそ…！
Translated Text:
I just can't accept this
... That's it...! Now's the time...!

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: オレのともだち！　【出：で】てこい　ジバニャン！\n【妖怪：ようかい】メダル　セットオン！
Translated Text:
My friend! Come out, Jibanyan!
Yo-kai Medal, Set On!

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】…　お【気持：きも】ちはわかりますが\n【妖怪：ようかい】ウォッチで【呼：よ】び【出：だ】しても…
Translated Text: Keta... I understand how you feel, but even\nif you summon them with Yo-kai Watch...

Original Text: 【呼：よ】んだニャン？
Translated Text: Did you call me, meow?

Original Text: 【出：で】てきたーっ！
Translated Text: It's out!

Original Text: 【出：で】てきたーっ！
Translated Text: It's out!

Original Text: ニャ…　ニャニャニャー！？
Translated Text: Meow… Meow-meow-meow!?

Original Text: よかったよ！　ジバニャーン！
Translated Text: That was great! Jibanyan!

Original Text: あ～　ゴロゴロしながら【食：た】べる\nチョコボーは【最高：さいこう】ニャ～ン…
Translated Text: Ahh... Eating Chocobo while\nlounging around is the best, meow...

Original Text: やっぱ…\nあのお【話：はなし】は【夢：ゆめ】だったニャン…？
Translated Text:
So... was that
story just a dream after all, meow...?

Original Text: きっとそうニャン…
Translated Text: I'm sure that's right, meow...

Original Text: 【夢：ゆめ】ではない
Translated Text: It's not a dream

Original Text: ニャー！　ゆ　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】ー！\n…じゃなくて　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】！？
Translated Text:
Meow! Yu... the voice of a dream!
...No, wait—Orochi Zhou Yu!?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】に【礼：れい】を【言：い】いたくてな
Translated Text: I just wanted to say thanks to you.

Original Text: そんなの　べつに\n【気：き】にしないでいいニャンよ！
Translated Text: Don't worry about that at all, meow!

Original Text: なんだかんだ【言：い】って\nオレっちも　【楽：たの】しかったし！
Translated Text: All things considered, I had a blast too!

Original Text: …お【前：まえ】のために　とくべつな【本：ほん】を\n【図書室：としょしつ】に【用意：ようい】した
Translated Text: …I’ve set aside a special\nbook for you in the library.

Original Text: とくべつな【本：ほん】…\nそれって　もしかして…！？
Translated Text:
A special book…
Could it be…!?

Original Text: （ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】ーーーッッ♪）
Translated Text: (Nyaa KB Photo Book——♪)

Original Text: その【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に\nお【前：まえ】を【入：い】れてやろう
Translated Text: I'll put you in that book.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】は\nそこの【英雄：えいゆう】になりたいのだろう？
Translated Text: You want to be a hero\nover there, don't you?

Original Text: …なりたい！\nなりたいニャン！　【今：いま】すぐに！！
Translated Text:
…I want to be that!
I want to be that, meow! Right now!!

Original Text: ならば　【図書室：としょしつ】へ【急：いそ】ぐことだ…
Translated Text: In that case, I'd better hurry to the library…

Original Text: ニャハハハハハハ！\n【図書室：としょしつ】へレッツゴーだニャ～ン！
Translated Text:
Meow ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Let's go to the library, meow~!

Original Text: ニャ！？　ふたりとも！\nどうして【図書室：としょしつ】に！？
Translated Text:
Huh!? You two!
What are you doing in the library!?

Original Text: なんとなく【気：き】になったダニ…
Translated Text: Those mites that I couldn't quite get out of my head...

Original Text: オラもズラ！\nあの【本：ほん】を　また【読：よ】みたくなったズラよ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I’m itching to read that book again!

Original Text: （みんなはきっと…\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』を【見：み】にきたニャンね）
Translated Text:
(I bet everyone came to see *Yo-kai
Sangokushi*, didn't they?)

Original Text: （だとしたら…\nい　【言：い】えないニャン…！）
Translated Text:
(If that's the case...
I can't say it, meow...!)

Original Text: （オレっちだけ　【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】の【世界：せかい】に\n【入：はい】りにきた…ニャンて！）
Translated Text: (It's just me who's come to step into\nthe world of this photo book... Meow!)

Original Text: か…　【考：かんが】えることは【同：おな】じニャンね\nじゃあ　みんなで【読：よ】むニャン？
Translated Text: Hmm... We're all thinking the\nsame thing, aren't we? Well then,\nshall we all read it together?

Original Text: あったダニ！\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』！
Translated Text:
I found it!
"Yo-kai Sangokushi"!

Original Text: やっぱ　【面白：おもしろ】いズラね～
Translated Text: That wig really is funny, isn't it?

Original Text: オレっちたち\nこんな【冒険：ぼうけん】をしてきたんだニャン…
Translated Text: We've been on all kinds\nof adventures, meow...

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】　【夢：ゆめ】のようダニ…
Translated Text: It really is like a dream, isn't it...

Original Text: そうニャンねー…\nでも　そろそろ【他：ほか】の【本：ほん】も【読：よ】みたい　みたいな
Translated Text:
Yeah, I guess so... But
I'm starting to feel like I want
to read some other books, too.

Original Text: （はやく\nニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】を【探：さが】したいニャンッ！）
Translated Text: (I wanna find the "Meow KB"\nphoto book ASAP, meow!)

Original Text: ジバニャン　【何：なに】よそ【見：み】してるダニ？\nもう【最後：さいご】のシーンになったダニよ！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan: "What are you
looking at, Dan? We're
already at the last scene, Dan!"

Original Text: 「【優：やさ】しくて【強：つよ】い\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】たちは」
Translated Text: "The Kind and Strong\nJibanyan and Liu Bei"

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】を【救：すく】って\nどこかへ【旅立：たびだ】っていった」
Translated Text: "He saved the Land of Sakura and then\nset off on a journey to someplace else."

Original Text: 「【彼：かれ】らはさくら【国：こく】の\n【真：しん】の【英雄：えいゆう】であった…」
Translated Text: "They were the true heroes of\nthe Land of Cherry Blossoms..."

Original Text: （そうニャン！　オレっちは\n【真：しん】のエーユーになるのニャン！）
Translated Text: (That's right, meow! I'm gonna\nbecome a true AU, meow!)

Original Text: （ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】のみんなが【待：ま】つ\n【夢：ゆめ】のパラダイスで…！）
Translated Text: (In the dream paradise where\neveryone at Nyaa KB is waiting…!)

Original Text: まだ【続：つづ】きがあるみたいズラ\n【読：よ】んでみるズラね
Translated Text: Looks like there's more\nto come. I'll give it a read.

Original Text: 「だが…\n【彼：かれ】らは【再：ふたた】び【帰：かえ】ってきた」
Translated Text:
"But...
they've come back again."

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】の\nもうひとつの【危機：きき】を【救：すく】うために」
Translated Text: "To Save Sakura Country\nfrom Yet Another Crisis"

Original Text: えっ！？
Translated Text: Huh!?

Original Text: も　もんげー！！
Translated Text: Wow, that's crazy!!

Original Text: ま　また『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に\n【吸：す】いこまれていくダニー！
Translated Text: Danny is getting sucked back\ninto *Yo-kai Sangokushi* again!

Original Text: ぎゃああああああー！\nこんなの　あんまりニャンー！
Translated Text:
Aaaaaaargh!
This is just too much, meow!

Original Text: オレっちの【夢：ゆめ】！　【希望：きぼう】！\nすぐそこにあるパラダイスがー…！
Translated Text:
My dream! My hope!
Paradise is right around the corner...!

Original Text: ニャーＫびっ…
Translated Text: Meow K...

Original Text: やあ　みなさん\nまたお【会：あ】いしましたね…
Translated Text: Hey, everyone—nice to see you all again…

Original Text: ほかでもない　【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したのは\nこの　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…
Translated Text: None other than this very\nWhisper Kongming was the\none who summoned him…

Original Text: ふざけんニャー！\nひゃくれつ【肉球：にくきゅう】！
Translated Text:
Don't mess with me, meow!
A hundred-fold paw pads!

Original Text: ニャニャニャニャニャ！
Translated Text: Meow, meow, meow, meow, meow!

Original Text: あだだだだだだだ！
Translated Text: Ah-da-da-da-da-da-da-da!

Original Text: オ　オレっちの【夢：ゆめ】を…　【夢：ゆめ】を【返：かえ】せー！\nうニャニャニァ～ン…
Translated Text:
G-Give me back my dream…
Give me back my dream!
Meow-nyan-nyan~…

Original Text: 【夢：ゆめ】って　なんのことズラ…？
Translated Text: What on earth are you talking about when you say "dream"...?

Original Text: 【今：いま】は　ほうっておくダニ\n【落：お】ちこみ【方：かた】が　ハンパないダニ…
Translated Text: Right now, if you just leave them alone,\nthese mites fall off in crazy numbers...

Original Text: …ところで　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】\nなんでまた　ミーたちを【呼：よ】んだダニ？
Translated Text: …By the way, Whisper Kongming,\nwhy'd you call us again, Dan?

Original Text: いたた…　みなさんのおかげで\n【確：たし】かにさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】が【訪：おとず】れたのですが…
Translated Text: Ouch… Thanks to all of you, peace has\ncertainly come to Sakura Country, but…

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】で　こまっている【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちの【姿：すがた】が\nいまだに【目撃：もくげき】されているのでうぃす！
Translated Text: There are still reports of troubled\nYo-kai being spotted all over the place!

Original Text: 【g】たのみごと【e】をしてくる\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちのことズラね
Translated Text: 【g】I'm talking about those military commander【e】\n【g】Yo-kai who come asking for favors【e】, right?

Original Text: もしやそれを\n【全部：ぜんぶ】ミーたちで【解決：かいけつ】しろと…
Translated Text: Are you seriously telling us to\nhandle all of that ourselves…?

Original Text: え～～～！！\nそれでわざわざ【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したニャン！？
Translated Text:
Whaaaat!! Is that
why you went out of your
way to call me over, Nyan!?

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ないダニ\n【天才軍師一人：てんさいぐんしひとり】じゃ　【何：なん】にも【解決：かいけつ】できないダニ
Translated Text: It can't be helped—Dani, the\ngenius strategist, can't solve\nanything on his own, Dani.

Original Text: シャラーップ！！！！\n【話：はなし】を【最後：さいご】まで【聞：き】く！！！！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!!!!
Listen to me until I'm done!!!!

Original Text: その【数：かず】たるや　【日：ひ】を【追：お】うごとに【増：ふ】えてまして\n【中：なか】には　【不穏：ふおん】な【香：かお】りのする【事件：じけん】も…
Translated Text: The number of such incidents is\ngrowing day by day, and some of them\nhave a rather ominous feel to them…

Original Text: もしやその【裏：うら】にはあのノルカソルカをしのぐ\n【妖怪：ようかい】の【陰謀：いんぼう】が　【隠：かく】されているのではないか！
Translated Text: Could it be that behind all this lies\na conspiracy by a Yo-kai even\nmore sinister than Norukasoruka?!

Original Text: …と　この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】のカンが\n【告：つ】げているのでうぃす！！
Translated Text: …That’s what my gut—as the genius\nstrategist Whisper Kongming—is\ntelling me, so there you go!!

Original Text: それで\nオラたちの【力：ちから】が【必要：ひつよう】なんズラね？
Translated Text: So that’s why you need our help, huh?

Original Text: ふわあ～\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のカンは【常：つね】に【当：あ】てにならないニャン
Translated Text: Whew~ You can never count on the\ngenius strategist's instincts, meow.

Original Text: 【要：よう】はたのみごとが【多：おお】すぎて【大変：たいへん】って【話：はなし】ダニ\n【素直：すなお】に【助：たす】けてくださいって【言：い】えばいいダニ
Translated Text:
Basically, it's just that there are
too many requests and it's getting
overwhelming. You should just be
honest and ask for help.

Original Text: あのねーアナタたち！\nちょっとは　【私：わたくし】を【信用：しんよう】しなさいよっ！
Translated Text:
Hey, you guys!
You've got to trust me a little, okay?!

Original Text: ま　どっちでもいいニャン
Translated Text: Well... either way is fine, meow.

Original Text: 【困：こま】ってる【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【放：ほう】っておけないダニ！
Translated Text: I just can't leave a military\ncommander-Yo-kai in trouble alone, Dani!

Original Text: オラも！\nこの【世界：せかい】のみんなに　また【会：あ】いてぇズラ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I wanna see everyone in this world again!

Original Text: そうそう　そう【来：こ】なくっちゃ！！\nさすがは　【我：われ】らが【英雄：えいゆう】たちでうぃす！！
Translated Text:
That's right! That's
exactly how it should be!!
As expected of our heroes!!

Original Text: あ！\nそれから【g】たのみごと【e】の【他：ほか】にも…
Translated Text:
Oh!
And besides that request, there's also...

Original Text: 【g】くにとりバトル【e】や　【g】チャレンジバトル【e】も\nいっそう　【盛：も】り【上：あ】がってるみたいですよ！
Translated Text: 【g】It looks like the Country Conquest【e】\n【g】Battles【e】 and Challenge【g】 Battles【e】 are\ngetting even more exciting!

Original Text: さあ！\nまだまだ【一緒：いっしょ】にさくら【国：こく】を【冒険：ぼうけん】しましょう！
Translated Text:
Come on! Let's
keep exploring Sakura Country together!

Original Text: さて　【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】が【現：あらわ】れたという\n【小学校：しょうがっこう】に【来：き】てみましたが…
Translated Text: Well, I came to this elementary school\nafter hearing that a white warrior-like\nYo-kai had appeared here, but…

Original Text: はるか【前方：ぜんぽう】に【見：み】える【巨大：きょだい】なガイコツが\nコマじろう【孫権殿：そんけんどの】の【兄上：あにうえ】でしょうか？
Translated Text: Is that huge skeleton visible far ahead\nKomajiro Sun Quan’s older brother?

Original Text: （どう【見：み】てもコマさんじゃないニャン…\n【絶対：ぜったい】に【違：ちが】…）
Translated Text:
(No matter how I look at it,
that's definitely not Komasan...
It's absolutely not...)

Original Text: （あれは【怪物：かいぶつ】ダニ…\nさすがのウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】も【間違：まちが】えな…）
Translated Text:
(That's a monster tick... Even
Whisper Kongming couldn't
have been wrong about that...)

Original Text: （もんげー！　こっちの【世界：せかい】のオラ…\nガイコツだったズラかー！？）
Translated Text:
(Whoa! So in this world, I... was a
skeleton, was I!?)

Original Text: あ～　【私：わたくし】　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】と【申：もう】しますー！\nドゥーユーアンダースタンドーッ！？
Translated Text:
Ah~ My name is Whisper Kongming!
Do you understand!?

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\n【行：い】っちゃったニャン！？
Translated Text:
Hey, genius strategist!
Did you just leave, meow!?

Original Text: た　【大変：たいへん】ニャン！\n【追：お】っかけて　【連：つ】れ【戻：もど】すニャン！
Translated Text:
Oh no!
I'm gonna chase after
him and bring him back!

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\n【行：い】っちゃったダニ！？
Translated Text:
Wow, what a genius strategist!
Did the tick really go
away!?

Original Text: バ　バッカじゃないかダニ！\n【早：はや】く【追：お】っかけて　【連：つ】れ【戻：もど】すダニ！
Translated Text:
You're such an idiot, Dani!
Hurry up and go after
him—bring him back, Dani!

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\n【行：い】っちゃったズラ！？
Translated Text:
Wow, what a genius strategist! Did he just
leave?!

Original Text: オラも【追：お】っかけて\nあいさつしねぇと…　【待：ま】ってズラ～！
Translated Text: I'd better run after him and\nsay hi, too... Wait, Zura~!

Original Text: はあはあ…\nあやうく【死：し】ぬところでした…
Translated Text:
Phew... That was a
close call... I almost died...

Original Text: 【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だったから\nあいさつしようとしただけなのに…
Translated Text: It was just a white warrior-type Yo-kai,\nso I was just trying to say hello...

Original Text: あのコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：にい】ちゃんが\nあんなゴツいガイコツなわけないニャン
Translated Text: There's no way that Koma-jiro—Sun\nQuan's older brother—could be\nsuch a burly skeleton, meow.

Original Text: 【天才：てんさい】ならよく【考：かんが】えるニャン！\nもう【今度：こんど】は【知：し】らないニャン！
Translated Text:
If you're a genius, think it over, meow!
I'm not taking responsibility
for this next time, meow!

Original Text: あのコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：にい】ちゃんが\nあんなゴツいガイコツなわけないダニ！
Translated Text: There's no way that Komajiro—Sun\nQuan's older brother—could be\nsuch a burly skeleton, you jerk!

Original Text: 【天才：てんさい】ならよく【考：かんが】えるダニ！\nもう【次：つぎ】は【助：たす】けないダニよ！
Translated Text:
"If you're a genius, you'd think twice, Dani!
I won't help you next time, Dani!"

Original Text: オラも…　あのガイコツを\nこっちのオラかと【思：おも】ってたズラ…
Translated Text: Me too… I thought that\nskeleton was me, too…

Original Text: お【互：たが】い　【危：あぶ】なかったズラね…\nもう【無茶：むちゃ】はやめるズラ！
Translated Text:
That was a close call for both of us, wasn't
it... Let's stop taking such risks from now
on!

Original Text: てへへ　すんません\nでも…　【私：わたくし】　【感動：かんどう】しました！
Translated Text: Hehe, sorry, but… I was really moved!

Original Text: 【口：くち】ではなんだかんだ【言：い】っても…\n【私：わたくし】を【必死：ひっし】に【助：たす】けてくださって…
Translated Text:
No matter what you say... you
went out of your way to help me
...

Original Text: そうしないと【話：はなし】が【進：すす】まないからニャン
Translated Text: If we don't do that, the story won't move forward, meow

Original Text: そうしないと【話：はなし】が【進：すす】まないダニ
Translated Text: Dani: "If we don't do that, we won't make any progress."

Original Text: そうしないとお【話：はなし】が【進：すす】まないズラ！
Translated Text: If we don't do that, the story won't move forward!

Original Text: か　【感動：かんどう】を【返：かえ】せーー！
Translated Text: Give me back that thrill—!

Original Text: とにかく…　【小学校：しょうがっこう】には\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：にい】ちゃんはいないニャン
Translated Text: Anyway… There’s no Koma-jiro\nSun Quan’s older brother at\nelementary school, meow.

Original Text: どうすれば　いいニャン…？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】　【何：なん】とかするニャン！
Translated Text:
What should I do, meow…?
The genius strategist
will figure it out, meow!

Original Text: とにかく…　【小学校：しょうがっこう】には\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：あに】はいないダニ！
Translated Text: Anyway… There’s no character named\nKoma-jiro Sun Quan’s older brother in\nelementary school, you know!

Original Text: どうすれば　いいダニ…？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】　【何：なん】とかしろダニ！
Translated Text:
What should I do, Dani…?
Genius Strategist, you’ve
got to figure this out, Dani!

Original Text: とにかく…　【小学校：しょうがっこう】には\nこっちのオラはいないズラ！
Translated Text: Anyway… There’s no one like\nme at this elementary school!

Original Text: どうすれば　いいズラ…？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】　【何：なん】とかしてほしいズラ！
Translated Text:
What should I do, Zura…?
Genius Strategist, please do
something about this, Zura!

Original Text: はいはい\n【私：わたくし】が【聞：き】きこみをいたしますよっと…
Translated Text: Okay, okay, I'll go around asking people...

Original Text: え～　このあたりの【住民：じゅうみん】に【聞：き】いたところ\nおおもり【山：やま】で【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【見：み】たそうです
Translated Text: Well... I heard from some locals\naround here that they saw a white\nwarrior-like Yo-kai on Mount Omori.

Original Text: この【国：くに】\nなんだか【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だらけニャン…
Translated Text: This country seems to be full of\nwhite warrior Yo-kai, meow...

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】は…　【本物：ほんもの】ダニ？
Translated Text: This time… a real tick?

Original Text: こっちのオラも\nなかなかの【迷子：まいご】っぷりズラ…
Translated Text: I'm pretty lost myself over here, too...

Original Text: まあ…　とりあえず【参：まい】りましょう！
Translated Text: Well... Let's just get going!

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】こそきっと\nコマじろう【孫権殿：そんけんどの】の【兄上：あにうえ】に【会：あ】えますよ！
Translated Text: Next time, I'm sure I'll get to meet Lord\nSun Quan's older brother, Komajiro!

Original Text: しかし…　【味方：みかた】になるとは【言：い】ったものの…\nアナタ【方：がた】の【弱：よわ】さは　【想像以上：そうぞういじょう】でうぃす
Translated Text:
But… even though I said
I’d be on your side…
you guys are way weaker than I imagined.

Original Text: とくに【仲間：なかま】！\n【英雄：えいゆう】にふさわしい【仲間：なかま】が【少：すく】なすぎます！
Translated Text:
Especially teammates! There just
aren't enough teammates worthy of a
hero!

Original Text: それでもなんとかするのが…\n【天才：てんさい】なんじゃないっスか？
Translated Text:
Isn't someone who can
still pull it off somehow... a
genius?

Original Text: ドキッ！\nま　まあ　【手：て】はあるんですけどね
Translated Text:
Whoa!
W-well, there are ways to do it, I guess...

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】～！
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】~!

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】?

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】?

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】?

Original Text: この【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】を【使：つか】うと\n【心強：こころづよ】い【仲間：なかま】が【手：て】に【入：はい】ることがあります
Translated Text: If you use this【g】 Yo-kai Gacha【e】,\nyou might get a reliable ally.

Original Text: ちなみに　ガシャを【引：ひ】くには\nガシャコインなどのコインが【必要：ひつよう】ですよ！
Translated Text: By the way, you'll need coins—like\nGacha Coins—to play the gacha!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】もむか～し\nガシャに【入：はい】っていたことがありまして…

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】を【引：ひ】き【当：あ】てたお【方：かた】は\nそれはそれは　おどろいていました！

Original Text: きっと　【変：へん】なのが【出：で】てきて\nびっくりしたっス…
Translated Text: I'm sure something weird popped\nup and gave me a shock...

Original Text: だまれ！　にせガッパ！

Original Text: さあ！　どんどんガシャを【引：ひ】いて\n【英雄：えいゆう】にふさわしき【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【集：あつ】めましょう！

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました」

Meow... The Yo-kai are gathering here.
Can I ask you something...?

Original Text: 【邪魔：じゃま】する【奴：やつ】は【通：とお】さーん！

Original Text: ニャーいきなり【何：なん】ニャー！

My heart's racing... Are

?

Original Text: ニャ？

Original Text: グッドタイミイイイイイイイング！
Translated Text: Good timing!

Original Text: メラメラッ！\n（うおおお　【助：たす】かったぜ！）

Blaze, blaze!
(Whoa! I'm saved!)
Huh...?

Original Text: ようこそさくら【国：こく】へ\n【救世主：きゅうせいしゅ】　ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】
Translated Text: Welcome to the Land of\nSakura, Savior Jibanyan Liu Bei

Original Text: りゅーくんたちを\n【助：たす】けてほしいのだ。
Translated Text: I want you to help Ryu-kun and the others.

Original Text: ははははははここは【通：とお】さーん！\n【覚悟：かくご】しろ！
Translated Text:
Hahahahahaha! You're
not getting past here!
Get ready!

Original Text: おお～っと【敵：てき】さんハイになっちゃったなあ！\nここは【二手：ふたて】に【分：わ】かれてバトルだ！
Translated Text:
Whoa—the enemy's
getting all hyped up! Let's
split into two groups and fight!

Original Text: メラメラ～ッ\n（オレと【隊長：たいちょう】はあっちで【敵：てき】を【食：く】い【止：と】める！）
Translated Text: Blaze, blaze~! (The captain and I will\nhold off the enemies over there!)

Original Text: メラメラ！\n（お【前：まえ】はここでりゅーくんと【戦：たたか】ってくれ！）
Translated Text:
Fire away!
(You stay here and fight Ryu-kun!)

Original Text: ななな　【何：なん】ニャこりゃーーーーー！
Translated Text: W-w-w-what on earth is this?!

Original Text: ウィスパーは【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】をよく【使：つか】うニャン？
Translated Text: Does Whisper shop at the Yo-kai Online Store a lot, meow?

Original Text: そうですね。\nいろいろ【買：か】っていますよ。
Translated Text:
That's right. I've been buying
all sorts of things.

Original Text: 【空気：くうき】キレイキレイマシーンは\nとても【役：やく】に【立：た】ったでしょう？
Translated Text: The air purifier must have\nbeen really helpful, right?

Original Text: あれは【半径：はんけい】５キロのイガイガグリを\nやっつける【優：すぐ】れものなのでうぃす！
Translated Text: That's a great little gadget for\ntaking out those prickly guri within\na 5-kilometer radius, y'know!

Original Text: そ　そうなんニャ…。
Translated Text: Oh, really, meow...

Original Text: もっとすごいのはないニャン？
Translated Text: Isn't there something even cooler, meow?

Original Text: むむっ！　【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】のすばらしさを\n【理解：りかい】していないようですね？
Translated Text: Hmm! It seems you don't quite\nunderstand how wonderful the\nYo-kai Mail-Order Store is, do you?

Original Text: ならば【見：み】せましょう…！
Translated Text: Well then, let me show you…!

Original Text: １ヶ【月分：げつぶん】のおこづかいをはたいて【買：か】った\n【無敵：むてき】のバリアー…。
Translated Text: An invincible barrier I bought with\na month's worth of allowance...

Original Text: 【安心安全：あんしんあんぜん】ムテバリくんの【力：ちから】を！
Translated Text: Trust in the power of Mutebari-kun for safety and peace of mind!

Original Text: なんて【名前：なまえ】ニャ！
Translated Text: What a name, meow!

Original Text: 【決：き】められた【回数：かいすう】だけ\nどんなダメージでも【防：ふせ】いでくれるのです！
Translated Text: It blocks any damage\na set number of times!

Original Text: さあ！\n【私：わたし】を【思：おも】いっきり【攻撃：こうげき】してください！
Translated Text:
Come on! Go ahead and attack
me with everything you've got!

Original Text: わ　わかったニャ…。
Translated Text: O-okay, I get it, meow...

Original Text: ニャニャニャニャ！
Translated Text: Meow, meow, meow, meow!

Original Text: ぐふっ！　げふっ！
Translated Text: Guh! Guh!

Original Text: ごふっ！　がはぁっ！
Translated Text: Guh! Gah!

Original Text: ニャ？\n【当：あ】たってしまったニャ。
Translated Text:
Meow?
I hit the jackpot, meow.

Original Text: そ　そんなバカな…。
Translated Text: "T-That can't be...!"

Original Text: まだ１【度：ど】も【使：つか】っていないはずなのに！
Translated Text: I'm sure I haven't used it even once!

Original Text: 【不良品：ふりょうひん】だったんじゃないかニャ？
Translated Text: Wasn't it a defective product, meow?

Original Text: そんなはずがありません！
Translated Text: There's no way that's true!

Original Text: まさか【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】が…　ありえない…。
Translated Text: I can't believe there's actually an online store for Yo-kai... That's impossible...

Original Text: ま　まあ\n【元気出：げんきだ】すニャ～！
Translated Text: W-well, cheer up, meow!

Original Text: ＺＺＺ…
Translated Text: Zzz... Ronron...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん！\n【兄：にい】ちゃん　【起：お】きるズラ！
Translated Text:
Bro!
Bro, wake up!

Original Text: むにゃむにゃ…\nソ　ソフトクリーム…！
Translated Text:
Mumble, mumble…
S… soft-serve ice cream…!

Original Text: ソフトクリーム\n【落：お】っことしてるズラッ
Translated Text: A whole bunch of people dropping\ntheir soft-serve ice cream

Original Text: もんげーー！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!?

Original Text: あらら…　【今度：こんど】は【兄：にい】ちゃんが\n【落：お】っこちちまったズラ…
Translated Text: Oh no… Now my big\nbrother’s fallen off too…

Original Text: イタタタ…\nお　オシリ【痛：いた】いズラ…
Translated Text:
Ouch, ouch, ouch…
My… my butt hurts…

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん\nいったい　どんな【夢：ゆめ】さ【見：み】てたズラ？
Translated Text: Bro, what kind of dream\nwere you having, anyway?

Original Text: ヨダレ　たらしながら　\nもんげー【嬉：うれ】しそうな【寝顔：ねがお】で…
Translated Text: With drool dripping down his\nchin, his sleeping face\nlooked so incredibly happy…

Original Text: 「【空：そら】からソフトクリームが！」\n…って　【叫：さけ】んでたズラよ？
Translated Text:
"Soft-serve ice cream
is falling from the sky!"
... Wasn't that what Zura was shouting?

Original Text: ！　そうズラ\n【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】で　オラは…
Translated Text: ! Yeah, in that dream, I was...

Original Text: 【空：そら】から【降：ふ】ってきた　もんげー【数：かず】の\nソフトクリームをぜんぶ　たいらげて…
Translated Text: I polished off every single one of\nthe crazy amount of soft-serve\nice cream that fell from the sky…

Original Text: 【戦：たたか】いに【勝：か】ったんズラよ！
Translated Text: We won the battle, you know!

Original Text: …それ　どんな【戦：たたか】いズラ？
Translated Text: …So, what kind of battle is that?

Original Text: そしたら　【誰：だれ】かに\n「お【前：まえ】は　エーユーだ」って【言：い】われたズラ
Translated Text: Then someone told me, "You're an AU."

Original Text: エーユー？\nああ　「【英雄：えいゆう】」のことズラね
Translated Text:
"AU?
" Oh, you mean "Hero," right?

Original Text: エーユーって　【何：なん】ズラ？
Translated Text: What's "AU" all about?

Original Text: ヒーロー\nって【意味：いみ】ズラ
Translated Text: "Hero"—that's a bit of a stretch

Original Text: ヒッ　ヒーロー…　ズラ…！？\nと、というと　あっ　あの…
Translated Text:
"H-Hero... a wig...!?
" I said, and then, "Uh, um..."

Original Text: 【都会：とかい】のビルの【谷間：たにま】を【飛：と】び【回：まわ】り…\n【悪：あく】の【組織：そしき】をやっつけるという…　あの…
Translated Text:
Flying through the skyscrapers
of the city… and taking down a
criminal organization… um…

Original Text: そうズラ　【兄：にい】ちゃんは\n【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】でヒーローになったんズラよ
Translated Text: That's right, Zura. My big brother\nbecame a hero in his dreams, Zura.

Original Text: もんげーーー！！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: ズラ…　【空：そら】からソフトクリームで\nソフトクリームの【戦：たたか】いの　エーユー…
Translated Text: Zura… A soft-serve battle with soft-serve\nice cream falling from the sky… AU…

Original Text: コマじろう\nオラ　もう１【回：かい】　【同：おんな】じ【夢：ゆめ】みたいズラ～
Translated Text: Komajiro, man... I think I'm having\nthe same dream all over again~

Original Text: …ズラ？　コマじろう？\nどこ【行：い】っちゃったズラ？？
Translated Text:
…Zura? Koma-jiro?
Where did Zura go??

Original Text: あ　コマさん！\n【元気：げんき】？
Translated Text:
Oh, Komasan!
How are you?

Original Text: ズラ？　ケータ！\nコマじろう　【見：み】なかったズラ？
Translated Text:
Didn't you see it, Keita?
Komajiro—didn't you see it?

Original Text: そこで　【会：あ】ったよ\nこれからオールで【ＤＪ：ディージェイ】のイベントなんだって
Translated Text: So, I ran into him there. He said he\nwas heading to an all-night DJ event.

Original Text: そのあと【音楽業界：おんがくぎょうかい】の【人：ひと】と【打：う】ち【合：あ】わせだって！\nコマじろうすごいよねー　【芸能人：げいのうじん】みたい！
Translated Text:
After that, he’s got a meeting with
someone from the music industry!
Komajiro is so cool—he’s
just like a celebrity!

Original Text: （コマじろう…　【都会：とかい】のビルの【谷間：たにま】を\n【飛：と】び【回：まわ】ってるズラ…！）
Translated Text: (Komajiro… That guy’s flying\nall over the place between\nthe skyscrapers in the city…!)

Original Text: コマじろうは\nきっとヒーローに【違：ちが】いないズラ…！
Translated Text: Komajiro must be a hero,\nno doubt about it...!

Original Text: オラも【兄：にい】ちゃんとして【負：ま】けられねえズラ…\nコマじろうがヒーローなら　オラはエーユ…
Translated Text:
As an older brother, I can't
let myself lose either... If
Komajiro's a hero, then I'm a...

Original Text: コマさんも　ヒーローにはまってるの？\nオレも【今：いま】　【昔：むかし】のヒーローの【本読：ほんよ】んでるんだ
Translated Text:
Are you into superheroes too, Komasan?
I'm reading some old superhero
comics right now, too.

Original Text: 【昔：むかし】のヒーロー？？
Translated Text: Heroes of the Past??

Original Text: うん　『【三国志：さんごくし】』っていってね\n【中国：ちゅうごく】っていう【国：くに】の　【英雄：えいゆう】の【話：はなし】だよ
Translated Text: Yeah, *Romance of the Three\nKingdoms*—it’s a story about the\nheroes of a country called China.

Original Text: エーユーッ！？
Translated Text: "What the...!?"

Original Text: オラ　エーユーになりてえズラ！\nオラ　その【本：ほん】　【読：よ】んでみたいズラ！
Translated Text:
Man, I wanna be an AU!
Man, I wanna read that book!

Original Text: いいよ　それじゃ【家：いえ】から【取：と】ってくるね\n【公園：こうえん】で【待：ま】ち【合：あ】わせしよ！
Translated Text: Sure. I'll go get it from home\nthen. Let's meet at the park!

Original Text: ケータ\nおそいズラね～
Translated Text: Keta, you're late, aren't you?

Original Text: （エーユーの【本：ほん】…\nきっと【夢：ゆめ】で【見：み】た【通：とお】りのお【話：はなし】ズラ…）
Translated Text:
(A.U.'s book... I
bet the story is just like
I saw in my dream...)

Original Text: （【心優：こころやさ】しき【妖怪：ようかい】が　ソフトクリームの【力：ちから】で\nもんげーヒーローに【変身：へんしん】する【話：はなし】ズラ…！）
Translated Text: (It's a story about a kind-hearted Yo-kai\nwho transforms into a super hero thanks\nto the power of soft-serve ice cream...!)

Original Text: （「もんげー！\n【兄：にい】ちゃん　カッコイイ～！」）
Translated Text:
("Wow!
Big bro, you're so cool~!")

Original Text: 【楽：たの】しみズラ～♪\nあとでソフトクリーム【買：か】いに【行：い】こうっとズラ
Translated Text: I'm so excited~♪ I'm gonna go get\nsome soft-serve ice cream later~

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん
Translated Text: Big Brother

Original Text: ズラッ
Translated Text: In a row

Original Text: こっ　コマじろう\n？？　【ＤＪ：ディージェイ】のイベントもう【終：お】わったズラ？
Translated Text: Wait... Komajiro?? Is the\nDJ event already over?

Original Text: 【ＤＪ：ディージェイ】の【前：まえ】に\n【腹：はら】ごしらえしようと【思：おも】って…
Translated Text: I thought I'd grab a bite\nto eat before the DJ set...

Original Text: のるか！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: そるか！
Translated Text: I see!

Original Text: ズラッ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!?

Original Text: ここに【生：は】えてる\n【草：くさ】を【食：た】べてみるズラ
Translated Text: I'm gonna try eating the\ngrass growing here.

Original Text: ズラッ…？\nく　【草：くさ】…　ズラ…？
Translated Text:
Zuraa...?
Wha—... Grass... Zuraa...?

Original Text: ってコマじろーーーーっ
Translated Text: "Koma-jirooooooo!"

Original Text: もっ\nもう【食：た】べちゃってる…　ズラッ…
Translated Text: I've already eaten it all... *slurp*...

Original Text: こ　コマじろう\n【草食：くさた】べるの…　クラブで【流行：はや】ってるズラ？
Translated Text: "Koma-jiro, are you eating grass...?\nIs that the latest trend at the club?"

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: ほら　【兄：にい】ちゃんも【食：た】べてみるズラよ
Translated Text: Come on, big brother, you should try some, too.

Original Text: もんげーーーー！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: （おなか　こわしちゃったズラ……）
Translated Text: (My tummy's acting up...)

Original Text: 【暑：あつ】い【日：ひ】はやっぱソフトクリームだよな～
Translated Text: On a hot day, there's nothing like soft-serve ice cream, right?

Original Text: むしょうに【食：た】べたくなるんだよねー\nソフトクリームって！
Translated Text: I just get this sudden craving\nfor soft-serve ice cream!

Original Text: （【今日：きょう】はソフトクリーム【我慢：がまん】するズラ……）
Translated Text: (I'm going to resist having soft-serve ice cream today...)

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: オレ　このソフトクリームを\nコーンのほうから【食：た】べるんだ！
Translated Text: I'm going to eat this soft-serve ice\ncream starting from the cone end!

Original Text: ズラ…？
Translated Text: A wig…?

Original Text: おや？　あそこにいるのは…\nコマさんとケータ【君：くん】のおともだちでは？
Translated Text:
Huh? Isn't that... Komasan and Keita's
friend over there?

Original Text: クリームがたれる？　たれない？\nドキドキするねぇ！
Translated Text:
Will the cream drip? Or won't it? It's so
nerve-wracking!

Original Text: ボクも\nのるかそるか！
Translated Text: It's all or nothing for me, too!

Original Text: ２【個：こ】のソフトクリームを\nジャグリングしながら【食：た】べる！
Translated Text: Eating two soft-serve ice\ncreams while juggling them!

Original Text: 【落：お】とすなよ！？　【落：お】とすなよ！？
Translated Text: Don't drop it! Don't drop it!

Original Text: はぁ～！\n【都会：とかい】の【人間：にんげん】は　もんげーズラね～！
Translated Text:
Whew!
City folks sure are something else!

Original Text: あんなソフトクリームの【食：た】べ【方：かた】\n【田舎：いなか】では【見：み】たことないズラ…！
Translated Text: I've never seen anyone eat soft-serve ice\ncream like that out in the countryside...!

Original Text: いやいやいや\nあんな【食：た】べ【方：かた】　だれもしないニャンよ…
Translated Text: No, no, no—nobody eats like that, meow…

Original Text: そういえば　「のるかそるか」って\nどういう【意味：いみ】ズラ？
Translated Text: Come to think of it, what does\n“all or nothing” mean, anyway?

Original Text: 「【成功：せいこう】するか【失敗：しっぱい】するかはわからないが\nとにかくやってみる！」
Translated Text: "I don't know if it'll work or not, but\nI'm going to give it a try anyway!"

Original Text: という【意味：いみ】でうぃす！
Translated Text: That's what I mean!

Original Text: さっきのケータもそうだけど\nみんな　ちょっと【変：へん】ニャン…
Translated Text: Just like Keita a little while ago,\neveryone’s a little weird, meow…

Original Text: もしかして…\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン？
Translated Text:
Could it be... the work of a
Yo-kai, meow?

Original Text: 【何：なに】をおっしゃいます！　こんなの\nごくごくフツーの【日常風景：にちじょうふうけい】でうぃす～！
Translated Text: What are you talking about!\nThis is just a totally ordinary\neveryday scene, you know!

Original Text: 【男：おとこ】の【子：こ】はくだらな～いことで\nスリルを【楽：たの】しむモンなんです！
Translated Text: Boys just love getting a\nthrill out of silly little things!

Original Text: ホントに　そうニャンか…？
Translated Text: Is that really true, meow…?

Original Text: でも…　【今朝：けさ】…\nオラの【弟：おとうと】のコマじろうも【変：へん】だったズラ…
Translated Text:
But… this morning…
my little brother, Komajiro,
was acting weird, too…

Original Text: 「のるかそるか！」
Translated Text: "It's do or die!"

Original Text: 「ここに【生：は】えてる\n【草：くさ】を【食：た】べてみるズラ！」
Translated Text: "Let's try eating the grass growing here!"

Original Text: と【叫：さけ】んでいたズラ！
Translated Text: That's what Zura was shouting!

Original Text: それは【止：と】めてあげましょうよ…
Translated Text: Let's stop that, shall we…

Original Text: やっぱりおかしいニャン…\nきっと　【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざニャン！
Translated Text:
Something's
definitely off, meow... It must
be the work of a Yo-kai, meow!

Original Text: んなわけないですって！　ん？
Translated Text: "No way!" Huh?

Original Text: ん～？　んーっ！！
Translated Text: Hmm? Hmm!!

Original Text: なんか　【私：わたくし】たちのまわり\n【光：ひか】ってませんかー！
Translated Text: Hey, isn't there some\nkind of glow around us?!

Original Text: もんげー！　まぶしいズラー！
Translated Text: Whoa! That's blinding!

Original Text: ニャニ～！
Translated Text: Meow~!

Original Text: あわわわ…　いったい【何：なに】が…！
Translated Text: Oh no... What on earth is going on...!

Original Text: そうだ…\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざだ…
Translated Text:
That's right... It must
be the work of a Yo-kai
...

Original Text: おそるべき【妖気：ようき】が\nお【前：まえ】の【世界：せかい】に…えいきょうを…
Translated Text: A terrifying demonic aura is about\nto... influence... your world...

Original Text: （あれ…\nこの【声：こえ】…　【聞：き】いたことあるズラ…）
Translated Text:
(Huh... this voice...
I think I've heard it before...)

Original Text: 【図書室：としょしつ】へ…
Translated Text: To the library…

Original Text: さんご…　という【本：ほん】を…　さがせ…
Translated Text: Find the book called *Sango*...

Original Text: …【消：き】えたニャン！
Translated Text: …He's gone, meow!

Original Text: これは…　まさか…
Translated Text: This is... Could it be...

Original Text: もんげー！　【都会人：とかいじん】のすることは\nやっぱり　ひと【味：あじ】ちがうズラね～！
Translated Text: Wow! City folks really do things\na little differently, don't they~!

Original Text: んなわけないでしょうが！
Translated Text: There's no way that's true!

Original Text: 【不可思議：ふかしぎ】な【現象：げんしょう】の【数：かずかず】々！\nそして　ナゾの【人物：じんぶつ】からの【ＳＯＳ：エスオーエス】！
Translated Text:
A series of mysterious phenomena!
And an SOS from a mysterious figure!

Original Text: これは　【大冒険：だいぼうけん】の【予感：よかん】が\nプンプンしますね！
Translated Text: This definitely feels like the\nstart of a great adventure!

Original Text: ウィスパー…　さっきは【日常風景：にちじょうふうけい】って\n【言：い】ってたくせに…
Translated Text: Whisper… Just a moment ago you were\nsaying it was just an everyday scene…

Original Text: シャラーップ！\nおだまりなさい！　このジバ【野郎：やろう】が！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!
Be quiet! You little brat!

Original Text: さあ　【物語：ものがたり】のカギは【図書室：としょしつ】にアリ！\nみなさん　【参：まい】りますよ！
Translated Text:
Well then, the key to the
story is in the library!
Everyone, let's go!

Original Text: もんげ～！\n【図書室：としょしつ】って【広：ひろ】いズラね～
Translated Text:
Wow!
The library sure is big, isn't it?

Original Text: よく【考：かんが】えたら…\nどの【本：ほん】をさがせば　いいのニャン？
Translated Text:
Come to think of it…
which book should I look for, meow?

Original Text: あの【天：てん】の【声：こえ】…\n「さんご」という【言葉：ことば】を【残：のこ】していました…
Translated Text:
That voice from the heavens…
It left behind the word “sango”…

Original Text: さんご…　サンゴ…\nということは　【海：うみ】の【本：ほん】にちがいありません！
Translated Text:
Coral… Coral…
That means it must be a
book about the ocean!

Original Text: う～ん\nウィスパーの【直感：ちょっかん】はアテにならないニャン
Translated Text: Hmm... You can't really trust\nWhisper's intuition, meow.

Original Text: オレっちたちは\n【別：べつ】のところをさがすニャン
Translated Text: We're gonna look for\nsomewhere else, meow.

Original Text: フッ　いいでしょう
Translated Text: Huh... That's pretty good, isn't it?

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の【直感：ちょっかん】が【勝：か】つか…\nジバニャンの【思：おも】いつきが【勝：か】つか！
Translated Text:
Will my intuition win out… or will
Jibanyan’s idea win out!

Original Text: 【勝負：しょうぶ】といこうじゃあーりませんか！\nでは　【私：わたくし】は　【海：うみ】の【図鑑：ずかん】コーナーへ！
Translated Text:
Let's make this a contest, shall we?
Well then, I'm off to the marine life section!

Original Text: じゃあ　はりきって\nさがすズラよ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get\nexcited and start looking!

Original Text: 【本：ほん】は\nもんげーいっぱいあるズラが…
Translated Text: There are a ton of books here...

Original Text: 【手分：てわ】けすれば\n【夜：よる】までには【終：お】わるズラ！
Translated Text: If we split up the work,\nwe'll be done by nightfall!

Original Text: 【夜：よる】…！？　ま　まあ\nぼちぼち　がんばるニャン…
Translated Text: Night…!? W-well, I'll just take it one\nstep at a time and do my best, meow…

Original Text: もんげー！\nお　オシリぶつけちゃったズラ…
Translated Text:
Whoa!
I just... bumped my butt...

Original Text: ズラ…？
Translated Text: A wig…?

Original Text: ズララララーーーッ
Translated Text: Zura-ra-ra-raaaaaa!

Original Text: お　オラ\nもんげ～～～～カッコになってるズラッッ
Translated Text: Oh my gosh~~~~ They look\nso cool, all lined up like that!

Original Text: ……\nこのカッコ………
Translated Text:
……These
parentheses………

Original Text: もんげ～カッコいいズラね～♪
Translated Text: Wow~ That wig is so cool~♪

Original Text: ちょっと　ジバニャン\n【今：いま】のオラ　カッコよくないズラ？
Translated Text: Hey, Jibanyan, don't I look\npretty cool right now?

Original Text: ……？\nズラ…？　ジバニャン？
Translated Text:
……?
A wig…? Jibanyan?

Original Text: あれ…？　そういえば\nここは【図書室：としょしつ】…　じゃないズラ？
Translated Text: Huh...? Come to think of it, isn't\nthis the library... or is it not?

Original Text: ビクトリアアアアアンッ！
Translated Text: Victoriaaaaaaah!

Original Text: もんげ～！？\n【何：なん】ズラ？　【何：なん】ズラ～？
Translated Text:
Whoa~!?
What's that? What's that~?

Translated Text: NULL
