Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラッ！\n（そこの【通：とお】りすがりの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(Hey, you passing-by warrior Yo-kai!)

Original Text: グッドタイミイイイイイイングッ！
Translated Text: Good timingggggg!

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: ズラじゃないのだ\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】なのだ
Translated Text: It's not a wig—it's a warrior Yo-kai.

Original Text: メラメ～ラッ！\n（オレたちに【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera-me-ra!
(Give us your strength!)

Original Text: ？　えっと…\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】せって　いったい【何：なに】するズラ？
Translated Text:
? Um... "
Give me a hand"? What exactly
are we supposed to do?

Original Text: もしケンカとかだったら\nオラはニガテ…ズラよ？
Translated Text: If it's a fight or something, I'm\nnot really good at that... right?

Original Text: あ　そういえばジバニャンと\nウィスパー　【見：み】なかったズラ？
Translated Text: Oh, come to think of it, didn't\nyou see Jibanyan and Whisper?

Original Text: ハハハハハ　ここは【通：とお】さーん！\n【覚悟：かくご】しろ！
Translated Text:
Hahahahaha! You're not getting past me!
Get ready!

Original Text: 【何：なん】ズラ？　【何：なん】ズラ？\nいったい【何：なに】がおこってるズラ？
Translated Text:
What's going on? What's going on? What
on earth is happening?

Original Text: そうこう【言：い】ってる【間：あいだ】に\n【敵：てき】さんは　ハイテンション！
Translated Text: While we were talking about this and that,\nthe enemy was getting really hyped up!

Original Text: ここは【二手：ふたて】に【分：わ】かれてバトルだ！
Translated Text: Here, we split into two groups and battle it out!

Original Text: メラメラ～ッ　メラメ～ラ！\n（オレと【隊長：たいちょう】はあっちで【敵：てき】を【食：く】い【止：と】める！）
Translated Text:
Blaze~! Blaze~!
(The captain and I will hold
off the enemies over there!)

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（お【前：まえ】は　りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】と【戦：たたか】ってくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(You go fight Ryu-kun, Liu Yu!)

Original Text: もんげーーー！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: いい【戦：たたか】いぶりだった！\nなかなかの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だな！
Translated Text:
That was a great fight! You're
quite the warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: ズラ～\nそれほどでも～
Translated Text: Zura~ Not really~

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ？\n（お【前：まえ】　どこの【国：くに】から【来：き】たんだ？）
Translated Text:
Mera... Mera Mera?
(Where are you from?)

Original Text: オラ　コマさんズラ！\n【田舎：いなか】から【出：で】てきたばっかりズラ～
Translated Text:
Hey, Komasan! I just got here from the
countryside~

Original Text: 【田舎：いなか】？\nなんだかフツーっぽい【名前：なまえ】の【国：くに】だな！
Translated Text:
The countryside?
That's a pretty ordinary-sounding
name for a country!

Original Text: メラ　メ～ラ！\n（ここは　さくら【国：こく】！）
Translated Text:
Mera~ Mera!
(This is Sakura Country!)

Original Text: ああ　やっぱりここは\nさくらニュータウンなんズラね
Translated Text: Ah, so this really is\nSakura New Town, isn't it?

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ\n（いや　さくら【国：こく】だ）
Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera (No, it's Sakura Country)

Original Text: さくらニュータウン？
Translated Text: Sakura New Town?

Original Text: メラメラ\n（さくら【国：こく】）
Translated Text: Mera Mera (Sakura Kingdom)

Original Text: さくらこく？？？
Translated Text: Sakura Country???

Original Text: ようこそさくら【国：こく】へ
Translated Text: Welcome to the Land of Cherry Blossoms

Original Text: ズラ…？
Translated Text: A wig…?

Original Text: どうやら【無事：ぶじ】\n【本：ほん】を【見：み】つけたようだな
Translated Text: Looks like you found the book after all.

Original Text: どこかで【聞：き】いたような【声：こえ】ズラ…
Translated Text: That voice sounds familiar...

Original Text: もんげー！\nコンビニの【前：まえ】で【聞：き】いた【声：こえ】ズラ！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
That's the voice I heard in front
of the convenience store!

Original Text: あの　ジバニャンとウィスパー\n【見：み】なかったズラか？
Translated Text: Hey, didn't you see Jibanyan and Whisper?

Original Text: ここは【本：ほん】に【封：ふう】じられし【世界：せかい】\nすなわち　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【世界：せかい】
Translated Text: This is a world sealed within a\nbook—that is, the world inside a book.

Original Text: 【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の…せかい？？
Translated Text: The world inside a book…??

Original Text: もんげー！　もしかしてオラ\n【今：いま】　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】にいるズラか！？
Translated Text: Whoa! Wait a minute—am I\nactually inside a book right now!?

Original Text: そうだ　お【前：まえ】はこの【本：ほん】…\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】
Translated Text:
That's right. You're the
Yo-kai chosen for this book...
*Yo-kai Sangokushi*.

Original Text: もんげー…\nたまげたズラー
Translated Text:
Whoa... I'm totally
blown away!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】は　この【本：ほん】の【呼：よ】びかけに【答：こた】えた\nそして【英雄：えいゆう】になりたいと【言：い】った
Translated Text: You answered this book’s call and\nsaid you wanted to become a hero.

Original Text: ズラ…？\nあ　そうズラ！
Translated Text:
A wig…?
Oh, right—a wig!

Original Text: オラ　エーユーになりたいズラ！\n【兄：にい】ちゃんカッコイイって【言：い】われたいズラ！
Translated Text:
I wanna be an AU!
I wanna have people tell me I'm cool, bro!

Original Text: ん？\nそれじゃあ　オラは【今：いま】…
Translated Text:
Huh?
So that means I'm...

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】よ\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【英雄：えいゆう】・【孫策：そんさく】となれ
Translated Text: O Chosen Yo-kai, become\nSun Ce, the hero of this book.

Original Text: エーユーなんズラ…！\nほんとに　ほんとの　エーユーなんズラ！
Translated Text:
What the heck is AU...!
It really, really is AU!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】よ
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: コマさん…　そんさく…！\nもんげー　カッコイイびひきズラ…！
Translated Text:
Komasan… That’s awesome…!
Man, that wig is so cool…!

Original Text: この【本：ほん】の【中：なか】と【外：そと】…\nふたつの【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うのだ
Translated Text:
Inside and outside this book… I must save
both worlds.

Original Text: もんげーっ\nお　オラがせかいをっ
Translated Text: Whoa! I'm gonna take over the world!

Original Text: もう　【声：こえ】は【届：とど】くことはない\n【私：わたし】の　【力：ちから】は【限界：げんかい】だ…
Translated Text: My voice will never reach them\nagain. I've reached my limit...

Original Text: はっ　せめてお【礼：れい】をっ\nお【礼：れい】をさせてほしいズラッ！
Translated Text: "Wait—at least let me thank\nyou! Let me thank you, please!"

Original Text: 【頼：たの】んだぞ…\n【選：えら】ばれし【英雄：えいゆう】・コマさん【孫策：そんさく】…
Translated Text:
I'm counting on you…
Chosen Hero Komasan Sun Ce…

Original Text: ……あ\n…【行：い】っちゃったズラ
Translated Text: ……Oh… he's gone.

Original Text: ほほう！\nお【前：まえ】　あの【孫策：そんさく】だったのか！
Translated Text:
Oh, really! So
you're that Sun Ce!

Original Text: 【孫策：そんさく】は　【優：やさ】しくてカッコイイ\nお【兄：にい】ちゃんなのだ
Translated Text: Sun Ce is a kind and cool older brother.

Original Text: お【兄：にい】ちゃん…
Translated Text: Big brother…

Original Text: メラ　メラッ　メラメ～ラ　メラ！\n（お【前：まえ】 コマじろう【孫権：そんけん】って【弟：おとうと】がいるだろ）
Translated Text:
Mera, Meraa, Mera-me-ra, Mera!
(Hey, you—Koma-jiro, you have a younger
brother named Sun Quan, right?)

Original Text: 【孫策：そんさく】と【孫権：そんけん】！　オレらは【会：あ】ったことはないが\n【当代一：とうだいいち】の　【人気：にんき】ブラザー【妖怪：ようかい】って【話：はなし】だぜ！
Translated Text: Sun Ce and Sun Quan! We've never met\nthem, but I hear they're the most popular\nbrother duo of Yo-kai around these days!

Original Text: そうズラか…\nこの【世界：せかい】にもオラには【弟：おとうと】が　いるズラね
Translated Text:
So that's how it is... I guess
I have a little brother in this
world, too.

Original Text: ズラ…\nオラ　この【本：ほん】に【運命：うんめい】を【感：かん】じるズラ…！
Translated Text:
Man
... I just feel like this book is my destiny...!

Original Text: オラ　この【世界：せかい】の\nコマじろうに【会：あ】ってみたいズラ！
Translated Text: Hey, I'd love to meet\nKoma-jiro from this world!

Original Text: 【願：ねが】いをかなえたいのなら\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めるのがいいのだ
Translated Text: If you want to make a wish come\ntrue, you should collect the orbs.

Original Text: ズラ…？\nほうじゅ…？
Translated Text:
A wig…?
A headband…?

Original Text: オイオイ【知：し】らないのか？\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【伝説：でんせつ】を！
Translated Text:
Hey, hey—don't you
know about the legend
of the treasure orb?!

Original Text: この【国：くに】にはフシギな【力：ちから】を【持：も】つ【八：やっ】つの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が\n【眠：ねむ】っていてな！
Translated Text: There are eight magical orbs\nwith mysterious powers\nhidden away in this country!

Original Text: すべての【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めると\nなんでも【願：ねが】いがかなうって【言：い】われてるのさ
Translated Text: They say that if you collect all the\norbs, any wish will come true.

Original Text: もんげー！\n【太：ふと】っ【腹：ぱら】な　お【話：はなし】ズラ…
Translated Text:
Wow!
What a generous story...

Original Text: その【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば\n【何：なん】でも【願：ねが】いがかなうズラね？
Translated Text: If you collect all those jewels,\nany wish will come true, right?

Original Text: どこに【行：い】けばもらえるズラ？
Translated Text: Where can I go to get one?

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】が【一個持：いっこも】ってるのだ\nだからあげるのだ
Translated Text: Ryu-kun (Liu Yu) has\none, so I'll give it to you.

Original Text: ズラ！？　【本当：ほんとう】にいいズラか？\nご【親切：しんせつ】に　ありがとズラ～
Translated Text:
A wig!? Is it really a good one?
Thanks a lot for your kindness~

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメ～ラ…\n（でも　【残：のこ】りはそう【簡単：かんたん】にはいかないぜ…）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…
(But the rest won’t be that easy…)

Original Text: メラッ　メラメラ　メ～ラ！\n（いまこの【国：くに】はまさに　【乱世：らんせ】！）
Translated Text:
Mera... Mera-mera... Me~ra!
(This country is truly in a
time of turmoil right now!)

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をめぐって\n【全国：ぜんこく】で【熱：あつ】いバトルが【起：お】きてるのさ
Translated Text: There's a fierce battle raging\nacross the country over this jewel.

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】では【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】ってる【妖怪：ようかい】が\nそれぞれのナワバリをしきってる
Translated Text: In Sakura Country, Yo-kai who\npossess treasure orbs rule over\ntheir respective territories.

Original Text: だから　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】ってたりゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】は\nこのあたりの【王様：おうさま】なのだ
Translated Text: That's why Ryu-kun, Liu Yu—who has\nthe jewel—is the king of this area.

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ　メラメ～ラッ\n（【王様：おうさま】たちはみんなお【互：たが】いの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をねらってる）
Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera, Mera~raa (All the\nkings are after each other's jewels.)

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメ～ラ…\n（つまり　すべての【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【手：て】に【入：い】れるには…）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…
(In other words, to get all the orbs…)

Original Text: 【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【挑：いど】んでビクトリアーン！\n【勝利：しょうり】を【勝：か】ちとらなきゃダメってことさ！
Translated Text:
Take on bosses across the
country and claim victory!
You’ve got to win!

Original Text: おおお…　またももんげ～【話：はなし】ズラ…\nお　オラ　【本当：ほんとう】に【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】ズラ…？
Translated Text:
Whoa... Monge's changing
the subject again... Oh
, man, am I really going to be okay...?

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】は\n【優：やさ】しくてカッコイイ　【英雄：えいゆう】なのだ
Translated Text: Komasan Sun Ce is a kind and cool hero.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】が【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【勝：か】てば\nきっと　さくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】がおとずれるのだ
Translated Text: If Komasan Sun Ce defeats the\nbosses across the country, peace\nwill surely come to Sakura Country.

Original Text: そ　そうズラか…？\nう　うん　オラがんばってみるズラ
Translated Text:
"So... is that how it is...?
" "Uh, yeah. I'll give it my best shot."

Original Text: オラ　もんげー\nカッコイイ　エーユーになってみせるズラ！
Translated Text: Man, this is so cool! I'm gonna\nbecome an AU, you hear me!

Original Text: その【意気：いき】だコマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nオレたちは【一緒：いっしょ】には【行：い】けないが…
Translated Text:
Way to go, Komasan Sun Ce!
We can't go with you, but...

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【旅：たび】の【無事：ぶじ】を　いのっている！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(I'm praying for a safe journey!)

Original Text: ありがとズラー！
Translated Text: Thanks a bunch!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: もんげーエーユー　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nいざ　【弟：おとうと】をさがしに【出発：しゅっぱつ】…ズラ！
Translated Text:
Mongee AU, Komasan Sun Ce!
Off we go to find my little brother… Zura!

Original Text: 【待：ま】つのだ
Translated Text: Wait.

Original Text: 【何：なん】ズラ？
Translated Text: What's up?

Original Text: コマじろう【孫権：そんけん】がいる【場所：ばしょ】は\nここから　とっても【遠：とお】いのだ
Translated Text: The place where Komajiro Sun\nQuan is is very far from here.

Original Text: もんげー！　【遠：とお】いんズラか！？\nそれは【困：こま】ったズラね…
Translated Text:
Whoa! Is it that far away!?
That's a problem, isn't it...

Original Text: オラ　【途中：とちゅう】で【道：みち】に【迷：まよ】っちまわないか\n【心配：しんぱい】ズラ…
Translated Text: Hey, I'm worried I might\nget lost along the way...

Original Text: 【安心：あんしん】するのだ　りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】が\nいっしょに【行：い】ってあげるのだ
Translated Text: Don't worry, Ryu-kun.\nLiu Yu will go with you.

Original Text: ほ　ほんとズラ？\nとっても【親切：しんせつ】ズラ！　ありがとうズラ！
Translated Text:
Is that really true? You're
so kind! Thank you!

Original Text: では　【気：き】を【取：と】り【直：なお】して…\nもんげーエーユー　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！　いざ…
Translated Text:
Well then, let's get back on track…
Mongee AU, Komasan
Sun Ce! Here we go…

Original Text: 【待：ま】つのだ
Translated Text: Wait.

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: まずは\nトレーニングからなのだ
Translated Text: It all starts with training.

Original Text: す　【少：すこ】しはデキるみたいっスね\nまあ　ともだちになってやっても…
Translated Text: Hmm... Looks like you're kind of good at\nthis. Well, I guess I'll let you be my friend...

Original Text: って\nそ　それは…　ほ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】っ！？
Translated Text: Wait, that's... a... a magic orb!?

Original Text: はっ！　ははーっ！\nご【無礼：ぶれい】　お【許：ゆる】しっスーっ！
Translated Text:
Whoa! Haha!
My apologies—please
forgive me! Whoosh!

Original Text: ズラ？　この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】って\nそんなに　スゴいんズラ？
Translated Text: Really? Is this gem really that amazing?

Original Text: そうなのだ　だから\n【使：つか】い【方：かた】をまちがえちゃダメなのだ
Translated Text: That's right. That's why you\nmustn't use it the wrong way.

Original Text: そんなすごいものをオラにくれるなんて…\nなんだか【申：もう】し【訳：わけ】ないズラ
Translated Text:
To think you'd give me
something so amazing... I
kind of feel bad about it.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】は　ほんとに\n【強：つよ】くて【優：やさ】しい　エーユーなのだ
Translated Text: Komasan Sun Ce is a truly\nstrong and kind A-U.

Original Text: だから　【早：はや】く【集：あつ】めて\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】に【会：あ】うといいのだ
Translated Text: So you should hurry up and gather them\nso you can meet Komajiro Sun Quan.

Original Text: 【強：つよ】くて【優：やさ】しい　エーユー…！\nえへへ　なんだか【嬉：うれ】しいズラ
Translated Text:
Strong yet gentle, AU…!
Hehehe, that makes me happy, you know?

Original Text: コマじろう【孫権：そんけん】さんの【住：す】んでるあたりは\nなんでも【今：いま】　【荒：あ】れてるらしいっスね
Translated Text: I hear the area where Komasan Sun Quan\nlives is pretty run-down these days.

Original Text: もんげーーー！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: そそそ…　それは\nいったい　どういうことズラ！？
Translated Text: W-w-wait... What on\nearth does that mean!?

Original Text: 【今：いま】は【乱世：らんせ】なのだ\n【各地：かくち】で【争：あらそ】いが【起：お】きているのだ
Translated Text: These are turbulent times; conflicts\nare breaking out all over the country.

Original Text: はっ　そうだったズラ…\n【悲：かな】しいことズラ…
Translated Text:
Oh, that's right... That's so
sad...

Original Text: オラ　【兄：にい】ちゃんとして\nこの【世界：せかい】の【弟：おとうと】を　【放：ほう】っておけないズラ！
Translated Text: Hey, as an older brother, I can't\njust leave my little brother in\nthis world all by himself!

Original Text: その【意気：いき】なのだ　【兄弟：きょうだい】　【２人：ふたり】そろえば\nきっと【平和：へいわ】が【戻：もど】るのだ
Translated Text: That's the spirit, brother. If the two of us\nstick together, peace will surely return.

Original Text: コマじろう！\n【今助：いまたす】けに【行：い】くからな　【待：ま】ってるズラよ～！
Translated Text:
Komajiro!
I'm coming to save you right
now, so wait for me, okay~!

Original Text: では　あらためて…\nもんげーエーユー　コマさんそんさ…
Translated Text:
Well then, let’s start over… Mongee
AU, Komasan, here we go…

Original Text: だれか　【助：たす】けてええええ！
Translated Text: Someone, help meeeee!

Original Text: ズラッ
Translated Text: In a row

Original Text: お【願：ねが】い！\nふたりのケンカを【止：と】めてえ！
Translated Text:
Please!
Stop them from fighting!

Original Text: えと…\nどちらさまズラ？
Translated Text:
Um...
Who are you, exactly?

Original Text: このへんでよくダンスやってる\nメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】　っスね
Translated Text: That's Mekabu-chan, also known\nas Abalone San-nyo, who's always\ndancing around here, right?

Original Text: おともだちのワカメくん【関索：かんさく】と\nコンブさん【関興：かんこう】がケンカしてるの
Translated Text: My friends Wakame-kun (Guan Suo) and\nKombu-san (Guan Xing) are fighting.

Original Text: ふたりとも【我：われ】を【忘：わす】れちゃって…\n【私：わたし】には　【止：と】められない！
Translated Text:
They've both lost control...
and there's nothing
I can do to stop them!

Original Text: それは【大変：たいへん】ズラねー\nオラもコマじろうとたまーにケンカするズラ
Translated Text: That's rough, man. I get into fights with\nKomajiro every now and then, too.

Original Text: まあ【男同士：おとこどうし】は\nケンカしてナンボっすからねー
Translated Text: Well, guys are only really\nguys if they fight, right?

Original Text: そんな　さわがなくっても\nそのうち【仲直：なかなお】りするんじゃないっスか？
Translated Text: You don't have to make such a fuss—don't\nyou think they'll make up eventually?

Original Text: そんな…\n【止：と】めてくれなかったら…　【私：わたし】…
Translated Text:
"Oh no... If you hadn't
stopped me... I..."

Original Text: あっ
Translated Text: Oh!

Original Text: うっ　うっ　しくしく…
Translated Text: Ugh... ugh... sniff, sniff...

Original Text: …あーあ　【泣：な】かした～
Translated Text: …Oh man, I made her cry~

Original Text: もんげー！？\nお　オラのせいズラ…！？
Translated Text:
No way!?
I—it's my fault...!?

Original Text: ズララッ　【泣：な】かないでズラ\nお　オラがなんとかする　ズラ
Translated Text: Zura-ra-ra... Don't cry, Zura-o.\nI'll take care of it. Zura

Original Text: うっく　えく…
Translated Text: Ugh... Eek...

Original Text: ズラッ\nズラズラズラーーッ
Translated Text: Zla-zla-zla-zlaaaaaa!

Original Text: ちょっと　ズラズラいってないで\nなんとかしなさいよっっっっ
Translated Text: Stop rambling on and just\ndo something alreadyyyyyy!

Original Text: ああ…ふたりが【仲：なか】よしに\nもどってくれて　うれしい！
Translated Text: Ah... I'm so glad they're\ngetting along again!

Original Text: ね　そこの【白：しろ】くって\nプリチーな　【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】さん♪
Translated Text: Hey, you there—that cute,\nwhite warrior Yo-kai♪

Original Text: …そ　そうズラねー
Translated Text: …Yeah, that’s about right.

Original Text: （お　【女：おんな】の【子：こ】って　もんげーズラ…）
Translated Text: (Oh... girls are such a pain...)

Original Text: 【大好：だいす】きなメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】のナミダは\nもう【見：み】たくないぜ！　フォー！
Translated Text: I don't want to see any more tears\nfrom my favorite Mekabu-chan,\nAbalone Sanjo! Four!

Original Text: ええ　メカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】に【似合：にあ】うのは\nそのまぶしい【笑顔：えがお】です！
Translated Text: Yeah, Mekabu-chan, what\nreally suits you, Abalone Sanjo,\nis that dazzling smile of yours!

Original Text: もしかして…\nそのコをとりあってケンカ…　とかっスか？
Translated Text:
Could it be... that you guys
got into a fight over that
girl... or something like that?

Original Text: ちっ　ちがいますって！\nいや　そうかもしれないですけど…
Translated Text:
Ugh, that's not what I meant!
Well, I guess you could say that...

Original Text: なんでケンカを【始：はじ】めたのか\nボクたちぜんぜん【覚：おぼ】えてないのさ…
Translated Text: We don't remember at all why we\nstarted fighting in the first place...

Original Text: もんげー…\nなんか　【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざ！　って【感：かん】じズラ
Translated Text:
Wow... It
totally feels like the work of a Yo-kai!

Original Text: この【近：ちか】くにキンギン【党：とう】という\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちがいるのだ
Translated Text: There's a group of warrior Yo-kai\ncalled the Kingin Party around here.

Original Text: え？　キンギン【党：とう】のことを\nもっと【知：し】りたいクマ？
Translated Text: Huh? Do you want to know more\nabout the Kingin Party, Kuma?

Original Text: だったら\nボクのうんちくを【聞：き】くクマ！
Translated Text: Well then, listen to my\nlittle bit of trivia, Bear!

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】は【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をあやつる【術：じゅつ】を\n【使：つか】うおそろしい【集団：しゅうだん】っス！
Translated Text: The Kingin Party is a terrifying group that\nuses magic to control warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】すのだ！
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce!
Let's defeat the Kingin Party!

Original Text: おおお…　もんげーエーユー\n【最初：さいしょ】の【戦：たたか】いってわけズラね…！
Translated Text: Whoa… So this is AU’s first battle, huh…!

Original Text: なんだか【燃：も】えてきたズラ～！
Translated Text: I'm really getting fired up now, Zura~!

Original Text: おおお　コマさん【孫策様：そんさくさま】が\n【燃：も】えていらっしゃるぜ！
Translated Text: Whoa! Komasan, Sun Ce is on fire!

Original Text: メカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】！\n【皆：みな】さんの【旅立：たびだ】ちの【前：まえ】に　お【礼：れい】の【品：　しなじな】々を！
Translated Text:
Meakabu-chan and Abalone San-nyo!
Here are some thank-you
gifts for everyone before
you set off on your journey!

Original Text: ハーイ　【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】さん\nあたしたちからのお【礼：れい】　たくさんあるのよ♪
Translated Text: Hey, White Warrior Yo-kai! We’ve\ngot lots of thank-you gifts for you♪

Original Text: いやいや　お【礼：れい】なんて【申：もう】し【訳：わけ】ないズラ\nオラはただ…
Translated Text: No, no—I wouldn't want you\nto thank me. Zuraora just...

Original Text: やだ　もしかして\nただこの【私：わたし】のハートが【欲：ほ】しいとか？
Translated Text: Oh no... Could it be that\nyou just want my heart?

Original Text: あ\nではないズラ
Translated Text: That's Not It

Original Text: フフ…\n【術：じゅつ】の【効果：こうか】はバッチリじゃ
Translated Text:
Hehe… The
spell worked like a charm.

Original Text: 【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】どもは\n【我：われ】らの【思：おも】いどおりに【争：あらそ】っておる
Translated Text: Those Yo-kai are fighting\njust as we intended.

Original Text: このスキに　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば…\n【野望：やぼう】を【果：は】たせようぞ
Translated Text:
If I gather the orbs while
they're distracted... I'll be
able to fulfill my ambition
.

Original Text: じゃが…いまいましい\nジャマ【者：もの】がおるようじゃな…
Translated Text: Well... looks like there's some\npesky meddler around...

Original Text: ドウと【言：い】うことはない　【幻術：げんじゅつ】の【霧：きり】を\n【大量：たいりょう】にまいておけば　【問題：もんだい】あるまいて！
Translated Text: There's nothing to worry about—as\nlong as we spread a ton of illusory\nmist, there won't be any problems!

Original Text: え？　ちょっと　【待：ま】て！
Translated Text: Huh? Wait a minute!

Original Text: そおーれ！　これでドウじゃ～？
Translated Text: There you go! How's that?

Original Text: こ　このアホウ！\nこれじゃ【我：われ】らも【身動：みうご】きとれん！
Translated Text:
Y-You idiot!
We can't move a muscle like this!

Original Text: どうやって\n【残：のこ】りの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をさがすんじゃ！？
Translated Text: How am I supposed to\nfind the rest of the orbs!?

Original Text: …ドウもすみません
Translated Text: …I'm really sorry

Original Text: ということで\nキンギン【党：とう】のアジトまでやってきたっス
Translated Text: So, I made it all the way to\nthe Kingin Party's hideout.

Original Text: け　けむいズラ…\nこ　これがこの【世界：せかい】の【都会：とかい】の【空気：くうき】ズラね…
Translated Text:
Whew... this is stifling...
So... this is what the air in a big
city in this world is like, huh...

Original Text: 【霧：きり】ッスね
Translated Text: It's foggy, isn't it?

Original Text: これじゃ　アジトがどこにあるか\nわからないっス
Translated Text: At this rate, I won't be able to\nfigure out where the hideout is.

Original Text: これもきっと\nキンギン【党：とう】の【幻術：げんじゅつ】なのだ
Translated Text: This must surely be another illusion\ncreated by the Kingin Party.

Original Text: だが　【安心：あんしん】するのだ\n【水晶玉：すいしょうだま】にすすむべき【道：みち】が【見：み】えるのだ
Translated Text: But don't worry—you can see the path\nyou should take in the crystal ball.

Original Text: ズラ…！　こ　この…\nクルクルっと【巻：ま】かれた【形：かたち】は…！
Translated Text:
A wig…! T-this… this
curly shape…!

Original Text: ソフトクリーム…！

Ho ho ho ho ho ho ho!
Here we go—off to the final battle!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】のかつやくによって\nキンギン【党：とう】は【滅：ほろ】びました…
Translated Text: Because of my actions, the\nKingin Party was destroyed…

Original Text: ですが　まだ【序：じょ】の【口：くち】！\n【私：わたくし】の【実力：じつりょく】はこんなものでは…！
Translated Text:
But that's just the tip of the iceberg!
This is nothing compared to
what I'm really capable of...!

Original Text: これが\nキンギン【党：とう】が【持：も】っていた【宝珠：ほうじゅ】なのだ
Translated Text: This is the jewel that the\nKingin Party possessed.

Original Text: わ～\nきれいズラね～
Translated Text: Wow, that's a pretty face!

Original Text: おらあ！\nふたりとも【話：はなし】を【聞：き】けー！
Translated Text:
Hey!
You two, listen up!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】つ【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】　【狙：ねら】う【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】は\nまだまだたくさんいます！
Translated Text: Warrior Yo-kai with Jewels: There are\nstill plenty of warrior yo-kai to target!

Original Text: いいですか　【今：いま】からこの【私：わたくし】が\n【現在：げんざい】のさくら【国：こく】の【情勢：じょうせい】を【解説：かいせつ】いたしますから
Translated Text: All right? I'm going to explain\nthe current situation in the Land\nof Sakura starting now, so—

Original Text: よーく\n【頭：あたま】にたたきこんでくださいね！
Translated Text: Make sure you really\nget that into your head!

Original Text: ＺＺＺ…ＺＺＺ…
Translated Text: Zzz... Zzz...

Original Text: 【聞：き】く【気：き】なし！
Translated Text: I'm not interested in listening!

Original Text: イカーッカッカッカ！
Translated Text: Ika-ka-ka-ka!

Original Text: どんな【願：ねが】いもかなうという【宝珠：ほうじゅ】…\n【私：わたし】が【集：あつ】めてやろうじゃなイカ！
Translated Text:
A magical gem that grants any wish…
I’m going to collect them all, aren’t I?!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓様：ぎちょうとうたくさま】～！
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, Lord Dong Zhuo~!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らがブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】に\n【手：て】こずっていたうちに…
Translated Text: While our Captain Bree was\nhaving a hard time with Guan Yu...

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が\n【何者：なにもの】かに【奪：うば】われたようです　トホホ
Translated Text: It looks like someone stole the\nKingin Party's jewel. Oh well...

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】　ぶようじん！
Translated Text: Kingin Party: Be Strong!

Original Text: きわめてイカんである！
Translated Text: That's totally messed up!

Original Text: で　その【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【奪：うば】ったヤツって…\nまさか　キミか！
Translated Text:
So... the one who stole that jewel...
don't tell me it was you!

Original Text: なんば【言：い】いよっとね\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】ばい　だるか～
Translated Text: "I'm saying, Komasan, Sun\nCe, right? Is that right~?"

Original Text: ほう…　あのコマさん【孫策：そんさく】
Translated Text: Hmm... That Komasan, Sun Ce...

Original Text: 【私：わたし】のジャマをするとは\nナカナカの【器：うつわ】…
Translated Text: To think you'd get in my\nway—you've got some nerve…

Original Text: だが　それだけでは【私：わたし】は【倒：たお】せんぞ！\n【私：わたし】には【四天王：してんのう】がいるのだからな！
Translated Text:
But that alone won't be
enough to defeat me!
After all, I have my Four Heavenly Kings!

Original Text: そして【何：なに】より\nこの【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】がいるではなイカ！
Translated Text: And best of all, isn't this the\nRed Demon Lu Bu right here?!

Original Text: あっかあああ～ん！
Translated Text: Aaaahhh!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】がすべて【集：あつ】まるのも\n【時間：じかん】の【問題：もんだい】ではなイカ！
Translated Text: It's only a matter of time before\nall the orbs are gathered, isn't it!

Original Text: イカーッカッカッカ！
Translated Text: Ika-ka-ka-ka!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】と【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】！\n【強：つよ】そうクマ…　【怖：こわ】そうクマ…
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone, Dong
Zhuo, and the Red Demon Lü Bu!
They look so strong... They look so scary...

Original Text: このふたりのうんちくを【聞：き】きたい【人：ひと】は\nこちらクマ…！
Translated Text: If you want to hear these two's\ninsights, click here, Bear…!

Original Text: もんげーエーユー　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nコマじろうを【助：たす】けに　いざ【参上：さんじょう】ズラ！！
Translated Text:
Mongee AU, Komasan
Sun Ce! I'm here to save
Koma-jiro—here I come!!

Original Text: …のはずが\n【早：はや】くも【道：みち】に【迷：まよ】ってしまったズラ
Translated Text: …or so I thought, but I ended\nup getting lost right away.

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】は　【物知：ものし】りズラ\nコマじろうがどこにいるか　【知：し】ってるズラ？
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming, do you know\nwhere Komajiro the Know-It-All is?

Original Text: ハイハイ　えーコマじろう…　さんですね？\nも　もちろん【知：し】ってますよ　【有名人：ゆうめいじん】ですから
Translated Text:
Oh, right. E-Koma Jiro… that’s you, right?
Of course I know
him—he’s famous, after all.

Original Text: さがしたぞ\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】
Translated Text: I found you, Komasan Sun Ce!

Original Text: えーっと　【妖怪：ようかい】パッド　【妖怪：ようかい】パッド…\nってギャビー―ンッッ！　この【方：　　かたがた】々はっっ
Translated Text:
Um... Yo-kai Pad, Yo-kai
Pad... Wait, GABBYYYY
! These people are...

Original Text: お【前：まえ】がコマさん【孫策：そんさく】か\nウワサどおり　いい【面：つら】してんじゃねえか
Translated Text: So you're Komasan, Sun Ce?\nJust like the rumors say—you've\ngot quite the face, don't you?

Original Text: わー　もんげー【立派：りっぱ】なおふたりズラー\nで　どちら【様：さま】ズラ？
Translated Text: Wow, what a magnificent\npair! Who are you two?

Original Text: シャラーップ！\n【超有名人：ちょうゆうめいじん】！　【超：ちょう】　【超：ちょう】　【超：ちょう】　【有名人：ゆうめいじん】！
Translated Text:
Shut up!
A super-famous person! A super,
super, super-famous person!

Original Text: ほほほほほ　やだもーこの【人：ひと】\n【田舎：いなか】から【出：で】てきたばっかりでえ～
Translated Text: Hahaha... Oh, come on—this\nperson just moved here from\nthe countryside, you know~

Original Text: こちら　さくら【国団々坂出身：こくだんだんざかしゅっしん】の【名家：めいか】・【袁家：えんけ】の\n【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】と【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】ですぞ！
Translated Text:
Here are Lord Yuan Shao, the Earth
Spider from the prestigious Yuan
family of Sakura-kuni’s Dandan-zaka,
and Lord Oogama En Jutsu!

Original Text: オラ　コマさんズラ\n【都会人：とかいじん】の【名前：なまえ】は　【長：なが】くてカッコいいズラねー
Translated Text: Hey, Komasan, city folks have\nsuch long, cool names, don't they?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】ら　あのキンギン【党：とう】を\n【倒：たお】したらしいな
Translated Text: I hear you guys took\ndown that Kingin Party.

Original Text: その【力：ちから】を【見：み】こんで【頼：たの】みがある\n…イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】さねえか？
Translated Text: I believe in your strength, so I have a\nfavor to ask… Chairman Ikakamone,\nwould you take down Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】？
Translated Text: Is Chairman Ikakamone actually Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】とは…！　その…\nあの…　えーと…　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】です！
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone,
Dong Zhuo is…! Um…
well… er… he’s the head of the villains!

Original Text: あっ　【悪：あく】の…　【親玉：おやだま】…！？
Translated Text: Oh, the... head of the evil... organization...!?

Original Text: このさくら【国：こく】さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】で\nヤツは【急成長：きゅうせいちょう】しておってな…
Translated Text: That guy’s been growing like\ncrazy here in the Sakura Housing\nDistrict of Sakura Country…

Original Text: ま　オレたちは【隣：となり】の【街：まち】のもんだが\nちょっと【見過：みす】ごせなくなってよ
Translated Text: Well, we're from the next town over,\nbut we just couldn't ignore it anymore.

Original Text: 【都会：とかい】にはびこる　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】！\nこれは　つまり…
Translated Text:
The mastermind of evil
running rampant in the city!
In other words…

Original Text: またとない\nもんげーエーユーの【出番：でばん】ズラ！
Translated Text: A once-in-a-lifetime,\nmind-blowing AU moment!

Original Text: 【通訳：つうやく】いたしますと\nよろこんで【協力：きょうりょく】するとのことでうぃすー
Translated Text: They said they'd be happy to\nhelp with interpreting, so...

Original Text: 【都会：とかい】のビルの【谷間：たにま】を\nもんげー【飛：と】び【回：まわ】るズラーッ！
Translated Text: They're flying all over the place\nbetween the city skyscrapers—whoa!

Original Text: もんげーエーユー　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nいざ　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】をやっつけるズラ！
Translated Text:
Mongee AU, Komasan Sun Ce!
Let's go take down the big bad boss!

Original Text: お【待：ま】ちください\nあれは…
Translated Text: Wait a minute—is that…

Original Text: メラ　メラ～！\n（コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera~!
(Komasan, Sun Ce!)

Original Text: アナタはたしか…えっと…その…
Translated Text: You're definitely... um... well...

Original Text: メラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！\n【前：まえ】は　お【世話：せわ】になったズラ！
Translated Text:
Mera Mera Lion Zhang Fei!
Thanks for everything back then, Zura!

Original Text: そう！　【今：いま】そう【言：い】おうと【思：おも】っていたんです！\nで　【何：なに】かご【用：よう】ですか？
Translated Text:
That's right! I was just about to say that!
So, is there something you need?

Original Text: メラメラメラ…\n（オレたちのすみかが…）
Translated Text:
Flame, flame, flame…
(Our home is…)

Original Text: メラメラ！　メ～ラ！\n（イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】におそわれて…）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze! Me~ra!
(Chairman Ikakamone has been
attacked by Dong Zhuo's army...)

Original Text: ヤツら　ますます\nつけあがっておるようだな…
Translated Text: Those guys seem to be getting\nmore and more cocky...

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメラッ！\n（どうか　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, mera!
(Please, lend me your strength!)

Original Text: もちろんズラ！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】にお【任：まか】せズラよ！
Translated Text:
Of course, Zura! Leave it to
Komasan Sun Ce, Zura!

Original Text: 【我：われ】ら　イカカモネ【議長董卓討伐：ぎちょうとうたくとうばつ】の　【志：こころざし】のもと\n【今：いま】まさに【一：ひと】つになっていたところでうぃす！
Translated Text: We—the Ikakamone Council—have\njust united under our shared resolve\nto defeat Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: メラメラ！\n（ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Whoosh!
(Thank you!)

Original Text: これで　【役者：やくしゃ】はそろったな…
Translated Text: Well, it looks like we've got all the players here now...

Original Text: さっそくイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】しに【行：い】こうぜ！
Translated Text: Let's go defeat Chairman Dong\nZhuo right away, Ikakamone!

Original Text: オホン！　その【前：まえ】にみなさん！
Translated Text: Ahem! But first, everyone!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らにふさわしい\nチーム【名：めい】を【決：き】めませんか？
Translated Text: Why don't we come up with\na team name that suits us?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】とゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たち\n…なんて　いかがです？
Translated Text: "Whisper Kongming and His\nFun-Loving Friends"... How about that?

Original Text: ハァァァ～？\nナメてるクマ！？
Translated Text:
Huhhh~?
Are you messing with me, Bear!?

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: 【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】がいいクマ！\n【説明：せつめい】はこちらクマ！
Translated Text:
The Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition is
awesome! Click here for more
info!

Original Text: ……\n【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】か　【悪：わる】くない
Translated Text:
……The Coalition
Against Dong Zhuo? Not bad.

Original Text: では　この【軍：ぐん】は【吾輩：わがはい】が【率：ひき】いる！\n【皆：みな】の【者：もの】　ついて【参：まい】れ！！
Translated Text:
"Very well, then—I shall lead this army!
Everyone, follow me!!"

Original Text: ありゃ　リーダーの【役：やく】とられちまった\nまあいいや　【今回：こんかい】はゆずってやるよ
Translated Text: Oh no, someone took my spot as\nleader. Oh well, I'll let it slide this time.

Original Text: 【行：ゆ】くぞ　【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】！\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【成敗：せいばい】するのだ！
Translated Text:
Let's go, Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition!
Chairman Ikakamone, let's
bring Dong Zhuo to justice!

Original Text: おおおー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: おい　【戦：たたか】いの【前：まえ】にひとつ\n【忠告：ちゅうこく】しといてやるぜ
Translated Text: Hey, I'll give you one piece\nof advice before the fight.

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【四天王：してんのう】に【気：き】をつけろ
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, watch out for Dong Zhuo's Four Heavenly Kings.

Original Text: ズラ…？\n【四天王：してんのう】…？
Translated Text:
A wig…?
The Four Heavenly Kings…?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】を【支：ささ】える\n【四将軍：よんしょうぐん】のことさ　ヤツらは　ズルがしこい
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, you mean the four\ngenerals who support Dong Zhuo’s\narmy, right? Those guys are really crafty.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】の【領地：りょうち】にも\n【攻：せ】めてくるかもしれねえ
Translated Text: Komasan might even\nattack Sun Ce's territory.

Original Text: りょうち…？
Translated Text: Ryochi…?

Original Text: ええ　【困：こま】った【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けたり\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】したりしたので…
Translated Text: Yeah, well, I helped some people in\ntrouble and defeated the Kingin Party, so...

Original Text: さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】のしせつを\nいくつか【持：も】っておりますよ！
Translated Text: We have a few facilities in\nthe Sakura residential area!

Original Text: せっかく\n【勝：か】ち【取：と】った【領地：りょうち】だ
Translated Text: We worked so hard to win this territory

Original Text: 【守：まも】りのメンバーをきっちり\n【置：お】いておいたほうがいいぜ！
Translated Text: You'd better make sure to have\nyour defensive players in position!

Original Text: 【数多：あまた】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【率：ひき】い　【土地：とち】を【治：おさ】める\nお【主：ぬし】ももう　【一国：いっこく】の【主：あるじ】よな
Translated Text: Leading countless Yo-kai and\ngoverning the land, you, too, are\nnow the ruler of a nation, aren't you?

Original Text: イヨッ　さくら【国：こく】の　【小覇王：しょうはおう】！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text:
Yay! The Little Conqueror of
the Land of Cherry Blossoms!
Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: しょうっ　【覇王：はおう】…！\nもんげー！　もんげーズラー！
Translated Text:
Whoa, the Overlord…! That’s
crazy! That’s so crazy!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち\nいい【戦：たたか】いぶりだったぞ！
Translated Text: You guys put up a great fight!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（コマさん【孫策：そんさく】　ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze~!
(Thank you, Komasan Sun Ce!)

Original Text: えへへ　もんげーエーユーは\nいつでも　【困：こま】ってる【妖怪：ようかい】の【味方：みかた】ズラ！
Translated Text: Hehehe... Mongee AU is always\nthere to help Yo-kai in trouble!

Original Text: え～【浮：う】かれるのはまだ【早：はや】いかと…\n【四天王：してんのう】は【残：のこ】り３【人：にん】もいますし
Translated Text:
Well... I guess it's still too early to
get carried away... There are still
three of the Four Heavenly Kings
left, after all.

Original Text: うるさいぞ！　【白：しろ】いの！\nフヨフヨしやがって！！
Translated Text:
Shut up! You white thing! Stop
wiggling around!!

Original Text: ぼへっー！　【頭：あたま】たたかない！\n【私：わたくし】のチャームポイントがぁ～！
Translated Text:
Ugh! Don't hit my head!
That's my best feature!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】からオレたちは\nえいえんの　ともだちだ！
Translated Text: Starting today, we're friends forever!

Original Text: メラッ　メラメラ！\n（【熱：あつ】い【誓：ちか】いを【結：むす】ぼう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze away!
(Let's make a fiery vow!)

Original Text: えいえんの…　ともだちっ…\nじいん…
Translated Text: Eternal... friends... Jinn...

Original Text: はううっ\nこれはまさしく【三国志一：さんごくしいち】の【名場面：めいばめん】…
Translated Text: Wow, this is truly one of the\ngreatest scenes in *Romance\nof the Three Kingdoms*…

Original Text: 『【公園：こうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』ー！
Translated Text: "The Park Oath"—!

Original Text: ちがーう！　『【桃園：とうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』クマ！\nこっちで【説明：せつめい】するクマ！
Translated Text:
No way! "The Oath of the
Peach Garden," Bear!
I'll explain it over here, Bear!

Original Text: …あれ？\nあの【人：ひと】　【劉備：りゅうび】じゃなくて　【孫策：そんさく】ですけど
Translated Text:
…Huh?
That guy isn't Liu Bei—it's Sun Ce.

Original Text: シャラーップ！
Translated Text: Shut up!

Original Text: ギャー！\nなんで【私怒：わたくしおこ】られるのっ
Translated Text:
Eek!
Why am I getting scolded?!

Original Text: （【拝啓：はいけい】　お【母：かあ】ちゃん　コマじろう\n【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【世界：せかい】は　とってもいいところズラ）
Translated Text: (Dear Mom, the world inside the Komajiro\nbook is such a wonderful place!)

Original Text: （オラ　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】で\n【一生：いっしょう】の　ともだちができたズラ！）
Translated Text: (Hey, I made a friend for life in this book!)

Original Text: よーし！　【覚悟：かくご】はできたな？\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text:
All right! Are you ready?
Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【我：われ】ら３【人：にん】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(The three of us!)

Original Text: 【生：う】まれた【時：とき】…いや【場所：ばしょ】も【違：ちが】うけど！
Translated Text: When I was born… well, actually, the place was different too!

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: We'll die together! Victorian!

Original Text: どさくさにまぎれて\n【私：わたくし】もビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: Taking advantage of the\ncommotion, I'm a Victorian too!

Original Text: 【白：しろ】いのは　【引：ひ】っこんでろ！
Translated Text: You white guy, get lost!

Original Text: ぐへっ…！\nどさくさにまぎれて…
Translated Text:
Guh...! While everyone was distracted
...

Original Text: こちらが…\n【入手：にゅうしゅ】できたでうぃす…　バタリ…
Translated Text:
Here it is… I managed to
get it… *thud*…

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「チャレンジバトル」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "Challenge Battle"app for the Yo-kai Pad.

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "【g】Yo-kai Pad"【e】 app, "Yo-kai Online Store."

Original Text: おお　ぶようじん【坊金旋：ぼうきんせん】よ！\n【負：ま】けてしまうとは【情：なさ】けないではなイカ
Translated Text:
Oh, you good-for-nothing Kin-sen!
How pathetic of you to
lose, don't you think?

Original Text: だがヤツは【四天王：してんのう】の【中：なか】では【最弱：さいじゃく】！
Translated Text: But he's the weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち３【人：にん】が【残：のこ】っていれば\nなんの【心配：しんぱい】もいらないではなイカ！
Translated Text: If the three of you are still here,\nthere’s nothing to worry about, right?

Original Text: そして…　【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】！
Translated Text: And… Red Demon Lu Bu!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】に　ジャングルハンターを\nまかせようではなイカ！
Translated Text: How about I let you handle\nthe Jungle Hunter, huh?

Original Text: あっか～ん！\nワシの【力：ちから】　【思：おも】い【知：し】らせてくれる！
Translated Text:
Oh no!
You're really showing
me what I'm made of!

Original Text: ズラーッ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】にとどめをさすズラ！
Translated Text: Zura! Chairman Kakamone delivers\nthe final blow to Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】ったああああ！
Translated Text: Wait a minute!

Original Text: な　【何：なん】ズラ！？
Translated Text: W-What the heck is that!?

Original Text: あ　あたしぃ　【第一印象：だいいちいんしょう】から\nアナタに【決：き】めてましたあ…
Translated Text: "I... I knew you were the one from\nthe very first moment I saw you..."

Original Text: って　ちがーう！
Translated Text: Wait—no way!

Original Text: りょ　りょ　りょ　【呂布：りょふ】ですっ！\n【呂布：りょふ】ですよおおおお！
Translated Text:
Ryō, Ryō, Ryō—it's Lü Bu!
It's Lü Buuuuu!

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】　さいきょう！\nとっても【恐：おそ】ろしい　【赤：あか】いヤツです！
Translated Text:
Sakura Kingdom—Saikyo! This is that
really scary red guy!

Original Text: ひとまず【逃：に】げましょう！
Translated Text: Let's get out of here for now!

Original Text: メラメラ！　メラッ！\n（オレが【食：く】い【止：と】める！　【行：い】け！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze!
(I'll hold them off! Go!)

Original Text: おいおい　オレもブラザーを【置：お】いて\n【逃：に】げるような　ヘタレじゃないぞ！
Translated Text: Hey, hey—I'm no wimp who'd just run\naway and leave my brother behind!

Original Text: オラにまかせるズラ！\nもんげーエーユーは　あきらめないズラ！
Translated Text:
Leave it to me!
Mongee AU never gives up!

Original Text: いや　ならばここは【私：わたくし】が！\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のかつやく　ごらんあれ！
Translated Text:
No—in that case, I'll take care of this!
Watch the genius strategist in action!

Original Text: …って　【誰：だれ】もいねえ！\nなんで【私：わたくし】のときは【誰：だれ】も【止：と】めないんじゃーいっ
Translated Text:
…Wait, there’s no one here!
Why doesn’t anyone stop
me when it’s my turn?!

Original Text: ま　【待：ま】ってー！\n【私：わたくし】も【逃：に】げるでうぃすー！
Translated Text:
W-Wait!
I'm running away too!

Original Text: ふうー\nここまでくれば【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】です…
Translated Text: Phew... Now that I've made\nit this far, I'll be fine...

Original Text: 【退：ひ】くことにはなったが…\nコマさん【孫策軍：そんさくぐん】の【戦：たたか】いぶりは【実：じつ】に【見事：みごと】
Translated Text:
Although they ended up
retreating… Komasan,
Sun Ce’s army fought truly magnificently.

Original Text: ああ　たいしたもんだ\nおかげでイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】たちは【弱：よわ】ってる
Translated Text: Wow, that's impressive. Thanks to\nthat, Chairman Ikakamone and\nDong Zhuo's forces are weakened.

Original Text: そこで…　【最後：さいご】の【仕上：しあ】げは\nお【主：ぬし】らに【任：まか】せたいのだが…
Translated Text: So… I’d like to leave the finishing\ntouches up to you guys…

Original Text: 【団：だんだん】々【坂：ざか】でトラブル【発生：はっせい】ってヤツだ\n【袁家：えんけ】は【帰：かえ】らなきゃなんねえ
Translated Text: It's that thing about trouble\nbreaking out at Dandan-zaka.\nThe Yuan family has to go home.

Original Text: でも　それだとオラたちの\nリーダーがいなくなってしまうズラ…
Translated Text: But then we'd be left without\na leader, wouldn't we...

Original Text: おおっと　これはゆゆしき【事態：じたい】っ\nならば【次：つぎ】のリーダーはこの【私：わたくし】が…
Translated Text: Whoa—this is a serious situation! In\nthat case, I’ll be the next leader…

Original Text: うむ\nリーダーはお【主：ぬし】がやれ
Translated Text: Hmm, you take the lead.

Original Text: うぃすー！　おまかせくだ…
Translated Text: Hey there! Leave it to me…

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nあとは　お【前：まえ】にまかせたぜ？
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce!
I'll leave the rest to you, okay?

Original Text: なんですとーーーー！
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: もんげー…！\nお　オラがリーダー…？
Translated Text:
Whoa…!
M-Me, the leader…?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】は【強：つよ】い\nそして　いい【仲間：なかま】にも【恵：めぐ】まれておる
Translated Text: You're strong, and you're\nblessed with great companions.

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: ヤツらがいっしょなら\n【無敵：むてき】だろ？
Translated Text: If they're all together,\nthey're invincible, right?

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっとお【待：ま】ちを…\nだれか　【忘：わす】れちゃいませんかー？
Translated Text:
Hey, wait a sec… Isn't
someone forgetting something?

Original Text: では　【頼：たの】んだぞ
Translated Text: All right, count on me.

Original Text: また【会：あ】おうぜ！
Translated Text: See you later!

Original Text: お　オラが…\nもんげー【軍：ぐん】の　リーダー…！
Translated Text:
I'm... the
leader of the Monge Army...!

Original Text: 【待：ま】ってー！　【袁家：えんけ】の【皆様：みなさま】ー！
Translated Text: Wait! Everyone from the Yuan family!

Original Text: いいかげん　【私：わたくし】の【名前：なまえ】くらい\n【覚：おぼ】えてくださいよ～！
Translated Text: For heaven's sake, just\nremember my name already!

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「メダルこうかん」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました」
Translated Text: "I got the 'Yo-kai 【g】Pad' app 'Medal Exchange.'【e】"

Original Text: （オラ…　この【世界：せかい】に【来：き】てから\nカッコイイ【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】になれてるズラ）
Translated Text: (Hey... ever since I came to this\nworld, I've become a pretty\ncool warrior-Yo-kai, haven't I?)

Original Text: （【夢：ゆめ】に【見：み】た　エーユーになれてるズラ\n【理想：りそう】の【兄：にい】ちゃんになれてるズラ）
Translated Text: (I’m finally the AU I dreamed of\nbecoming. I’m finally the ideal older\nbrother I’ve always wanted to be.)

Original Text: どうしたブラザー！　【元気：げんき】ないな！\nエクササイズでもするか？
Translated Text:
What's up, bro! You seem down!
Want to work out or something?

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（オレたちがいつもついている！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(We're always by your side!)

Original Text: じいん…\nううん　なんでもないズラ…
Translated Text:
Hmm...
No, never mind...

Original Text: オラきっと　いつかは【田舎：いなか】に【帰：かえ】るズラ\nそれでも　ともだちズラか？
Translated Text: I'm sure I'll go back to the countryside\nsomeday. But will you still be my friend?

Original Text: 【当：あ】たり【前：まえ】だ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Of course, bro!

Original Text: メラ　メーラ！\n（【友情：ゆうじょう】に【場所：ばしょ】は【関係：かんけい】ないぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera!
(Friendship knows no boundaries!)

Original Text: ううう…\nオラ　【涙：なみだ】が【止：と】まらないズラ
Translated Text:
Ugh... Man
, I just can't stop crying.

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】は　ほんとにいい【世界：せかい】ズラ\nオラ　この【世界：せかい】のみんなが【大好：だいす】きズラ！
Translated Text: This world is really a great world, Zuraora!\nI love everyone in this world, Zura!

Original Text: いつか\nコマじろうとお【母：かあ】ちゃんもつれてくるズラ！
Translated Text: Someday I'm gonna bring\nKomajiro and Mom along, too!

Original Text: メラ！　メラメラ！\n（【元気：げんき】になったね　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！）
Translated Text:
Mera! Mera-mera!
(You're looking much better
now, Komasan Sun Ce!)

Original Text: そして　オレたちには\nまだ【大事：だいじ】なミッションが【残：のこ】ってるぞ！
Translated Text: And we still have an important\nmission left to complete!

Original Text: わかってるズラ！\nみんなでイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】すズラー！
Translated Text:
We know that, dude! Let's
all team up to take down
Chairman Dong Zhuo, dude!

Original Text: メラメラメラ　メラ！\n（【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】を　【先：さき】に【倒：たお】そう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze, blaze!
(Let's take down the Red Ogre Lu Bu first!)

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】があると\nヤツはそこに【逃：に】げこむぞ！
Translated Text: If one of the Four Heavenly Kings has\na territory, that guy will run off to it!

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】をすべて【制圧：せいあつ】しろ！\nそうすれば　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text:
Conquer all of the Four
Heavenly Kings' territories!
Then—Victorian!

Original Text: わかったズラ！\nビクトリアーン！　ズラ！
Translated Text:
Got it, wig!
Victorian! Wig!

Original Text: みなさん！　お【疲：つか】れ【様：さま】です！\nジャングルハンターは　すぐそこですよ！
Translated Text:
Hey, everyone! Great job today!
Jungle Hunter is just around the corner!

Original Text: っていねえ！\nリーダーがいねえ！
Translated Text:
Wait a minute!
Where's the leader?!

Original Text: まっ　まさか【迷子：まいご】！\n【敵本陣：てきほんじん】を【目：め】の【前：まえ】にしてまさかの【迷子：まいご】っ
Translated Text:
No way... I'm lost!
Right in front of the enemy's
headquarters, and I'm actually lost!

Original Text: まったく　とんだ【主：あるじ】でございます！\nまあ【手：て】のかかる【主：あるじ】ほど【可愛：かわい】いとは【言：い】いますが
Translated Text:
What a strange master he is!
Well, they do say that the more trouble
a master causes, the cuter he is...

Original Text: ちょっと【様子：ようす】を【見：み】てまいらねばっ\n【私：わたくし】ってば　なんて【面倒見：めんどうみ】のよい【軍師：ぐんし】！
Translated Text: I'll have to go check on things for a\nbit. Wow, I'm such a caring strategist!

Original Text: プンプン！　これじゃあまるで\n【軍師：ぐんし】というより【執事：しつじ】もいいところでうぃす！
Translated Text: Grrr! At a rate like this, I'm not\nso much a military strategist\nas I am—at best—a butler!

Original Text: あ　【次：つぎ】はイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】との【最終決戦：さいしゅうけっせん】！\n【全軍：ぜんぐん】　【準備：じゅんび】をととのえて【挑：いど】んでくださいねっ
Translated Text:
Okay, next up is the final showdown with
Chairman Dong Zhuo of the Ikakamone!
All troops, get ready and give it your all!

Original Text: あ　…フッフーン\n【平和：へいわ】になったら【私：わたくし】　【執事：しつじ】に【転職：てんしょく】しよっと♪
Translated Text: Ah... Hmm... Once peace comes, I think\nI'll switch careers and become a butler♪

Original Text: いつの【間：ま】にか\n【追：お】いつめられているではなイカ…
Translated Text: Before I knew it, I found myself\nbacked into a corner, didn't I…

Original Text: ここの【守：まも】りは\nお【前：まえ】に【任：まか】せてもいイカ？
Translated Text: Is it okay if I leave the\ndefense of this place to you?

Original Text: なにぃ？　どこに【行：い】く？
Translated Text: What? Where are you going?

Original Text: イカカカカ…\n【大事：だいじ】な【使命：しめい】を【果：は】たさねばイカんのだ
Translated Text:
Ika-ka-ka-ka… I simply must fulfill this
important mission.

Original Text: ンーーーーーッ！\nビクトリアーーーーーーン！
Translated Text:
Huuuuuuu!
Victoriaaaaaaa!

Original Text: メラ！　メラアアア！\n（この【勝利：しょうり】！　【熱：あつ】いぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera! Meraaaaa!
(This victory! It's so exciting!)

Original Text: いや…！\n【喜：よろこ】ぶのは　まだ【早：はや】いでうぃす！
Translated Text:
No...!
It's too soon to celebrate!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓勢力：ぎちょうとうたくせいりょく】の【残党：ざんとう】が\nこちらに【向：む】かってきていますー！
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, the remnants of\nDong Zhuo's forces are heading this way!

Original Text: み　みんなもう\n【戦：たたか】う【力：ちから】は　【残：のこ】ってないズラ！
Translated Text: "E-everyone, we don't have\nthe strength to fight anymore!"

Original Text: メラ！\n（【先：さき】に【逃：に】げろ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(Run away first!)

Original Text: ここはオレたちが【食：く】いとめる！\n【行：い】け！　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text:
We'll hold them off here!
Go! Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: ふたりを【置：お】いて\nいけるわけないズラ！
Translated Text: There's no way I can just\nleave the two of them behind!

Original Text: メラ！\n（いいやオレが！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(No, I will!)

Original Text: ズラ！
Translated Text: Zura!

Original Text: メラッ！
Translated Text: Mela!

Original Text: だーーっ　いいからもう！\nみんなで【逃：に】げますよっ
Translated Text:
"Come on—enough already! Let's
all run away!"

Original Text: そういうわけにはいかないなあ！\nウォッチ　ニイ　サン　ポー！！
Translated Text:
That's not going to work!
Watch out, Niisan Po!!

Original Text: ズララララッ！？
Translated Text: Zura-ra-ra-ra-ra!?

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: あのふたり…\nオラたちを【助：たす】けてくれたズラ…
Translated Text:
Those two... the ones who helped us
...

Original Text: 【残党：ざんとう】は\nすごい【数：かず】だったそうです…
Translated Text: I hear there were a huge\nnumber of stragglers…

Original Text: ううう　【今頃：いまごろ】きっと\n【二人：ふたり】はバラバラのめちゃくちゃに…！
Translated Text: Ugh... By now, they're probably\ncompletely torn apart...!

Original Text: オラの　せいズラ…\nともだちを【助：たす】けられなかったズラ…
Translated Text:
It's my fault... I couldn't save my
friend...

Original Text: ぐすん　オラやっぱり　エーユーでも\nカッコイイ【兄：にい】ちゃんでもなかったズラ…！
Translated Text: Sniff... So he wasn't an AU character\nor a cool older guy after all...!

Original Text: 【泣：な】くのは【早：はや】いぜ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Don't cry just yet, bro!

Original Text: ぎゃあああああ！\nお　おばけ～！！！
Translated Text:
Aaaaaaah!
A ghost~!!!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（おばけじゃない　【妖怪：ようかい】だ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(I'm not a ghost—I'm a Yo-kai!)

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: メラメラメ～ラ！\n（【生：う】まれた【時：とき】は　ちがっても！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze~!
(Even if we were born different!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーーン！！\n…だろ！？
Translated Text:
We'll die together! Victoriaaa!!
… Right!?

Original Text: よ　よかったズラ！\nほんとの　ほんとによかったズラー！！
Translated Text:
Whew, that was close!
I'm really, really glad that's over!!

Original Text: もうひとつ！\nブラザーにビッグなプレゼントだ！
Translated Text:
One more thing!
It's a big present for my brother!

Original Text: メラ！\n（【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(It's a gem!)

Original Text: ズズラッ
Translated Text: Zuzuraa

Original Text: 【残党相手：ざんとうあいて】にバトルしてる【時：とき】に\n【井戸：いど】で　【見：み】つけたんだ！
Translated Text: I found it in a well while I was\nbattling some stragglers!

Original Text: メラメラ\n（【持：も】っていってくれ）
Translated Text: Mera Mera (Take this with you)

Original Text: いつも　オラはもらってばっかりで…\nいいズラ？
Translated Text:
I'm always the one
getting stuff... Is that okay
?

Original Text: いいも【悪：わる】いもないぞ！\nブラザー！
Translated Text:
There's no such thing as good or bad,
bro!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（【熱：あつ】き【友情：ゆうじょう】のあかしだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(A testament to our fiery friendship!)

Original Text: ゆうじょうの　あかし…！\nじいん…！
Translated Text:
A sign of friendship…!
A tingle…!

Original Text: メラ　メラメラッ！\n（さあ　みんなで【勝利：しょうり】のお【祝：いわ】いだ！）
Translated Text:
Mela, Mela, Mela!
(Come on, let's all celebrate our victory!)

Original Text: そうおっしゃると【思：おも】っていました\n【準備：じゅんび】はバッチリできておりますよ～！
Translated Text: I knew you'd say that. I'm all set!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！　グレイトだ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming! That's great!

Original Text: グレイト？　いえいえ…ここは\nビクトリアーン！　…と【言：い】ってくださいな！
Translated Text: Great? No, no… This is\nVictorian! …Please say that!

Original Text: （ズラ…　みんなとの【思：おも】い【出：で】…\nたくさん　できていくズラ！）
Translated Text:
(Zura… Memories with everyone…
I’m making so many of them, Zura!)

Original Text: はー\n【平和：へいわ】ズラねー
Translated Text: Man, they sure put on a\npeaceful front, don't they?

Original Text: ええー\nお【茶：ちゃ】が【美味：おい】しいでうぃすねー

Original Text: ソフトクリーム\n【食：た】べたくなってきたズラねー
Translated Text: I'm starting to feel like having some\nsoft-serve ice cream, aren't I?

Original Text: はいはい　ではこの【帽子：ぼうし】を【取：と】って\n【私：わたくし】のソフトクリームを…
Translated Text: Okay, okay. So take off this hat and\ngive me my soft-serve ice cream…

Original Text: ってちがーーーーうっ！！
Translated Text: No, that's not it at all!!

Original Text: はい！　アナタはだあれ！？\nそう！　このさくら【国：こく】のニューヒーロー！
Translated Text:
Yes! Who are you!? That's
right! The new hero of the Land of Sakura!

Original Text: 【小覇王：しょうはおう】　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\n…【何度聞：なんどき】いても　もんげーカッコイイズラー
Translated Text:
The Little Conqueror, Komasan Sun Ce!
…No matter how many times
I hear it, it’s sooo cool!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めて　【弟君：おとうとぎみ】に【会：あ】うって【話：はなし】\nどうなったんですか！
Translated Text: What happened to that story\nabout collecting the jewels\nto meet your little brother?!

Original Text: …はっ！　そうだったズラ！
Translated Text: …Oh! That’s right!

Original Text: こっちの【世界：せかい】のコマじろうが【危：あぶ】ないズラ！\nオラが【助：たす】けにいってやらないとズラ！
Translated Text:
Komajiro in this world is in danger, man!
I've gotta go save him, man!

Original Text: だったら【家：いえ】でまったりしてる【場合：ばあい】ですかい！\nさーいざ【外：そと】へ！　【冒険：ぼうけん】へ！
Translated Text:
So, is this really the time to just
be lounging around at home?!
Come on, let's head outside!
Off on an adventure!

Original Text: あ　お【客：きゃく】さんズラ\n【今出：いまで】るズラー
Translated Text: Oh, the customers are coming out now!

Original Text: …ほんとにわかってんですかね
Translated Text: …Do they really understand?

Original Text: あの…　えっと…\n【団々坂：だんだんざか】のしどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】…
Translated Text:
Um... well... that stammering
Tōken from Dandan-zaka...

Original Text: その…　お【願：ねが】いが　あの…\nあるんだけど…　えっと…
Translated Text:
Well... I have a favor to ask...
um...

Original Text: あ～　【話：はなし】がまったくすすみません！\nならば　【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った…
Translated Text:
Ugh... This conversation
isn't going anywhere!
Well then, I bought this from
the Yo-kai Online Store...

Translated Text:
The Ultimate "Good Listener" Machine!
With this, you'll have girls' hearts
in the palm of your hand…

Original Text: わしづかみ？
Translated Text: A firm grip?

Original Text: えーそうそう！　…って\nなんでそこだけスラッと【出：で】てくるんですかっ
Translated Text: Oh, right! …Wait, why does only\nthat part just pop into my head?

Original Text: …おほん　【気：き】を【取：と】り【直：なお】して\n【私：わたくし】がこのお【方：かた】の【言葉：ことば】を【代弁：だいべん】いたします！
Translated Text: …Ahem. Let me compose myself\nand speak on behalf of this person!

Original Text: えっと…　【団々坂：だんだんざか】の【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】と\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】がいきなりケンカを？
Translated Text: Um... Did Yuan Shao, the Earth Spider\nof Dandan Slope, and Yuan Shu, the\nGiant Toad, suddenly get into a fight?

Original Text: 【大：おお】きな【家同士：いえどうし】が【争：あらそ】い　【自分：じぶん】をはじめ\n【住民：じゅうみん】たちも【困：こま】っている…
Translated Text: There's a dispute between two large\nhouseholds, and it's causing trouble\nfor me and the other residents...

Original Text: なにとぞ　【人気：にんき】　【急上昇中：きゅうじょうしょうちゅう】の\nニューヒーロー　コマさん【孫策殿：そんさくどの】の【力：ちから】で…
Translated Text: Please, with the power of Komasan\nSun Ce—the new hero whose\npopularity is skyrocketing—...

Original Text: ふたりのケンカを【止：と】めてくれないか\n…ということでうぃす！
Translated Text: "Could you please stop these two\nfrom fighting...?" So, here goes!

Original Text: あの　もんげー【立派：りっぱ】なおふたりズラね\n【息：いき】ピッタリで　カッコよかったズラ
Translated Text: Man, those two were so\nimpressive—they were in perfect\nsync and looked really cool.

Original Text: いったい【何：なに】があったんでしょ\nここは【行：い】ってみるしかなさそうですね
Translated Text: I wonder what on earth happened here.\nI guess I'll just have to go check it out.

Original Text: あの…　よろしく…
Translated Text: Um... Nice to meet you...

Original Text: あの…ここで【今：いま】から…その…
Translated Text: Um... right here, right now... well...

Original Text: どうやら　【袁家：えんけ】のふたりが\nこの【場：ば】で【会談：かいだん】をするようです…
Translated Text: It seems the two members of the Yuan\nfamily are going to hold talks right here…

Original Text: 【以前：いぜん】から【思：おも】っていたが\nお【主：ぬし】とはことごとく…　【合：あ】わぬ！
Translated Text: I've been thinking this for a while now,\nbut you and I just... don't get along at all!

Original Text: そいつは　こっちのセリフだ！\nもうオメーとは　やってらんねーぜ！
Translated Text:
That’s exactly what I’d
say! I can’t deal with you
anymore!

Original Text: 【吾輩：わがはい】に【従：したが】う【気：き】がないのならば…\n【戦：たたか】いを【続：つづ】けるだけだ
Translated Text:
If you have no intention of
following me… then I’ll just keep
fighting.

Original Text: ハッ　【上等：じょうとう】だ！　この【際：さい】\nどっちが【上：うえ】か　ハッキリさせようぜ！
Translated Text: Ha! Bring it on! Let's settle this\nonce and for all—who's the boss!

Original Text: うーん　いきなり【険悪：けんあく】！
Translated Text: Hmm... Things got tense right away!

Original Text: もんげー【立派：りっぱ】なお【二人：ふたり】だったのに…\nどうしてケンカになっちゃったズラ？
Translated Text:
They were such a wonderful
couple… so why did they end up
fighting?

Original Text: ん？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: ん？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: おっ\nお【久：ひさ】しぶりでございますー
Translated Text: Wow, it’s been a while!

Original Text: おおっ！　よくぞ【来：き】てくれた！\n【吾輩：わがはい】と【共：とも】に　このわからず【屋：や】を…
Translated Text:
Whoa! I'm so glad you came!
Join me in dealing with
this stubborn fool…

Original Text: おおーっと！　オレの【相棒：あいぼう】に\n【気安：きやす】く【話：はな】しかけないでもらおーか！
Translated Text: Whoa! Don't you dare talk\nto my partner like that!

Original Text: なあ？　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text: Hey, Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: 【何：なに】を【言：い】うか！　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】は\n【吾輩：わがはい】のために【来：き】てくれたのだ
Translated Text: What are you talking about!\nKomasan Sun Ce came here for me!

Original Text: ズ　ズラ？\nオ　オラ…ズラ…
Translated Text:
Z... Zura?
O... Ora... Zura...

Original Text: そんなあいまいな【返事：へんじ】で\n【吾輩：わがはい】たちが【納得：なっとく】すると【思：おも】っておるのか？
Translated Text: Do you really think we'll be\nsatisfied with such a vague answer?

Original Text: 【決：き】めるんなら　スマートにたのむぜ？\nさあ　どっちにつくんだ？
Translated Text:
If you're going to decide,
at least do it smartly, okay?
So, which side are you on?

Original Text: ひいいい…\nあの　その　それは　えっと…
Translated Text:
Eek…
Um, well, that’s, uh…

Original Text: なんでアナタが\nしどろもどろになってんですかっ
Translated Text: Why are you stammering like that?!

Original Text: あの【様子：ようす】…どっちつかずな【態度：たいど】を\n【取：と】っていると…
Translated Text: The way things looked... if you keep\ntaking a fence-sitting stance...

Original Text: 【我々：われわれ】　【多分：たぶん】\nふたりからボッコボコにされますので
Translated Text: We'll probably get beaten\nto a pulp by those two, so...

Original Text: こうなったら\nどっちにつくか【明：あき】らかにしましょ！
Translated Text: Now that it's come to this, let's\nmake it clear which side we're on!

Original Text: 【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】の【味方：みかた】をしたいなら\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】のしせつを【攻：せ】めましょう
Translated Text: If you want to side with Lord Yuan\nShao, the Earth Spider, attack\nLord Oogama En Jutsu's, facilities.

Original Text: 【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】の【味方：みかた】をしたいなら\n【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】のしせつを【攻：せ】めるのです
Translated Text: If you want to side with Lord Oogama\nEn Jutsu, you must attack Lord Yuan\nShao, the Earth Spider’s, facilities.

Original Text: ズ　ズラ…\nお　オラいったいどうしたら…
Translated Text:
Zuu... Zura... Oh
... Oh man, what on earth
am I supposed to do...

Original Text: さあさ！　エーユーたるもの\n【自分：じぶん】の【道：みち】は　【自分：じぶん】で【切：き】り【開：ひら】いてくださーいっ
Translated Text: Come on! As an AU, you’ve\ngot to blaze your own trail!

Original Text: やはり　お【主：ぬし】は【吾輩：わがはい】の【味方：みかた】か！\n【百万：ひゃくまん】の【軍勢：ぐんぜい】を【得：え】た【思：おも】いだぞ！
Translated Text:
So you really are on my side after all!
I feel as if I’ve gained an army of a
million!

Original Text: いざ　あのわからず【屋：や】を\n【共：とも】に【討：う】ち【果：は】たそうではないか！
Translated Text: Come on, let's join forces and\ntake down that stubborn fool!

Original Text: …ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいズラ
Translated Text: …Let me ask you one thing, Zura

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】はなんズラ？
Translated Text: What do you think caused the two of them to fight?

Original Text: それは…　【言：い】えぬ
Translated Text: Well... I can't say that.

Original Text: 【戦：いくさ】に【勝利：しょうり】した【後：あと】\nあやつから【聞：き】けばよかろう…
Translated Text: You should ask him about\nit after we win the battle…

Original Text: なんか　しどろもどろだね…
Translated Text: You're kind of stumbling over your words, aren't you...

Original Text: 「【g】【協力：きょうりょく】バトル【e】」ができるようになりました」
Translated Text: "【g】Co-op【e】 Battles are now available."

Original Text: へっへっへ　【信：しん】じてたぜ！\nさすがは　オレの【相棒：あいぼう】！
Translated Text:
Heh, heh, heh... I knew you would!
Just like I expected from my partner!

Original Text: 【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】を\nソッコーでやっつけてやろうぜ！
Translated Text: Let's take down Yuan Shao,\nthe Earth Spider, in a flash!

Original Text: …ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいズラ
Translated Text: …Let me ask you one thing, Zura

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】はなんズラ？
Translated Text: What do you think caused the two of them to fight?

Original Text: それは…　まあ　なんだ
Translated Text: Well... I guess...

Original Text: バトルに【勝：か】った【後：あと】　あのガンコヤローから\n【聞：き】けばいいんじゃね？
Translated Text: After we win the battle, why don't\nwe just ask that stubborn jerk?

Original Text: なんか　しどろもどろだね…
Translated Text: You're kind of stumbling over your words, aren't you...

Original Text: 「【g】【協力：きょうりょく】バトル【e】」ができるようになりました」
Translated Text: "【g】Co-op【e】 Battles are now available."

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】らの　おかげで\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】のしせつは【制圧：せいあつ】できた！
Translated Text: Thanks to you all, we've managed\nto subdue that toad Yuan Shu!

Original Text: あやつを　【連：つ】れてこい！
Translated Text: Bring that guy here!

Original Text: えっと　その　はい…
Translated Text: Um... well... yes...

Original Text: いったい【何：なに】が【起：お】ころうとしてるズラ…？
Translated Text: What on earth is about to happen...?

Original Text: 【決：き】まってますよ　【処刑：しょけい】です　【処刑：しょけい】\n【同族：どうぞく】の【争：あらそ】いの【悲：かな】しき【結末：けつまつ】ですね…
Translated Text: It's a done deal. Execution.\nExecution. What a tragic end\nto a feud among relatives…

Translated Text:
"Sho... shokei...!!!
"... What's that supposed to mean?

Translated Text: Hey, I brought that big fat\nguy, Yuan Shu, with me.

Original Text: 【敗北：はいぼく】を【認：みと】めよ\nそして　【誓：ちか】ってもらおう…
Translated Text: Admit defeat, and then\nlet me make you swear...

Original Text: 【今後：こんご】　【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】は…\n『つぶあん』のまんじゅうを【食：た】べると！
Translated Text:
From
now on, Oogama En Jutsu, will... eat
manju filled with sweet red bean paste!

Original Text: えー\nまさか…　とは【思：おも】いまうぃすが
Translated Text: Well, I can't believe it... but

Translated Text: So that's what caused the fight... Is that it?

Translated Text: Don't underestimate manju!

Translated Text: Sweet red bean paste, where you can\nfully savor the natural sweetness of\nthe ingredients, is the classic choice!

Translated Text: …Hah! Don't make me laugh!

Original Text: のどごしが　なめらかな\nこしあんこそ　ナンバーワンだろーが！
Translated Text: Smooth, silky-textured koshi-an\nis definitely the best, right?!

Translated Text: Well, I guess that stubborn earth spider\nYuan Shao will never get it, will he?!

Translated Text: What...!

Original Text: もっ\nもうケンカはダメズラーーー！！！
Translated Text: No, no, no—no more fighting!!!

Translated Text: You two are crazy for dragging\neveryone else into something like that!!

Original Text: おかげさまで\n【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】のしせつは【全部：ぜんぶ】うばえたぜ
Translated Text: Thanks to you guys, I managed to take\nall of Earth Spider Yuan Shao's facilities!

Original Text: さあ　あいつを　【連：つ】れてこい！
Translated Text: Come on, bring that guy here!

Original Text: えっと　その　はい…
Translated Text: Um... well... yes...

Original Text: いったい【何：なに】が【起：お】ころうとしてるズラ…？
Translated Text: What on earth is about to happen...?

Original Text: 【決：き】まってますよ　【処刑：しょけい】です　【処刑：しょけい】\n【同族：どうぞく】の【争：あらそ】いの【悲：かな】しき【結末：けつまつ】ですね…
Translated Text: It's a done deal. Execution.\nExecution. What a tragic end\nto a feud among relatives…

Original Text: しょっ　しょけいっ…！！！\n…って　【何：なん】ズラ？
Translated Text:
"Sho... shokei...!!!
"... What's that supposed to mean?

Original Text: あの　その\n【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】を【連：つ】れてきたよ
Translated Text: Um, I brought that Tsuchigumo,\nYuan Shao, with me.

Translated Text: Admit you lost, and I'll\nmake you promise, okay?

Translated Text:
From now on, Tsuchigumo Yuan
Shao will… eat manju filled with
“koshi-an”!

Original Text: えー\nまさか…　とは【思：おも】いまうぃすが
Translated Text: Well, I can't believe it... but

Translated Text: So that's what caused the fight... Is that it?

Original Text: まんじゅうを　【甘：あま】く【見：み】るんじゃねぇ！
Translated Text: Don't underestimate manju!

Original Text: のどごしが　なめらかな\nこしあんこそ　ナンバーワンだろーが！
Translated Text: Smooth, silky-textured koshi-an\nis definitely the best, right?!

Original Text: フッ…　【笑：わら】わせる
Translated Text: Huh... That's funny.

Original Text: 【素材：そざい】の【甘：あま】みを【存分：ぞんぶん】に【味：あじ】わえる\nつぶあんこそ　【王道：おうどう】！
Translated Text: Sweet red bean paste, where you can\nfully savor the natural sweetness of\nthe ingredients, is the classic choice!

Original Text: そんなことも　わからんとは\nお【主：ぬし】も　まだまだだな
Translated Text: If you don't even know something like\nthat, you've still got a long way to go.

Original Text: なにぃ？
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: もっ\nもうケンカはダメズラーーー！！！
Translated Text: No, no, no—no more fighting!!!

Original Text: そんなことに【他：ほか】のみんなを【巻：ま】きこむなんて\nふたりともおかしいズラ！！
Translated Text: You two are crazy for dragging\neveryone else into something like that!!

Original Text: たしかに…　【吾輩：わがはい】たちは\n【少：すこ】し　まわりが【見：み】えていなかったようだ
Translated Text: That's true... It seems we weren't\nquite seeing the bigger picture.

Original Text: ああ…　【今：いま】の【今：いま】まで\nまんじゅうのことしか　【頭：あたま】になかったぜ
Translated Text: Ah... Up until just now, all I\ncould think about was manju.

Eek!

!! I've got a
bad feeling about this!

Touken, you're all over the
place! Go check on the jewel

You really saved me!
This is a token of my
gratitude—please accept it.

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】ズラ！

Well then…
Let’s set off for Komajiro
Sun Quan’s place!

Translated Text:
Is something wrong, Zura?
Oh, if you need to use the bathroom,
go ahead and go first, Zura.

That's great. So, let's get right to it...
Wait, no way!!

This might be... a sign that something

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だけでなく　【団々坂：だんだんざか】も\n【自由：じゆう】に【使：つか】っていいらしいです！

Yeah, yeah!

Translated Text:
Whoosh!
I'm on fire, whoosh!

Translated Text: Oh, your brother's country\nis right around the corner.

Original Text: ズラーッ
Translated Text: A whole bunch

The remaining orbs are probably...
in the possession of the

Hero No. 1!
The Little Overlord’s younger

Whoa!
Komajiro!

Hero No. 2!
The Blue Warrior Yo-kai, Full of Guts!

There's a good chance he has the jewel!

Just then, his older brother,
Komasan Sun Ce, appeared!

truly become a savior?

Zura!
Yo-kai Sangokushi! Things

I'm super excited, Bear!
The Age of the Three
Kingdoms is finally here!

Komasan and Sun Ce's army... It looks like

My territory and my

That's... a barrier!

Super Deluxe Drill!

Waaah!

Komajiro's military strategist…!

Translated Text: I know

You want to break through

This is just what I needed! I'll

(That voice… I’ve
heard it before…!)

Hey, Komajiro Sun Quan
wig! How's it going,
wig?!

Komajiro…!

Please, Zura! I want you to find my big

Translated Text:
Yay! Is that
okay?

…Wait, what?
Hold on, hold on!
