Translated Text: I'm the guy who acts like a big brother from the world outside the book.

Original Text: オラ　こっちの【世界：せかい】のコマじろうのことも\n【心配：しんぱい】だったから　【会：あ】いにきたズラ
Translated Text: Hey, I was worried about Koma-jiro in\nthis world too, so I came to see him.

Original Text: こっちの【世界：せかい】のオラが【迷子：まいご】なんズラね\nなんだかちょっと　【恥：は】ずかしいズラ…
Translated Text: I guess I'm lost in this world...\nIt's kind of embarrassing...

Original Text: コマじろう\n【兄：にい】ちゃんが【兄：にい】ちゃんを【見：み】つけてやる　ズラ！
Translated Text: Komajiro-nii-chan is going\nto find you, big bro! Zura!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん…　たのむズラ！
Translated Text: Big bro… Please, man!

Original Text: イヤ　わけわかりませんっっ
Translated Text: No way—I don't get it at all!!

Original Text: 【協力：きょうりょく】　【感謝：かんしゃ】する\nお【礼：れい】に【一曲：いっきょく】　【贈：おく】ろう…
Translated Text: To show my gratitude for\nyour cooperation, let me\ndedicate a song to you…

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【音楽：おんがく】センスは\nこの【国一：くにいち】といわれてるズラ！
Translated Text: They say Orochi Zhou Yu has the best\nmusical taste in the whole country!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんも　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【曲：きょく】を\nいつも【楽：たの】しく【聴：き】いてたズラ…
Translated Text: My older brother always enjoyed\nlistening to Orochi Zhou Yu's songs, too...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんとオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】は\n【最高：さいこう】の…　ともだちズラ！
Translated Text: My brother and Orochi Zhou Yu are\nthe best… *pretending to be friends*!

Original Text: へー　こっちの【世界：せかい】のオラにも\nすてきなともだちが　いたんズラね
Translated Text: Huh... So even I, in this world,\nhad some great friends, didn't I?

Original Text: そう！
Translated Text: That's right!

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】らの【友情：ゆうじょう】は\n【断金：だんきん】の【交：まじ】わりって【言：い】われてるクマ！
Translated Text: People say their friendship is as\nstrong as a bond of gold, Bear!

Original Text: おや　【曲：きょく】がはじまりましたよ\nすてきな　しらべですねー
Translated Text: Oh, the song has started.\nWhat a lovely melody!

Original Text: （…【久：ひさ】しぶりだな）
Translated Text: (…It’s been a while.)

Original Text: 「【g】「【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【音楽：おんがく】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: "【g】I got the 'Yo-kai Pad:【e】 Music' app."

Original Text: やっぱり　あの【時：とき】の【声：こえ】ズラね！
Translated Text: It really was that voice slip back then!

Original Text: そうだ\nよくここまで【無事：ぶじ】だったな　【英雄：えいゆう】
Translated Text: That's right—it's amazing you\nmade it this far unscathed, Hero.

Original Text: えへへ　この【世界：せかい】のみんなが\nオラを【助：たす】けてくれたズラ
Translated Text: Hehehe... It seems like everyone\nin this world helped me out.

Original Text: みんなのおかげで　オラここまで【来：こ】れたズラ\nエーユーになれたズラ！
Translated Text: Thanks to all of you, I've made it\nthis far and become a Zura-E-U!

Original Text: …【知：し】っている
Translated Text: …I know

Original Text: お【前：まえ】ならば　この【危機：きき】を\n【救：すく】ってくれると【思：おも】っていた
Translated Text: I thought you were the one who\ncould save us from this crisis.

Original Text: ゆえに　この【国：くに】の【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】せ…\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【呼：よ】び【寄：よ】せた
Translated Text:
And so, I showed them the dreams
of this country… and drew them into
this book.

Original Text: 【危機：きき】…\nこの【国：くに】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちの【戦：たたか】いのことズラね
Translated Text:
"Crisis"... You mean the battles between
this country's warrior Yo-kai, right?

Original Text: ちがう　もっと【大：おお】きな…\nいや　【今言：いまい】うのはやめておこう
Translated Text:
No, something bigger... No,
I'd better not say that right now.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】　お【前：まえ】は\n【私：わたし】のそうぞう【以上：いじょう】のかつやくを【見：み】せてくれた
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce—you’ve performed\nbeyond my wildest expectations.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】ならば　この【先：さき】\nいかなる　【困難：こんなん】をも【乗：の】りこえられるだろう
Translated Text: If it's you, I'm sure you'll be able to\novercome any difficulties that lie ahead.

Original Text: この【調子：ちょうし】で　これからも【頼：たの】む…\n【私：わたし】も　【協力：きょうりょく】はおしまない
Translated Text:
Keep it up... I'll keep doing
my part, too.

Original Text: うん　ともだちが【一緒：いっしょ】なら\nオラ　【何：なに】があっても　こわくないズラ！
Translated Text: Yeah, as long as my friends\nare with me, I'm not scared of\nanything that might happen!

Original Text: それにこれからは\nオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】も【一緒：いっしょ】ズラ！
Translated Text: Plus, from now on, Orochi\nZhou Yu will be with us too!

Original Text: また【新：あたら】しいともだちが　できたズラ！\nもんげー　たのもしいズラ！
Translated Text:
I've made another new friend!
Wow, he's so reliable!

Original Text: …ふ\nああ【私：わたし】もだ　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】
Translated Text: …Oh, me too! Komasan, Sun Ce

Original Text: 【我：わ】が【主：あるじ】は　コマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：あに】で\n【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だ
Translated Text: My master is Komajiro Sun Quan's\nolder brother, a white warrior Yo-kai.

Original Text: 【小学校：しょうがっこう】で\n【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【見：み】たという【情報：じょうほう】がある
Translated Text: There are reports of a white\nwarrior-like Yo-kai being\nseen at an elementary school.

Original Text: きっとオラに　そっくりの【妖怪：ようかい】ズラ\n【行：い】ってみるズラ！
Translated Text: I'm definitely going to try on a\nYo-kai mask that looks just like me!

Original Text: しかし　この【世：よ】に２つの【世界：せかい】があったとは…\nショーゲキでうぃす！
Translated Text:
But to think there were two
worlds in this world… That’s a
shocker!

Original Text: 【本：ほん】の【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】には\n【本：ほん】の【外：そと】のコマじろうがいるズラよ
Translated Text: Outside the world of books,\nthere’s a Koma-jiro who exists\noutside the book, you know.

Original Text: ならば　【本：ほん】の【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】には\n【本：ほん】の【外：そと】の【私：わたくし】も【存在：そんざい】するということっっ
Translated Text: In that case, that means there’s\nalso a “me” outside the book in\nthe world beyond the book!!!

Original Text: ああ！　【会：あ】ってみたいもう【一人：ひとり】の【私：わたくし】に！\nきっと【私同様：わたくしどうよう】　【超：ちょう】ダンディで　【超有能：ちょうゆうのう】で
Translated Text:
Ah! I’d love to meet that
other version of me!
I’m sure she’s just as incredibly dashing
and incredibly capable as I am...

Original Text: って　【置：お】いていくんじゃねー！！
Translated Text: "Don't just leave it there!!"

Original Text: 【見：み】てください！\n【武将妖怪同士：ぶしょうようかいどうし】が　もめているようです！
Translated Text:
Look!
It looks like some warrior
Yo-kai are having a fight!

Original Text: このよくわからん【木：き】のゴミを\n【池：いけ】に【投：な】げたのは　お【主：ぬし】かー！
Translated Text: So it was you who threw this weird\npiece of wood into the pond, was it?!

Original Text: あ　あれは…　【私：わたくし】の【木像：もくぞう】ー！？
Translated Text: W-Wait... Is that... my wooden statue!?

Original Text: そして　こちらからは…　\nまたあのクマー！？
Translated Text:
And from this side… That bear again
!?

Original Text: 【孔明：こうめい】の【木像：もくぞう】の【話：はなし】…\n【聞：き】きたいクマね？
Translated Text:
The story about the wooden
statue of Kongming…
You want to hear it, don’t you, Bear?

Original Text: とにかく…　これを【池：いけ】に【投：な】げこめば\n【願：ねが】いがかなうって【聞：き】いたダニ！
Translated Text: Anyway... I heard that if you throw this into\nthe pond, your wish will come true, Dani!

Original Text: だから　どんどん【投：な】げるダニ！\nミーは【早：はや】く【帰：かえ】りたいダニ！
Translated Text:
So keep throwing, Dani!
I wanna go home soon, Dani!

Original Text: や　やめてー！\nそんなにドボドボ【落：お】とさないでー！
Translated Text:
No, stop it! Don't let it drip all over
like that!

Original Text: あれは　【図書室：としょしつ】で【見：み】た\n【妖怪：ようかい】ズラ！
Translated Text: That was the Yo-kai\nZura I saw in the library!

Original Text: きっと　あの【妖怪：ようかい】　オラと【一緒：いっしょ】で\n【本：ほん】の【外：そと】から【中：なか】にきた　【妖怪：ようかい】ズラ！
Translated Text: I bet that Yo-kai—just like me—came from\noutside the book into it! What a Yo-kai!

Original Text: おのれ～！\nいい【加減：かげん】にせんかー！
Translated Text:
Damn it! Give it
a rest already!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！\nあの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をやっつけるズラ！
Translated Text:
Whisper, Kongming! Let's take down
that warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: わかってます！
Translated Text: I know!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の　かわいい【像：ぞう】を【池：いけ】に【捨：す】てる\n【不良妖怪：ふりょうようかい】なんて【成敗：せいばい】してやりますよ！
Translated Text: I'm going to teach that delinquent\nYo-kai a lesson for throwing my\ncute statue into the pond!

Original Text: あ　ちがうズラ！\nあの【大：おお】きなほうを　やっつけるズラ！
Translated Text:
"No, wait! I'm gonna take down
that big one!"

Original Text: えええー？
Translated Text: Whaaaat?

Original Text: おかげで【助：たす】かったダニ…\nありがとうダニ…
Translated Text:
Thanks to you, I'm saved,
Danni... Thank you, Danni...

Original Text: よくわからないうちに\n【変：へん】な【世界：せかい】に【連：つ】れてこられて…
Translated Text: Before I knew it, I was whisked\naway to a strange world…

Original Text: ひとりぼっちで　さびし【過：す】ぎて\nちょっとパニックになってたダニ…
Translated Text: Dani, all alone and feeling so lonely\nthat she was starting to panic a little…

Original Text: それは【大変：たいへん】だったズラね…
Translated Text: That must have been tough...

Original Text: オラの【場合：ばあい】\nラッキーなことに…
Translated Text: In my case, luckily…

Original Text: 【出会：であ】った【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】が\nみんな【親切：しんせつ】だったズラ！
Translated Text: All the warrior Yo-kai I met were so kind!

Original Text: みんなで【助：たす】け【合：あ】って　【旅：たび】をして…\n【今：いま】ではみんな　ともだちズラ！
Translated Text:
We helped each other out as
we traveled together… and now
we’re all best friends!

Original Text: ともだち…
Translated Text: Friends…

Original Text: ミーは　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンダニ
Translated Text: Me is in Pyeongdani, USA

Original Text: ここでは\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】って【呼：よ】ばれてるダニ
Translated Text: Here, he's called "Usapyon\nZhongda"—a tick.

Original Text: オラは　コマさん！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】　ズラ！
Translated Text:
I'm Komasan!
Komasan Sun Ce wig!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\n【今日：きょう】から　オラたちも　ともだちズラ！
Translated Text:
USA, Pyong and Nakata!
Starting today, we're friends too!

Original Text: 【一緒：いっしょ】に　いこうズラ！
Translated Text: Let's go together, Zura!

Original Text: うう　いいダニか？\nありがとうダニ　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text:
Ugh... Is that a good tick?
Thanks, tick! Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: エエ【話：はなし】や…
Translated Text: That's a nice story...

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\nふだんはちょーっと　おとぼけ【気味：ぎみ】ですが…
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce! He’s
usually a little… airheaded, but…

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】に　もんげーカッコいいエーユーに\n【見：み】えてきましたよ！
Translated Text: He's really starting to look like\nan incredibly cool AU to me!

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】ら\nわしを【忘：わす】れるでないわ！
Translated Text: Don't you dare forget me, you lot!

Original Text: あれ？　アナタ\nまだ　そんな【所：ところ】にいらしたんですか？
Translated Text: Huh? You're still there?

Original Text: なぜワシが【池：いけ】にゴミを【捨：す】てたヤツに\n【負：ま】けねばならんのじゃー！
Translated Text: Why the heck do I have to lose to the\nguy who threw trash in the pond?!

Original Text: ごめんダニ！\nどうか　ゆるしてほしいダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm sorry, Danni!
Please forgive me, Danni!

Original Text: きっとひとりぼっちで【心細：こころぼそ】かったズラ\nゆるしてあげてほしいズラ
Translated Text: I'm sure he was all alone and feeling\nlonely, so please forgive him.

Original Text: しょうがない　ゆるしてやろう\nワシも【少：しょうしょう】々　【気：き】が【立：た】っとったからの
Translated Text: Oh well, I'll let it slide. I was a\nlittle on edge myself, after all.

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】たちの【前：まえ】にも\n【池：いけ】に【物：もの】を【捨：す】てるヤツがおったんじゃ…
Translated Text: There were people who threw\nthings into the pond even\nbefore you guys came along…

Original Text: たしか【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃったが…\n【燃：も】えかけのぶっそうな【物：もの】を【捨：す】ておってのう…
Translated Text:
I'm pretty sure he was a white
warrior-Yo-kai... but he just tossed
away something that was still
smoldering and looked like
it was about to explode...

Original Text: 【投：な】げ【返：かえ】して　【池：いけ】をキレイにした【瞬間：しゅんかん】に\nお【主：ぬし】たちに【木像：もくぞう】を【投：な】げこまれて…
Translated Text: Just as I threw it back and\ncleaned up the pond, you guys\nthrew wooden statues at me…

Original Text: 【頭：あたま】にきてしまった
Translated Text: I got really mad.

Original Text: その【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】はどこに【行：い】ったズラ？
Translated Text: Where did that warrior Yo-kai go, I wonder?

Original Text: たしか\n【正天寺：しょうてんじ】のほうに【向：む】かっていったぞ
Translated Text: I'm pretty sure he\nheaded toward Shoten-ji.

Original Text: 【急：いそ】ぎましょう！\nきっと　この【世界：せかい】のアナタですっ
Translated Text:
Let's hurry!
You're definitely the "you" of this world!

Original Text: 【待：ま】て！　【行：い】く【前：まえ】にバツとして\n【池：いけ】のゴミをひとつ【持：も】っていけ！
Translated Text: Wait! Before you go, as a penalty, pick\nup one piece of trash from the pond!

Original Text: その【玉：たま】が　【池：いけ】の【底：そこ】でずっとチカチカ\n【光：ひか】るせいで　【少：すこ】しも【眠：ねむ】れやしない
Translated Text: Because that orb keeps flickering at the\nbottom of the pond, I can't sleep a wink.

Original Text: こ　これはー！
Translated Text: W-Wow!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】ズラ！\nありがとズラー
Translated Text:
Treasure Ball Zura!
Thanks, Zura!

Original Text: あれ…？\nあの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…
Translated Text:
Huh…?
That warrior-Yo-kai…

Original Text: ちっとも【白：しろ】くねえ！\nていうかむしろ【赤：あか】い！
Translated Text:
It's not white at all!
Actually, it's more like red!

Original Text: ニャニャニャッ！？
Translated Text: Meow, meow, meow!?

Original Text: あ　ジバニャンズラ！
Translated Text: Oh, Jibanyan!

Original Text: ニャアアア\nコマさあああん
Translated Text: Meowww, Koma-saaan!

Original Text: オラの【世界：せかい】の　ジバニャンズラね！\n【会：あ】えて　よかったズラ！　【元気：げんき】にしてたズ…
Translated Text:
This is my world, Jibanyan!
It's great to see you! I hope
you've been doing well...

Original Text: 【助：たす】けてニャアアアア
Translated Text: Help me, meowwwww!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: ぎょええええっ\nなんですか　あの【白：しろ】くてデッカイの！
Translated Text: Eeeeeek! What is that huge white thing?!

Original Text: あの【赤：あか】いネコも　ミーたちと【一緒：いっしょ】に\n【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【落：お】ちた【妖怪：ようかい】ダニね
Translated Text: That red cat is also a Yo-kai mite\nthat fell into the book with us.

Original Text: そうズラ！\n【力：ちから】を【合：あ】わせて【助：たす】ける　ズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right, Zura!
Let's work together to save him, Zura!

Original Text: ＯＫダニ！
Translated Text: OK, Danni!

Original Text: あいつ…\nもんげーつよさ　ズラ！
Translated Text:
That guy... he's crazy strong
!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: ひゃああああ！\n【特大：とくだい】のドクロ【爆弾：ばくだん】をかかえてます！
Translated Text:
Yaaaaaah! I'm holding a
giant skull bomb!

Original Text: ミーのレーザーガンで\n【撃：う】ち【落：お】とすダニ！
Translated Text: Shoot down the mites with Mii's laser gun!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: お【次：つぎ】は\nオレっちの　ひゃくれつ【肉球：にくきゅう】ニャン！
Translated Text: Next up is my "Hyakuretsu Paw Paws"!

Original Text: もんげ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】はオラの\nひとだま【乱舞：らんぶ】！　ズラ！
Translated Text: And to finish it off, here comes\nmy soul-orbs dance! Zura!

Original Text: ズラーッ！
Translated Text: Whoosh!

Original Text: もんげーー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: やりました！\nお【三方：さんかた】　すばらしい【戦：たたか】いぶりです！
Translated Text:
We did it!
All three of you put up a fantastic fight!

Original Text: てれるズラー
Translated Text: Tere-ru Zura

Original Text: ミーにかかれば　こんなの【楽勝：らくしょう】ダニ！
Translated Text: With me on the case, this is a piece of cake!

Original Text: 【助：たす】けてくれて　ありがとニャン\nこれで　みんな【合流：ごうりゅう】できたニャンね
Translated Text: Thanks for your help, meow!\nNow we're all together, meow!

Original Text: ヤツから　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】もゲットできたし\nこれでめでたし　めでたし…
Translated Text: I even managed to get the jewel from\nhim, so all's well that ends well...

Original Text: それではみなさん\n【気：き】をつけて【帰：かえ】りましょ…
Translated Text: Well then, everyone,\nlet's head home safely…

Original Text: って　【帰：かえ】れねえ！！！
Translated Text: "Wait, I can't go home!!!"

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】の！　コマじろう【孫権様：そんけんさま】の！\nお【兄様：にいさま】！
Translated Text:
In this world! Komajiro Sun Quan's! Older
brother!

Original Text: それを【探：さが】す【話：はなし】　どうなりましたっ！？
Translated Text: The story about looking for it—what happened to it!?

Original Text: こっちの【世界：せかい】のコマじろうの　【兄：にい】ちゃんは\nオラにそっくりの　【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…
Translated Text: In this world, Koma-jiro's older\nbrother is a white warrior\nYo-kai who looks just like me…

Original Text: そういやアイツ　コマさんみたいに\nもんげー　もんげー　【言：い】ってたニャン
Translated Text: Come to think of it, that guy kept saying\n"monge, monge" just like Komasan, meow.

Original Text: もしや…\nもしかして…
Translated Text:
Could it be…
Could it really be…

Original Text: いましがた【私：わたくし】たちがボッコボコにした\nあのデッカイのが　【本当：ほんとう】のお【兄様：にいさま】っっ！
Translated Text: That huge guy we just beat the crap\nout of—he's the real big brother!!!

Original Text: だーーーっ　【全然：ぜんぜん】　【似：に】てねえ！\nもんげー　しか【似：に】てねえ！
Translated Text:
Whaaaat?! They don't look anything alike!
The only thing they have in common is "
Monge"!

Original Text: ユーは　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ダニ\nこういう【時：とき】こそ【名案：めいあん】を　【考：かんが】えるダニ
Translated Text: You're a genius strategist, Dani. This\nis exactly the kind of situation where\nyou come up with a brilliant idea, Dani.

Original Text: …いや\nこいつは【多分：たぶん】アテにならないニャン
Translated Text: …Nah, I don't think I can\ncount on this guy, meow.

Original Text: むむむ　【失礼：しつれい】なっ
Translated Text: Hmm... How rude!

Original Text: ここは…　のるかそるか！\nすり【替：か】わりの【計：けい】しかございません！
Translated Text:
This is... do or die! Our only option is
a switch!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\n【今日：きょう】からアナタがこっちの【世界：せかい】でもお【兄様：にいさま】！
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce!
Starting today, you're my big
brother in this world, too!

Original Text: もんげーっ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: 【外見：がいけん】が【全然：ぜんぜん】ちがうダニ！
Translated Text: A tick that looks completely different!

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】！　【白：しろ】ければ　\nきっと　わかりませんって！
Translated Text: It's okay! If it's white, they\ndefinitely won't notice!

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: ひええええっ！\nまたよみがえったニャン！？
Translated Text:
Eeeeeek!
It came back to life again, meow!?

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: 「てきとうなこと　【言：い】いやがって\n　このドあほう【軍師：ぐんし】が！」
Translated Text: "How dare you spout such nonsense,\nyou idiotic military strategist!"

Original Text: ニャッ　コマさん！？\nなんでこいつが【言：い】ってることわかるニャン！
Translated Text:
Meow... Komasan!?
How come I can understand
what this guy's saying, meow!

Original Text: 「そんなことで　ごまかせるか\n　このドあほう【軍師：ぐんし】が！」
Translated Text: "Do you really think you can\npull the wool over my eyes with\nthat, you idiotic strategist?!"

Original Text: 「オラ　【自分：じぶん】の【国：くに】に【帰：かえ】るズラ！」\n…と　【言：い】ってるズラ
Translated Text:
"Hey, I'm going back to my own country!"
... or so he says.

Original Text: ドあほうドあほう　【言：い】い【過：す】ぎでうぃす！
Translated Text: "You idiot, you idiot"—I'm going overboard here!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんを【助：たす】けてくれて\n【本当：ほんとう】にありがとうズラ
Translated Text: Thanks so much for\nsaving my brother, Zura.

Original Text: ほら【兄：にい】ちゃんも\nちゃんとお【礼言：れいい】ったズラか？
Translated Text: See? Even my big brother said\nthank you properly, didn't he?

Original Text: ズ　ズラー\n（ありがとうございましたズラ…）
Translated Text: Zu... Zu-ra (Thank you, Zu-ra...)

Original Text: （こっちの【世界：せかい】でも\nコマじろうは　しっかりものズラね～）
Translated Text: (Even in this world, Koma-jiro\nsure does look like a responsible\nlittle guy, doesn't he?)

Original Text: みんなに【何：なに】か\nお【礼：れい】をしなければならないズラ！
Translated Text: I've got to thank everyone for something!

Original Text: いいダニ！\nミーも【元々：もともと】はコマさんに【助：たす】けられたダニ
Translated Text:
What a great tick!
I, too, was originally saved by Komasan.

Original Text: オレっちもニャン　コマさんはいつも\n【優：やさ】しくて　ともだち【思：おも】いだニャン
Translated Text: Me too, meow. Komasan is\nalways so kind and cares so\nmuch about his friends, meow.

Original Text: もんげー…！
Translated Text: Whoa…!

Original Text: えへへ\nでも　コマじろうの　【兄：にい】ちゃんのことは
Translated Text: Hehehe, but as for\nKomajiro's big brother...

Original Text: オラと　ジバニャンと　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン\n３【人力：にんちから】をあわせて　がんばったズラ！
Translated Text: Ora, Jibanyan, and USA-Pyon—the three\nof us joined forces and gave it our all!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei!
USA Pyon Zhongda!

Original Text: みんな　カッコイイズラ！\n３【人：にん】とも　この【国：くに】のエーユー　ズラ！
Translated Text:
You guys all look so cool!
All three of you are this
country's A-listers!

Original Text: オレっちたち【全員：ぜんいん】　エーユーニャン！？
Translated Text: All of us... E-U-Nyan!?

Original Text: ダニ！　【光栄：こうえい】ダニ！
Translated Text: Dani! It's an honor, Dani!

Original Text: 【中：なか】でも　【優：やさ】しくて　ともだち【思：おも】いの\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】は…
Translated Text: Above all, Komasan Sun Ce—who is kind\nand always looks out for his friends—is…

Original Text: オラの　【一番：いちばん】のヒーロー　ズラ！
Translated Text: My number one hero—Zura!

Original Text: コマじろう…！
Translated Text: Komajiro…!

Original Text: エーユーの【兄：にい】ちゃん！
Translated Text: Hey, AU guy!

Original Text: この【国：くに】にはまだ【困：こま】ってる【人：ひと】が【大勢：おおぜい】いるズラ\n３【人：にん】で【助：たす】けてあげてほしいズラ！
Translated Text: There are still a lot of people in this\ncountry who are struggling, so I want\nthe three of you to help them out!

Original Text: うん　コマじろう！\n【兄：にい】ちゃん　【約束：やくそく】するズラ！
Translated Text:
Yeah, Komajiro!
Big bro, I promise!

Original Text: きっと　３【人力：にんちから】をあわせて\nこの【世界：せかい】を　【平和：へいわ】にしてみせるズラ！
Translated Text: The three of us will definitely join forces\nand make this world a peaceful place!

Original Text: 【我：わ】が【主：あるじ】　マイティードッグ【孫策：そんさく】を\n【救：すく】ってくれて【感謝：かんしゃ】する
Translated Text: I thank my master, Mighty\nDog Sun Ce, for saving me.

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】は　【急：きゅう】に「のるかそるか」と\n【思：おも】い【立：た】ち…
Translated Text: Suddenly, he decided it was "do or die"...

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【本拠地：ほんきょち】にひとりで\n【乗：の】りこみたくなったらしい
Translated Text: It seems he felt like storming the\nenemy's stronghold all by himself.

Original Text: もともと【勇：ゆう】かんな【将：しょう】だったが…\nちょっと【無謀：むぼう】すぎたな…
Translated Text:
He was a brave general to
begin with… but he was a
little too reckless…

Original Text: こっちの【世界：せかい】でも「のるかそるか」が\n【流行：はや】ってるニャンね
Translated Text: "All or nothing" is all the rage\nin this world, too, meow.

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】も\n【昨日言：きのうい】ってた　【気：き】がするズラ
Translated Text: I think Whisper Kongming said\nsomething like that yesterday, too.

Original Text: チョー【不自然：ふしぜん】な【流行：はや】りダニ！\nすごく【気：き】になるダニ
Translated Text:
This trend is so unnatural! It
really has me wondering about it.

Original Text: さて…　それでは\nお【前：まえ】たちの【言：い】う　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪軍：ぶしょうようかいぐん】…
Translated Text: Well then… So, this “Blue General\nYo-kai Army” you’re talking about…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【結界：けっかい】を　やぶるため\nさくせんを【考：かんが】えよう
Translated Text: Let's come up with a strategy\nto break through the Cao Cao\narmy's barrier at Fuyunyan.

Original Text: さて　【結界：けっかい】をやぶるには…　\nウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】　どうするべきか？
Translated Text:
So, to break through the barrier… Whisper
Kongming, what should we do?

Original Text: へっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: あの【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせん…　\n【私：わたし】はすでに　この【紙：かみ】に【書：か】いてある
Translated Text:
A strategy to break through that barrier...
I've already written it down
on this piece of paper.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】と【同：おな】じ【意見：いけん】なのか\n【確：たし】かめたいのだ
Translated Text: I just want to make sure you agree with me.

Original Text: よよよよよ　よいでしょう！\nさらさらっと…！
Translated Text:
Yoyoyoyo—That's great!
Just like that...!

Original Text: それ　さっきオレっちが【鼻：はな】をかんだ\nチリ【紙：がみ】ニャンよ…？
Translated Text: Hey... isn't that the tissue I\njust used to blow my nose...?

Original Text: シャラーーップ！
Translated Text: Shut up!

Original Text: では　ふたり【同時：どうじ】に【見：み】せよう
Translated Text: Well then, let's show them both at the same time.

Original Text: そう…　【火：ひ】だ！
Translated Text: Yeah... Fire!

Original Text: （よかったー！\n【本当：ほんとう】によかったー！）
Translated Text:
(Phew!
That's a relief! I'm so glad!)

Original Text: （【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った\n【透：す】けるコンタクトをつけておいて…！）
Translated Text: (I’ll make sure to wear the\nsee-through contacts I bought\nfrom the Yo-kai online store…!)

Original Text: …だが　【今：いま】　【火：ひ】を【使：つか】っても\n【私：わたし】たちが　【燃：も】えるだけ
Translated Text: …But even if we used fire\nnow, it would only burn us.

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【方角：ほうがく】…
Translated Text: Fu Nyang, in the direction of Cao Cao's army…

Original Text: 【東南：とうなん】の【方向：ほうこう】に【風：かぜ】をふかせ　\n【火：ひ】の【玉：たま】を【飛：と】ばす【必要：ひつよう】がある
Translated Text: You need to make the wind blow toward\nthe southeast and launch a fireball.

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…お【前：まえ】は\n【不可能：ふかのう】を【可能：かのう】にする【男：おとこ】と【聞：き】いた
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming… I’ve heard you’re the\nman who makes the impossible possible.

Original Text: いや～　やっと　【私：わたくし】のことを\nわかってくれる【方：かた】に【出会：であ】えました！
Translated Text: Wow—I’ve finally met someone\nwho really understands me!

Original Text: ぷぷぷ　それってつまり　たいてい\n【信用：しんよう】されてないってことニャーン
Translated Text: Hehehe... So that basically means...\npeople usually don't trust me, meow.

Original Text: 【余計：よけい】なことは　【言：い】わんでよろしい！
Translated Text: Don't say anything unnecessary!

Original Text: ならば\n【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】をふかせてくれるな？
Translated Text: In that case, why don't you\nlet the southeast wind blow?

Original Text: 【当然：とうぜん】です！\nそんなの【簡単：かんたん】…　え？　えええー？
Translated Text:
Of course!
That's easy... Huh? What?!

Original Text: どーしましょ～！？\nもし【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】が　ふかなかったら…
Translated Text:
What should we do~!?
What if the southeast wind doesn't blow…

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】は　【処刑：しょけい】だそうです～！
Translated Text: Apparently, I'm going to be executed!

Original Text: ま…　【妖怪：ようかい】だから\n【処刑：しょけい】されても【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】ニャン？
Translated Text: Well... since I'm a Yo-kai, it's okay\nif I get executed, right, meow?

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】じゃありませんってば！\nこうなりゃ【意地：いじ】でも【風：かぜ】をふかせますよ！
Translated Text:
I'm telling you, it's not okay!
At this point, I'll make the
wind blow no matter what!

Original Text: でも　どうするダニ？\n【風向：かぜむ】きを【変：か】えるなんて【無理：むり】ダニ…
Translated Text:
But what are we going to do, Dani?
There's no way we can change
the wind direction, Dani…

Original Text: お【待：ま】ちください…\nめいそうに【入：はい】ります…
Translated Text: Please wait... I'm going to meditate...

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】が【目：め】をつぶって\nなんか　ぶつぶつ【言：い】ってるズラ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming has his\neyes closed and is muttering\nsomething under his breath!

Original Text: ポクポクポク…\nチーーン！　ひらめいた！
Translated Text:
Tap, tap, tap…
Ding! I’ve got it!

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】に【関係：かんけい】する【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】から\n【力：ちから】を【借：か】りるでうぃす！
Translated Text: I'm going to borrow power\nfrom wind-related Yo-kai!

Original Text: ふぁあああ～　ニャるほど～\nそりゃあ　いい【考：かんが】えニャ～ン
Translated Text: Faaaaah~ I see~ That's\na great idea, meow~

Original Text: なんで【他人事：たにんごと】な【空気：くうき】だしてんですっ\nアナタがたにも【手伝：てつだ】っていただきますよっ
Translated Text: Why are you acting like this has\nnothing to do with you? You\nguys are going to help out, too!

Original Text: ＺＺＺ…　ＺＺＺ…\nニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】に…　モテモテニャン…
Translated Text:
ZZZ… ZZZ… Meow
, KB… I'm so popular, meow…

Original Text: なんで【寝：ね】てやがんでいっ！！！
Translated Text: Why the hell are you sleeping?!

Original Text: ジバニャンと　ウィスパーは\nこっちの【世界：せかい】でも　【息：いき】ピッタリズラねー
Translated Text: Jibanyan and Whisper are still a perfect\nmatch even in this world, aren't they?

Original Text: まるで【水：みず】と【油：あぶら】のようダニねー
Translated Text: It's just like oil and water, isn't it?

Original Text: ちょーっとちがうクマ！
Translated Text: This bear is a little different!

Original Text: 【孫策：そんさく】と【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【友情：ゆうじょう】は　【断金：だんきん】の【交：まじ】わり…
Translated Text: The friendship between Sun Ce and Zhou Yu was as unbreakable as a bond forged from gold…

Original Text: 【孔明：こうめい】と【劉備：りゅうび】の【友情：ゆうじょう】は　【水魚：すいぎょ】の【交：まじ】わり\nと【呼：よ】ばれてるクマ！
Translated Text: The friendship between Kongming\nand Liu Bei is called a "bond as\nclose as fish and water," you know!

Original Text: えー　オレっち【水：みず】は【苦手：にがて】ニャン\nその【話：はなし】　【直：なお】したほうがいいニャンよ
Translated Text: Um... I'm not good with water, meow.\nYou should fix that part, meow.

Original Text: 【世界：せかい】の【歴史：れきし】にケチをつけないっっ
Translated Text: Don't find fault with world history!!!

Original Text: さあ！\n【風：かぜ】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしにいきますよ！
Translated Text:
All right! Let's go find the
Wind General Yo-kai!

Original Text: やあやあ　どうもどうも
Translated Text: Hey there, hey there. Thanks, thanks.

Original Text: そこにいるのは\n【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さんではないですか？
Translated Text: Isn't that Tengu Ma Su over there?

Original Text: そうだが…\n【貴様：きさま】　いったい【何者：なにもの】だ？
Translated Text:
That's true... but who the hell are you
?

Original Text: あやしい【者：もの】じゃございません！\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text:
I'm not a suspicious character!
I'm just looking for a
warrior-Yo-kai who can control
the wind…

Original Text: 【断：ことわ】る
Translated Text: Decline

Original Text: ほんのちょっとだけ！\nちょっと【手伝：てつだ】ってもらうだけですから…
Translated Text:
Just a little bit!
I just need you to help me out a little…

Original Text: お【断：ことわ】りだ
Translated Text: No way.

Original Text: こまったズラね…
Translated Text: That's a tough one...

Original Text: それにしても【態度：たいど】がデカいダニ！\nさすがは【天狗：てんぐ】！！
Translated Text:
Still, that tick sure is cocky!
Just like a tengu!!

Original Text: なんだと？
Translated Text: What?

Original Text: わーー！　【今：いま】のなし！\n【今言：いまい】ったことは　【忘：わす】れてくださ…
Translated Text:
Whoa! Never mind that!
Please forget what I just said…

Original Text: あーーもう　じれったいニャン！
Translated Text: Aaaah, this is so frustrating, meow!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！\nここは【力：ちから】ずくでいくしかないニャン！
Translated Text:
Whisper, Kongming! We've
got no choice but to take
this by force, meow!

Original Text: ほう　このオレとやろうってか？\n【面白：おもしろ】い…　かかってこい！
Translated Text:
Oh, so you want to take me on?
That's interesting... Bring it on!

Original Text: フン　なかなかやるな…\n【仕方：しかた】ない　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもいいぞ
Translated Text:
Hmph... Not bad...
I guess I have no choice.
I'll lend you a hand.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございますー！\nおかげで　【結界：けっかい】もなんとかできそうですー！
Translated Text:
Oh, thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I think I'll be able
to set up the barrier after all!

Original Text: ただ　そんな【大風：おおかぜ】…\nオレだけじゃ【力不足：ちからぶそく】だ
Translated Text:
But with winds that
strong… I can't handle it on
my own.

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【力：ちから】…\nもっと【集：あつ】めたほうがいいかもな
Translated Text:
The power of the wind-controlling
warrior-Yo-kai… Maybe I should gather
more of it.

Original Text: でも　まったく\n【手：て】がかりがないニャン…
Translated Text: But I don't have a single clue, meow...

Original Text: だったら　ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】に\n【会：あ】いにいけ
Translated Text: In that case, go see the immortal Zaci.

Original Text: 【仙人：せんにん】！\nなんだか【物知：ものし】りそうダニ！
Translated Text:
Sage!
You seem like you know a lot, don't you!

Original Text: あの【仙人：せんにん】なら　【貴様：きさま】らに\nきっと【道：みち】を【示：しめ】してくれるはずだ
Translated Text: That hermit will surely show you the way.

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さん　ありがとズラ！
Translated Text: Tengu Ba Su, thanks a bunch!

Original Text: よーし　そうと【決：き】まれば…
Translated Text: All right, now that it's decided...

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】のとこへ\nレッツゴーだニャン！
Translated Text: Let's go see the immortal Zaci, Meow!

Original Text: みなさん…　【私：わたくし】のためにそこまで…\nやはり【持：も】つべき【者：もの】は　ともだち…！
Translated Text:
Everyone… Going to such
lengths for me… Friends
really are the best thing in life…!

Original Text: って　あれ？　ちょっとー！\n【私：わたくし】を【置：お】いていかないでー！
Translated Text:
Wait... Huh? Hey! Don't leave
me behind!

Original Text: フフフ…　お【主：ぬし】たちの【願：ねが】いは\nすでに　もうわかっておる
Translated Text: Heh heh heh… I already know\nwhat you’re wishing for.

Original Text: そこの【白：しろ】いの…\nお【主：ぬし】の【命：いのち】が　かかっておるのじゃろ？
Translated Text:
That white thing over there…
Your life depends on it, doesn't it?

Original Text: さっすが【仙人様：せんにんさま】！\nそれでは【私：わたくし】を【助：たす】けてくださ…
Translated Text:
As expected of you, Sage!
Well then, please help me…

Original Text: ダル～～～ん\nめんどうくさそうだから　お【断：ことわ】りじゃ
Translated Text: Ugh... that sounds like\na hassle, so I'll pass.

Original Text: え…！？　そんなーーっ！
Translated Text: Huh…!? No wayyyy!

Original Text: ただ…ワシを【楽：たの】しませることができたら\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもよいぞ
Translated Text: But… if you can entertain me,\nI might just lend you a hand.

Original Text: さて　どうする？
Translated Text: So, what should we do?

Original Text: やります！　【楽：たの】しませます！\nおもに　このさくら【国：こく】の【英雄：えいゆう】たちが！
Translated Text:
We'll do it! We'll entertain you!
Mainly, the heroes of this Land of Sakura!

Original Text: ズラ！？
Translated Text: A wig!?

Original Text: ウィースーパー～～～！
Translated Text: We're awesome~~~!

Original Text: ほっほっほ\nでは…　【楽：たの】しませてもらおうかのう！
Translated Text: Ho ho ho... Well then... I\nsuppose I'll have some fun!

Original Text: なんじゃ　ワシみたいに　【首：くび】を【飛：と】ばしたり\nツルやヒツジに【化：ば】けたりはできんのか
Translated Text: What's the deal? Can't you do stuff\nlike me—like making your head fly off\nor turning into a crane or a sheep?

Original Text: ！！　そんなことができるのは\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】だけでうぃす！
Translated Text: !! Only a sage can do something like that!

Original Text: …まあ　お【主：ぬし】らの【必死：ひっし】なさまは\n【面白：おもしろ】かった
Translated Text: …Well, it was funny to see\nyou guys trying so hard.

Original Text: 【願：ねが】いをかなえてやろう
Translated Text: I'll make your wish come true.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございます！
Translated Text: Oh, thank you!

Original Text: じつは　【我：われわれ】々\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text: Actually, we're looking for a\nmilitary commander-type Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind…

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐうばしょく】さん【以外：いがい】に\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】は　ご【存知：ぞんじ】ないかと…
Translated Text: I was wondering if you knew of any\nother immortals besides Tengu Ba Su...

Original Text: …かぜカモ【劉琦：りゅうき】に\n【会：あ】いにいくがいい
Translated Text: …Go on, go see Liu Qi, the “Wind Duck.”

Original Text: おお！　ではその【方：かた】が\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…！？
Translated Text: Wow! So that person is a warrior-Yo-kai\nwho controls the wind…!?

Original Text: ほっほっほ…\nそれは【行：い】けば　わかるじゃろうて
Translated Text:
Ho ho ho… Well, you’ll
find out once you get
there, won’t you?

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈様：せんにんさじさま】！\nこのご【恩：おん】は【一生：いっしょう】　【忘：わす】れません！
Translated Text:
Master Zici, the One-Eyed
Immortal! I will never forget
this kindness for the rest of my life!

Original Text: かぜカモ【劉琦殿：りゅうきどの】！\nお【願：ねが】いがあって【参：まい】りました！
Translated Text:
Lord Liu Qi of Kazekamo!
I’ve come to ask you for a favor!

Original Text: かぜカモ…\n【手：て】みじかに　お【願：ねが】いね
Translated Text:
A cold, maybe...
Just a quick favor, okay?

Original Text: …というわけで
Translated Text: …So,

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】をあやつる【強力：きょうりょく】な【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nさがしてます！
Translated Text: I'm looking for a powerful warrior-Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind!

Original Text: アナタ　【知：し】ってますよね？
Translated Text: You know that, right?

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る？　ボクはみんなを\n【風邪：かぜ】っぽくするだけカモ
Translated Text: Control the wind? Maybe I just\nmake everyone feel like they're\ncoming down with a cold.

Original Text: ニャンと…！　\nそれって　まさか…
Translated Text:
Wow...
! Could it be...

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】じゃなくて\n「【風邪：かぜ】」を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】ってことダニ？
Translated Text: So he's a military\ncommander-Yo-kai who controls\n"colds" rather than the wind, right?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…\nかわいそうズラ…
Translated Text:
Whisper Kongming…
Poor guy…

Original Text: あ　あ　あのジジイーーーーっ！\nテキトーなこと【教：おし】えやがって～！！
Translated Text:
"Hey... hey... you old geezer!!!
How dare you teach me such
nonsense~!!"

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nしょうがないニャン！
Translated Text:
You're such a genius strategist!
Oh well, meow!

Original Text: とりあえず\n【今：いま】の【戦力：せんりょく】でなんとかするニャン！
Translated Text: For now, let's just make do\nwith what we've got, meow!

Original Text: 【人：ひと】ごとだと【思：おも】って！　このままだと…\n【私：わたくし】　【処刑：しょけい】ですよ　しょ・け・い！
Translated Text:
Don't act like this has nothing to
do with you! If things keep going
like this... I'm going to be
executed. E-x-e-c-u-t-i-o-n!

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】の【力：ちから】を【借：か】りれば\n【風：かぜ】は【起：お】こせるダニ！
Translated Text: If I get some help from Tengu Ba\nSu, I can make the wind blow, Dani!

Original Text: そうズラ！\n【後：あと】はオラたちがなんとかするズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right! We'll take care of
the rest!

Original Text: そんなこと【言：い】ったって\nどうにもなりませーん！　うわーん！
Translated Text: Saying that won't change a thing! Waaah!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！
Translated Text: Whisper, Kongming!

Original Text: 【天才：てんさい】なら…　どんなピンチも\n【頭：あたま】で【切：き】りぬけるニャン！
Translated Text: If I'm a genius... I can use my brain\nto get out of any tight spot, meow!

Original Text: はっ
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【思：おも】わず　【取：と】り【乱：みだ】してしまいました…\nお【見苦：みぐる】しい【限：かぎ】りでういっす…
Translated Text:
I just lost my cool without
meaning to… I’m really
sorry for making such
a spectacle of myself…

Original Text: では　さっそく　【帰：かえ】って\n【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせんをねりましょう！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get right to it and come up\nwith a plan to break through the barrier!

Original Text: あの～
Translated Text: Um...

Original Text: アナタはお【呼：よ】びじゃありません！
Translated Text: You're not invited!

Original Text: …【一応：いちおう】　ついていくカモ
Translated Text: …I guess I'll go along with it.

Original Text: ボクの【結界：けっかい】をやぶるなんて…\n【少：すこ】しは　デキる【連中：れんちゅう】みたいだね
Translated Text:
To break through my barrier...
Looks like you guys are pretty
capable, don't you?

Original Text: でも　まだまださくせんはある\n【安心：あんしん】してよ　フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】
Translated Text: But I still have plenty of strategies up my\nsleeve, so don't worry, Fu Nyang Cao Cao.

Original Text: ばっふぅぅう～～～ん…！
Translated Text: Baaaaaahhh~~~!…!

Original Text: なっ！？\nフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！？
Translated Text:
What!?
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【動：うご】きが\n【活発：かっぱつ】になってきた
Translated Text: Fu Nyang: Cao Cao's army\nhas become more active.

Original Text: …コマさん【孫策：そんさく】\nヤツらの【狙：ねら】いは　お【前：まえ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ
Translated Text: …Komasan, Sun Ce, and the rest of\nthem—they’re after your magic orb.

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】は【今：いま】まで\nそんな【野心：やしん】を【見：み】せていなかった
Translated Text: Fuyunian Cao Cao had never\nshown such ambition before.

Original Text: だが　【宝珠狩：ほうじゅが】りに【反対：はんたい】した\nキュウビ【荀彧：じゅんいく】を【牢：ろう】に【入：い】れたらしい
Translated Text: However, it seems he had\nKyuubi Jun Iku, who opposed the\njewel hunt, thrown into prison.

Original Text: ヤツは【本気：ほんき】だ\nこれは【全面戦争：ぜんめんせんそう】になる…
Translated Text: He's serious. This is\ngoing to be all-out war...

Original Text: ここはオラに【任：まか】せるズラ
Translated Text: Leave this to me, man.

Original Text: どこに【行：い】くつもりだ？
Translated Text: Where are you going?

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【目的：もくてき】がオラの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】なら\nオラ　ひとりで【会：あ】いにいくズラ
Translated Text: If the enemy's after my gem,\nI'll go meet them all by myself.

Original Text: ……【何：なに】をカッコつけている
Translated Text: ……Why are you trying to act so cool?

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】に【今：いま】\n【倒：たお】れてもらっては【困：こま】るんだ
Translated Text: We can't have the hero going down now.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】たちも【協力：きょうりょく】する
Translated Text: We'll help, too.

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…
Translated Text: Orochi Zhou Yu…

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】たちも\n【忘：わす】れてもらっちゃ【困：こま】るのだ！
Translated Text: You can't just forget about\nRyu-kun, Liu Yu, and the others!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメラ！\n（オレたちも【当然：とうぜん】　【行：い】くぜ！）
Translated Text:
Fire, fire!
(Of course we're going too!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は…　【一緒：いっしょ】だぜ！
Translated Text: When we die… we'll be together!

Original Text: みんな…
Translated Text: Everyone…

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】でのアナタの【活躍：かつやく】\nいちばんよく【知：し】ってるのは　この【私：わたくし】ですよっ
Translated Text: I'm the one who knows best just\nhow amazing you are in this world!

Original Text: どんなにウザがられても…\nついていくでうぃす！
Translated Text:
No matter how much people
get annoyed with me… I'm
sticking with you!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming…

Original Text: ともだちって　どこの【世界：せかい】にいっても\nいいもんニャンねー
Translated Text: Friends are great no matter\nwhere you go, aren't they, meow?

Original Text: 【友情：ゆうじょう】に　【国境：こっきょう】も　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】も【外：そと】もないダニ！
Translated Text: Friendship knows no borders—not even within or outside a book, Dani!

Original Text: …みんな　ありがとズラ！\nもう【少：すこ】しだけ【力：ちから】を【借：か】してほしいズラ！
Translated Text:
…Thanks, everyone!
I need your help just a little bit more!

Original Text: じゃあ　【行：い】くズラ！\n【目指：めざ】すはフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】ズラ！
Translated Text:
Alright, let's go! Our target
is Fu Nyang Cao Cao!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\n【決着：けっちゃく】をつけるズラ！
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang, Cao Cao! Let's
settle this once and for all!

Original Text: フフフ…でふー！
Translated Text: Hehehe… Phew!

Original Text: ニャ！\nいきなりゲップとは　【失礼：しつれい】ニャン！
Translated Text:
Meow!
Burping out of the blue
like that—how rude, meow!

Original Text: ち　ちがうダニ！
Translated Text: No, that's a different kind of mite!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】の【体：からだ】…\nみるみる【大：おお】きくなってるダニ！
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang, Cao Cao's body...
The tick is getting bigger right
before our eyes!

Original Text: ニャ？　ニャニャニャー！！
Translated Text: Meow? Meow-meow-meow!!

Original Text: でふ～！\nデカニャン【曹操：そうそう】でふ～！
Translated Text:
Defu~!
It's Big Cat Cao Cao, defu~!

Original Text: もんげーー！　オラのお【母：かあ】ちゃんみたいに\nデッカくなっちまったズラ～！！
Translated Text: Whoa! This wig's gotten\nas huge as my mom!!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】～！\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【全部：ぜんぶ】くれでふ～！
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce~! Give me all the
orbs, please~!

Original Text: や　やったニャン…
Translated Text: Y-Yay, meow…

Original Text: デカニャン【曹操：そうそう】が\nしぼんでいくダニ！
Translated Text: Dekanyan Cao Cao is shrinking like a tick!

Original Text: …\nオレはいったい【何：なに】を…
Translated Text:
…What on earth
am I…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\nどうやら【正気：しょうき】に【戻：もど】ったみたいだね
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!
Looks like he's come to his senses.

Original Text: これで【一件落着：いっけんらくちゃく】ズラ！
Translated Text: That settles it, then!

Original Text: 【今：いま】ので　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が…【八：やっ】つズラ！
Translated Text: With that, the orbs... eight in a row!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が　【全部集：ぜんぶあつ】まったダニ！\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るお【願：ねが】いをするダニ！
Translated Text:
Dani has collected all the orbs!
Dani is asking to return to her
original world!

Original Text: そうニャン！\nきっとケータやみんなが【心配：しんぱい】してるニャン！
Translated Text:
That's right, meow! I'm
sure Keita and everyone else
are worried about me, meow!

Original Text: そうズラ！\nオラたち【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】らないとだめズラ…
Translated Text:
That's right!
We've gotta get back
to our original world...

Original Text: でも　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】にそれを【願：ねが】ったら…\nこの【世界：せかい】ともお【別：わか】れズラね…
Translated Text:
But if I make that wish on the
jewel… I’ll have to say goodbye to
this world, won’t I…

Original Text: わかります！　わかりますとも！\n【私：わたくし】との【別：わか】れが　【心苦：こころぐる】しいのですね！？
Translated Text:
I get it! I totally get it!
It’s hard for you to say
goodbye to me, isn’t it!?

Original Text: ご【心配：しんぱい】なく！　【必要：ひつよう】とあらば\n【私：わたくし】も【一緒：いっしょ】に　そちらの【世界：せかい】へ…！！
Translated Text: Don't worry! If necessary, I'll\ngo with you to that world...!!

Original Text: それは　ごめんだニャン…
Translated Text: No way, meow…

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\n【体：からだ】には　【気：き】をつけるのだ！
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce!
Take care of yourself!

Original Text: さよならは【言：い】わないっス！\nきっと　また【会：あ】えるっスから！
Translated Text:
I'm not saying goodbye!
I'm sure we'll meet again!

Original Text: うん…　そうズラね！
Translated Text: Yeah... That's right!

Original Text: メラメラ…　メラメラ！\n（どこに【行：い】っても…　ともだちだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze... Blaze!
(No matter where I go... you're my friend!)

Original Text: ブラザー！\nオレたちのこと　【忘：わす】れんなよ！
Translated Text:
Bro!
Don't forget about us!

Original Text: もちろんズラ！\n【三人：さんにん】の【誓：ちか】いは　えいえんズラ！
Translated Text:
Of course, Zura!
The three of us swear—eternal Zura!

Original Text: 【結局：けっきょく】　お【主：ぬし】への【借：か】り\n【返：かえ】すことができなんだな…
Translated Text: So, in the end, I wasn't\nable to pay you back...

Original Text: もうケンカしねえから\nそれで【勘弁：かんべん】してくれ
Translated Text: I won't fight anymore, so\nplease cut me some slack.

Original Text: そうズラ！　みんな【仲良：なかよ】しが【一番：いちばん】ズラ！\nそれに…
Translated Text:
That's right! It's best when
everyone gets along! And besides
...

Original Text: まんじゅうは　つぶあんも\nこしあんも　どっちでもおいしいズラ！
Translated Text: Manju are delicious no matter whether\nthey're filled with coarse-grained red\nbean paste or smooth red bean paste!

Original Text: じゃあ…みんな　さよならズラ！\nオラ　みんなのこと【忘：わす】れないズラ！
Translated Text:
Well then… Bye-bye, everyone!
I won't forget you guys!

Original Text: じゃあ　ジバニャン\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン…
Translated Text: Well then, Jibanyan Usapyon…

Original Text: いよいよ　【祈：いの】るダニね？
Translated Text: It's finally time for the praying mantis, isn't it?

Original Text: いでよ　えーと…【神様：かみさま】！
Translated Text: Come forth... um... God!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らの【願：ねが】い…
Translated Text: Our wish…

Original Text: かなえたまえズラーーー！！
Translated Text: Make it happen, Zuuuuu!!

Original Text: も　もんげー…
Translated Text: Wow...

Original Text: そ　【空：そら】に【島：しま】が…\n【浮：う】かんでるニャン……！
Translated Text:
Wha—there's an island...
floating in the sky, meow...!

Original Text: あははははは！
Translated Text: Hahahahahaha!

Original Text: 【見：み】るダニ！\nあいつら　【戻：もど】ってきたダニッ
Translated Text:
Look at those ticks!
They're back, man!

Original Text: キミたち　ぽかーんとしてるね…\nま　ムリもないか…
Translated Text:
You guys look kind of dumbfounded…
Well, I guess I can’t blame you…

Original Text: 【説明：せつめい】してやるしかないっしょ\nよーく【聞：き】いておけよ！
Translated Text: I guess I'll just have to explain\nit to you. Listen carefully!

Original Text: この『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』は\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】が【作：つく】り【出：だ】した【本：ほん】！
Translated Text: This *Yo-kai Sangokushi* is a\nbook created by King Enma!

Original Text: もんげー！！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: 【強大：きょうだい】な【力：ちから】を【持：も】ちすぎた　ボクら【兄弟：きょうだい】を\n【封：ふう】じ【込：こ】めるためにね
Translated Text: To seal away us brothers, who\nhad become far too powerful...

Original Text: 【自力：じりき】で【出：で】たいと【思：おも】ってたんだけど　さすがは\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】の【本：ほん】　そう【簡単：かんたん】にはいかなかった
Translated Text: I was hoping to get out on my own,\nbut—as you’d expect from a book\nby King Enma—it wasn’t that easy.

Original Text: でもよ　【長：なが】～い【時間：じかん】がたったせいか\n【最近：さいきん】　【封印：ふういん】の【力：ちから】が【弱：よわ】まってるんだ！
Translated Text: But you know what? Maybe because so\nmuch time has passed, the power of the\nseal has been getting weaker lately!

Original Text: その【証拠：しょうこ】に…\nオレたちの【妖気：ようき】　【本：ほん】の【外：そと】に【出：で】てたっしょ？
Translated Text:
As proof of that…
our demonic energy was
leaking out of the book, right?

Original Text: まさか…　それで\nみんな　【変：へん】になったのかニャン！？
Translated Text: No way… Is that why\neveryone went crazy, meow!?

Original Text: ご【名答：めいとう】！
Translated Text: That's the right answer!

Original Text: もう　この【本：ほん】に\nボクらを【抑：おさ】え【続：つづ】ける【力：ちから】はないんだ
Translated Text: This book no longer has\nthe power to hold us back.

Original Text: そんな【今：いま】なら…\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めて【祈：いの】れば…
Translated Text:
If I do it now… if I gather the
orbs and pray…

Original Text: 【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】に\n【出：で】られると【思：おも】ってね
Translated Text: I thought I'd be able to go\nout into the world, you see

Original Text: あわわ…\nそうなったら　【大変：たいへん】ダニ…！
Translated Text:
Oh no... If
that happens, it'll be a real disaster...!

Original Text: なんとか１【個集：こあつ】めたんだけど\nだれかさんに　ジャマされてねえ…
Translated Text: I managed to collect one, but\nsomeone got in the way...

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】…\n【知：し】ってるっしょ？
Translated Text:
Chairman Dong Zhuo of the Ikakamone...
You know who he is, right?

Original Text: あいつに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めてもらおうと\n【思：おも】ったのに…　くそっ…
Translated Text: I was counting on him to collect\nthe orbs for me... Damn it...

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【時：とき】も\nやってくれたね…
Translated Text: They did that for Li Ru in\n"Dondoro" too, didn't they…

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【妖気：ようき】で【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【力：ちから】が\n【弱：よわ】まって　いけると【思：おも】ったら…
Translated Text: Li Ru's demonic aura was gradually\nweakening the power of the jewel, and\njust when I thought I was about to make it...

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をかっさらわれた…
Translated Text: The jewel was stolen...

Original Text: だから　コマさん【孫策：そんさく】…
Translated Text: So, Komasan, Sun Ce…

Original Text: キミたちが【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めるのを【待：ま】って\nまとめてうばおうと【思：おも】ってさ
Translated Text: I was planning to wait for you\nguys to collect the orbs so I\ncould steal them all at once.

Original Text: さあ　のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nもちろん　するっしょ？
Translated Text:
Alright, it's a do-or-die showdown!
Of course you're in, right?

Original Text: ニャンで　そうなるニャ～ン！？
Translated Text: Why on earth would that happen, meow~!?

Original Text: やっぱり　そうだよね…　でも…\nこの【勝負：しょうぶ】…
Translated Text:
I guess that’s how it is… But…
this match…

Original Text: へへっ\n【強制的：きょうせいてき】に　【受：う】けてもらうからな
Translated Text: Heh heh... I'm going to\nmake you take it, you know.

Original Text: じゃあ　おたがい　がんばろう\nはあ…　【早：はや】く【終：お】わるといいな…
Translated Text: Well then, let's both do our best.\nSigh... I hope this ends soon...

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】にビッグボスが【出現：しゅつげん】し\n【暴：あば】れまわっているようです！
Translated Text: It looks like Big Bosses are appearing\nall over the place and running amok!

Original Text: ノルカ【軍：ぐん】がさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】と【団々坂：だんだんざか】を\n【攻：せ】めており…
Translated Text: The Norka Army is attacking the Sakura\nResidential District and Dandan-zaka…

Original Text: ソルカ【軍：ぐん】がおつかい【横丁：よこちょう】と\nさくら【中央：ちゅうおう】シティをこうげき【中：ちゅう】です
Translated Text: The Solka Army is currently attacking\nOtsukai Yokocho and Sakura Central City.

Original Text: まず　そいつらを【倒：たお】すズラ！
Translated Text: First things first—let's take those guys down!

Original Text: せっかくここまで\nみんなで【戦：たたか】ってきたズラ…
Translated Text: We've all fought our way\nthis far together, after all...

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】の【最後：さいご】に　この【国：くに】を…\nともだちを【見捨：みす】てるわけにはいかないズラ！
Translated Text:
At the very last moment, I just can't
abandon this country... or my friends!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】…
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce…

Original Text: オラは　この【国：くに】の　エーユー　ズラ！\nみんなのために　【戦：たたか】うズラ！
Translated Text:
I'm this country's AU-Zura! I'll fight for
everyone, Zura!

Original Text: それに　ノルカやソルカが【外：そと】に【出：で】たら\nたいへんズラ！
Translated Text: Besides, it'd be a real mess\nif Norka and Solka got out!

Original Text: さあ　もう【一回：いっかい】\nさくら【国：こく】の【平和：へいわ】を【取：と】りもどすズラ！
Translated Text: Alright, let's restore peace to\nSakura Country once again!

Original Text: 【二人：ふたり】ともどうしたズラ？\n【早：はや】くしないと　みんなが【危：あぶ】ないズラ！
Translated Text:
What's up with you two?
Hurry up—everyone's in danger!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】…\n【今度：こんど】の【相手：あいて】はきびしすぎるダニ…
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce… This
next opponent is way too tough, Dani…

Original Text: ズラッ
Translated Text: In a row

Original Text: オレっちも…\n【勝：か】てる【気：き】が　まるでしないニャン
Translated Text:
I don't think I
stand a chance either, meow...

Original Text: ズラ…
Translated Text: Wig…

Original Text: オレっちたちは\nこの【世界：せかい】の【妖怪：ようかい】じゃないニャン
Translated Text: We're not Yo-kai from this world, meow.

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】は\nどうしてそこまで　がんばれるダニ？
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce, how come you can keep\npushing yourself so hard, you little bug?

Original Text: オラ　この【世界：せかい】が【大好：だいす】きズラ\nたくさん　【大切：たいせつ】なともだちが　できたズラ
Translated Text: Hey, I really love this world! I've\nmade so many great friends!

Original Text: ともだちを　【見捨：みす】てることなんか\nできねえ　ズラ
Translated Text: I could never abandon my friends, Zura.

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】のともだちに\n【会：あ】えなくなってもいいのか？
Translated Text: Is it really okay to stop\nseeing your true friends?

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】の【弟：おとうと】に…\n【会：あ】えなくなってもいいのか？
Translated Text:
Is it really okay... if I
can't see my real brother anymore?

Original Text: オラは　この【国：くに】の　エーユーズラ\nオラ　この【国：くに】を【必：かなら】ず【平和：へいわ】にするって
Translated Text: "I am Euzuraola of this country, and I will\ndefinitely bring peace to this country."

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】のコマじろうと【約束：やくそく】したズラ
Translated Text: The wig I promised Komajiro of this world

Original Text: だから　【弟：おとうと】との【約束：やくそく】も【守：まも】らないで\n【一人：ひとり】だけ　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るなんて…
Translated Text: So, to break my promise to my\nyounger brother and go back to\nmy original world all by myself...

Original Text: オラ　そんなカッコ【悪：わる】い\n【兄：にい】ちゃんになりたくねえズラ！！
Translated Text: Dude, I don't wanna be\nthat kind of lame guy!!

Original Text: …ケータに【会：あ】えなくなるのはさびしいニャン\nけど…　オレっちも【戦：たたか】うニャン！
Translated Text: …I’ll be sad not to see Keita anymore,\nmeow… but I’m gonna fight too, meow!

Original Text: ケータは　【優：やさ】しい【心：こころ】を【持：も】ってるニャン\nきっとケータも【同：おな】じことをするはずニャン！
Translated Text: Keta has a kind heart, meow. I'm sure\nKeta would do the same thing, meow!

Original Text: わかったダニ\nミーも【一緒：いっしょ】に【戦：たたか】うダニ！
Translated Text: Got it, Danimi! I'll fight alongside you, Dan!

Original Text: あきらめず　【前：まえ】にすすむ！\nそうすれば　きっと【道：みち】は【開：ひら】けるダニ！
Translated Text:
Don't give up—keep moving forward!
If you do, the path will
surely open up, Dani!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち…
Translated Text: You guys…

Original Text: 【覚悟：かくご】は【決：き】まったニャン！\nオレっちたちの【友情：ゆうじょう】パワー！
Translated Text:
I'm ready, meow! The power of
our friendship!

Original Text: ノルカとソルカに\nわからせてやるダニ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna teach Norka\nand Solka a lesson, Dan!

Original Text: ズラ…\n【二人：ふたり】とも…！
Translated Text:
Zura…
both of you…!

Original Text: やっぱり　ともだちが【一緒：いっしょ】なら\nどんなことでも　こわくないズラ！
Translated Text: After all, when my friends are with\nme, I'm not afraid of anything!

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】も！\nいっしょに　【行：い】こうズラ！
Translated Text:
Orochi Zhou Yu, too! Let's go
together, Zura!

Original Text: ふっ\nありがとう…
Translated Text: Huh, thanks…

Original Text: ビッグボス…\n【全員：ぜんいん】　やっつけたニャン！
Translated Text:
Big Boss…
I took them all down, meow!

Original Text: みなさん　お【見事：みごと】です！
Translated Text: Way to go, everyone!

Original Text: ノルカソルカの【封印境：ふういんきょう】への【道：みち】が\n【開：ひら】けましたよー！
Translated Text: The path to the Sealed Realm\nof Norukasoruka has opened!

Original Text: いくダニよ\nエーユーのみんな！
Translated Text: Hey, everyone at AU!

Original Text: 【今：いま】こそ【突：つ】っこむズラー！
Translated Text: Now's the time to go for it, Zura!

Original Text: ノルカとソルカ…\nふっかつ　しちゃったズラ！？
Translated Text:
Norka and
Solka… Did they actually
come back to life!?

Original Text: ええ！　ノルカソルカは【双子：ふたご】…
Translated Text: Really?! Norka and Sorka are twins…

Original Text: 【一方：いっぽう】だけを【倒：たお】しても\n【片方：かたほう】さえ【無事：ぶじ】なら　ふっかつするのです！
Translated Text: Even if you defeat just one of\nthem, as long as the other\none is still alive, it will revive!

Original Text: そういうことは【早：はや】く【言：い】えニャン！
Translated Text: You should've said that sooner, meow!

Original Text: いでえーー！
Translated Text: Ouch!

Original Text: で　でも　ご【安心：あんしん】を…\nさくせんがあります…
Translated Text:
But... don't worry... I have a
plan...

Original Text: ヤツらは【倒：たお】された【日：ひ】の\n【二日後：ふつかご】にふっかつします
Translated Text: They'll come back to life two\ndays after they're defeated.

Original Text: つまり！　【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】した【次：つぎ】の【日：ひ】に\nもう【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】せば…
Translated Text: In other words! If you defeat one and\nthen defeat the other the very next day…

Original Text: ふっかつしないズラね？
Translated Text: It's not coming back, is it?

Original Text: そのとおりでうぃすー！
Translated Text: That's right, y'all!

Original Text: のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nオラたちが　【勝：か】ったズラ！
Translated Text:
It was a do-or-die showdown!
We won, man!

Original Text: やったダニ！\n【今度：こんど】こそ【本当：ほんとう】に【終：お】わりダニ！
Translated Text:
Yes, mites!
This time it's really over, mites!

Original Text: これで　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】れるニャンね！
Translated Text: Now I can go back to my original world, meow!

Original Text: ん…？\nニャニャニャニャー！
Translated Text:
Hmm...?
Meow, meow, meow, meow!

Original Text: じ　【地震：じしん】ダニー！
Translated Text: Oh, an earthquake, Danny!

Original Text: もんげー！\nし　【島：しま】がー　【島：しま】がー！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
The island—the island!

Original Text: お　【驚：おどろ】いてるヒマはございませんっ！\nヤツらが【逃：に】げてしまいますよっ！
Translated Text:
There's no time to be surprised!
They'll get away!

Translated Text: NULL

Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: どうやら　ふたりは【合体：がったい】し\nノルカソルカとなったようです！
Translated Text: It looks like the two of them have\nmerged to become Norukasoruka!

Original Text: どんなヤツが【相手：あいて】でも\nオレっちたちは【怖：こわ】くないニャン！
Translated Text: No matter who we're up against,\nwe're not scared, meow!

Original Text: そうダニ！　ミーたちには\n【頼：たよ】れる【仲間：なかま】がいっぱいいるダニ！
Translated Text: That's right, Dani! We've got lots\nof friends we can count on, Dani!

Original Text: チーム『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』ズラ！
Translated Text: Team "Yo-kai Sangokushi"—Here We Go!

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】こそ　【最後：さいご】の【戦：たたか】いズラ！\nがんばるズラよ！
Translated Text:
This time, it's definitely
the final battle! I'm gonna
give it my all!

Original Text: ラニャー！
Translated Text: Ranya!

Original Text: まかせるダニー！
Translated Text: Leave it to Danny!

Original Text: ちょっと　ウィスパー…\nこの【結末：けつまつ】　どういうことなの？
Translated Text:
Hey, Whisper... What's the deal with this
ending?

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】ら　さくら【国：こく】の【英雄：えいゆう】たちは\n【本：ほん】の【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うことを【選：えら】んだようです…
Translated Text:
It seems that Jibanyan, Liu Bei,
and the other heroes of Sakura
Country have chosen to save
the world within the book…

Original Text: え…\n【兄：にい】ちゃんも…　ズラ…？
Translated Text:
Huh... So you too
, big bro... a wig...?

Original Text: イエス
Translated Text: Yes

Original Text: それじゃ　【兄：にい】ちゃんは\nもう　こっちの【世界：せかい】には…
Translated Text: Well then, does that mean my\nbrother isn't in this world anymore...

Original Text: 【戻：もど】ってきません
Translated Text: They won't come back.

Original Text: ウソだよね？
Translated Text: You're kidding, right?

Original Text: ジバニャンたちが　この【本：ほん】に【入：はい】って…\nもう【戻：もど】ってこないなんて…　そんなの…
Translated Text:
Jibanyan and the others
went inside this book… and
now they’re never coming
back… That’s just…

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】…
Translated Text: Keta...

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】も【悲：かな】しいです！\nですが　それが【彼：かれ】らの【決断：けつだん】！
Translated Text:
I'm sad too!
But that's their decision!

Original Text: 【男子：だんし】ならば！　ともだちならば！\nともだちの【決断：けつだん】を【受：う】け【入：い】れねばなりませんっ
Translated Text:
If you're a guy! If you're a
friend! You have to accept your
friend's decision!

Original Text: …その【通：とお】りズラ
Translated Text: …That's right, Zura.

Original Text: コマじろう…\nさびしくないの…！？
Translated Text:
Komajiro… Aren’t you lonely…
!?

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんは　オラが【生：う】まれたときから\nオラの【兄：にい】ちゃんで…
Translated Text: My big brother has been my big\nbrother ever since I was born…

Original Text: オラの【一番：いちばん】のともだちズラ
Translated Text: Acting like I'm the best friend ever

Original Text: いつも【優：やさ】しくて…　カッコよくて…\nもんげー　【勇気：ゆうき】があって…
Translated Text:
He's always so kind... and cool...
and man, he's so brave...

Original Text: オラの【一番：いちばん】の…　ヒーローズラ…！
Translated Text: My absolute favorite… Heroes Ra…!

Original Text: コマじろう…！
Translated Text: Komajiro…!

Original Text: ううん！\nやっぱり　もう【会：あ】えないなんてだめだ！
Translated Text:
No way!
I just can't stand the thought
of never seeing you again!

Original Text: なんとかしなきゃ…\nそうだっ！　【今：いま】こそ！
Translated Text:
I've got to do something...
That's it! Now's the time!

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: オレのともだち！\n【出：で】てこい　コマさん！
Translated Text:
My friend!
Come out, Komasan!

Original Text: 【妖怪：ようかい】メダル　セットオン！
Translated Text: Yo-kai Medals: Set On!

Original Text: ケータ【君：くん】…　お【気持：きも】ちはわかりますが\n【妖怪：ようかい】ウォッチで【呼：よ】び【出：だ】しても…
Translated Text: Keta... I understand how you feel, but even\nif you summon them with Yo-kai Watch...

Original Text: ズラ？
Translated Text: A wig?

Original Text: 【出：で】てきたーっ！
Translated Text: It's out!

Original Text: 【出：で】てきたーっ！
Translated Text: It's out!

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃ…\n【兄：にい】ちゃああああん！
Translated Text:
Big bro…
Big broooooo!

Original Text: よかった…\nそうだ　ジバニャンも【早：はや】く【呼：よ】び【戻：もど】さないと！
Translated Text:
That's a relief... Oh, right
—I have to call Jibanyan back soon, too!

Original Text: はー\n【今日：きょう】もいい　【天気：てんき】ズラー
Translated Text: Ahh, the weather's great again today!

Original Text: そうズラねー\nあ　【兄：にい】ちゃん！　あの【雲：くも】！
Translated Text: Hey, bro! Look at that cloud!

Original Text: ！\nソフトクリームにそっくりズラ！
Translated Text:
!
It looks just like soft-serve ice cream!

Original Text: コマじろう！　【今日：きょう】は【兄：にい】ちゃんが\nソフトクリームおごってやるズラ！
Translated Text: Komajiro! Today, big brother's gonna\ntreat you to a soft-serve ice cream!

Original Text: ほんとズラッ！？
Translated Text: Seriously, a whole bunch of them!?

Original Text: 【最近：さいきん】の【兄：にい】ちゃん\nますますカッコいいズラ～！
Translated Text: My big brother's been looking\ncooler and cooler lately!

Original Text: えへへ\n【照：て】れるズラ～
Translated Text: Hehehe, I'm so embarrassed~

Original Text: （なんたって　【兄：にい】ちゃんは\nさくら【国：こく】の　エーユーだったズラ！）
Translated Text: (After all, my big brother used\nto be an AU in Sakura Country!)

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん　ごちそうさまズラ！\nじゃオラ　【ＤＪ：ディージェイ】のイベント【行：い】ってくるズラ！
Translated Text:
Bro, thanks for the meal!
Alright, I'm off to a DJ event!

Original Text: いってらっしゃいズラ～
Translated Text: Have a good trip, Zura~

Original Text: （あっちの【世界：せかい】のコマじろうも\n【元気：げんき】にしてるといいズラ…）
Translated Text: (I hope Koma-jiro over\nthere is doing well, too...)

Original Text: ああ　【元気：げんき】にしている
Translated Text: Oh, I'm doing well.

Original Text: ズラッ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!?

Original Text: こっ　この【声：こえ】…\nオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】っ！？
Translated Text:
W-Wait, that voice… Orochi
Zhou Yu!?

Original Text: ふ　【久：ひさ】しぶりだな\nお【前：まえ】に【礼：れい】を【言：い】いにきた
Translated Text: Hey... It's been a while. I\njust came by to thank you.

Original Text: お【礼：れい】なんて　いらねえズラよ！\nみんなが　【元気：げんき】なら【何：なに】よりズラ！
Translated Text:
I don't need any thanks, you know!
As long as everyone's doing
well, that's all that matters!

Original Text: オラ…\nまたみんなに【会：あ】いたいズラ！
Translated Text:
Hey... I really want to see you all again
!

Original Text: ……【本当：ほんとう】か？
Translated Text: ……Is that true?

Original Text: ならば　【図書室：としょしつ】へ【来：き】てくれ
Translated Text: In that case, please come to the library.

Original Text: また　あの【本：ほん】を【読：よ】めばいいズラね！
Translated Text: Well, I guess I'll just have to read that book again!

Original Text: わかったズラ！
Translated Text: Got it, dude!

Original Text: ニャ！？　ふたりとも！\nどうして【図書室：としょしつ】に！？
Translated Text:
Huh!? You two!
What are you doing in the library!?

Original Text: なんとなく【気：き】になったダニ…
Translated Text: Those mites that I couldn't quite get out of my head...

Original Text: オラもズラ！\nあの【本：ほん】を　また【読：よ】みたくなったズラよ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I’m itching to read that book again!

Original Text: 【考：かんが】えることは【同：おな】じニャンね\nじゃあ　みんなで【読：よ】むニャン？
Translated Text: We're all thinking the same thing, aren't\nwe? So, shall we all read it together?

Original Text: あったダニ！\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』！
Translated Text:
I found it!
"Yo-kai Sangokushi"!

Original Text: 「【優：やさ】しくて【強：つよ】い\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】たちは」
Translated Text: "Komasan, Sun Ce, and the\nothers—they're kind yet strong"

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】を【救：すく】って\nどこかへ【旅立：たびだ】っていった」
Translated Text: "He saved the Land of Sakura and then\nset off on a journey to someplace else."

Original Text: 「【彼：かれ】らはさくら【国：こく】の\n【真：しん】の【英雄：えいゆう】であった…」
Translated Text: "They were the true heroes of\nthe Land of Cherry Blossoms..."

Original Text: オレっちたち\nこんな【冒険：ぼうけん】をしてきたんだニャン…
Translated Text: We've been on all kinds\nof adventures, meow...

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】　【夢：ゆめ】のようダニね…
Translated Text: It really is like a dream, isn't it...

Original Text: またさくら【国：こく】のみんなに【会：あ】いたいズラね～\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に【入：はい】りたいズラね～
Translated Text: I really want to see everyone\nin Sakura Country again~ I want\nto jump right into this book~

Original Text: ね　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！
Translated Text: Hey, USA!

Original Text: そうダニねー\n（【次：つぎ】はむしろ　【宇宙：うちゅう】の【本：ほん】がいいダニ）
Translated Text: Yeah, mites, huh? (Next time, I'd\nactually prefer a book about space.)

Original Text: ね　ジバニャン！
Translated Text: Hey, Jibanyan!

Original Text: そうニャンねー\n（【次：つぎ】はむしろ　ニャー【ＫＢ：ケービー】【写真集：しゃしんしゅう】の【中：なか】が…）
Translated Text: That's right, meow~ (Next time, I'd rather\nsee inside the "Meow KB" photo book...)

Original Text: ズラ！
Translated Text: Zura!

Original Text: まだ【続：つづ】きがあるみたいズラ！
Translated Text: Looks like there's more to come!

Original Text: 「だが…\n【彼：かれ】らは【再：ふたた】び【帰：かえ】ってきた」
Translated Text:
"But...
they've come back again."

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】の\nもうひとつの【危機：きき】を【救：すく】うために」
Translated Text: "To Save Sakura Country\nfrom Yet Another Crisis"

Original Text: ニャニッ
Translated Text: Meow!

Original Text: もんげー！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!

Original Text: ま　また『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に\n【吸：す】いこまれていくダニー！
Translated Text: Danny is getting sucked back\ninto *Yo-kai Sangokushi* again!

Original Text: やあ　みなさん\nまたお【会：あ】いしましたね…
Translated Text: Hey, everyone—nice to see you all again…

Original Text: ほかでもない　【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したのは\nこの　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…
Translated Text: None other than this very\nWhisper Kongming was the\none who summoned him…

Original Text: なあんだ\nお【前：まえ】かニャン
Translated Text: Oh, it's just you, Meow.

Original Text: オラ\nオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】に　【会：あ】いたかったズラ！
Translated Text: I really wanted to meet\nOra Orochi Zhou Yu!

Original Text: そのあからさまながっかり【感：かん】！\nえーえー　【悪：わる】かったですね【私：わたくし】でっ
Translated Text:
That obvious look of disappointment!
Oh, oh... I'm sorry about that. It's my fault.

Original Text: ところで　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】\nなんでまた　ミーたちを【呼：よ】んだダニ？
Translated Text: By the way, Whisper Kongming,\nwhy'd you call us again, Dan?

Original Text: みなさんのおかげで\n【確：たし】かにさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】が【訪：おとず】れたのですが…
Translated Text: Thanks to all of you, peace has\nindeed come to Sakura Country, but…

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】で　こまっている【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちの【姿：すがた】が\nいまだに【目撃：もくげき】されているのでうぃす！
Translated Text: There are still reports of troubled\nYo-kai being spotted all over the place!

Original Text: 【g】たのみごと【e】をしてくる\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちのことズラね
Translated Text: 【g】I'm talking about those military commander【e】\n【g】Yo-kai who come asking for favors【e】, right?

Original Text: もしやそれを\n【全部：ぜんぶ】ミーたちで【解決：かいけつ】しろと…
Translated Text: Are you seriously telling us to\nhandle all of that ourselves…?

Original Text: え～～～！！\nそれでわざわざ【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したニャン！？
Translated Text:
Whaaaat!! Is that
why you went out of your
way to call me over, Nyan!?

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ないダニ\n【天才軍師一人：てんさいぐんしひとり】じゃ　【何：なん】にも【解決：かいけつ】できないダニ
Translated Text: It can't be helped—Dani, the\ngenius strategist, can't solve\nanything on his own, Dani.

Original Text: シャラーップ！！！！\n【話：はなし】を【最後：さいご】まで【聞：き】く！！！！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!!!!
Listen to me until I'm done!!!!

Original Text: その【数：かず】たるや　【日：ひ】を【追：お】うごとに【増：ふ】えてまして\n【中：なか】には　【不穏：ふおん】な【香：かお】りのする【事件：じけん】も…
Translated Text: The number of such incidents is\ngrowing day by day, and some of them\nhave a rather ominous feel to them…

Original Text: もしやその【裏：うら】にはあのノルカソルカをしのぐ\n【妖怪：ようかい】の【陰謀：いんぼう】が　【隠：かく】されているのではないか！
Translated Text: Could it be that behind all this lies\na conspiracy by a Yo-kai even\nmore sinister than Norukasoruka?!

Original Text: …と　この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】のカンが\n【告：つ】げているのでうぃす！！
Translated Text: …That’s what my gut—as the genius\nstrategist Whisper Kongming—is\ntelling me, so there you go!!

Original Text: それで\nオラたちの【力：ちから】が【必要：ひつよう】なんズラね？
Translated Text: So that’s why you need our help, huh?

Original Text: ふわあ～\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のカンは【常：つね】に【当：あ】てにならないニャン
Translated Text: Whew~ You can never count on the\ngenius strategist's instincts, meow.

Original Text: 【要：よう】はたのみごとが【多：おお】すぎて【大変：たいへん】って【話：はなし】ダニ\n【素直：すなお】に【助：たす】けてくださいって【言：い】えばいいダニ
Translated Text:
Basically, it's just that there are
too many requests and it's getting
overwhelming. You should just be
honest and ask for help.

Original Text: あのねーアナタたち！\nちょっとは　【私：わたくし】を【信用：しんよう】しなさいよっ！
Translated Text:
Hey, you guys!
You've got to trust me a little, okay?!

Original Text: ま　どっちでもいいニャン
Translated Text: Well... either way is fine, meow.

Original Text: 【困：こま】ってる【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【放：ほう】っておけないダニ！
Translated Text: I just can't leave a military\ncommander-Yo-kai in trouble alone, Dani!

Original Text: オラも！\nこの【世界：せかい】のみんなに　また【会：あ】いてぇズラ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I wanna see everyone in this world again!

Original Text: そうそう　そう【来：こ】なくっちゃ！！\nさすがは　【我：われ】らが【英雄：えいゆう】たちでうぃす！！
Translated Text:
That's right! That's
exactly how it should be!!
As expected of our heroes!!

Original Text: あ！\nそれから【g】たのみごと【e】の【他：ほか】にも…
Translated Text:
Oh!
And besides that request, there's also...

Original Text: 【g】くにとりバトル【e】や　【g】チャレンジバトル【e】も\nいっそう　【盛：も】り【上：あ】がってるみたいですよ！
Translated Text: 【g】It looks like the Country Conquest【e】\n【g】Battles【e】 and Challenge【g】 Battles【e】 are\ngetting even more exciting!

Original Text: さあ！\nまだまだ【一緒：いっしょ】にさくら【国：こく】を【冒険：ぼうけん】しましょう！
Translated Text:
Come on! Let's
keep exploring Sakura Country together!

Original Text: はっ！！\nいつの【間：ま】にか【眠：ねむ】っていたダニ…
Translated Text:
Whoa!!
A tick that had fallen asleep
without me even noticing…

Original Text: ちわっち！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！
Translated Text: Hi there! USA!

Original Text: フッフッフ…　あなた【今：いま】\nとってもヘンテコな【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】ていましたね？
Translated Text: Heh, heh, heh… You were having a really\nweird dream just now, weren't you?

Original Text: …ギクッ　なぜそれを…
Translated Text: …Whoa. Why did you bring that up…

Original Text: 【美少女探偵：びしょうじょたんてい】イナホの【推理力：すいりりょく】を\nなめてもらっちゃあ【困：こま】りますなぁ
Translated Text: You really shouldn't underestimate\nthe deductive skills of the\nbeautiful young detective Inaho.

Original Text: キミの【顔：かお】　【汗：あせ】　【起：お】き【方：かた】…\nすべてがその【結論：けつろん】を【示：しめ】しているのだよ
Translated Text:
Your face, your sweat,
the way you wake up…
everything points to that conclusion.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【君：くん】！
Translated Text: Pyon-kun from the USA!

Original Text: す　すごいダニ…
Translated Text: Wow... that's a huge tick...

Original Text: す　すいません…
Translated Text: I'm... I'm sorry...

Original Text: 【私：わたし】が【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさんの【夢：ゆめ】の【記憶：きおく】を\n【投影：とうえい】していました…
Translated Text: I was projecting Usapyon's\ndream memories...

Original Text: ずこーっ！
Translated Text: Thud!

Original Text: ハッくん　いきなりネタバレは\nカンベンしてもらえますかねえ…
Translated Text: Haku-kun, could you please go easy\non the spoilers right off the bat…?

Original Text: イナウサ【不思議探偵社：ふしぎたんていしゃ】のボスはワタシ！\nキミたちは【忠実：ちゅうじつ】な【助手：じょしゅ】であるべき…
Translated Text:
I'm the boss of the Inausa
Mystery Detective Agency!
You guys should be my loyal assistants…

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっと【待：ま】ったダニ！
Translated Text: Hey, wait a sec, Dan!

Original Text: なにかね？
Translated Text: What's up?

Original Text: なんで　ミーの【夢：ゆめ】をのぞき【見：み】たダニ？
Translated Text: Why did you peek into Mii's dreams, Dan?

Original Text: いや～　【悪：わる】いとは【思：おも】ったんだけどぉ\nあんまり　うなされてるもんで　つい…
Translated Text: Man... I knew it was wrong, but he\nwas tossing and turning so much\nthat I just couldn't help myself...

Original Text: ひどいダニ！\nプライバシーの【侵害：しんがい】ダニ！
Translated Text:
Those awful bugs! Those
privacy-invading bugs!

Original Text: ごめん　ごめん！
Translated Text: Sorry, sorry!

Original Text: でも　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン　【急：きゅう】に【眠：ねむ】っちゃうわ\nうなされるわで…　ちょっと【心配：しんぱい】で…
Translated Text: But USA-Pyon—she suddenly fell\nasleep and started having\nnightmares… I’m a little worried…

Original Text: 【初：はじ】めてのことでしたので\nもしかして【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざかと【思：おも】いまして…
Translated Text: Since it was my first time experiencing\nsomething like this, I wondered if\nmaybe it was the work of a Yo-kai…

Original Text: ナゾを【解：と】くカギは【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】にあり！\nってことで　のぞかせてもらったのだよ
Translated Text:
"The key to solving the
mystery lies in dreams!
" So that's why I got to take a peek.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【君：くん】！
Translated Text: Pyon-kun from the USA!

Original Text: その【呼：よ】び【方：かた】はやめるダニ！
Translated Text: Stop calling me that, Dani!

Original Text: では　もう【一度：いちど】\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさんの【夢：ゆめ】を【投影：とうえい】します
Translated Text: Now, let's project Usapyon's\ndream once more.

Original Text: ええええ！？\n【恥：は】ずかしいダニ！　やめるダニ！
Translated Text:
Whaaaat!? That's so
embarrassing, Mite! Stop it, Mite!

Original Text: まあまあ…　これも【捜査：そうさ】のため！\nハッくん　よろしく！
Translated Text:
Well, well... This is all for the investigation!
Haku-kun, count on you!

Original Text: なんの【捜査：そうさ】ダニ！\n【納得：なっとく】いかないダニー！
Translated Text:
What kind of investigation is this, Danny!
I don't buy it, Danny!

Original Text: 【映像：えいぞう】　ストーップ！\nこの【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンが【着：き】てる【服：ふく】…
Translated Text:
Cut!
Look at the clothes this
USA guy is wearing…

Original Text: これは【手元：てもと】の【資料：しりょう】によりますと…\n【古代中国：こだいちゅうごく】…　【漢：かん】の【時代：じだい】の【文官：ぶんかん】の【服：ふく】！
Translated Text:
According to the materials I have here…
this is the attire worn by civil officials in
ancient China… during the Han Dynasty!

Original Text: つまり　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンは\nメリケン【妖怪：ようかい】でありながら…
Translated Text: In other words, even though\nUsapyon is a Yo-kai…

Original Text: チャイナ【風：ふう】なコスプレに\nひそかにあこがれていた！
Translated Text: I’ve secretly always wanted to\ntry a Chinese-style cosplay!

Original Text: ちがうダニ！\nミーはコスプレには【興味：きょうみ】ないダニ！
Translated Text:
No, that's not me!
I'm not interested in cosplay!

Original Text: では　【昨日：さくじつ】の【午後：ごご】…\n【中国：ちゅうごく】のドラマをむさぼるように【見：み】ていた！
Translated Text:
So, yesterday afternoon… I was glued to a
Chinese drama!

Original Text: ちがうダニ！\nミーは【海外：かいがい】ドラマも【見：み】てないダニ！
Translated Text:
No, that's not me!
I don't even watch foreign TV shows!

Original Text: ならば　この【夢：ゆめ】は\nなんなんでしょうなあ…
Translated Text: Well then, I wonder what\nthis dream is all about…

Original Text: 【本人：ほんにん】に【知識：ちしき】はなく　【見覚：みおぼ】えもない\nなのに　なぜこれほど【鮮明：せんめい】に…？
Translated Text: He has no knowledge of it and doesn't\neven recognize it—so why is it so vivid...?

Original Text: テレパシーかもしれません
Translated Text: It might be telepathy.

Original Text: テ　テレパシー！？
Translated Text: T... Telepathy!?

Original Text: だれかの【強：つよ】い【念：ねん】が\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさんに【送：おく】られて…
Translated Text: Someone's powerful thoughts\nwere sent to Usapyon...

Original Text: 【夢：ゆめ】となった…
Translated Text: It became a dream…

Original Text: キ　キターーーー！\nつまりそれは…　【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】からの【交信：こうしん】！
Translated Text:
It's hereeeeeee!
So that means... a message from aliens!

Original Text: なんで【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】が\n【中国：ちゅうごく】の【念：ねん】を【送：おく】るダニーッ！
Translated Text: Why are aliens sending\nthoughts to China, Danny?!

Original Text: まさか…　【生：い】きているうちに\n【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】と【接触：せっしょく】できようとは…！
Translated Text: I never would have thought...\nthat I'd actually make contact\nwith aliens in my lifetime...!

Original Text: 【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】へのメッセージを【書：か】いた【手紙：てがみ】…\nあれ　どこにしまったっけ…？
Translated Text:
That letter I wrote with a message for
aliens… Hmm, where did I put it…?

Original Text: イナホさん\nなんか　ガサゴソしてます…
Translated Text: Inaho seems to be rustling around...

Original Text: ほっとくダニ
Translated Text: The "Leave-Alone" Mite

Original Text: こうなったら…\n【自分：じぶん】の【問題：もんだい】は【自分：じぶん】で【解決：かいけつ】するダニ！
Translated Text:
Well, if it's come to this... I'll solve
my own problems, Dan!

Original Text: ハッくん！\nミーの【夢：ゆめ】をもう【一度見：いちどみ】せてくれダニ！
Translated Text:
Hack-kun! Show me
Mii's dream one more time, Dan!

Original Text: 【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】は【今：いま】　どのへんにいるのかしら…\nワクワクが【止：と】まらないであります！
Translated Text:
I wonder where the aliens are
right now… I just can’t stop getting
excited!

Original Text: 【夢：ゆめ】では「【劉備：りゅうび】と【孫権：そんけん】…」\nと【言：い】ってるダニ…
Translated Text:
In my dream, the tick is
saying, “Liu Bei and Sun Quan…”

Original Text: 【劉備：りゅうび】というのは　【中国：ちゅうごく】の【本：ほん】…\n『【三国志：さんごくし】』の【登場人物：とうじょうじんぶつ】のようです
Translated Text:
It seems that Liu Bei is a
character from the Chinese book
*Records of the Three Kingdoms*.

Original Text: 『さんごくし』…
Translated Text: "Sangokushi"...

Original Text: 「ほんをさがせ」\nというメッセージもあったダニね…
Translated Text:
That tick had a message
that said, “Find the book”…

Original Text: ……ああ！
Translated Text: ……Oh!

Original Text: ああああ！\nキタキター！！
Translated Text:
Aaaah!
It's here, it's here!!

Original Text: い　いきなりなんダニーッ！
Translated Text: "Whoa, what the heck, Danny?!"

Original Text: ワタシにも【今：いま】！\nビビッと【宇宙：うちゅう】から【交信：こうしん】がキター！！
Translated Text:
I just got it too!
I just felt a sudden connection
from outer space!!

Original Text: ええええ！？
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: ちょっと\nコンビニに【行：い】ってくる！
Translated Text: I'm just going to the\nconvenience store for a bit!

Original Text: イナホさん　【様子：ようす】が【変：へん】では…？
Translated Text: Inaho, aren't you acting a little strange...?

Original Text: そうダニか？\nいつもあんな【感：かん】じダニ…
Translated Text:
So, is it a tick? It
always looks like that...

Original Text: とにかく　ついていきましょう！
Translated Text: Anyway, let's just go with it!

Original Text: あ　イナホさん！
Translated Text: Oh, Inaho!

Original Text: コ　コンビニのど【真：ま】ん【中：なか】で\nあやしい【踊：おど】りを【踊：おど】っているダニ！
Translated Text: Look! A tick dancing a weird dance right\nin the middle of a convenience store!

Original Text: のるか…　そるか…\nのるか…　そるか…
Translated Text:
Go for it… or back off…
go for it… or back off…

Original Text: イナホ！\nやめるダニ！　【恥：は】ずかしいダニ！
Translated Text:
Inaho!
Stop it, Danni! Shame on you, Danni!

Original Text: のるか…
Translated Text: Should I go for it…

Original Text: そるか！
Translated Text: I see!

Original Text: …？\n「のるかそるか」ってなんダニ！？
Translated Text:
…?
What the heck is “all or nothing”?!

Original Text: 「【成功：せいこう】するか【失敗：しっぱい】するかはわからないけど\n　やってみる」ことらしいです
Translated Text: It seems the idea is, “I don’t\nknow if I’ll succeed or fail,\nbut I’m going to give it a try.”

Original Text: ここに【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】が【来：く】ることを【期待：きたい】し…\n【現在：げんざい】　【交信中：こうしんちゅう】であります！
Translated Text:
Hoping that aliens will visit here… We are
currently in communication!

Original Text: のるか…　そるか…\nのるか…　そるか…
Translated Text:
Go for it… or back off…
go for it… or back off…

Original Text: た　たしかに\nいつも【以上：いじょう】に【変：へん】ダニ！
Translated Text: Yeah... you're right—he's\nacting even weirder than usual!

Original Text: もしかしたら　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさんの【夢：ゆめ】と\n【何：なに】か【関係：かんけい】があるかも…
Translated Text: Maybe it has something to\ndo with Usapyon's dream...

Original Text: 【早：はや】く【解決：かいけつ】しないと　【大変：たいへん】ダニ！
Translated Text: If we don't solve this soon, it's going to be a real problem!

Original Text: のるか…　そるか…\nのるか…　そるか…
Translated Text:
Go for it… or back off…
go for it… or back off…

Original Text: イナホさんを\nほうっておいて【平気：へいき】でしょうか…
Translated Text: Is it really okay to just leave Inaho alone…

Original Text: とにかく【今：いま】は\n【夢：ゆめ】の【分析：ぶんせき】を【続：つづ】けるダニ！
Translated Text: Anyway, for now, Dani is going\nto keep analyzing her dreams!

Original Text: もしかしたら\n【何：なに】かを【見落：みお】としているかもしれないダニ！
Translated Text: Dani—maybe you're missing something!

Original Text: そうですね…　では！
Translated Text: Yeah... Well then!

Original Text: あれ？\n【映像：えいぞう】が【出：で】ないダニよ？
Translated Text:
Huh? Why isn't the
video playing, Dani?

Original Text: そんなはずは…\nああ　なんですかこの【光：ひかり】は…！
Translated Text:
That can't be... Oh
, what is this light...!

Original Text: ダニーッ！？
Translated Text: Danny!?

Original Text: 【光：ひかり】の【中：なか】に\n【何：なに】か【影：かげ】が【見：み】えますが…
Translated Text: I can see a shadow in the light, but...

Original Text: すべて\n【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざだ…
Translated Text: It's all the work of Yo-kai...

Original Text: おそるべき【妖気：ようき】が\nお【前：まえ】の【世界：せかい】に…えいきょうを…
Translated Text: A terrifying demonic aura is about\nto... influence... your world...

Original Text: この【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】ダニ！
Translated Text: That voice is... the voice of Yume, the tick!

Original Text: 【図書室：としょしつ】へ…
Translated Text: To the library…

Original Text: さんご…　という【本：ほん】を…　さがせ…
Translated Text: Find the book called *Sango*...

Original Text: …【消：き】えました…
Translated Text: …It's gone…

Original Text: いったい…　【何事：なにごと】ダニ…
Translated Text: What on earth... What's going on, Dani...

Original Text: キタキタキター！
Translated Text: It's here, it's here, it's finally here!

Original Text: 【不可思議：ふかしぎ】な【現象：げんしょう】の【数々：かずかず】！\nそして　ナゾの【光：ひか】る【物体：ぶったい】！
Translated Text:
A host of mysterious phenomena!
And a mysterious glowing object!

Original Text: これは…　まさに…\n【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】が【近：ちか】づいている【証拠：しょうこ】！
Translated Text:
This is... definitely... proof that
aliens are approaching!

Original Text: テメー…\nいい【加減：かげん】にするダニー！
Translated Text:
You... Cut
it out, Danny!

Original Text: のるか…　そるか…\nのるか…　そるか…
Translated Text:
Go for it… or back off…
go for it… or back off…

Original Text: イナホさん\nまた【交信：こうしん】にもどりました…
Translated Text: Inaho is back on the air...

Original Text: ハッくん！\nイナホのこと【頼：たの】むダニ！
Translated Text:
Haku-kun! Please look out for
Inaho, Dan!

Original Text: ひとりでいたら\nただの【変：へん】な【人：ひと】ダニ！
Translated Text: If I were alone, I'd just be a weirdo, Dani!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさんは　どちらへ？
Translated Text: Where is Pyon-san from the U.S. headed?

Original Text: 【図書室：としょしつ】ダニ！
Translated Text: Library Mites!

Original Text: 【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】の【正体：しょうたい】…\nつきとめてやるダニ！
Translated Text:
The true identity of the voice
in my dreams… I’m going to
track it down, you little bug!

Original Text: イナホが【通：かよ】っている\n【学校：がっこう】に【着：つ】いたダニ…
Translated Text: Dani arrived at the school Inaho attends…

Original Text: ここの【図書室：としょしつ】に\nナゾをとくカギがあるダニ！
Translated Text: Dani, the key to solving the\nmystery is in this library!

Original Text: …いざ\n【突入：とつにゅう】ダニー！
Translated Text: …Let's go, Danny!

Original Text: い　【痛：いた】いダニ…\n……ん？
Translated Text:
Ouch... that tick hurts...
Hmm?

Original Text: なっ
Translated Text: Nah...

Original Text: なっ　なんダニ！\nこの【格好：かっこう】はー！
Translated Text:
Wha—what the heck! Look at
this outfit!

Original Text: これはさっきイナホが【言：い】ってた…\n【昔：むかし】の【中国：ちゅうごく】の【服：ふく】…！？
Translated Text:
Is this what Inaho was talking
about earlier… traditional
Chinese clothing…!?

Original Text: それに【一緒：いっしょ】に【落：お】ちた\n【妖怪：ようかい】たちはどこへ？
Translated Text: And where did the Yo-kai\nwho fell with him go?

Original Text: っていうか　ここはどこダニ…！？\nミーは【図書室：としょしつ】にいたはず…
Translated Text:
Wait, where the heck am I…!?
I was supposed to be in the library…

Original Text: まままままさか…\nこれも【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざダニ！？
Translated Text:
No, no, no, no way… Could this
be the work of a Yo-kai, too
, Dani!?

Original Text: ビクトリアーーーーンッ！
Translated Text: Victoriaaaaaaa!
Mites~!!?
