Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラッ！\n（そこの【通：とお】りすがりの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(Hey, you passing-by warrior Yo-kai!)

Original Text: グッドタイミイイイイイイングッ！
Translated Text: Good timingggggg!

Original Text: 【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】？　ミーのことダニか？
Translated Text: A warrior-Yo-kai? Are you calling Mee a tick?

Original Text: そう　どう【見：み】ても\nその【格好：かっこう】は　【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】なのだ
Translated Text: Yeah, no matter how you look at it, that\noutfit is definitely that of a warrior Yo-kai.

Original Text: メラメ～ラッ！\n（オレたちに【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera-me-ra!
(Give us your strength!)

Original Text: …えーっと　とりあえず【落：お】ち【着：つ】いて\n【話：はなし】を【整理：せいり】するダニ
Translated Text: …Um… Anyway, let’s calm down\nand get our thoughts in order, Dani.

Original Text: ミーは【変：へん】な【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】て\nイナホが【交信：こうしん】して【図書室：としょしつ】に【来：き】て…
Translated Text: Mee had a weird dream, and Inaho\ncontacted her and came to the library...

Original Text: それなのに…なんで【今：いま】\nこんなことになってるダニーー！？
Translated Text: And yet… why is this\nhappening right now, Dan?!

Original Text: はははははは　ここは【通：とお】さーん！\n【覚悟：かくご】しろ！
Translated Text:
Hahahahahaha! You're
not getting past here!
Brace yourself!

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】はなんダニー！
Translated Text: What's up now, Danny!

Original Text: そうこう【言：い】ってる【間：あいだ】に\n【敵：てき】さんは　ハイテンション！
Translated Text: While we were talking about this and that,\nthe enemy was getting really hyped up!

Original Text: ここは【二手：ふたて】に【分：わ】かれてバトルだ！
Translated Text: Here, we split into two groups and battle it out!

Original Text: メラメラ～ッ　メラメ～ラ！\n（オレと【隊長：たいちょう】はあっちで【敵：てき】を【食：く】い【止：と】める！）
Translated Text:
Blaze~! Blaze~!
(The captain and I will hold
off the enemies over there!)

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（お【前：まえ】は　りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】と【戦：たたか】ってくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(You go fight Ryu-kun, Liu Yu!)

Original Text: えぇ～！？\nそりゃ　なんダニーーー！？
Translated Text:
What?!
What kind of mite is that?!

Original Text: いい【戦：たたか】いぶりだった！\nなかなかの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】だな！
Translated Text:
That was a great fight! You're
quite the warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: はあ…　はあ…\nまあこっちも【必死：ひっし】だったダニよ…
Translated Text:
Haa… Haa…
Well, I was doing my best too, you know…

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ？\n（お【前：まえ】　どこの【国：くに】から【来：き】たんだ？）
Translated Text:
Mera... Mera Mera?
(Where are you from?)

Original Text: ミーは【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！\n【ＵＳＡ：ゆーえすえー】から【来：き】たダニ！
Translated Text:
"I'm from the USA!
I'm a tick from the USA!"

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：ゆーえすえー】？\nほう！　【強：つよ】そうな【名前：なまえ】の【国：くに】だな！
Translated Text:
The USA?
Wow! That's a country with a
name that sounds powerful!

Original Text: メラ　メ～ラ！\n（ここは　さくら【国：こく】！）
Translated Text:
Mera~ Mera!
(This is Sakura Country!)

Original Text: えっ！\nさくらニュータウン？
Translated Text:
Huh!
Sakura New Town?

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ\n（いや　さくら【国：こく】だ）
Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera (No, it's Sakura Country)

Original Text: ど　どこダニ…それ…
Translated Text: W-where's the tick... that...

Original Text: …ようこそ　さくら【国：こく】へ
Translated Text: …Welcome to the Land of Cherry Blossoms

Original Text: ダニー！？\nユーは　あの【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】っ！？
Translated Text:
Danny!?
Are you the voice from that dream!?

Original Text: どうやら【無事：ぶじ】\n【本：ほん】を【見：み】つけたようだな
Translated Text: Looks like you found the book after all.

Original Text: ゆ　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】！\nここは…　いったいどこダニ！
Translated Text:
Yu: The voice of a dream!
This place… Where on earth is this?!

Original Text: ここは【本：ほん】に【封：ふう】じられし【世界：せかい】\nすなわち　【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【世界：せかい】
Translated Text: This is a world sealed within a\nbook—that is, the world inside a book.

Original Text: ミーは\n【本：ほん】の【世界：せかい】に【来：き】ちゃったダニ！？
Translated Text: Mee, did you end up in the\nworld of books, Danni!?

Original Text: そうだ　お【前：まえ】はこの【本：ほん】…\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】…！
Translated Text:
That's right—you're the
Yo-kai chosen for this book...
*Yo-kai Sangokushi*...!

Original Text: ようかい…\nさんごくし…！？
Translated Text:
Youkai…
Sango-kishi…!?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】は　この【本：ほん】の【呼：よ】びかけに【答：こた】えた\nそして　【英雄：えいゆう】になりたいと【言：い】った
Translated Text: You answered this book’s call, and\nyou said you wanted to be a hero.

Original Text: そんなこと【一言：ひとこと】も【言：い】ってないダニ！
Translated Text: I never said anything like that, Dani!

Original Text: むしろミーは【巻：ま】き【込：こ】まれただけダニ！\n【今：いま】すぐ【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にもどしてくれダニ！
Translated Text:
Actually, I just got dragged
into this, you know!
Send me back to my original
world right now, you know!

Original Text: こうしている【間：あいだ】にも\nイナホの【変：へん】な【踊：おど】りは【続：つづ】いているダニ！
Translated Text: Even as we speak, Inaho's weird\ndance is still going on, Dani!

Original Text: 【選：えら】ばれし【妖怪：ようかい】よ\nこの【本：ほん】の【中：なか】の【英雄：えいゆう】・【仲達：ちゅうたつ】となれ
Translated Text: O Chosen Yo-kai, become\nNakata, the hero of this book.

Original Text: 【人：ひと】の【話：はなし】を【聞：き】けダニ！
Translated Text: Listen to what people have to say, you jerk!

Original Text: そして　この【本：ほん】の【中：なか】と【外：そと】…\nふたつの【世界：せかい】を【救：すく】うのだ
Translated Text:
And I will save
both worlds—the one inside this
book and the one outside it…

Original Text: テメー…！　ミーの【話：はなし】を…
Translated Text: You...! You're ignoring what I'm saying...

Original Text: もう　【声：こえ】が【届：とど】くことはない\n【私：わたし】の【力：ちから】は　【限界：げんかい】だ…
Translated Text: My voice will never reach you\nagain. I've reached my limit...

Original Text: えっ…？\nど　どーいうことダニ？
Translated Text:
Huh…?
W-what do you mean, Dani?

Original Text: 【頼：たの】んだぞ…\n【選：えら】ばれし【英雄：えいゆう】・【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…
Translated Text:
I'm counting on you…
Chosene Hero, Usapyon Zhongda…

Original Text: ま　【待：ま】ってダニ！　【夢：ゆめ】のこ…
Translated Text: W-Wait, Dani! My dream...

Original Text: もう　【聞：き】こえないダニ…
Translated Text: The tick I can't hear anymore...

Original Text: ほほう！\nお【前：まえ】　あの【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】だったのか！
Translated Text:
Oh, really! So
you're one of those USA Pyon guys!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】は　【強：つよ】くてかしこい\nこのあたりで【一番：いちばん】の…
Translated Text: The USA Pyon gang is strong and\nsmart—the best around here…

Original Text: メラメラ　メ～ラッ！\n（【人気武将妖怪：にんきぶしょうようかい】なんだぜっ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze~!
(He's a popular warrior-Yo-kai, you know!)

Original Text: へー\nそれは【光栄：こうえい】ダニ！
Translated Text: Wow, that's an honor, Dani!

Original Text: って　うっかり\n【乗：の】せられてる【場合：ばあい】じゃないダニーッ！
Translated Text: "Danny, this isn't the time\nto be getting carried away!"

Original Text: さっきから【展開：てんかい】が【急：きゅう】すぎて\nまったく　ついていけないダニッ！
Translated Text: The plot's been moving way too fast\nlately—I can't keep up at all, Dan!

Original Text: ちゅうたつ？　エーユー？\nもうワケわかんないダニ！！
Translated Text:
"Chuutatsu"? "AYU"?
I have no idea what's going on anymore!!

Original Text: ていうか　そもそも\nミーは【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】れるダニ！？
Translated Text: I mean, can I even go back to my\noriginal world in the first place!?

Original Text: イナホ！　ハッくん！\nだれか【助：たす】けてダニーーー！
Translated Text:
Inaho! Haku-kun!
Someone help me, Daniii!

Original Text: …【願：ねが】いをかなえたいのなら\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば　いいのだ
Translated Text: …If you want your wish to come true,\nall you have to do is collect the orbs.

Original Text: ダニ…？\nほうじゅ…？
Translated Text:
Mites…?
Hojo…?

Original Text: オイオイ【知：し】らないのか？\n【八：やっ】つの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【伝説：でんせつ】を！
Translated Text:
Hey, hey—don't you know
about the legend of the
Eight Precious Gems?

Original Text: この【国：くに】にはフシギな【力：ちから】を【持：も】つ【八：やっ】つの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が\n【眠：ねむ】っていてな！
Translated Text: There are eight magical orbs\nwith mysterious powers\nhidden away in this country!

Original Text: すべての【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めると\n【何：なん】でも【願：ねが】いがかなうって【言：い】われてるんだ！
Translated Text: They say that if you collect all the\norbs, any wish will come true!

Original Text: 【七：なな】つじゃなくて【八：やっ】つ？\nどっかで【聞：き】いたような【話：はなし】ダニ…
Translated Text:
Seven, or is it eight?
That sounds familiar...

Original Text: とにかくその【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば\n【何：なん】でも【願：ねが】いがかなうダニね？
Translated Text: So, if you collect those orbs, you\ncan have any wish granted, right?

Original Text: てことはきっと【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にも【戻：もど】れるダニ！\nどこに【行：い】けばゲットできるダニ？
Translated Text:
That means I’m sure I can go
back to my original world, Dani!
Where can I go to get it, Dani?

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】が【一個持：いっこも】ってるのだ\nだから　あげるのだ
Translated Text: Ryu-kun (Liu Yu) has\none, so I'll give it to you.

Original Text: ラッキーダニ！
Translated Text: Lucky Tick!

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメ～ラ…\n（でも　【残：のこ】りはそう【簡単：かんたん】にはいかないぜ…）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…
(But the rest won’t be that easy…)

Original Text: メラッ　メラメラ　メ～ラ！\n（いまこの【国：くに】はまさに　【乱世：らんせ】！）
Translated Text:
Mera... Mera-mera... Me~ra!
(This country is truly in a
time of turmoil right now!)

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をめぐって\n【全国：ぜんこく】で【熱：あつ】いバトルが【起：お】きてるんだ！
Translated Text: There are some intense battles going\non all over the country over this gem!

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】では【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】ってる【妖怪：ようかい】が\nそれぞれのナワバリをしきってる！
Translated Text: In Sakura Country, Yo-kai who\npossess treasure orbs rule over\ntheir respective territories!

Original Text: だから　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【持：も】ってたりゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】は\nこのあたりの【王様：おうさま】なのだ
Translated Text: That's why Ryu-kun, Liu Yu—who has\nthe jewel—is the king of this area.

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ　メラメ～ラッ\n（【王様：おうさま】たちはみんなお【互：たが】いの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をねらってる）
Translated Text: Mera, Mera, Mera, Mera~raa (All the\nkings are after each other's jewels.)

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメ～ラ…\n（つまり　すべての【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【手：て】に【入：い】れるには…）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, me~ra…
(In other words, to get all the orbs…)

Original Text: 【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【挑：いど】んでビクトリアーン！\n【勝：か】ちとって【行：い】かなきゃならん！！
Translated Text:
Take on bosses across the country
and claim victory! We’ve got to keep
winning!!

Original Text: とてつもなく\nめんどくさいダニ…
Translated Text: Those incredibly annoying mites…

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】は\n【強：つよ】くてかしこいヒーローなのだ
Translated Text: The USA Pyon gang are\nstrong and smart heroes.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】が【全国：ぜんこく】のボスに【勝：か】てば\nきっとさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】がおとずれるのだ
Translated Text: If the USA Pyon gang defeats the\nbosses across the country, peace\nwill surely come to Sakura Country.

Original Text: う～ん\nそんな【都合：つごう】よく　いくダニか？
Translated Text: Hmm... Do things ever go that smoothly?

Original Text: （でもミーが　この【本：ほん】のエーユーなら…\nあんがい　【楽：らく】に　【集：あつ】められるかも…？）
Translated Text:
(But if I were the AU in this
book… maybe it wouldn’t be
that hard to collect them after all…?)

Original Text: やるダニ…\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るには　やるっきゃないダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm gonna do it, Dani… If
I want to go back to my
original world, I've got no
choice but to do it, Dani!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\nオレたちは【一緒：いっしょ】には【行：い】けないが…
Translated Text:
USA, Pyong and Nakata!
We can't go with you, but...

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【旅：たび】の【無事：ぶじ】を　いのっている！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(I'm praying for a safe journey!)

Original Text: サンキュー　ダニ！
Translated Text: Thanks, Dani!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: じゃあ　【何：なに】をしたらいいのか\n【教：おし】えてくれダニ！
Translated Text: So tell me what I'm supposed to do, Dani!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】とは\nかしこい　【人気者：にんきもの】なのだ！
Translated Text: Usapyon Zhongda is smart and popular!

Original Text: それは　さっき【聞：き】いたダニ…
Translated Text: That's the tick I heard about a moment ago...

Original Text: そして　このさくら【国：こく】を【治：おさ】めるのに\nふさわしい　【強：つよ】い【男：おとこ】なのだ！
Translated Text: And he is a strong man—the right man\nto rule this Land of Cherry Blossoms!

Original Text: だから…\nきたえなきゃ　ダメなのだ
Translated Text:
That's why... I have to train
.
Huh...?

Original Text: では　トレーニング【開始：かいし】　なのだ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get this training started!

Original Text: す　【少：すこ】しはデキるみたいっスね\nまあ　ともだちになってやっても…
Translated Text: Hmm... Looks like you're kind of good at\nthis. Well, I guess I'll let you be my friend...

Original Text: って\nそ　それは…　ほ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】っ！？
Translated Text: Wait, that's... a... a magic orb!?

Original Text: はっ！　ははーっ！\nご【無礼：ぶれい】　お【許：ゆる】しっスーっ！
Translated Text:
Whoa! Haha!
My apologies—please
forgive me! Whoosh!

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】って\nそんなに　スゴいんダニ？
Translated Text: Is this gem really that amazing?

Original Text: そうなのだ　だから\n【使：つか】い【方：かた】をまちがえちゃダメなのだ
Translated Text: That's right. That's why you\nmustn't use it the wrong way.

Original Text: でも　そんなすごいもの\nもらってもいいダニか？
Translated Text: But is it really okay for a tick\nto get something so amazing?

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】がかしこくて\n【強：つよ】いのは　よくわかったのだ
Translated Text: I’ve come to fully understand that Usapyon\nZhongda is both smart and strong.

Original Text: だから　【早：はや】く【集：あつ】めて\n【願：ねが】いをかなえるといいのだ
Translated Text: So you should gather them quickly\nand make your wish come true.

Original Text: サンキューダニ！\nミーは　がんばるダニ！
Translated Text:
Thanks, Dani!
I'll do my best, Dani!

Original Text: オレも　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】さんの\n【力：ちから】になりたいっス！
Translated Text: I want to help Mr. Pyon\nNakata from the USA, too!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【見：み】て\n【態度：たいど】がコロっと【変：か】わったダニ…
Translated Text: Dani, whose attitude changed completely\nthe moment he saw the jewel…

Original Text: まあ　いいダニ\nみんなで　【宝珠集：ほうじゅあつ】めに【出発：しゅっぱつ】ダニー！
Translated Text: Well, okay, everyone—let's head\nout to collect some orbs, Danny!

Original Text: 【早：はや】くも【壁：かべ】にぶち【当：あ】たったダニ\nどこに【行：い】けばいいダニ…？
Translated Text: I've already hit a wall.\nWhere should I go, Dan...?

Original Text: 【今：いま】は　【乱世：らんせ】なのだ\n【困：こま】っている【人：ひと】も【多：おお】いのだ
Translated Text: These are turbulent times, and\nmany people are struggling.

Original Text: そういう【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けてあげるのだ\nそれが　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】なのだ
Translated Text: That's what we do—we help\npeople like that. That's what\nUsapyon Zhongda is all about.

Original Text: それが…　って【言：い】われても…\n【全然：ぜんぜん】　ピンと【来：こ】ないダニ…
Translated Text:
Even if you say, “Well,
that’s…”—I just don’t get it at
all, Dani…

Original Text: だれか　【助：たす】けてええええ！
Translated Text: Someone, help meeeee!

Original Text: な　なんか【来：き】たダニ！
Translated Text: W-Wait, a tick just showed up!

Original Text: お【願：ねが】い！\nふたりのケンカを【止：と】めて！
Translated Text:
Please!
Stop them from fighting!

Original Text: おともだちのワカメくん【関索：かんさく】と\nコンブさん【関興：かんこう】がケンカしてるの
Translated Text: My friends Wakame-kun (Guan Suo) and\nKombu-san (Guan Xing) are fighting.

Original Text: ふたりとも【我：われ】を【忘：わす】れちゃって…\n【私：わたし】には　【止：と】められない！
Translated Text:
They've both lost control...
and there's nothing
I can do to stop them!

Original Text: そういう【時：とき】は\n【少：すこ】し【熱：ねつ】が【冷：さ】めるのを【待：ま】つダニ
Translated Text: In situations like that, Dani waits\nfor things to cool down a bit.

Original Text: 【第三者：だいさんしゃ】が【入：はい】ると\nよけい【話：はなし】がこじれるダニ
Translated Text: When a third party gets involved, things\ntend to get even more complicated.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】ではこんな【時：とき】\n【弁護士：べんごし】に【相談：そうだん】するダニ…
Translated Text: In the U.S., people like to consult\na lawyer in situations like this...

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…
Translated Text: Usapyon Zhongda…

Original Text: わかったダニ！　やるダニ！
Translated Text: Got it, Dani! Let's do it, Dani!

Original Text: だから　そんなつぶらなひとみで\nミーを【見：み】るのを　やめるダニー！
Translated Text: So stop looking at me with\nthose big, round eyes, Danny!

Original Text: ああ…ふたりが【仲：なか】よしに\nもどってくれて　うれしい！
Translated Text: Ah... I'm so glad they're\ngetting along again!

Original Text: 【大好：だいす】きなメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】のナミダは\nもう【見：み】たくないぜ！　フォー！
Translated Text: I don't want to see any more tears\nfrom my favorite Mekabu-chan,\nAbalone Sanjo! Four!

Original Text: ええ　メカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】に【似合：にあ】うのは\nそのまぶしい【笑顔：えがお】です！
Translated Text: Yeah, Mekabu-chan, what\nreally suits you, Abalone Sanjo,\nis that dazzling smile of yours!

Original Text: …なんとなく　ケンカした【理由：りゆう】が\nわかったダニ
Translated Text: …Somehow, I think I figured out\nwhy we got into a fight, Dani.

Original Text: べ　べつに【三角関係：さんかくかんけい】とかではありませんよ！\nいや　そうかもしれないですけど…
Translated Text:
It's—it's not like there's a
love triangle or anything!
Well, maybe there is...

Original Text: なんでケンカを【始：はじ】めたのか\nボクたちぜんぜん【覚：おぼ】えてないのさ…
Translated Text: We don't remember at all why we\nstarted fighting in the first place...

Original Text: これは…\nきっと【妖怪：ようかい】のしわざダニ…！
Translated Text:
This must
be... the work of a Yo-kai, Dani...!

Original Text: この【近：ちか】くにキンギン【党：とう】という\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちがいるのだ
Translated Text: There's a group of warrior Yo-kai\ncalled the Kingin Party around here.

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】！？\nそれ　なんダニ！？
Translated Text:
The Kingin Party!?
What on earth is that!?

Original Text: え？　キンギン【党：とう】のことを\nもっと【知：し】りたいクマ？
Translated Text: Huh? Do you want to know more\nabout the Kingin Party, Kuma?

Original Text: ダニ！？
Translated Text: Mites!?

Original Text: だったら\nボクのうんちくを【聞：き】くクマ！
Translated Text: Well then, listen to my\nlittle bit of trivia, Bear!

Original Text: …この【世界：せかい】\nいろいろ【突然：とつぜん】すぎるダニ…
Translated Text: …This world is just full of things that\nhappen way too suddenly, Dan…

Original Text: …おっと\n【話：はなし】をもとにもどすダニ！
Translated Text: …Oops, let's get back on track, Dani!

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】は【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をあやつる【術：じゅつ】を\n【使：つか】うおそろしい【集団：しゅうだん】っス！
Translated Text: The Kingin Party is a terrifying group that\nuses magic to control warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】すのだ！
Translated Text:
USA, Pyong Nakata! Let's defeat
the Kingin Party!

Original Text: ええ～…
Translated Text: Hmm...

Original Text: ああ！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達様：ちゅうたつさま】が\nごきげんナナメみたいだぜ…！
Translated Text: Oh no! It looks like Mr. Usapyon\nZhongda is in a bad mood…!

Original Text: きっと　お【礼：れい】をしてないからです\nあなたの【活躍：かつやく】をたたえまして…
Translated Text: It must be because I haven't thanked\nyou yet. To honor your achievements…

Original Text: われら【数々：かずかず】のお【礼：れい】の【品：しな】をご【用意：ようい】しております\nどうぞお【受：う】け【取：と】りください！
Translated Text: We have prepared a variety of thank-you\ngifts for you—please accept them!

Original Text: い　いや　ミーは\n【別：べつ】にそんなつもりは…
Translated Text: "No, no, I didn't mean it that way..."

Original Text: まだ　【満足：まんぞく】されていないようですね…\nメカブちゃん【鮑三娘：ほうさんじょう】　ならば　あれです！
Translated Text:
It seems you're still not satisfied... Well, if
it's Mekabu-chan and
Abalone Sanjo, then it's that!

Original Text: え…　もしかして…\nお【礼：れい】は　このわ・た・し…？（ポッ）
Translated Text:
Huh... Could it be... that the "
thank you" is for me...? (blush)

Original Text: こ　こっちをもらっておくダニ！\nさよならダニー！
Translated Text:
"I'll take this one, Danny!
Bye, Danny!"

Original Text: フフ…\n【術：じゅつ】の【効果：こうか】はバッチリじゃ
Translated Text:
Hehe… The
spell worked like a charm.

Original Text: 【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】どもは\n【我：われ】らの【思：おも】いどおりに【争：あらそ】っておる
Translated Text: Those Yo-kai are fighting\njust as we intended.

Original Text: このスキに　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めれば…\n【野望：やぼう】を【果：は】たせようぞ
Translated Text:
If I gather the orbs while
they're distracted... I'll be
able to fulfill my ambition
.

Original Text: じゃが…いまいましい\nジャマ【者：もの】がおるようじゃな…
Translated Text: Well... looks like there's some\npesky meddler around...

Original Text: ドウと【言：い】うことはない　【幻術：げんじゅつ】の【霧：きり】を\n【大量：たいりょう】にまいておけば　【問題：もんだい】あるまいて！
Translated Text: There's nothing to worry about—as\nlong as we spread a ton of illusory\nmist, there won't be any problems!

Original Text: え？　ちょっと　【待：ま】て！
Translated Text: Huh? Wait a minute!

Original Text: そおーれ！　これでドウじゃ～？
Translated Text: There you go! How's that?

Original Text: こ　このアホウ！\nこれじゃ【我：われ】らも【身動：みうご】きとれん！
Translated Text:
Y-You idiot!
We can't move a muscle like this!

Original Text: どうやって\n【残：のこ】りの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をさがすんじゃ！？
Translated Text: How am I supposed to\nfind the rest of the orbs!?

Original Text: …ドウもすみません
Translated Text: …I'm really sorry

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】のアジトは\nここかダニ？
Translated Text: Is this the Kingin Party's hideout, Dani?

Original Text: …って\n【霧：きり】で【見：み】えないダニ…
Translated Text: …but I can't see the tick\nbecause of the fog…

Original Text: これじゃ　アジトがどこにあるか\nわからないっス
Translated Text: At this rate, I won't be able to\nfigure out where the hideout is.

Original Text: これもきっと\nキンギン【党：とう】の【幻術：げんじゅつ】なのだ
Translated Text: This must surely be another illusion\ncreated by the Kingin Party.

Original Text: だが　【安心：あんしん】するのだ\n【水晶玉：すいしょうだま】にすすむべき【道：みち】が【見：み】えるのだ
Translated Text: But don't worry—you can see the path\nyou should take in the crystal ball.

Original Text: ソフトクリームの\nできそこないみたいのが　いるダニ…
Translated Text: There's a mite that looks like\na failed soft-serve ice cream...

Original Text: それは【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のお【姿：すがた】なのだ
Translated Text: That is the figure of a genius military strategist.

Original Text: テンサイグンシ？
Translated Text: Tensai Gunshi?

Original Text: その【知性：ちせい】で【風：かぜ】を【読：よ】み【天：てん】をも【動：うご】かす\nとっても【頭：あたま】のいいお【方：かた】のことっス
Translated Text: I'm talking about that incredibly smart\nperson who can read the winds and even\nmove the heavens with their intellect.

Original Text: ミーも　この【世界：せかい】では\nかしこい【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】ってことダニ？
Translated Text: So, does that mean I'm considered\na smart military commander-Yo-kai\nin this world, too?

Original Text: その【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】と【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】\nどっちがかしこいダニ？
Translated Text: Which one's smarter, that genius\nstrategist or those USA Pyon buddies?

Original Text: いい【勝負：しょうぶ】なんじゃないっスかー？
Translated Text: Isn't this a pretty close match?

Original Text: 【適当：てきとう】すぎるダニ…
Translated Text: That tick is way too careless…

Original Text: お【告：つ】げに【従：したが】い　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】に【会：あ】いにいくのだ\nでも…　【道：みち】はきっとけわしいのだ！
Translated Text: Following the revelation, I’m off to\nmeet the genius strategist—but…\nthe path ahead is sure to be rugged!

Original Text: だから　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】には\nいろんなアイテムをあげるのだ！
Translated Text: That's why I give all kinds of\nitems to my friends in the USA!

Original Text: まずは【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】！
Translated Text: First【g】 up: the Yo-kai Gacha【e】!

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】Yo-kai Gacha【e】?

Original Text: この【g】【妖怪：ようかい】ガシャ【e】を【引：ひ】くと\n【心強：こころづよ】い【仲間：なかま】が【手：て】に【入：はい】ることがあるのだ！
Translated Text: If you spin this【g】 Yo-kai gacha【e】,\nyou might just get a reliable ally!

Original Text: ちなみに　ガシャを【引：ひ】くには\nガシャコインなど　コインが【必要：ひつよう】なのだ！
Translated Text: By the way, you need coins—like\nGacha Coins—to play the gacha!

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】に【g】【妖怪：ようかい】メダルアプリ【e】！
Translated Text: Next【g】 up: the Yo-kai Medal app【e】!

Original Text: 【g】【妖怪：ようかい】メダルアプリ【e】？
Translated Text: 【g】The Yo-kai Medal app【e】?

Original Text: 【六妖将軍：ろくようしょうぐん】を【編成：へんせい】したり\n【仲間：なかま】を【入：い】れかえたりするときに　【使：つか】うのだ！
Translated Text: Use this when forming a team\nof the Six Demon Generals or\nswapping out party members!

Original Text: さあ　【準備：じゅんび】はととのったのだ！\n【行：い】くのだ！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text:
All right, we're all set! Let's
go! USA Pyon-nakata!

Hey, Tensai Gunshi!

Hey! Which school are you guys from?
Coming here to start a fight? You
really know how to stir things up!

No, no, that's not it, Dani!
We're just...

"This guy won't listen, Danny!

I'm not really confident, but
... I'll give it a try!

Translated Text: "But don't overdo it, Dan. If you go\ntoo far, you'll lose your friends, Dan."

Original Text: なんか　ちがう【感：かん】じがするのだ…\nでも　りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】はわからないのだ
Translated Text:
It just feels a little off... but
I don't really know about Ryu-kun, Liu Yu.

Original Text: まあ　【手紙：てがみ】の【返事：へんじ】が【来：く】るまで\nほかの【困：こま】っている【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けるのだ
Translated Text: Well, until I get a reply to my letter,\nI'll just help other people in need.
Wow!!

Original Text: 【正直：しょうじき】　めんどくさいダニ…

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】……

O-okay, Danni... So
I'll stop staring, Danni!

That letter really struck a chord with me…

Original Text: だーっ！　なんなんですかー！\nあのクマ！

Waaah! What on earth is that?!
That bear!

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】に　これが\nかしこい【軍師：ぐんし】ダニか…？

Ahem… Um… Let me get my

I see... If it were
me, I'd solve it right away!

That's so cool! I can really sense his

By the way, honey, check this out too!
Invincible Barrier-kun!

Turn it on while you sleep!
Now you can block out
your husband's snoring!

Wow, that's so nice!
But it must be expensive, right? …It is!

Translated Text:
No, no!
And today, I'm going to add this, too!

Original Text: 【g】すれちがいバトルアプリ【e】！\nこちらでバトルを【楽：たの】しむだけで…

【g】A "Pass-by Battle" app【e】!
Just enjoy battling here, and...

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明社長：こうめいしゃちょう】　【太：ふと】っ【腹：ぱら】っス！\nで　【気：き】になるお【値段：ねだん】は…？

Whisper President
Kongming—what a generous guy!
So, what’s the price, you ask…?

Translated Text: …Just do whatever you want, you jerk…

Original Text: 「【g】ともだち【手帳：てちょう】【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I got a "【g】Friendship Notebook【e】."

Translated Text:
A private home?
No way! This is a battlefield!

Even a peaceful home has
become a battlefield… Am I a
tick fighting in a place that holds
someone’s memories…?

Translated Text:
In that case! Let's 【g】make【e】
【g】some fun【e】 memories
in Sakura Country, too!

Translated Text: "I got the 'Memories'Yo-kai Pad app."

Original Text: さすが　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\n【残：のこ】すはキン【張角：ちょうかく】だけなのだ！
Translated Text:
As expected of the USA Pyon
gang! Only Kin Zhang Jue
remains!

Translated Text: But there's still some fog left.\nI have no idea where he is.

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nなんとかするダニ！
Translated Text:
The Genius Strategist!
Dani, Who Always Finds a Way!

Original Text: ん～\n【空気：くうき】キレイキレイマシーンでも…

As expected… my rivals…
the USA Pyon brothers!

I can't believe you noticed
the button I "deliberately"

Translated Text: Enough is enough, you tick!

Original Text: ぎゃああ！
Translated Text: Aaaargh!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】のかつやくによって\nキンギン【党：とう】は【滅：ほろ】びました…
Translated Text: Because of my actions, the\nKingin Party was destroyed…

Translated Text:
But that's just the tip of the iceberg!
This is nothing compared to
what I'm really capable of...!

Translated Text: This is the jewel that the\nKingin Party possessed.

Original Text: やったダニ！\nこの【調子：ちょうし】でいくダニ！

Way to go, Dani!
Keep it up, Dani!

Hey!
You two, listen up!

Original Text: ミーにいろいろ【言：い】う【前：まえ】に…

(Th... That bastard... Someday
I'm gonna crush him!)

Translated Text: Ika-ka-ka-ka!

A magical gem that grants any wish…

Original Text: キンギン【党：とう】　ぶようじん！
Translated Text: Kingin Party: Be Strong!

Original Text: きわめてイカんである！
Translated Text: That's totally messed up!

Translated Text: So... the one who stole that\njewel—could it be... you!?

Original Text: なんば【言：い】いよっとね\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】ばい　だるか～
Translated Text: I'm saying, Namba, USA\nPyon, Nakata, bye—see ya~

Original Text: ほう…　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】
Translated Text: Hmm... USA Pyon and friends

Original Text: 【私：わたし】のジャマをするとは\nナカナカの【器：うつわ】…
Translated Text: To think you'd get in my\nway—you've got some nerve…

Original Text: だが　それだけでは【私：わたし】は【倒：たお】せんぞ！\n【私：わたし】には【四天王：してんのう】がいるのだからな！
Translated Text:
But that alone won't be
enough to defeat me!
After all, I have my Four Heavenly Kings!

Translated Text: And best of all, isn't this the\nRed Demon Lu Bu right here?!

Chairman Ikakamone, Dong
Zhuo, and the Red Demon Lü Bu!
They look so strong... They look so scary...

Translated Text: If you want to hear these two's\ninsights, click here, Bear…!

Translated Text: Hey there, genius strategist!

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【場所：ばしょ】がわかる\n【道具：どうぐ】を【出：だ】してくれダニ～！

Translated Text: I found you, Usapyon Zhongda!

Translated Text:
I see... Just like the rumors
say, he's actually quite handsome.

Translated Text:
Huh?
Who are you guys?

Translated Text:
!! Shut up!
You insolent jerk!!

Original Text: この【方々：かたがた】をどなたと【心得：こころえ】る！
Translated Text: Who do you think these people are?!

Original Text: さくら【国団々坂出身：こくだんだんざかしゅっしん】の【名家：めいか】・【袁家：えんけ】の\n【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】と【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】ですぞ！
Translated Text:
Meet Lord Yuan Shao, the Earth
Spider from the prestigious Yuan
family of Dandan-zaka in Sakura
Country, and Lord Oogama En Jutsu!

Original Text: で　その【名家：めいか】とやらが\nなんの【用：よう】ダニ？
Translated Text: So, what does that so-called\ndistinguished family want with me?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】ら　あのキンギン【党：とう】を\n【倒：たお】したらしいな
Translated Text: I hear you guys took\ndown that Kingin Party.

Original Text: その【力：ちから】を【見：み】こんで【頼：たの】みがある\n…イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】さねえか？
Translated Text: I believe in your strength, so I have a\nfavor to ask… Chairman Ikakamone,\nwould you take down Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】？
Translated Text: Is Chairman Ikakamone actually Dong Zhuo?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】とは…！　その…\nあの…　えーと…　【悪：あく】の【親玉：おやだま】です！
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone,
Dong Zhuo is…! Um…
well… er… he’s the head of the villains!

Original Text: 【時間：じかん】がかかったわりには\nざっくりすぎる【説明：せつめい】ダニ…
Translated Text: For all the time it took, that\nexplanation is way too vague, Dani…

Original Text: このさくら【国：こく】さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】で\nヤツは【急成長：きゅうせいちょう】しておってな…
Translated Text: That guy’s been growing like\ncrazy here in the Sakura Housing\nDistrict of Sakura Country…

Original Text: ま　オレたちは【隣：となり】の【街：まち】のもんだが\nちょっと【見過：みす】ごせなくなってよ
Translated Text: Well, we're from the next town over,\nbut we just couldn't ignore it anymore.

Original Text: これ【以上：いじょう】のもめごとは\nこりごりダニ…
Translated Text: I'm done with any more trouble, Dani…

Original Text: おお…　【相手：あいて】が【大物：おおもの】であっても\nイヤなものはきっぱりと【断：ことわ】る…！
Translated Text: Wow… Even if the other\nperson is a big shot, I’ll flat-out\nrefuse anything I don’t like…!

Original Text: なんと【堂：　　どうどう】々とした【態度：たいど】！\nさすがは　【我：わ】がライバル！
Translated Text:
What a confident demeanor!
Just as I’d expect from my rival!

Original Text: ということで…\n【残念：ざんねん】ながら【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達殿：ちゅうたつどの】は…
Translated Text:
So…
unfortunately, our friends in the USA…

Original Text: でも　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】に【次：つぎ】の【手：て】もないみたいだし\nつきあってもいいダニ！
Translated Text:
But since even the genius
strategist doesn't seem to have
another move up his sleeve, I
guess it's okay to go along with it!

Original Text: …よろこんで【協力：きょうりょく】するとのことですっ！
Translated Text: …They said they’d be happy to help!

Original Text: でも…　【袁家：えんけ】に\nどう【協力：きょうりょく】すればいいダニ？
Translated Text: But… how should I help\nthe Yuan family, Dani?

Original Text: ん？　お【待：ま】ちください！\nあれは…
Translated Text:
Huh? Wait a minute! That's
...

Original Text: メラメラ～！\n（【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！）
Translated Text:
Fire, fire~!
(USA Pyon and Nakata!)

Original Text: アナタはたしか…えっと…その…
Translated Text: You're definitely... um... well...

Original Text: メラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！\n【前：まえ】は　【世話：せわ】になったダニ！
Translated Text:
Fiery Lion Zhang Fei!
Thanks for everything back then, Dani!

Original Text: そう！　【今：いま】そう【言：い】おうと【思：おも】っていたんです！\nで　【何：なに】かご【用：よう】ですか？
Translated Text:
That's right! I was just about to say that!
So, is there something you need?

Original Text: メラメラメラ…\n（オレたちのすみかが…）
Translated Text:
Flame, flame, flame…
(Our home is…)

Original Text: メラメラ！　メ～ラ！\n（イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】におそわれて…）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze! Me~ra!
(Chairman Ikakamone has been
attacked by Dong Zhuo's army...)

Original Text: 【連中：れんちゅう】は　ますます\nつけあがっておるようだな…
Translated Text: It seems like those guys are\ngetting more and more cocky…

Original Text: メラ　メラメラメラッ！\n（どうか　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, mera, mera, mera!
(Please, lend me your strength!)

Original Text: ちょうど　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】すと【決：き】めたとこダニ！
Translated Text: I just decided to take down\nChairman Ikakamone, Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: 【大船：おおぶね】に【乗：の】ったつもりで\nいいダニ！
Translated Text: Just think of yourself as\nbeing on a big ship, Dani!

Original Text: メラメラ！\n（ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Whoosh!
(Thank you!)

Original Text: これで　【役者：やくしゃ】はそろったな…
Translated Text: Well, it looks like we've got all the players here now...

Original Text: さっそくイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を\n【倒：たお】しに【行：い】こうぜ！
Translated Text: Let's go defeat Chairman Dong\nZhuo right away, Ikakamone!

Original Text: オホン！　その【前：まえ】にみなさん！
Translated Text: Ahem! But first, everyone!

Original Text: 【我：われ】らにふさわしい\nチーム【名：めい】を【決：き】めませんか？
Translated Text: Why don't we come up with\na team name that suits us?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】とゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たち\n…なんて　いかがです？
Translated Text: "Whisper Kongming and His\nFun-Loving Friends"... How about that?

Original Text: ハァァァ～？\nナメてるクマ！？
Translated Text:
Huhhh~?
Are you messing with me, Bear!?

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: 【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】がいいクマ！\n【説明：せつめい】はこちらクマ！
Translated Text:
The Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition is
awesome! Click here for more
info!

Original Text: ……\n【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】か　【悪：わる】くない
Translated Text:
……The Coalition
Against Dong Zhuo? Not bad.

Original Text: では　この【軍：ぐん】は【吾輩：わがはい】が【率：ひき】いる！\n【皆：みな】の【者：もの】　ついて【参：まい】れ！！
Translated Text:
"Very well, then—I shall lead this army!
Everyone, follow me!!"

Original Text: ありゃ　リーダーの【役：やく】とられちまった\nまあいいや　【今回：こんかい】はゆずってやるよ
Translated Text: Oh no, someone took my spot as\nleader. Oh well, I'll let it slide this time.

Original Text: 【行：ゆ】くぞ　【反董卓連合軍：はんとうたくれんごうぐん】！\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【成敗：せいばい】するのだ！
Translated Text:
Let's go, Anti-Dong Zhuo Coalition!
Chairman Ikakamone, let's
bring Dong Zhuo to justice!

Original Text: おおおー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: おい　【戦：たたか】いの【前：まえ】にひとつ\n【忠告：ちゅうこく】しといてやるぜ
Translated Text: Hey, I'll give you one piece\nof advice before the fight.

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【四天王：してんのう】に【気：き】をつけろ
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, watch out for Dong Zhuo's Four Heavenly Kings.

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】…？
Translated Text: Les quatre généraux célestes... ?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】の【軍：ぐん】を【支：ささ】える\n【四将軍：よんしょうぐん】のことさ　ヤツらは　ズルがしこい
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, you mean the four\ngenerals who support Dong Zhuo’s\narmy, right? Those guys are really crafty.

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】の【領地：りょうち】にも\n【攻：せ】めてくるかもしれねえ
Translated Text: The USA might even attack\nPyon and Nakata's territory.

Original Text: りょうち？　ミーは\nいつの【間：ま】にか【国：くに】を【持：も】ってたダニ？
Translated Text: Ryochi? Did Mee end up with a\ncountry without me even realizing it?

Original Text: ええ　【困：こま】った【人：ひと】を【助：たす】けたり\nキンギン【党：とう】を【倒：たお】したりしたので…
Translated Text: Yeah, well, I helped some people in\ntrouble and defeated the Kingin Party, so...

Original Text: さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】のしせつを\nいくつか【持：も】っておりますよ！
Translated Text: We have a few facilities in\nthe Sakura residential area!

Original Text: せっかく\n【勝：か】ち【取：と】った【領地：りょうち】だ
Translated Text: We worked so hard to win this territory

Original Text: 【守：まも】りのメンバーをきっちり\n【置：お】いておいたほうがいいぜ！
Translated Text: You'd better make sure to have\nyour defensive players in position!

Original Text: なんだか【大変：たいへん】そうダニね…\nよし　わかったダニ！
Translated Text:
That sounds like a lot of
work, doesn't it, Dani... Okay
, got it, Dani!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち\nいい【戦：たたか】いぶりだったぞ！
Translated Text: You guys put up a great fight!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】　ありがとう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze~!
(Thanks, Usapyon Zhongda!)

Original Text: 【当然：とうぜん】のことをしたまでダニ！
Translated Text: I just did what anyone would do, Dan!

Original Text: え～【浮：う】かれるのはまだ【早：はや】いかと…\n【四天王：してんのう】は【残：のこ】り３【人：にん】もいますし
Translated Text:
Well... I guess it's still too early to
get carried away... There are still
three of the Four Heavenly Kings
left, after all.

Original Text: うるさいぞ！　【白：しろ】いの！\nフヨフヨしやがって！！
Translated Text:
Shut up! You white thing! Stop
wiggling around!!

Original Text: ぼへっー！　【頭：あたま】たたかない！\n【私：わたくし】のチャームポイントがぁ～！
Translated Text:
Ugh! Don't hit my head!
That's my best feature!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text: USA, Pyong Nakata!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】からオレたちは\nえいえんの　ともだちだ！
Translated Text: Starting today, we're friends forever!

Original Text: メラッ　メラメラ！\n（【熱：あつ】い【誓：ちか】いを【結：むす】ぼう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze away!
(Let's make a fiery vow!)

Original Text: ミー　『さんごくし』は\nあまり【詳：くわ】しくないダニ…
Translated Text: Me: I don't know much\nabout *Sangokushi*...

Original Text: でも　これって\nミーと【誓：ちか】っていいものダニ？
Translated Text: But... is it okay to make a\npromise with Mee about this?

Original Text: 【何：なに】　【言：い】ってるんですか　アナタ！\nこれはまさしく【三国志一：さんごくしいち】の【名場面：めいばめん】…
Translated Text:
What are you talking about?!
This is truly the greatest scene in
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*…

Original Text: 『【公園：こうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』ー！
Translated Text: "The Park Oath"—!

Original Text: ちがーう！　『【桃園：とうえん】の【誓：ちか】い』クマ！\nこっちで【説明：せつめい】するクマ！
Translated Text:
No way! "The Oath of the
Peach Garden," Bear!
I'll explain it over here, Bear!

Original Text: （なんだかよくわかんないダニ）
Translated Text: (Some kind of tick I don't really understand)

Original Text: （でも　まあ\n【楽：たの】しいそうだし　いいダニ！）
Translated Text: (But, well, it looks like fun, so that's fine!)

Original Text: よーし！　【覚悟：かくご】はできたな？\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text:
All right! Are you ready?
You guys from USA Pyon!

Original Text: メラ　メラメラ！\n（【我：われ】ら３【人：にん】！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera, Mera!
(The three of us!)

Original Text: 【生：う】まれた【時：とき】…いや【場所：ばしょ】も【違：ちが】うけど！
Translated Text: When I was born… well, actually, the place was different too!

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: We'll die together! Victorian!

Original Text: どさくさにまぎれて\n【私：わたくし】もビクトリアーン！
Translated Text: Taking advantage of the\ncommotion, I'm a Victorian too!

Original Text: 【白：しろ】いのは　【引：ひ】っこんでろ！
Translated Text: You white guy, get lost!

Original Text: ぐへっ…！\nどさくさにまぎれて…
Translated Text:
Guh...! While everyone was distracted
...

Original Text: こちらが…\n【入手：にゅうしゅ】できたでうぃす…　バタリ…
Translated Text:
Here it is… I managed to
get it… *thud*…

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「チャレンジバトル」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "Challenge Battle"app for the Yo-kai Pad.

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: I downloaded the "【g】Yo-kai Pad"【e】 app, "Yo-kai Online Store."

Original Text: おお　ぶようじん【坊金旋：ぼうきんせん】よ！\n【負：ま】けてしまうとは【情：なさ】けないではなイカ
Translated Text:
Oh, you good-for-nothing Kin-sen!
How pathetic of you to
lose, don't you think?

Original Text: だがヤツは【四天王：してんのう】の【中：なか】では【最弱：さいじゃく】！
Translated Text: But he's the weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たち３【人：にん】が【残：のこ】っていれば\nなんの【心配：しんぱい】もいらないではなイカ！
Translated Text: If the three of you are still here,\nthere’s nothing to worry about, right?

Original Text: そして…　【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】！
Translated Text: And… Red Demon Lu Bu!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】に　ジャングルハンターを\nまかせようではなイカ！
Translated Text: How about I let you handle\nthe Jungle Hunter, huh?

Original Text: あっか～ん！\nワシの【力：ちから】　【思：おも】い【知：し】らせてくれる！
Translated Text:
Oh no!
You're really showing
me what I'm made of!

Original Text: みんな　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】に\nとどめを【刺：さ】すダニ！
Translated Text: Everyone, check this out—the\ntick that delivers the final\nblow to Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】ったああああ！
Translated Text: Wait a minute!

Original Text: ダニ？　どーしたダニ？
Translated Text: Dani? What's up, Dani?

Original Text: あ　あたしぃ　【第一印象：だいいちいんしょう】から\nアナタに【決：き】めてましたあ…
Translated Text: "I... I knew you were the one from\nthe very first moment I saw you..."

Original Text: って　ちがーう！
Translated Text: Wait—no way!

Original Text: りょ　りょ　りょ　【呂布：りょふ】ですっ！\n【呂布：りょふ】ですよおおおお！
Translated Text:
Ryō, Ryō, Ryō—it's Lü Bu!
It's Lü Buuuuu!

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】　さいきょう！\nとっても【恐：おそ】ろしい　【赤：あか】いヤツです！
Translated Text:
Sakura Kingdom—Saikyo! This is that
really scary red guy!

Original Text: ひとまず【逃：に】げましょう！
Translated Text: Let's get out of here for now!

Original Text: メラメラ！　メラッ！\n（オレが【食：く】い【止：と】める！　【行：い】け！）
Translated Text:
Blaze! Blaze!
(I'll hold them off! Go!)

Original Text: おいおい　オレもブラザーを【置：お】いて\n【逃：に】げるような　ヘタレじゃないぞ！
Translated Text: Hey, hey—I'm no wimp who'd just run\naway and leave my brother behind!

Original Text: いや　ミーにまかせるダニ！\n【仲達：ちゅうたつ】の【知恵：ちえ】を【見：み】せてやるダニ！
Translated Text:
No way—leave it to me, Dan!
I'll show you what I'm made of, Dan!

Original Text: いや　ならばここは【私：わたくし】が！\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のかつやく　ごらんあれ！
Translated Text:
No—in that case, I'll take care of this!
Watch the genius strategist in action!

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ
Translated Text: Please, go ahead

Original Text: メ～ラメ～ラ
Translated Text: Mee-ra Mee-ra

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ
Translated Text: Please, go ahead

Original Text: って　【止：と】めないのかよ！？
Translated Text: "What, you're not going to stop him!?"

Original Text: いやー！\n【私：わたくし】も【逃：に】げるでうぃすー！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
I'm running away too!

Original Text: ふうー\nここまでくれば【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】です…
Translated Text: Phew... Now that I've made\nit this far, I'll be fine...

Original Text: 【退：ひ】くことにはなったが…\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【軍：ぐん】の【戦：たたか】いぶりは【実：じつ】に【見事：みごと】
Translated Text:
Although they ended up retreating…
the USA Pyeong Army’s performance
in battle was truly magnificent.

Original Text: ああ　たいしたもんだ\nおかげでイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】たちは【弱：よわ】ってる
Translated Text: Wow, that's impressive. Thanks to\nthat, Chairman Ikakamone and\nDong Zhuo's forces are weakened.

Original Text: そこで…　【最後：さいご】の【仕上：しあ】げは\nお【主：ぬし】らに【任：まか】せたいのだが…
Translated Text: So… I’d like to leave the finishing\ntouches up to you guys…

Original Text: 【団々坂：だんだんざか】でトラブル【発生：はっせい】ってヤツだ\n【袁家：えんけ】の【連中：れんちゅう】は【帰：かえ】らなきゃなんねえ
Translated Text: So there's been some trouble\nat Dandan-zaka. The Yuan\nfamily folks have to head home.

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっと　【待：ま】った！\nリーダーがいないとまずいダニ！
Translated Text:
Wait—wait a minute! We're
in trouble without our
leader, Dani!

Original Text: おまかせください！\nこういう【時：とき】に【頼：たよ】りになるのが　【私：わたくし】！
Translated Text:
Leave it to me! I'm the one
you can count on in times like
these!

Original Text: うむ\nリーダーはお【主：ぬし】がやれ
Translated Text: Hmm, you take the lead.

Original Text: うぃすー！　おまかせくだ…
Translated Text: Hey there! Leave it to me…

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\nあとは　お【前：まえ】にまかせたぜ？
Translated Text:
USA, Pyong Nakata!
I'll leave the rest to you, okay?

Original Text: なんですとーーーー！
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】【生：う】まれのミーがリーダー？\nそんなの　むりダニ！
Translated Text:
Me, born in the USA, as the leader?
No way, that's impossible!

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】は【強：つよ】い\nそして　いい【仲間：なかま】にも【恵：めぐ】まれておる
Translated Text: You're strong, and you're\nblessed with great companions.

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: ヤツらがいっしょなら\n【無敵：むてき】だろ？
Translated Text: If they're all together,\nthey're invincible, right?

Original Text: ちょ　ちょっとお【待：ま】ちを…\nだれか　【忘：わす】れちゃいませんかー？
Translated Text:
Hey, wait a sec… Isn't
someone forgetting something?

Original Text: では　【頼：たの】んだぞ
Translated Text: All right, count on me.

Original Text: また【会：あ】おうぜ！
Translated Text: See you later!

Original Text: はあ…なんか\nどんどん【責任重大：せきにんじゅうだい】になっていくダニ
Translated Text: Sigh... It feels like my responsibilities are\njust getting heavier and heavier, Dani.

Original Text: ミー…　いつイナホのとこに\nもどれるダニ？
Translated Text: Me... When can I go back\nto Inaho's place, Dani?

Original Text: 【待：ま】ってー！　【袁家：えんけ】の【皆様：みなさま】ー！
Translated Text: Wait! Everyone from the Yuan family!

Original Text: いいかげん　【私：わたくし】の【名前：なまえ】くらい\n【覚：おぼ】えてくださいよ～！
Translated Text: For heaven's sake, just\nremember my name already!

Original Text: 「【g】【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「メダルこうかん」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました」
Translated Text: "I got the 'Yo-kai 【g】Pad' app 'Medal Exchange.'【e】"

Original Text: どうしたブラザー！　【元気：げんき】ないな！\nエクササイズでもするか？
Translated Text:
What's up, bro! You seem down!
Want to work out or something?

Original Text: メラ　メラメ～ラ！\n（オレたちが　いつもついているぞ！）
Translated Text:
Mera, Mera-me~ra!
(We're always by your side!)

Original Text: …ミー\nこの【世界：せかい】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃないダニ
Translated Text: …Mee, I'm not a military\ncommander-Yo-kai in this world, am I?

Original Text: いつかは　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るダニ\nそれでも　ともだちでいてくれるダニ？
Translated Text: Someday, I'll go back to my old world, Dan.\nEven so, will you still be my friend, Dan?

Original Text: 【当：あ】たり【前：まえ】だ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Of course, bro!

Original Text: メラメラメラメーラ！\n（【友情：ゆうじょう】に【場所：ばしょ】は【関係：かんけい】ないぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera Mera Mera-me-ra!
(Friendship knows no bounds!)

Original Text: そうダニか…
Translated Text: So, it's a tick, huh...

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】\nノガッパ【姜維：きょうい】…
Translated Text: Ryu-kun, Liu Yu, Walkappa, Jiang Wei…

Original Text: そして　ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】に\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】…
Translated Text: And then there's Captain Bree, Guan\nYu, and Melamelion Zhang Fei…

Original Text: ミーは　ここに【来：き】て\n【困：こま】ってばっかりだったけど…
Translated Text: Ever since I came here, I've been\nhaving nothing but trouble...

Original Text: ミーには　みんなが…\n【頼：たよ】りになる　ともだちがいるダニ！
Translated Text:
Mee has... friends she can always
count on, Dani!

Original Text: メラメラ！　メラメラ！\n（【元気：げんき】になったな！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！）
Translated Text:
Blaze away! Blaze away!
(You guys are full of energy
now, USA Pyon friends!)

Original Text: よーし！\nその【調子：ちょうし】だ　ブラザー！
Translated Text:
All right!
Keep it up, bro!

Original Text: そして　オレたちには\nまだ【大事：だいじ】なミッションが【残：のこ】ってるぞ！
Translated Text: And we still have an important\nmission left to complete!

Original Text: そうダニ！　【今度：こんど】こそ\nイカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】を【倒：たお】すダニー！
Translated Text: That's right, Danny! This time, Danny will\ndefinitely defeat Chairman Dong Zhuo!

Original Text: メラメラメラ　メラ！\n（【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】を　【先：さき】に【倒：たお】そう！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze, blaze!
(Let's take down the Red Ogre Lu Bu first!)

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】があると\nヤツはそこに【逃：に】げこむぞ！
Translated Text: If one of the Four Heavenly Kings has\na territory, that guy will run off to it!

Original Text: 【四天王：してんのう】の【領地：りょうち】をすべて【制圧：せいあつ】しろ！\nそうすれば　ビクトリアーン！
Translated Text:
Conquer all of the Four
Heavenly Kings' territories!
Then—Victorian!

Original Text: ＯＫ！\nまかせるダニー！！
Translated Text:
OK!
Leave it to me, Danny!!

Original Text: みなさん！　お【疲：つか】れ【様：さま】です！\nジャングルハンターは　すぐそこですよ！
Translated Text:
Hey, everyone! Great job today!
Jungle Hunter is just around the corner!

Original Text: ジャングルハンター？\nそれって　なんダニ？
Translated Text:
Jungle Hunter?
What kind of tick is that?

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】のアジトですが…\nまさか　それを【知：し】らないで【今：いま】まで？
Translated Text:
Chairman Ikakamone, this
is Dong Zhuo’s hideout…
You’ve actually had no
idea about this until now?

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の　ライバルたる　アナタが？\nよもや　いくらなんでも　そんな…！
Translated Text:
You—my rival—of all people?
No way—that’s just too much…!

Original Text: （ま　まんめんの【笑：え】みダニ…）
Translated Text: (A... a beaming smile, Dan...)

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ありませんねぇ…
Translated Text: I guess there's nothing we can do about it...

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】は　イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】との【最終決戦：さいしゅうけっせん】！\n【準備：じゅんび】をととのえて【挑：いど】んでくださいよ？
Translated Text:
Next up is the final showdown
with Chairman Ikakamone, Dong
Zhuo! Make sure you're fully
prepared before you take him on, okay?

Original Text: この【天：てん】・【才：さい】・【軍：ぐん】・【師：し】がっ！\nアナタを【立派：りっぱ】に【支：ささ】えてみせますからね！
Translated Text:
This genius military strategist!
I'll make sure to support
you to the best of my ability!

Original Text: いつの【間：ま】にか\n【追：お】いつめられているではなイカ…
Translated Text: Before I knew it, I found myself\nbacked into a corner, didn't I…

Original Text: ここの【守：まも】りは\nお【前：まえ】に【任：まか】せてもいイカ？
Translated Text: Is it okay if I leave the\ndefense of this place to you?

Original Text: なにぃ？　どこに【行：い】く？
Translated Text: What? Where are you going?

Original Text: イカカカカ…\n【大事：だいじ】な【使命：しめい】を【果：は】たさねばイカんのだ
Translated Text:
Ika-ka-ka-ka… I simply must fulfill this
important mission.

Original Text: ンーーーーーッ！\nビクトリアーーーーーーン！
Translated Text:
Huuuuuuu!
Victoriaaaaaaa!

Original Text: メラ！　メラアアア！\n（この【勝利：しょうり】！　【熱：あつ】いぜ！）
Translated Text:
Mera! Meraaaaa!
(This victory! It's so exciting!)

Original Text: いや…！\n【喜：よろこ】ぶのは　まだ【早：はや】いでうぃす！
Translated Text:
No...!
It's too soon to celebrate!

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓勢力：ぎちょうとうたくせいりょく】の【残党：ざんとう】が\nこちらに【向：む】かってきていますー！
Translated Text: Chairman Ikakamone, the remnants of\nDong Zhuo's forces are heading this way!

Original Text: ピンチ　ダニ！　こっちは\nこれ【以上：いじょう】　【戦：たたか】えないダニよ！？
Translated Text: We're in a tight spot, Mite!\nI can't fight any more, Mite!

Original Text: メラ！\n（【先：さき】に【逃：に】げろ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(Run away first!)

Original Text: ここはオレたちが【食：く】いとめる！\n【行：い】け！　【ＵＳＡ：ゆーえすえー】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text:
We'll hold them off here!
Go! Usapyon Zhongda!

Original Text: なに【言：い】ってるダニ！\nふたりを【置：お】いていけるわけないダニ！
Translated Text:
What are you talking about, Dani!
There's no way I could leave
the two of you behind, Dani!

Original Text: どうせなら　ふたりの【代：か】わりに\nこの【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】を【置：お】いてくダニ！
Translated Text: If we're going to do this anyway,\nlet's leave this genius strategist\nbehind instead of those two, Dani!

Original Text: アナタね～！　いくらなんでも\nそりゃないんじゃ　ござんせ～ん！？
Translated Text: Hey, you! Come on—that’s just\ntoo much, don’t you think?!

Original Text: ピーピーうるさいぞ！\nふたりとも！
Translated Text:
Stop making all that noise, you
two!

Original Text: ダニイイイイ！
Translated Text: Daniiiii!

Original Text: ひゃああああ！
Translated Text: Yaaaaaah!

Original Text: あのふたり…\n【無事：ぶじ】だといいダニが…
Translated Text:
Those two... I hope they're
okay...

Original Text: 【残党：ざんとう】は　すごい【数：かず】だったそうです\nきっとバラバラのメチャクチャに…
Translated Text: I hear there were a huge number of\nstragglers. They must have been scattered\nall over the place in total disarray…

Original Text: うわーーん…！\nミーのせいダニ～！
Translated Text:
Waaah…! It's all
my fault, Dani~!

Original Text: ミーが　もっと【強：つよ】くて\nもっと　しっかりしていたら…！
Translated Text: If only I were stronger\nand more resilient…!

Original Text: 【泣：な】くのは【早：はや】いぜ　ブラザー！
Translated Text: Don't cry just yet, bro!

Original Text: ぎゃあああああ！\nお　おばけ～！！！
Translated Text:
Aaaaaaah!
A ghost~!!!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（おばけじゃない　【妖怪：ようかい】だ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(I'm not a ghost—I'm a Yo-kai!)

Original Text: ブリー【隊長関羽：たいちょうかんう】！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
Burii Taichou Kan U!
Flame Lion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: メラメラメ～ラ！\n（【生：う】まれた【時：とき】は　ちがっても！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze, blaze~!
(Even if we were born different!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は【一緒：いっしょ】だ！　ビクトリアーーン！！\n…だろ！？
Translated Text:
We'll die together! Victoriaaa!!
… Right!?

Original Text: よ　よかったダニ！\n【本当：ほんとう】に　【無事：ぶじ】でよかったダニー！！
Translated Text:
Whew... I'm so glad, Danny!
I'm really glad you're safe, Danny!!

Original Text: もうひとつ！\nブラザーにビッグなプレゼントだ！
Translated Text:
One more thing!
It's a big present for my brother!

Original Text: メラ！\n（【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ！）
Translated Text:
Mera!
(It's a gem!)

Original Text: げげっ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: 【残党相手：ざんとうあいて】にバトルしてる【時：とき】に\n【井戸：いど】で　【見：み】つけたんだ！
Translated Text: I found it in a well while I was\nbattling some stragglers!

Original Text: メラメラ\n（【持：も】っていってくれ）
Translated Text: Mera Mera (Take this with you)

Original Text: いいダニか？
Translated Text: Is it a good tick?

Original Text: いいも【悪：わる】いもないぞ！\nブラザー！
Translated Text:
There's no such thing as good or bad,
bro!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラ！\n（【熱：あつ】き【友情：ゆうじょう】のあかしだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze, blaze!
(A testament to our fiery friendship!)

Original Text: う…　【泣：な】けるダニ！\nみんな…　ありがとダニ！
Translated Text:
Ugh... This is so touching!
Everyone... thank you so much!

Original Text: みんなも【無事：ぶじ】で　おまけに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】も【手：て】に【入：はい】って\nパーティーでもしたい【気分：きぶん】ダニ！
Translated Text: Everyone's safe, and on top of that, we got\nthe gem—I'm in the mood to throw a party!

Original Text: そうおっしゃると【思：おも】っていました\n【準備：じゅんび】はバッチリできておりますよ～！
Translated Text: I knew you'd say that. I'm all set!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！　グレイトだ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming! That's great!

Original Text: グレイト？　いえいえ…ここは\nビクトリアーン！　…と【言：い】ってくださいな！
Translated Text: Great? No, no… This is\nVictorian! …Please say that!

Original Text: さあ\nみんなで　さわぎまくるダニー！
Translated Text: Come on, everyone—let's\nget Danny all riled up!

Original Text: いや～\nのどかな【時間：じかん】ですねえ
Translated Text: Wow, what a peaceful time this is.

Original Text: そうダニ…\nつかの【間：ま】の【休息：きゅうそく】って【感：かん】じダニ…
Translated Text:
Yeah, Dan... It feels like just a
brief respite, Dan...

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】　アナタをライバルと【見：み】なし\n【数々：かずかず】の【無礼：ぶれい】を【働：はたら】いてきましたが…
Translated Text: I’ve regarded you as a rival and committed\nnumerous acts of disrespect, but…

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】はその【反省：はんせい】の【意味：いみ】もこめまして\nプレゼントを【用意：ようい】しました
Translated Text: With that in mind—and as a way of\nreflecting on what happened—I’ve\nprepared a gift for you today.

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】…　ありがとうダニ！\nミーもいろいろ【言：い】って【悪：わる】かったダニ！
Translated Text:
Genius strategist… Thanks, Dani!
I'm sorry for all the things I said, Dani!

Original Text: 【開：あ】けてもいいダニか？
Translated Text: Is it okay to open this?

Original Text: どうぞどうぞ…
Translated Text: Go ahead, go ahead…

Original Text: …このビラビラした【服：ふく】はなんダニ？
Translated Text: …What on earth is this frilly outfit?

Original Text: いやあ…いまいちプリチーさが【足：た】りない\nアナタのために【用意：ようい】した…
Translated Text: Well... I've prepared this just for you,\nsince you're not quite "pretty" enough...

Original Text: かわいらしい【服：ふく】でうぃすーー！
Translated Text: Here I am in my cute outfit!

Original Text: 【以後：いご】は　プリチー【担当：たんとう】として\nスミに【引：ひ】っこんでいただいて…
Translated Text: From now on, I'd like you to step\nback and let Sumi take over as\nthe "Pretty" representative...

Original Text: さくせん【面：めん】はすべて！\nこの【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】におまかせを…
Translated Text:
Leave all the strategic planning to
this genius military strategist…

Original Text: テメー…！
Translated Text: You...!

Original Text: （ベイダーモード！）
Translated Text: (Vader Mode!)

Original Text: いやー！\n【冗談：じょうだん】ですってば！　ジョーダン！！
Translated Text:
Oh, come on! I'm just
kidding! Just kidding!!

Original Text: はあはあ…\nせっかくの【服：ふく】がチリチリに…
Translated Text:
Phew, phew…
My nice outfit is all wrinkled up…

Original Text: …ん？\nお【客：きゃく】さんダニ！　【行：い】ってこいダニ！
Translated Text:
…Huh?
A customer, Mite! Go get 'em, Mite!

Original Text: は　はーい！
Translated Text: Y-yeah!

Original Text: あの…　えっと…\n【団々坂：だんだんざか】のしどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】…
Translated Text:
Um... well... that stammering
Tōken from Dandan-zaka...

Original Text: その…　お【願：ねが】いが　あの…\nあるんだけど…　えっと…
Translated Text:
Well... I have a favor to ask...
um...

Original Text: あ～　【話：はなし】がまったくすすみません！\nならば　【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った…
Translated Text:
Ugh... This conversation
isn't going anywhere!
Well then, I bought this from
the Yo-kai Online Store...

Original Text: モテる【聞：き】き【上手：じょうず】マシーン！\nこれで【私：わたくし】が　【代弁：だいべん】します！
Translated Text:
The Ultimate "Good Listener" Machine!
Let me speak for you!

Original Text: （その【道具：どうぐ】　いったい\nなんに【使：つか】うつもりだったダニ…）
Translated Text: (What on earth was Dani\nplanning to use that tool for…?)

Original Text: えっと…　【団々坂：だんだんざか】の【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】と\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】がいきなりケンカを？
Translated Text: Um... Did Yuan Shao, the Earth Spider\nof Dandan Slope, and Yuan Shu, the\nGiant Toad, suddenly get into a fight?

Original Text: 【大：おお】きな【家同士：いえどうし】が【争：あらそ】い　【自分：じぶん】をはじめ\n【住民：じゅうみん】たちも【困：こま】っている…
Translated Text: There's a dispute between two large\nhouseholds, and it's causing trouble\nfor me and the other residents...

Original Text: なにとぞ　さくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】の【英雄：えいゆう】\n【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達殿：ちゅうたつどの】の　お【力：ちから】で…
Translated Text: I humbly ask that, through the power\nof Mr. Usapyon Zhongda, the hero\nof the Sakura Residential District…

Original Text: ふたりのケンカを【止：と】めてくれないか\n…ということでうぃす！
Translated Text: "Could you please stop these two\nfrom fighting...?" So, here goes!

Original Text: ケンカの【原因：げんいん】は　なんダニ？
Translated Text: What's the reason for the fight?

Original Text: 【考：かんが】えても【仕方：しかた】ありません\nここは【行：い】ってみるしかないでしょうね
Translated Text: There's no point in thinking about it—I\nguess I'll just have to go check it out.

Original Text: あの…　よろしく…
Translated Text: Um... Nice to meet you...

Original Text: あの…ここで【今：いま】から…その…
Translated Text: Um... right here, right now... well...

Original Text: どうやら　【袁家：えんけ】のふたりが\nこの【場：ば】で【会談：かいだん】をするようです…
Translated Text: It seems the two members of the Yuan\nfamily are going to hold talks right here…

Original Text: 【始：はじ】まる【前：まえ】から\nぴりぴりしてるダニ…
Translated Text: Dani is already on edge\nbefore it even starts…

Original Text: 【以前：いぜん】から【思：おも】っていたが\nお【主：ぬし】とはことごとく…　【合：あ】わぬ！
Translated Text: I've been thinking this for a while now,\nbut you and I just... don't get along at all!

Original Text: そいつは　こっちのセリフだ！\nもうオメーとは　やってらんねーぜ！
Translated Text:
That’s exactly what I’d
say! I can’t deal with you
anymore!

Original Text: 【吾輩：わがはい】に【従：したが】う【気：き】がないのならば…\n【戦：たたか】いを【続：つづ】けるだけだ
Translated Text:
If you have no intention of
following me… then I’ll just keep
fighting.

Original Text: ハッ　【上等：じょうとう】だ！　この【際：さい】\nどっちが【上：うえ】か　ハッキリさせようぜ！
Translated Text: Ha! Bring it on! Let's settle this\nonce and for all—who's the boss!

Original Text: なんかめっちゃ【険悪：けんあく】ダニ…
Translated Text: The vibe is super tense...

Original Text: ん？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: ん？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: ヒッ！\nお　お【久：ひさ】しぶりダニ…？
Translated Text:
Whoa!
It's been a while, hasn't it...?

Original Text: おおっ！　よくぞ【来：き】てくれた！\n【吾輩：わがはい】と【共：とも】に　このわからず【屋：や】を…
Translated Text:
Whoa! I'm so glad you came!
Join me in dealing with
this stubborn fool…

Original Text: おおーっと！　オレの【相棒：あいぼう】に\n【気安：きやす】く【話：はな】しかけないでもらおーか！
Translated Text: Whoa! Don't you dare talk\nto my partner like that!

Original Text: なあ？　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text: Hey, you guys from USA Pyon!

Original Text: 【何：なに】を【言：い】うか！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】は\n【吾輩：わがはい】のために【来：き】てくれたのだ
Translated Text: What are you talking about! My friends\nfrom USA Pyeong came here just for me.

Original Text: ま　まあまあ　ふたりとも…\nミーは【別：べつ】にどっちの【味方：みかた】とか…
Translated Text:
Well... well, well... both of them...
I'm not really on either side or anything...

Original Text: そんなあいまいな【返事：へんじ】で\n【吾輩：わがはい】たちが【納得：なっとく】すると【思：おも】っておるのか？
Translated Text: Do you really think we'll be\nsatisfied with such a vague answer?

Original Text: 【決：き】めるんなら　スマートにたのむぜ？\nさあ　どっちにつくんだ？
Translated Text:
If you're going to decide,
at least do it smartly, okay?
So, which side are you on?

Original Text: ひいいい…\nあの　その　それは　えっと…
Translated Text:
Eek…
Um, well, that’s, uh…

Original Text: なんで　しどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】が\nしどろもどろになってるダニ！
Translated Text: Why is Shidoro-modoro Tōken\nstuttering like that, you jerk!

Original Text: ちょっと　タンマー！\n【話：はな】しあいの【時間：じかん】をくださーいっ！
Translated Text:
Hey, wait a sec! Give us a chance to
talk!

Original Text: こうなったら\nどっちにつくか【明：あき】らかにしましょう…
Translated Text: Now that it's come to this, let's\nmake it clear which side we're on…

Original Text: 【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】の【味方：みかた】をしたいなら\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】のしせつを【攻：せ】めましょう
Translated Text: If you want to side with Lord Yuan\nShao, the Earth Spider, attack\nLord Oogama En Jutsu's, facilities.

Original Text: 【大：おお】ガマ【袁術殿：えんじゅつどの】の【味方：みかた】をしたいなら\n【土蜘蛛袁紹殿：つちぐもえんしょうどの】のしせつを【攻：せ】めるのです
Translated Text: If you want to side with Lord Oogama\nEn Jutsu, you must attack Lord Yuan\nShao, the Earth Spider’s, facilities.

Original Text: どっちつかずの【態度：たいど】を【取：と】っていると\nふたりから【攻：せ】められそうダニ…
Translated Text: If I keep taking a fence-sitting\nstance, it looks like both of them\nare going to come after me, Dani…

Original Text: ええ！　だから　このさい…\n【思：おも】いっきり　【戦：たたか】ってやりましょう！
Translated Text:
Wow! So, since we're at it...
let's fight with everything
we've got!

Original Text: かぶき【役者：やくしゃ】のできそこない！\n【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】をボコりますか？
Translated Text:
You're a lousy Kabuki actor!
Are you going to beat up
Yuan Shao, the Earth Spider?

Original Text: 【軽口：かるくち】がいらつくガマやろう！\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】をシメますか？
Translated Text:
That toad's smart-aleck remarks
are getting on my nerves!
Should we take down
that big toad, Yuan Shu?

Original Text: シュッ　シュッ！\nどっちにしても　やってやりますよー！
Translated Text:
Whoosh, whoosh!
Either way, I'm gonna do it!

Original Text: 【前：まえ】　【袁家：えんけ】にスルーされたのが\nよっぽど　くやしかったダニね…
Translated Text: Man, Dani must have been really\nupset about being ignored by\nthe Yuan family earlier…

Original Text: やはり　お【主：ぬし】は【吾輩：わがはい】の【味方：みかた】か！\n【百万：ひゃくまん】の【軍勢：ぐんぜい】を【得：え】た【思：おも】いだぞ！
Translated Text:
So you really are on my side after all!
I feel as if I’ve gained an army of a
million!

Original Text: いざ　あのわからず【屋：や】を\n【共：とも】に【討：う】ち【果：は】たそうではないか！
Translated Text: Come on, let's join forces and\ntake down that stubborn fool!

Original Text: まあ　がんばるダニ\nでも　ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいダニ
Translated Text: Well, I'll do my best, but\ncould you tell me one thing?

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】は\nなんダニ？
Translated Text: What caused the two of them to fight?

Original Text: それは…　【言：い】えぬ
Translated Text: Well... I can't say that.

Original Text: 【戦：いくさ】に【勝利：しょうり】した【後：あと】\nあやつから【聞：き】けばよかろう…
Translated Text: You should ask him about\nit after we win the battle…

Original Text: なんか　しどろもどろだね…
Translated Text: You're kind of stumbling over your words, aren't you...

Original Text: 「【g】【協力：きょうりょく】バトル【e】」ができるようになりました」
Translated Text: "【g】Co-op【e】 Battles are now available."

Original Text: へっへっへ　【信：しん】じてたぜ！\nさすがは　オレの【相棒：あいぼう】！
Translated Text:
Heh, heh, heh... I knew you would!
Just like I expected from my partner!

Original Text: 【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】を\nソッコーでやっつけてやろうぜ！
Translated Text: Let's take down Yuan Shao,\nthe Earth Spider, in a flash!

Original Text: まあ　がんばるダニ\nでも　ひとつ【聞：き】かせてほしいダニ
Translated Text: Well, I'll do my best, but\ncould you tell me one thing?

Original Text: ふたりがケンカした【原因：げんいん】は\nなんダニ？
Translated Text: What caused the two of them to fight?

Original Text: それは…　まあ　なんだ
Translated Text: Well... I guess...

Original Text: バトルに【勝：か】った【後：あと】　あのガンコヤローから\n【聞：き】けばいいんじゃね？
Translated Text: After we win the battle, why don't\nwe just ask that stubborn jerk?

Original Text: なんか　しどろもどろだね…
Translated Text: You're kind of stumbling over your words, aren't you...

Original Text: 「【g】【協力：きょうりょく】バトル【e】」ができるようになりました」
Translated Text: "【g】Co-op【e】 Battles are now available."

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】らの　おかげで\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】のしせつは【制圧：せいあつ】できた！
Translated Text: Thanks to you all, we've managed\nto subdue that toad Yuan Shu!

Original Text: あやつを　【連：つ】れてこい！
Translated Text: Bring that guy here!

Original Text: えっと　その　はい…
Translated Text: Um... well... yes...

Original Text: いったい\n【何：なに】が【起：お】ころうとしているダニ…？
Translated Text: What on earth is about to happen, Dani…?

Original Text: 【決：き】まってますよ　【処刑：しょけい】です　【処刑：しょけい】\n【同族：どうぞく】の【争：あらそ】いの【悲：かな】しき【結末：けつまつ】ですね…
Translated Text: It's a done deal. Execution.\nExecution. What a tragic end\nto a feud among relatives…

Original Text: あの　その\n【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】を【連：つ】れてきたよ
Translated Text: Hey, I brought that big fat\nguy, Yuan Shu, with me.

Original Text: 【敗北：はいぼく】を【認：みと】めよ\nそして　【誓：ちか】ってもらおう…
Translated Text: Admit defeat, and then\nlet me make you swear...

Original Text: 【今後：こんご】　【大：おお】ガマ【袁術：えんじゅつ】は…\n『つぶあん』のまんじゅうを【食：た】べると！
Translated Text:
From
now on, Oogama En Jutsu, will... eat
manju filled with sweet red bean paste!

Original Text: まさか…　とは【思：おも】うダニが…
Translated Text: I never would have thought... but this tick...

Original Text: ケンカの【原因：げんいん】って…　それ？
Translated Text: So that's what caused the fight... Is that it?

Original Text: まんじゅうを　【甘：あま】く【見：み】るでない！
Translated Text: Don't underestimate manju!

Original Text: 【素材：そざい】の【甘：あま】みを【存分：ぞんぶん】に【味：あじ】わえる\nつぶあんこそ　【王道：おうどう】！
Translated Text: Sweet red bean paste, where you can\nfully savor the natural sweetness of\nthe ingredients, is the classic choice!

Original Text: …ハッ　【笑：わら】わせんな！
Translated Text: …Hah! Don't make me laugh!

Original Text: のどごしが　なめらかな\nこしあんこそ　ナンバーワンだろーが！
Translated Text: Smooth, silky-textured koshi-an\nis definitely the best, right?!

Original Text: まあ　ガンコな【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】さんには\n【一生：いっしょう】　わかんねぇだろーがな！
Translated Text: Well, I guess that stubborn earth spider\nYuan Shao will never get it, will he?!

Original Text: なんだと…！
Translated Text: What...!

Original Text: ふたりとも　いい【加減：かげん】にするダニ！！
Translated Text: Both of you, cut it out already!!

Original Text: そんなことに　【他：ほか】のみんなを【巻：ま】きこむなんて\nおかしいダニ！
Translated Text: It's crazy of you to drag everyone\nelse into something like that, Dani!

Original Text: おかげさまで\n【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】のしせつは【全部：ぜんぶ】うばえたぜ
Translated Text: Thanks to you guys, I managed to take\nall of Earth Spider Yuan Shao's facilities!

Original Text: さあ　あいつを　【連：つ】れてこい！
Translated Text: Come on, bring that guy here!

Original Text: えっと　その　はい…
Translated Text: Um... well... yes...

Original Text: いったい\n【何：なに】が【起：お】ころうとしているダニ…？
Translated Text: What on earth is about to happen, Dani…?

Original Text: 【決：き】まってますよ　【処刑：しょけい】です　【処刑：しょけい】\n【同族：どうぞく】の【争：あらそ】いの【悲：かな】しき【結末：けつまつ】ですね…
Translated Text: It's a done deal. Execution.\nExecution. What a tragic end\nto a feud among relatives…

Original Text: あの　その\n【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】を【連：つ】れてきたよ
Translated Text: Um, I brought that Tsuchigumo,\nYuan Shao, with me.

Original Text: 【負：ま】けを【認：みと】めろ\nそして　【約束：やくそく】してもらうぜ？
Translated Text: Admit you lost, and I'll\nmake you promise, okay?

Original Text: 【今後：こんご】　【土蜘蛛袁紹：つちぐもえんしょう】は…\n『こしあん』のまんじゅうを【食：た】べると！
Translated Text:
From now on, Tsuchigumo Yuan
Shao will… eat manju filled with
“koshi-an”!

Original Text: まさか…　とは【思：おも】うダニが…
Translated Text: I never would have thought... but this tick...

Original Text: ケンカの【原因：げんいん】って…　それ？
Translated Text: So that's what caused the fight... Is that it?

Original Text: まんじゅうを　【甘：あま】く【見：み】るんじゃねぇ！
Translated Text: Don't underestimate manju!

Original Text: のどごしが　なめらかな\nこしあんこそ　ナンバーワンだろーが！
Translated Text: Smooth, silky-textured koshi-an\nis definitely the best, right?!

Original Text: フッ…　【笑：わら】わせる
Translated Text: Huh... That's funny.

Original Text: 【素材：そざい】の【甘：あま】みを【存分：ぞんぶん】に【味：あじ】わえる\nつぶあんこそ　【王道：おうどう】！
Translated Text: Sweet red bean paste, where you can\nfully savor the natural sweetness of\nthe ingredients, is the classic choice!

Original Text: そんなことも　わからんとは\nお【主：ぬし】も　まだまだだな
Translated Text: If you don't even know something like\nthat, you've still got a long way to go.

Original Text: なにぃ？
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: ふたりとも　いい【加減：かげん】にするダニ！！
Translated Text: Both of you, cut it out already!!

Original Text: そんなことに　【他：ほか】のみんなを【巻：ま】きこむなんて\nおかしいダニ！
Translated Text: It's crazy of you to drag everyone\nelse into something like that, Dani!

Original Text: たしかに…　【吾輩：わがはい】たちは\n【少：すこ】し　まわりが【見：み】えていなかったようだ
Translated Text: That's true... It seems we weren't\nquite seeing the bigger picture.

Original Text: ああ…　【今：いま】の【今：いま】まで\nまんじゅうのことしか　【頭：あたま】になかったぜ
Translated Text: Ah... Up until just now, all I\ncould think about was manju.

Original Text: まったく…　まんじゅうぐらいで\n【戦：たたか】うだなんて【前代未聞：ぜんだいみもん】です！
Translated Text: Seriously... Fighting over a\nmanju? That's unheard of!

Original Text: もっと【大事：だいじ】なもののために\n【戦：たたか】ってくださいよ…
Translated Text: Please fight for something\nmore important…

Original Text: たとえば【宝珠：ほうじゅ】とか…　ブツブツ…
Translated Text: Like, for example, a magic orb... Mumble, mumble...

Original Text: ビンゴ！
Translated Text: Bingo!

Original Text: ひーっ！\nいきなり【大声：おおごえ】でなんです！？
Translated Text:
Eek!
Why are you yelling all of a sudden!?

Original Text: 【袁家：えんけ】にも【代々：だいだい】【伝：つた】わる【宝珠：ほうじゅ】がある
Translated Text: The Yuan family also has a treasure pearl that has been passed down through the generations.

Original Text: その【宝珠：ほうじゅ】とお【札：ふだ】の【力：ちから】で\nある【恐：おそ】ろしい【怪物：かいぶつ】を【封印：ふういん】しているんだ
Translated Text: It’s sealing away a terrifying monster using\nthe power of that jewel and the talisman.

Original Text: 【吾輩：わがはい】たちは　つねに\nそのことを【気：き】にかけていたのだが…
Translated Text: We were always concerned\nabout that, but…

Original Text: 【最近：さいきん】　まったく【様子：ようす】を【見：み】てねえ\nまんじゅうで　【頭：あたま】がいっぱいだったからな
Translated Text: Lately, my head’s been\ncompletely filled with those\nmanju I haven’t checked on at all.

Original Text: もし　だれかがワザと…
Translated Text: If someone were to deliberately...

Original Text: お【二方：ふたかた】の【目：め】を　まんじゅうに\n【向：む】けさせていたとすると…
Translated Text: If we assume that both of them had\ntheir eyes fixed on the manju…

Original Text: た　【大変：たいへん】ダニ！
Translated Text: Oh, man, mites!

Original Text: しどろもどろ【陶謙：とうけん】！\nすぐに【怪物：かいぶつ】の【様子：ようす】を【見：み】てくるのだ！
Translated Text:
Touken, you're all flustered!
Go check on the monster
right away!

Original Text: え　その　あ　はい…
Translated Text: Uh... well... uh... yeah...

Original Text: ミーたちも【急：いそ】ぐダニ！
Translated Text: We're in a hurry, too, Dani!

Original Text: 【礼：れい】を【言：い】わせてくれ\nもし　お【主：ぬし】たちがいなければ【今頃：いまごろ】…
Translated Text: Let me just say thank you—if it\nweren't for you guys, by now I'd be...

Original Text: 【団々坂：だんだんざか】は\nどんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】のものになっていた
Translated Text: Dandan-zaka had become the\nproperty of Dondoro Ri Ju.

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】に【助：たす】かった！　【礼：れい】は【何：なに】がいい？\nなんでも【言：い】ってくれ！
Translated Text:
That really helped! What
would you like as a thank-you?
Just let me know!

Original Text: …じゃあ　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をくれダニ！
Translated Text: …Well then, give me the gem, you louse!

Original Text: アナタ！\n【袁家：えんけ】の【秘宝：ひほう】をそんなあっさりと…
Translated Text:
Hey, you! How could you just give away
the Yuan family's treasure so easily…

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】か…　よかろう
Translated Text: A jewel, huh... All right, then.

Original Text: あっさり…
Translated Text: That was quick…

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】は【倒：たお】したしな\nそれに…
Translated Text: We've already taken down Li\nRu, after all. And besides...

Original Text: 【故郷：こきょう】に【帰：かえ】るのに【必要：ひつよう】なんだろ？\nえんりょしないで　【持：も】ってけよ
Translated Text:
You need this to go back home, right?
Don't be shy—just take it.

Original Text: 【助：たす】かるダニ！
Translated Text: Thanks, Tani!

Original Text: 【袁家：えんけ】は【仲：なか】なおりしたし\nこれで　みんな【解決：かいけつ】ダニ！
Translated Text: The Yuan family has made up, so\neverything’s all sorted out now!

Original Text: いえ…\nそうとも【限：かぎ】りません…
Translated Text:
Well... that's
not necessarily true...

Original Text: 【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】をして…\nどうしたダニ？
Translated Text:
You're looking so serious... What's
wrong, Dani?

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の【後頭部：こうとうぶ】が\nなぜかじんわり【熱：あつ】いんです…
Translated Text: For some reason, the back\nof my head feels warm...

Original Text: これは…\n【不吉：ふきつ】なことが【起：お】こる【前触：まえぶ】れかも…！
Translated Text:
This might be... a sign that something
bad is about to happen...!

Original Text: あー　それはきっと\nホカホカあんこのせいダニ！
Translated Text: Ah, that must be because of the\npiping-hot red bean paste, Dani!

Original Text: さっき　まんじゅうを【食：た】べた【時：とき】に\n【手：て】が　あんこまみれになって…
Translated Text: A little while ago, when I was\neating a manju, my hands got\ncovered in red bean paste…

Original Text: テメェ…　【人：ひと】の【頭：あたま】を\nハンカチ【代：が】わりに【使：つか】うんじゃねえ！
Translated Text: You... Don't use people's\nheads as handkerchiefs!

Original Text: いやー　【袁家：えんけ】の【人：ひと】たちは\n【本当：ほんとう】に【太：ふと】っ【腹：ぱら】ですね！
Translated Text: Wow, the Yuan family sure is generous!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だけでなく　【団々坂：だんだんざか】も\n【自由：じゆう】に【使：つか】っていいらしいです！
Translated Text: It seems you're free to use not only the\nJewel but also Dandan-zaka as well!

Original Text: これで　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達軍：ちゅうたつぐん】は\nさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】と【団々坂：だんだんざか】をゲット！
Translated Text: With this, the Usapyon Zhongda Army\nhas taken over the Sakura Residential\nDistrict and Dandan Slope!

Original Text: このまま【行：い】けば\nさくら【国：こく】の【統一：とういつ】も【夢：ゆめ】では…
Translated Text: If things keep going this way,\nthe unification of Sakura Country\nmight not be just a dream...

Original Text: どうしたダニ？\nいきなり【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】で【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【見：み】つめて…
Translated Text:
What's up, Dani? Why are you
suddenly staring at the jewel with
such a scary look on your face...

Original Text: おなかでも【痛：いた】いダニ？

No!
I was just thinking about
the power of this gem!

I'm starting to get a little...

So what's going to

What's going to happen to this world, Dan?

Then don't even mention it, you

The remaining orbs are probably...

Hero No. 1

Hero No. 2!
The Blue Warrior Yo-kai, Full of Guts!

Genius Strategist… Do I have to fight

Yes! Of course!
That goes without saying!!

The Awesome Warrior Yo-kai!
The Blue Warrior Yo-kai!
And Usapyon Zhongda!

Original Text: ノンノンノン！

I'm super excited, Bear!
The Age of the Three
Kingdoms is finally here!

The USA Pyeong Nak-dal
Army… Looks like

Translated Text: If you want to learn more about\nCao Cao and Xun Yu, click here!

Original Text: 【領地：りょうち】と【宝珠：ほうじゅ】…\nだれにも　【渡：わた】さないよ

My territory and my
gem... I won't let anyone

That's... a barrier!
The enemy's pretty good, isn't it...

Translated Text: But don't worry—I've got this. I figured\nsomething like this might happen...

Original Text: スーパーデラックスドリル！\n【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】のレビューも【高評価：こうひょうか】！
Translated Text:
Super Deluxe Drill!
It’s getting rave reviews on

Translated Text: Well then, I'm off!

Original Text: うわあああん！\n２【秒：びょう】で【壊：こわ】れやがったー！
Translated Text:
Waaah!
It broke in two seconds!

Original Text: あ　お【客：きゃく】さんダニ？
Translated Text: Oh, is that a customer, Dani?
…Huh?

Original Text: アナタは…オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】！\nたしか　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【軍師：ぐんし】では！？

You're... Orochi Zhou Yu!
Aren't you that military strategist from
*Monge* who's a warrior-Yo-kai!?

Translated Text:
Wait, wait, wait... An enemy!?
Genius Strategist—I'll
figure something out, Dani!!

Translated Text:
Hey—hey! Don't use
me as a human shield!!

Translated Text: Hmph… Don’t panic. I didn’t\ncome here to fight today.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】たちと　【協力：きょうりょく】して\nあの【結界：けっかい】をやぶらないか？
Translated Text: Why don't you work with us to\nbreak through that barrier?

Original Text: （この【声：こえ】…！！！　もしかして…！？）
Translated Text: (That voice…!!! Could it be…!?)

Original Text: いい【返事：へんじ】を【待：ま】っている
Translated Text: I'm waiting for a positive response.

Original Text: さて　どうするダニ…
Translated Text: So, what are you going to do, Dani…

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】いわく…\nオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【提案：ていあん】に【乗：の】りましょう
Translated Text:
According to Whisper
Kongming… Let’s go along with
Orochi Zhou Yu’s proposal.

Translated Text: The surefire way to win a three-way\nbattle is to “watch from the sidelines”!

Original Text: ふたつの【国：くに】がつぶしあうのを【待：ま】ち\nおいしいところをいただく！
Translated Text: Wait for the two countries to destroy each\nother, then take the best parts for myself!

Original Text: 【結界：けっかい】を【張：は】った　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪軍：ぶしょうようかいぐん】は\n【今：いま】まさに「【高：たか】みの【見物：けんぶつ】」【状態：じょうたい】！
Translated Text: The blue warrior-Yo-kai army, having\nset up a barrier, is now simply sitting\nback and watching from above!

Original Text: これを【許：ゆる】してはなりません！
Translated Text: We must not allow this!

Original Text: ？\nどうかしましたか？
Translated Text:
?
Is something wrong?

Original Text: すごいダニ！\n【今：いま】はじめて【天才：てんさい】と【思：おも】ったダニ！
Translated Text:
What an amazing tick! This is the
first time I've ever thought
a tick was a genius!

Translated Text:
…Is this your first time?
…You’ve been a genius for a
long time now…

Original Text: じゃあ　さっそく\nもんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】に【会：あ】いにいくダニ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's go meet those\nawesome warrior Yo-kai right away!

Original Text: ああ　そんな【気軽：きがる】に…\nいちおう　【敵地：てきち】は【敵地：てきち】なんですから！
Translated Text:
Oh, come on—don't be
so casual about it... After
all, enemy territory is enemy territory!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】もおともいたしますー！
Translated Text: I'll come along, too!

Original Text: （オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…！）
Translated Text: (Orochi Zhou Yu…!)

Original Text: （まちがいないダニ！\nあの【声：こえ】は…　【夢：ゆめ】の【中：なか】で【聞：き】いた【声：こえ】…！）
Translated Text:
(It's definitely Dani!
That voice... the voice
I heard in my dream...!)

Translated Text: (I'm sure Orochi Zhou\nYu will be a big help!)

Original Text: さて　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【国：くに】に\nやってきたダニ！
Translated Text: Well then, Danni has arrived in\nthe land of the Monge military\ncommanders and Yo-kai!

Translated Text: I'd like to say, "Glad you came," but\nthings have gotten way beyond that.

Translated Text: For more details, please ask my lord’s\nyounger brother, Komajiro Sun Quan.

Translated Text:
Hey, Komajiro Sun Quan
wig! How's it going,
wig?!

Translated Text: My big brother just wandered\noff somewhere, man!

Translated Text: You're quite a free-spirited\nmonarch, aren't you…

Translated Text:
Please, Zura! I want you to find my big
brother, Zura!

Original Text: この【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をあげるから\n【協力：きょうりょく】してほしいズラ！
Translated Text: I'll give you this gem,\nso please help me out!

Original Text: ええ！？　いいダニ？
Translated Text: What!? Good ticks?

Translated Text: As long as my big bro's\nokay, that's all that matters!

Translated Text:
Got it, Dani!
Leave it to me, Dani!

Translated Text:
(That said…
I have absolutely no clues… Dan…)

Translated Text: (Oh well, Dani... I'll talk it over with\nthe genius strategist later, Dani.)

Translated Text: To show my gratitude for\nyour cooperation, let me\ndedicate a song to you…

Translated Text: They say Orochi Zhou Yu has the best\nmusical taste in the whole country!

Translated Text: Oh, so it's a tick?

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんも　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【曲：きょく】を\nいつも【楽：たの】しく【聴：き】いてたズラ…
Translated Text: My older brother always enjoyed\nlistening to Orochi Zhou Yu's songs, too...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃんとオロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】は\n【最高：さいこう】の…　ともだちズラ！
Translated Text: My brother and Orochi Zhou Yu are\nthe best… *pretending to be friends*!

Original Text: そう！　そのとおりだクマ！
Translated Text: That's right! You're absolutely right, Bear!

Original Text: も　もんげー！？
Translated Text: What the...!?

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】らの【友情：ゆうじょう】は\n【断金：だんきん】の【交：まじ】わりって【言：い】われてるクマ！
Translated Text: People say their friendship is as\nstrong as a bond of gold, Bear!

Original Text: ちなみに　【劉備：りゅうび】と【孔明：こうめい】は\n【水魚：すいぎょ】の【交：まじ】わりと【言：い】われてるクマ！
Translated Text: By the way, Liu Bei and Kongming are\nsaid to be as close as fish and water!

Original Text: ミーなんか　この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】と\n【水：みず】と【油：あぶら】の【交：まじ】わりダニ…
Translated Text: As for me, I just don't get along\nwith this genius strategist at all...

Translated Text: That's right! If I'm clear water, then\nthose USA Pyon guys are stagnant oil.

Translated Text: It's a relationship where we don't just\ncross paths—we actually repel each other!

Original Text: テメー…！
Translated Text: You...!

Original Text: あの～　【他国：たこく】まで【来：き】て\nケンカしないでほしいズラ…
Translated Text: Um... I really wish you guys\nwouldn't get into fights when\nyou're in another country...

Original Text: 「【g】「【妖怪：ようかい】パッドアプリ「【音楽：おんがく】」【e】」を【入手：にゅうしゅ】しました
Translated Text: "【g】I got the 'Yo-kai Pad:【e】 Music' app."

Translated Text: It's a miracle you made it\nthis far unscathed… Hero

Translated Text:
Orochi Zhou Yu…! So
you really were the one back then…!

Translated Text: That's right.

Translated Text: Why... did you bring\nme to this world, Dani?

Translated Text: It's because I thought you were the\none who could save us from this crisis.

Translated Text:
That is why I showed them the
dream of this country… and led
them to this book.

Translated Text:
A crisis... is that like a war between
countries, Dani?

Translated Text:
No, something bigger... No,
I'd better not say that right now.

Original Text: 【思：おも】わせぶりダニ…
Translated Text: That teasing tick…

Translated Text: Any ordinary Yo-kai would have been\ndefeated by the time they got here.

Translated Text: But you performed even\nbetter than I had imagined.
