Translated Text:
Keep it up... I'll keep doing
my part, too.

Original Text: ミーは…　いまだに\nいろいろ【納得：なっとく】できないダニ…
Translated Text: Me... I'm still a tick who can't quite\nwrap my head around a lot of things...

Original Text: でも…\nここまできたら【退：ひ】けないダニ！
Translated Text:
But… there’s no turning back
now, Dani!

Original Text: 【協力：きょうりょく】するダニ！\nこの【国：くに】のためにがんばるダニ！
Translated Text:
Ticks that help out!
Ticks that work hard for this country!

Original Text: さすが【英雄：えいゆう】　だな
Translated Text: He really is a hero.

Original Text: でも　もう【本：ほん】の【中：なか】は\nノーサンキュー　ダニ！
Translated Text: But no thanks to the book anymore, Dani!

Original Text: もし　【今度願：こんどねが】いをかなえてくれるのなら…\n【宇宙：うちゅう】に【行：い】ってみたいダニ！
Translated Text:
If you're going to grant me a
wish this time... I'd love to go to
space, Dani!

Original Text: フッ…　【考：かんが】えておこう
Translated Text: Hmm... I'll have to think about that.

Original Text: 【先：さき】ほど【住民：じゅうみん】から【連絡：れんらく】が【入：はい】った
Translated Text: I just received a call from a resident.

Original Text: 【小学校：しょうがっこう】で【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を【見：み】たという\n【行：い】ってくれるか？
Translated Text: Can you believe someone said\nthey saw a white warrior-like\nYo-kai at an elementary school?

Original Text: 【白：しろ】い…？\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】がまたサボって【遊：あそ】んでたダニ？
Translated Text:
White…?
Was that the genius strategist slacking off
and playing around again, you little pest?

Original Text: 【人聞：ひとぎ】きの【悪：わる】いことを\nおっしゃいますね…
Translated Text: That's a bit rude of you to say...

Original Text: この【大事：だいじ】な【時：とき】に\n【私：わたくし】がぶらぶら【遊：あそ】ぶとお【思：おも】いで？
Translated Text: Do you think I'd just be hanging\naround and playing at a time like this?

Original Text: 【小学校：しょうがっこう】で【飼：か】われているような\nきゃわいい　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンなら　ともかく！
Translated Text: Well, if it's one of those cute USA\nbunnies you see at elementary\nschools, that's a different story!

Original Text: テメー！\nそっちこそ【知：し】ったかぶり【軍師：ぐんし】のくせにー！
Translated Text:
You!
You're the one acting like
some know-it-all strategist!

Original Text: ンだと！？　コラァ～！！
Translated Text: What?! Hey, you!!

Original Text: 【我：わ】が【主：あるじ】も【白：しろ】いんだ…　ふたりとも\n【早：はや】く　【小学校：しょうがっこう】に【行：い】ってくれないか…
Translated Text: My master is white, too... I wish they'd\nboth go to elementary school already...

Original Text: ハ　ハハ…　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…\nちょっと　ふざけただけダニ…
Translated Text:
Ha, ha, ha… Orochi Zhou Yu…
I was just messing around a
little, you know…

Original Text: す　すぐに【行：い】きますから\nそんな【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】をなさらないで…　ね
Translated Text: I'll go right away, so please\ndon't look so scared... okay?

Original Text: 【見：み】てください！\n【武将妖怪同士：ぶしょうようかいどうし】が　もめているようです！
Translated Text:
Look!
It looks like some warrior
Yo-kai are having a fight!

Original Text: このよくわからん【木：き】のゴミを\n【池：いけ】に【投：な】げたのは　お【主：ぬし】かー！
Translated Text: So it was you who threw this weird\npiece of wood into the pond, was it?!

Original Text: あ　あれは…　【私：わたくし】の【木像：もくぞう】ー！？
Translated Text: W-Wait... Is that... my wooden statue!?

Original Text: そして　こちらからは…　\nまた　あのクマがー！？
Translated Text:
And from this side… That
bear again—!?

Original Text: 【孔明：こうめい】の【木像：もくぞう】の【話：はなし】…\n【聞：き】きたいクマね？
Translated Text:
The story about the wooden
statue of Kongming…
You want to hear it, don’t you, Bear?

Original Text: とにかく　この【木像：もくぞう】を【池：いけ】に【投：な】げこめば\n【願：ねが】いがかなうって【聞：き】いたニャン！
Translated Text: Anyway, I heard that if you throw\nthis wooden figurine into the pond,\nyour wish will come true, meow!

Original Text: だから　どんどん【投：な】げるニャン！\nオレっち　【早：はや】く【帰：かえ】りたいニャン！
Translated Text:
So keep throwing 'em, meow!
I wanna go home soon, meow!

Original Text: や　やめてー！\nそんなにドボドボ【落：お】とさないでー！
Translated Text:
No, stop it! Don't let it drip all over
like that!

Original Text: （あれは…！\n【図書室：としょしつ】で【見：み】た【妖怪：ようかい】ダニ！）
Translated Text:
(That's...!
The Yo-kai mite I saw in the library!)

Original Text: おのれ～！\nいい【加減：かげん】にせんかー！
Translated Text:
Damn it! Give it
a rest already!

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nあの【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をやっつけるダニ！
Translated Text:
Genius Strategist! The Mite That Defeats
That Warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: わかってます！
Translated Text: I know!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】の　かわいい【像：ぞう】を【池：いけ】に【捨：す】てる\n【不良妖怪：ふりょうようかい】なんて【成敗：せいばい】してやりますよ！
Translated Text: I'm going to teach that delinquent\nYo-kai a lesson for throwing my\ncute statue into the pond!

Original Text: そんな【像：ぞう】は　どうでもいいダニ！\nあの【大：おお】きな【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をやっつけるダニ！
Translated Text:
I don't care about a statue like
that, Mite! I'm going to take down
that giant warrior Yo-kai, Mite!

Original Text: なんですとー！？
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: おかげで【助：たす】かったニャン…\nありがとニャン…
Translated Text:
You really saved me, meow…
Thanks, meow…

Original Text: あのあと…　オレっち\nそりゃあもう【大変：たいへん】な【目：め】にあったニャン
Translated Text: After that… I really went\nthrough a rough time, meow.

Original Text: それで…　ウィスパーの【木像：もくぞう】に\nヤツあたりしてしまったニャン…
Translated Text: So... I accidentally hit that guy with\nthe wooden statue of Whisper...

Original Text: その【気持：きも】ち…\nよくわかるダニ
Translated Text:
I
totally get how you feel, Dani.

Original Text: ミーの【場合：ばあい】\nラッキーなことに…
Translated Text: In Mii's case, luckily...

Original Text: 【最初：さいしょ】に【会：あ】った【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちが\nみんな【親切：しんせつ】だったダニ！
Translated Text: All the warrior Yo-kai I met\nat first were so kind, Dani!

Original Text: その【後：あと】も　いい【仲間：なかま】に【出会：であ】えて\nなんとか　がんばってるダニ！
Translated Text: Since then, I've met some great\nfriends, and I'm doing my best, Dani!

Original Text: ひとりで【心細：こころぼそ】いんだったら\nミーと　いっしょに【来：く】るダニ？
Translated Text: If you're feeling lonely on your own,\nwhy don't you come with me, Dani?

Original Text: いいニャンか！？
Translated Text: Is that okay, kitty!?

Original Text: もちろんダニ！\nえっと…　【名前：なまえ】は…？
Translated Text:
Of course, it's a tick!
Um... what's its name...?

Original Text: ここでは\nジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】って【呼：よ】ばれてるニャン！
Translated Text: Here, I'm called Jibanyan Liu Bei!

Original Text: まあ…\nよくわからないんですけど…
Translated Text:
Well... I'm not
really sure...

Original Text: ミーは【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\nよろしくダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm from the USA, guys!
Nice to meet you, guys!

Original Text: ミーも\n【最初：さいしょ】はよくわかんなかったダニ…
Translated Text: At first, I didn't really\nunderstand it either, Dani...

Original Text: でも　【最近：さいきん】になって　\nこの【名前：なまえ】がまあまあ【好：す】きになってきたダニ！
Translated Text: But lately, I've actually started to\nlike this name pretty well, Dani!

Original Text: あのーおふたりとも\nお【取：と】りこみ【中：ちゅう】すいません
Translated Text: Um, I'm sorry to bother you\nboth while you're busy.

Original Text: つられたろう【丸甘寧殿：まるかんねいどの】の\n【怒：いか】りが【収：おさ】まらないんですが…
Translated Text: Tsurataroumaru—Lord Gan\nNing’s anger just won’t subside…

Original Text: なぜワシが【池：いけ】にゴミを【捨：す】てたヤツに\n【負：ま】けねばならんのじゃー！
Translated Text: Why the heck do I have to lose to the\nguy who threw trash in the pond?!

Original Text: ごめんニャン！\nどうか　ゆるしてほしいニャン！
Translated Text:
I'm sorry, meow!
Please forgive me, meow!

Original Text: ミーからも　お【願：ねが】いダニ！\nこいつ　めちゃくちゃ【反省：はんせい】してるダニ！
Translated Text:
I'm asking you, too, Danni!
This guy is really, really sorry, Danni!

Original Text: しょうがない　ゆるしてやろう\nワシも【少々：しょうしょう】　【気：き】が【立：た】っとったからの
Translated Text: Oh well, I'll let it slide. I was a\nlittle on edge myself, after all.

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】たちの【前：まえ】にも\n【池：いけ】に【物：もの】を【捨：す】てるヤツがおったんじゃ…
Translated Text: There were people who threw\nthings into the pond even\nbefore you guys came along…

Original Text: たしか【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】じゃったが…\n【燃：も】えかけのぶっそうな【物：もの】を【捨：す】ておってのう…
Translated Text:
I'm pretty sure he was a white
warrior-Yo-kai... but he just tossed
away something that was still
smoldering and looked like
it was about to explode...

Original Text: 【投：な】げ【返：かえ】して　【池：いけ】をキレイにした【瞬間：しゅんかん】に\nお【主：ぬし】たちに【木像：もくぞう】を【投：な】げこまれて…
Translated Text: Just as I threw it back and\ncleaned up the pond, you guys\nthrew wooden statues at me…

Original Text: 【頭：あたま】にきてしまった
Translated Text: I got really mad.

Original Text: 【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】！？\nそいつはどこに【行：い】ったダニ？
Translated Text:
A white Yo-kai warrior!?
Where the heck did that guy go?

Original Text: たしか\n【正天寺：しょうてんじ】のほうに【向：む】かっていったぞ
Translated Text: I'm pretty sure he\nheaded toward Shoten-ji.

Original Text: 【急：いそ】ぎましょう！\nきっと　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】さんです！
Translated Text:
Let's hurry!
It's definitely a super-awesome
warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: 【待：ま】て！　【行：い】く【前：まえ】にバツとして\n【池：いけ】のゴミをひとつ【持：も】っていけ！
Translated Text: Wait! Before you go, as a penalty, pick\nup one piece of trash from the pond!

Original Text: その【玉：たま】が　【池：いけ】の【底：そこ】でずっとチカチカ\n【光：ひか】るせいで　【少：すこ】しも【眠：ねむ】れやしない
Translated Text: Because that orb keeps flickering at the\nbottom of the pond, I can't sleep a wink.

Original Text: こ　これはー！
Translated Text: W-Wow!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】ダニ！\nまさかの【展開：てんかい】ダニー！
Translated Text:
The Jewel Mite! What an
unexpected twist, Danny!

Original Text: 【見：み】てください！\n【白：しろ】い【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】が　ふたりいます！
Translated Text:
Look! There are two
white warrior Yo-kai!

Original Text: あ　ジバニャン！\nもんげー【会：あ】いたかったズラよ～！
Translated Text:
Ah, Jibanyan!
Man, I’ve really missed you!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: オレっちのことを【知：し】ってるから…
Translated Text: Because you know me...

Original Text: あっちの【小：ちい】さいのは\n【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】のコマさんニャン！
Translated Text: That little one over there is Komasan\nfrom our original world, meow!

Original Text: ってことは　【行方不明：ゆくえふめい】の\nコマじろう【孫権：そんけん】の【兄：あに】って…
Translated Text: So that means the missing Koma-jiro\nis Sun Quan's older brother...

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: もんげー！？\nでっけぇ【犬：いぬ】に　【食：く】われちまうズラー！
Translated Text:
Whoa! I'm gonna get eaten
by that huge dog!

Original Text: あの【小：ちい】さな【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…\n【助：たす】けてあげないとだめダニ！
Translated Text:
That little warrior Yo-kai… I’ve gotta
help him, man!

Original Text: ジバニャン【劉備：りゅうび】！\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してくれダニ！
Translated Text:
Jibanyan Liu Bei! Lend me your
strength, Dani!

Original Text: 【言：い】われなくても\nわかってるニャン！
Translated Text: I know that without being told, meow!

Original Text: あいつ…\nま　まだ【立：た】ち【上：あ】がってくるダニ！
Translated Text:
That guy... he's... he's
still getting back up, that pest!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: ひゃああああ！\n【特大：とくだい】のドクロ【爆弾：ばくだん】をかかえてます！
Translated Text:
Yaaaaaah! I'm holding a
giant skull bomb!

Original Text: オレっちのひゃくれつ【肉球：にくきゅう】で\nひるますニャン！
Translated Text: My lightning-fast paw pads\nwill make you flinch, meow!

Original Text: もんげぇぇぇぇ！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: オラが【火：ひ】をつけるズラ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna light this thing on fire!

Original Text: もんげ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】はミーの\nレーザーガン！　ダニーー！
Translated Text: Last but not least, Mii's laser gun! Danni—!

Original Text: いっけええええええダニー！
Translated Text: Go, go, go, Danny!

Original Text: もんげーー！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: やりましたね！\nお【三方：さんかた】　すばらしい【戦：たたか】いぶりです！
Translated Text:
Way to go!
All three of you put up a fantastic fight!

Original Text: いやあ　それほどでもないズラ
Translated Text: Nah, it's not really that big of a deal.

Original Text: 【余裕：よゆう】だったニャン！
Translated Text: That was a piece of cake, meow!

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】もゲットできたし\nこれでめでたし　めでたし…
Translated Text: I got the jewel, too, so\nall's well that ends well...

Original Text: じゃないダニーーー！
Translated Text: No, it's not a tick!

Original Text: ど　どうしました？
Translated Text: Wh—what's wrong?

Original Text: もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nうっかり【倒：たお】してしまったダニ…
Translated Text: Dani, who accidentally defeated\na massive warrior Yo-kai…

Original Text: …？　ああああっ！
Translated Text: …? Aaaah!

Original Text: それが【何：なに】か【問題：もんだい】ニャン？
Translated Text: Is there a problem with that, meow?

Original Text: ミーたちは　もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【連：つ】れて【帰：かえ】る【約束：やくそく】をしたダニ…
Translated Text: We promised to bring back that\ncrazy warrior Yo-kai, you know…

Original Text: もんげー【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【勢力：せいりょく】は\nきっと　【我：われ】らをゆるさないでしょう
Translated Text: The forces of those crazy warrior\nYo-kai will surely never forgive us.

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！　こういう【時：とき】こそ\nいい【手：て】を【考：かんが】えるダニ！
Translated Text: A genius strategist! This is exactly\nthe kind of situation where Dani\ncomes up with a brilliant move!

Original Text: ここは…　のるかそるか！\nすり【替：か】わりの【計：けい】しかございません！
Translated Text:
This is... do or die! Our only option is
a switch!

Original Text: そこのアナタ！
Translated Text: Hey, you over there!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】からアナタは【孫策：そんさく】！\nコマさん【孫策：そんさく】です！
Translated Text:
Starting today, you're Sun Ce!
Komasan Sun Ce!

Original Text: もんげー！？
Translated Text: No way!?

Original Text: 【見：み】た【目：め】が【全然：ぜんぜん】ちがうダニ！
Translated Text: A tick that looks completely different!

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】！　【白：しろ】ければ　\nきっと　わかりませんって！
Translated Text: It's okay! If it's white, they\ndefinitely won't notice!

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: ひええええっ！\nまたよみがえったダニ！？
Translated Text:
Eeeeeek!
That tick came back to life again!?

Original Text: もんげー！　もんげー！
Translated Text: Whoa! Whoa!

Original Text: コマさん！\nあいつ　なんて【言：い】ってるダニ？
Translated Text:
Komasan!
What's that guy saying, Dani?

Original Text: 「そんなことで　ごまかせるか\n　ドあほう【軍師：ぐんし】…」
Translated Text: "Do you really think you can pull\nthat off, you total idiot strategist…?"

Original Text: 「【自分：じぶん】の【国：くに】に【帰：かえ】るズラ！」\nと【言：い】ってるズラ！
Translated Text:
"Go back to your own country, Zura!" he's
saying, Zura!

Original Text: ドあほう…？\nひどい【言：い】われようでうぃす…
Translated Text:
What a moron…? That’s a pretty
harsh thing to say…

Original Text: まあまあ…\nとりあえず　【目的：もくてき】は【達成：たっせい】ダニ！
Translated Text:
Well, well... Anyway
, mission accomplished!

Original Text: マイティードッグ【孫策：そんさく】を\n【救：すく】ってくれて【感謝：かんしゃ】する
Translated Text: Thank you, Mighty Dog, for saving Sun Ce.

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】は　【急：きゅう】に「のるかそるか」と\n【思：おも】い【立：た】ち…
Translated Text: Suddenly, he decided it was "do or die"...

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【本拠地：ほんきょち】にひとりで\n【乗：の】りこみたくなったらしい
Translated Text: It seems he felt like storming the\nenemy's stronghold all by himself.

Original Text: もともと【勇：ゆう】かんな【将：しょう】だったが…\nちょっと【無謀：むぼう】すぎたな…
Translated Text:
He was a brave general to
begin with… but he was a
little too reckless…

Original Text: （こっちの【世界：せかい】でも「のるかそるか」が\n【流行：はや】ってるダニ？）
Translated Text: (Is "all or nothing" a trend\nin this world too, Dani?)

Original Text: （ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】もそんなこと【言：い】ってたし\nなんだか　【気：き】になるダニ…）
Translated Text: (Whisper Kongming said\nsomething like that, too, so I\ncan't help but wonder about it...)

Original Text: さて…　それでは\nお【前：まえ】たちの【言：い】う　【青：あお】き【武将妖怪軍：ぶしょうようかいぐん】…
Translated Text: Well then… So, this “Blue General\nYo-kai Army” you’re talking about…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【結界：けっかい】を　やぶるため\nさくせんを【考：かんが】えよう
Translated Text: Let's come up with a strategy\nto break through the Cao Cao\narmy's barrier at Fuyunyan.

Original Text: 【結界：けっかい】をやぶるには…　\nウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】　どうするべきか？
Translated Text:
To break through the barrier… Whisper
Kongming—what should we do?

Original Text: へっ？
Translated Text: Huh?

Original Text: あの【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせん…　\n【私：わたし】はすでに　この【紙：かみ】に【書：か】いてある
Translated Text:
A strategy to break through that barrier...
I've already written it down
on this piece of paper.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】と【同：おな】じ【意見：いけん】なのか\n【確：たし】かめたいのだ
Translated Text: I just want to make sure you agree with me.

Original Text: よよよよよ　よいでしょう！\nさらさらっと…！
Translated Text:
Yoyoyoyo—That's great!
Just like that...!

Original Text: それ　さっきミーが【鼻：はな】をかんだ\nチリ【紙：かみ】ダニよ…？
Translated Text: Wait... isn't that the tissue\ndust mite from when Mii blew\nher nose a little while ago...?

Original Text: シャラーーップ！
Translated Text: Shut up!

Original Text: では　ふたり【同時：どうじ】に【見：み】せよう
Translated Text: Well then, let's show them both at the same time.

Original Text: そう…　【火：ひ】だ！
Translated Text: Yeah... Fire!

Original Text: （よかったー！\n【本当：ほんとう】によかったー！）
Translated Text:
(Phew!
That's a relief! I'm so glad!)

Original Text: （【妖怪通販：ようかいつうはん】で【買：か】った\n【透：す】けるコンタクトをつけておいて…！）
Translated Text: (I’ll make sure to wear the\nsee-through contacts I bought\nfrom the Yo-kai online store…!)

Original Text: （だーかーらー…\n【何：なに】に【使：つか】うつもりだったダニ…？）
Translated Text:
(So... what were you planning to
use that tick for...?)

Original Text: …だが　【今：いま】　【火：ひ】を【使：つか】っても\n【私：わたし】たちが　【燃：も】えるだけ
Translated Text: …But even if we used fire\nnow, it would only burn us.

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【方角：ほうがく】…
Translated Text: Fu Nyang, in the direction of Cao Cao's army…

Original Text: 【東南：とうなん】の【方向：ほうこう】に【風：かぜ】をふかせ　\n【火：ひ】の【玉：たま】を【飛：と】ばす【必要：ひつよう】がある
Translated Text: You need to make the wind blow toward\nthe southeast and launch a fireball.

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…　お【前：まえ】は\n【不可能：ふかのう】を【可能：かのう】にする【男：おとこ】と【聞：き】いた
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming… I’ve heard you’re the\nman who makes the impossible possible.

Original Text: いや～　やっと　【私：わたくし】のことを\nわかってくれる【方：かた】に【出会：であ】えましたね！
Translated Text: Wow—I finally met someone\nwho really understands me!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】のまわりの【連中：れんちゅう】ときたら　この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】を\nまったく【尊敬：そんけい】してないものですから～
Translated Text: The folks around me, though—they\ndon't have the slightest bit of\nrespect for this genius strategist~

Original Text: うるさいダニ！
Translated Text: Noisy mites!

Original Text: ならば\n【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】をふかせてくれるな？
Translated Text: In that case, why don't you\nlet the southeast wind blow?

Original Text: 【当然：とうぜん】です！\nそんなの【簡単：かんたん】…　え？　えええー？
Translated Text:
Of course!
That's easy... Huh? What?!

Original Text: どーしましょ～！？\nもし【東南：とうなん】の【風：かぜ】が　ふかなかったら…
Translated Text:
What should we do~!?
What if the southeast wind doesn't blow…

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】は　【処刑：しょけい】だそうです～！
Translated Text: Apparently, I'm going to be executed!

Original Text: ま…　【妖怪：ようかい】だから\n【処刑：しょけい】されても【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】ダニ？
Translated Text: Well... since I'm a Yo-kai, it's\nokay if I get executed, right?

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】じゃありませんってば！\nこうなりゃ【意地：いじ】でも【風：かぜ】をふかせますよ！
Translated Text:
I'm telling you, it's not okay!
At this point, I'll make the
wind blow no matter what!

Original Text: でも　どうするニャン？\n【風向：かぜむ】きを【変：か】えるなんて【大変：たいへん】ニャン…
Translated Text:
But what should we do, meow?
Changing the wind direction
is such a hassle, meow…

Original Text: お【待：ま】ちください…\nめいそうに【入：はい】ります…
Translated Text: Please wait... I'm going to meditate...

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】が【目：め】をつぶって\nなんか　ぶつぶつ【言：い】ってるズラ！
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming has his\neyes closed and is muttering\nsomething under his breath!

Original Text: ポクポクポク…\nチーーン！　ひらめいた！
Translated Text:
Tap, tap, tap…
Ding! I’ve got it!

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】に【関係：かんけい】する【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の\n【力：ちから】を【借：か】りるんです！
Translated Text: We'll enlist the help of\na wind-related Yo-kai!

Original Text: ふぁあああ～　なるほど～\nそれは　いい【考：かんが】えダニ～
Translated Text: Waaah~ I see~ That's a great idea, Danni~

Original Text: …あくびをしなーい！\nアナタたちにも【手伝：てつだ】ってもらいますよ
Translated Text:
…Don't yawn!
I'm counting on you guys to help out, too.

Original Text: えーー　なんでミーが？\nこれを【頼：たの】まれたのは　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ダニ？
Translated Text:
Wait—why me? Wasn't
this supposed to be for
"Genius Strategist Dani"?

Original Text: いや　もちろん　【私：わたくし】ひとりでも\nその　なんとかなりますが…
Translated Text: Well, of course, I could probably\nmanage it on my own, but…

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】に　【手柄：てがら】を【立：た】てられるのは　アナタ…\nくやしいのでは？　くやしいでしょう？
Translated Text:
You're the one who gets to take the
credit... Doesn't that make you feel
frustrated? You must be frustrated, right?

Original Text: まったく…\nすなおに【助：たす】けて　と【言：い】えばいいダニ…
Translated Text:
Seriously... he should just
say, "Please help me," Dan...

Original Text: 【言：い】えません！\n【口：くち】がさけても【言：い】えませんーっ！
Translated Text:
I can't say it! I'd rather my
mouth split open than say it—!

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ないダニ…\nついていってあげるダニ！
Translated Text:
Oh well, I guess I'll just
go along with it!

Original Text: はい！　【話：はなし】は【決：き】まり！\n【風：かぜ】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしに【行：い】きますよ！
Translated Text:
Okay! It's settled!
Let's go find the Wind General Yo-kai!

Original Text: やあやあ　どうもどうも
Translated Text: Hey there, hey there. Thanks, thanks.

Original Text: そこにいるのは\n【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さんではないですか？
Translated Text: Isn't that Tengu Ma Su over there?

Original Text: そうだが…\n【貴様：きさま】　いったい【何者：なにもの】だ？
Translated Text:
That's true... but who the hell are you
?

Original Text: あやしい【者：もの】じゃございません！\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text:
I'm not a suspicious character!
I'm just looking for a
warrior-Yo-kai who can control
the wind…

Original Text: 【断：ことわ】る
Translated Text: Decline

Original Text: ほんのちょっとだけ！\nちょっと【手伝：てつだ】ってもらうだけですから…
Translated Text:
Just a little bit!
I just need you to help me out a little…

Original Text: お【断：ことわ】りだ
Translated Text: No way.

Original Text: こまったズラね…
Translated Text: That's a tough one...

Original Text: 【天狗：てんぐ】だけに\n【態度：たいど】がてんぐニャン
Translated Text: Just like a tengu, his\nattitude is "tengu-nyan."

Original Text: なんだと？
Translated Text: What?

Original Text: わーー！　【今：いま】のなし！\n【今言：いまい】ったことは　【忘：わす】れてくださ…
Translated Text:
Whoa! Never mind that!
Please forget what I just said…

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！\nここで　さくせんは【必要：ひつよう】ないダニ！
Translated Text:
Whisper, Kongming!
We don't need a strategy here, Danni!

Original Text: 【口：くち】で【言：い】ってもダメなら\n【力：ちから】ずくで　わからせてやるダニーー！
Translated Text: If talking doesn't work, I'll make\nyou understand by force, you jerk!

Original Text: ほう　このオレとやろうってか？\n【面白：おもしろ】い…　かかってこい！
Translated Text:
Oh, so you want to take me on?
That's interesting... Bring it on!

Original Text: フン　なかなかやるな…\n【仕方：しかた】ない　【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもいいぞ
Translated Text:
Hmph... Not bad...
I guess I have no choice.
I'll lend you a hand.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございますー！\nおかげで　【結界：けっかい】もなんとかできそうですー！
Translated Text:
Oh, thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I think I'll be able
to set up the barrier after all!

Original Text: ただ　そんな【大風：おおかぜ】…\nオレだけじゃ【力不足：ちからぶそく】だ
Translated Text:
But with winds that
strong… I can't handle it on
my own.

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】の【力：ちから】…\nもっと【集：あつ】めたほうがいいかもな
Translated Text:
The power of the wind-controlling
warrior-Yo-kai… Maybe I should gather
more of it.

Original Text: でも　まったく\n【手：て】がかりがないニャン…
Translated Text: But I don't have a single clue, meow...

Original Text: だったら　ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】に\n【会：あ】いにいけ
Translated Text: In that case, go see the immortal Zaci.

Original Text: 【仙人：せんにん】！\nなんだか【物知：ものし】りそうニャン！
Translated Text:
Sage!
You seem like you know a lot, meow!

Original Text: あの【仙人：せんにん】なら　【貴様：きさま】らに\nきっと【道：みち】を【示：しめ】してくれるはずだ
Translated Text: That hermit will surely show you the way.

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】さん　ありがとズラ！
Translated Text: Tengu Ba Su, thanks a bunch!

Original Text: よーし　そうと【決：き】まれば…
Translated Text: All right, now that it's decided...

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈：せんにんさじ】のとこへ\nレッツゴー　ダニ！
Translated Text: Let's go see the immortal Zazi! Dani!

Original Text: みなさん…　【私：わたくし】のためにそこまで…\nやはり【持：も】つべき【者：もの】は　ともだち…！
Translated Text:
Everyone… Going to such
lengths for me… Friends
really are the best thing in life…!

Original Text: って　あれ？　ちょっとー！\n【私：わたくし】を【置：お】いていかないでー！
Translated Text:
Wait... Huh? Hey! Don't leave
me behind!

Original Text: フフフ…　お【主：ぬし】たちの【願：ねが】いは\nすでに　もうわかっておる
Translated Text: Heh heh heh… I already know\nwhat you’re wishing for.

Original Text: そこの【白：しろ】いの…\nお【主：ぬし】の【命：いのち】が　かかっておるのじゃろ？
Translated Text:
That white thing over there…
Your life depends on it, doesn't it?

Original Text: さっすが【仙人様：せんにんさま】！\nそれでは【私：わたくし】を【助：たす】けてくださ…
Translated Text:
As expected of you, Sage!
Well then, please help me…

Original Text: ダル～～～ん\nめんどうくさそうだから　お【断：ことわ】りじゃ
Translated Text: Ugh... that sounds like\na hassle, so I'll pass.

Original Text: え…！？　そんなーーっ！
Translated Text: Huh…!? No wayyyy!

Original Text: ただ…ワシを【楽：たの】しませることができたら\n【力：ちから】を【貸：か】してやってもよいぞ
Translated Text: But… if you can entertain me,\nI might just lend you a hand.

Original Text: さて　どうする？
Translated Text: So, what should we do?

Original Text: やります！　【楽：たの】しませます！\nおもに　この【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】が！
Translated Text:
We're going to do it! We're
going to entertain you!
Mainly these USA Pyon buddies!

Original Text: テ　テメー！
Translated Text: You... you bastard!

Original Text: ほっほっほ\nでは…　【楽：たの】しませてもらおうかのう！
Translated Text: Ho ho ho... Well then... I\nsuppose I'll have some fun!

Original Text: なんじゃ　ワシみたいに　【首：くび】を【飛：と】ばしたり\nツルやヒツジに【化：ば】けたりはできんのか
Translated Text: What's the deal? Can't you do stuff\nlike me—like making your head fly off\nor turning into a crane or a sheep?

Original Text: ！！　そんなことができるのは\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】だけでうぃすー！
Translated Text: !! Only a sage can do\nsomething like that, you know!

Original Text: …まあ　お【主：ぬし】らの【必死：ひっし】なさまは\n【面白：おもしろ】かった
Translated Text: …Well, it was funny to see\nyou guys trying so hard.

Original Text: 【願：ねが】いをかなえてやろう
Translated Text: I'll make your wish come true.

Original Text: あ　ありがとうございます！
Translated Text: Oh, thank you!

Original Text: じつは　【我：われわれ】々\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をさがしてまして…
Translated Text: Actually, we're looking for a\nmilitary commander-type Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind…

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐうばしょく】さん【以外：いがい】に\n【仙人様：せんにんさま】は　ご【存知：ぞんじ】ないかと…
Translated Text: I was wondering if you knew of any\nother immortals besides Tengu Ba Su...

Original Text: …かぜカモ【劉琦：りゅうき】に\n【会：あ】いにいくがいい
Translated Text: …Go on, go see Liu Qi, the “Wind Duck.”

Original Text: おお！　ではその【方：かた】が\n【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】…！？
Translated Text: Wow! So that person is a warrior-Yo-kai\nwho controls the wind…!?

Original Text: ほっほっほ…\nそれは【行：い】けば　わかるじゃろうて
Translated Text:
Ho ho ho… Well, you’ll
find out once you get
there, won’t you?

Original Text: ひとまか【仙人左慈様：せんにんさじさま】！\nこのご【恩：おん】は【一生：いっしょう】　【忘：わす】れません！
Translated Text:
Master Zici, the One-Eyed
Immortal! I will never forget
this kindness for the rest of my life!

Original Text: かぜカモ【劉琦殿：りゅうきどの】！\nお【願：ねが】いがあって【参：まい】りました！
Translated Text:
Lord Liu Qi of Kazekamo!
I’ve come to ask you for a favor!

Original Text: かぜカモ…\n【手：て】みじかに　お【願：ねが】いね
Translated Text:
A cold, maybe...
Just a quick favor, okay?

Original Text: …というわけで
Translated Text: …So,

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】をあやつる【強力：きょうりょく】な【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\nさがしてます！
Translated Text: I'm looking for a powerful warrior-Yo-kai\nwho can control the wind!

Original Text: アナタ　【知：し】ってますよね？
Translated Text: You know that, right?

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】を【操：あやつ】る？　ボクはみんなを\n【風邪：かぜ】っぽくするだけカモ
Translated Text: Control the wind? Maybe I just\nmake everyone feel like they're\ncoming down with a cold.

Original Text: ニャンと…！　\nそれって　まさか…
Translated Text:
Wow...
! Could it be...

Original Text: 【風：かぜ】じゃなくて\n「【風邪：かぜ】」を【操：あやつ】る【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】ってことダニ？
Translated Text: So he's a military\ncommander-Yo-kai who controls\n"colds" rather than the wind, right?

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】さん…\nかわいそうズラ…
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming... Poor guy...

Original Text: あ　あ　あのジジイーーーーっ！\nテキトーなこと【教：おし】えやがって～！！
Translated Text:
"Hey... hey... you old geezer!!!
How dare you teach me such
nonsense~!!"

Original Text: て　【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】！\nしょうがないダニ！
Translated Text:
What a genius strategist!
Oh well, you little pest!

Original Text: とりあえず\n【今：いま】の【戦力：せんりょく】でなんとかするダニよ！
Translated Text: For now, let's just make do\nwith the team we have, Dani!

Original Text: 【人：ひと】ごとだと【思：おも】って！　このままだと…\n【私：わたくし】　【処刑：しょけい】ですよ　しょ・け・い！
Translated Text:
Don't act like this has nothing to
do with you! If things keep going
like this... I'm going to be
executed. E-x-e-c-u-t-i-o-n!

Original Text: 【天狗馬謖：てんぐばしょく】の【力：ちから】を【借：か】りれば\n【風：かぜ】は【起：お】こせるニャン！
Translated Text: With Tengu Ba Su's help, I can\nmake the wind blow, meow!

Original Text: そうズラ！\n【後：あと】はオラたちがなんとかするズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right! We'll take care of
the rest!

Original Text: そんなこと【言：い】ったって\nどうにもなりませーん！　うわーん！
Translated Text: Saying that won't change a thing! Waaah!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！
Translated Text: Whisper, Kongming!

Original Text: ミーのライバルは…　こんなピンチに\n【負：ま】けるようなヤワな【男：おとこ】じゃないダニ！
Translated Text: Mee's rival is... Dani—he's not some\nwimp who'd lose in a crisis like this!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…！
Translated Text: USA, Pyong, Nakata…!

Original Text: そ　そうですね\n【私：わたくし】は　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】！
Translated Text: Yeah, that's right. I'm Whisper Kongming!

Original Text: このピンチ　【天才的：てんさいてき】なひらめきで\n【切：き】り【抜：ぬ】けてみせまうぃす！
Translated Text: I'm going to get us out of this\ntight spot with a stroke of genius!

Original Text: では　さっそく　【帰：かえ】って\n【結界：けっかい】をやぶる　さくせんをねりましょう！
Translated Text: Well then, let's get right to it and come up\nwith a plan to break through the barrier!

Original Text: あの～
Translated Text: Um...

Original Text: アナタはお【呼：よ】びじゃありません！
Translated Text: You're not invited!

Original Text: …【一応：いちおう】　ついていくカモ
Translated Text: …I guess I'll go along with it.

Original Text: ボクの【結界：けっかい】をやぶるなんて…\n【少：すこ】しは　デキる【連中：れんちゅう】みたいだね
Translated Text:
To break through my barrier...
Looks like you guys are pretty
capable, don't you?

Original Text: でも　まだまださくせんはある\n【安心：あんしん】してよ　フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】
Translated Text: But I still have plenty of strategies up my\nsleeve, so don't worry, Fu Nyang Cao Cao.

Original Text: ばっふぅぅう～～～ん…！
Translated Text: Baaaaaahhh~~~!…!

Original Text: なっ！？\nフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！？
Translated Text:
What!?
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操軍：そうそうぐん】の【動：うご】きが\n【活発：かっぱつ】になってきた
Translated Text: Fu Nyang: Cao Cao's army\nhas become more active.

Original Text: …【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】\nヤツらの【狙：ねら】いは　お【前：まえ】の【宝珠：ほうじゅ】だ
Translated Text: …Those USA guys—Pyon and his\ncrew—are after your treasure orb.

Original Text: まさか…！？
Translated Text: No way…!?

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】は【今：いま】まで\nそんな【野心：やしん】を【見：み】せていなかった
Translated Text: Fuyunian Cao Cao had never\nshown such ambition before.

Original Text: だが　【宝珠狩：ほうじゅが】りに【反対：はんたい】した\nキュウビ【荀彧：じゅんいく】を【牢：ろう】に【入：い】れたらしい
Translated Text: However, it seems he had\nKyuubi Jun Iku, who opposed the\njewel hunt, thrown into prison.

Original Text: ヤツは【本気：ほんき】だ\nこれは【全面戦争：ぜんめんせんそう】になる…
Translated Text: He's serious. This is\ngoing to be all-out war...

Original Text: ここはミーにまかせるダニ！
Translated Text: Leave this to me, Dani!

Original Text: どこに【行：い】くつもりだ？
Translated Text: Where are you going?

Original Text: 【敵：てき】の【目的：もくてき】がミーの【宝珠：ほうじゅ】なら\nひとりで【会：あ】いにいくダニ！
Translated Text: If the enemy's goal is Mee's Orb,\nI'll go face them alone, Dani!

Original Text: ……【何：なに】をカッコつけている
Translated Text: ……Why are you trying to act so cool?

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】に【今：いま】\nくたばってもらっては【困：こま】るんだ
Translated Text: I can't have the hero dying right now.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】たちも【協力：きょうりょく】する
Translated Text: We'll help, too.

Original Text: オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】…
Translated Text: Orochi Zhou Yu…

Original Text: りゅーくん【劉虞：りゅうぐ】たちも\n【忘：わす】れてもらっちゃ【困：こま】るのだ！
Translated Text: You can't just forget about\nRyu-kun, Liu Yu, and the others!

Original Text: メラメラ　メラメラ！\n（オレたちも【当然：とうぜん】　【行：い】くぜ！）
Translated Text:
Fire, fire!
(Of course we're going too!)

Original Text: 【死：し】ぬ【時：とき】は…　【一緒：いっしょ】だぜ！
Translated Text: When we die… we'll be together!

Original Text: みんな…
Translated Text: Everyone…

Original Text: まったく…\nすなおに【助：たす】けて　と【言：い】えばいいのです
Translated Text:
Seriously... you should just ask for help
straight out.

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ないですねぇ…\n【私：わたくし】も　ついていってあげますよ！
Translated Text:
I guess there's no helping
it... I'll go with you, too
!

Original Text: 【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】…
Translated Text: Stratège de génie…

Original Text: こっちのともだちも\n【悪：わる】くないニャンね？
Translated Text: My friends over here aren't\nso bad, are they, meow?

Original Text: もんげー\nステキな【関係：かんけい】ズラ！
Translated Text: What an awesome relationship!

Original Text: …みんな　ありがとうダニ！\nもう【少：すこ】しだけ【力：ちから】を【借：か】りるダニ！
Translated Text:
…Thanks, everyone!
I'm going to need a little more help!

Original Text: じゃあ　【行：い】くダニ！\n【目指：めざ】すはフユニャン【曹操：そうそう】ダニ！
Translated Text:
Alright, let's go, Dani!
Our target is Fu Nyang Cao Cao, Dani!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\n【決着：けっちゃく】をつけるダニ！
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!
Let's settle this, Dani!

Original Text: フフフ…でふー！
Translated Text: Hehehe… Phew!

Original Text: げっ！\nいきなりゲップとは　【失礼：しつれい】ダニ！
Translated Text:
Yikes!
Burping right off the bat?
That's rude, you little bug!

Original Text: ち　ちがうニャン！
Translated Text: N-No, that's not it, meow!

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】の【体：からだ】…\nみるみる【大：おお】きくなってるニャン！
Translated Text:
Fuyunyan Cao Cao's body...
it's getting bigger right
before my eyes, meow!

Original Text: わわわわー！
Translated Text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!

Original Text: でふ～！\nデカニャン【曹操：そうそう】でふ～！
Translated Text:
Defu~!
It's Big Cat Cao Cao, defu~!

Original Text: もんげーー！　オラのお【母：かあ】ちゃんみたいに\nデッカくなっちまったズラ～！！
Translated Text: Whoa! This wig's gotten\nas huge as my mom!!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】～！\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【全部：ぜんぶ】くれでふ～！
Translated Text:
Hey, Usapyon Zhongda~! Give me all the
jewels, please~!

Original Text: や　やったダニ…
Translated Text: Oh, those pesky ticks…

Original Text: デカニャン【曹操：そうそう】が\nしぼんでいくニャン！
Translated Text: Big Cat Cao Cao is shrinking, meow!

Original Text: …\nオレはいったい【何：なに】を…
Translated Text:
…What on earth
am I…

Original Text: フユニャン【曹操：そうそう】！\nどうやら【正気：しょうき】に【戻：もど】ったみたいだね
Translated Text:
Fu Nyang Cao Cao!
Looks like he's come to his senses.

Original Text: これで【一件落着：いっけんらくちゃく】ズラ！
Translated Text: That settles it, then!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: ついに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】が　【全部集：ぜんぶあつ】まったニャン！\nさっそく【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】るニャーン！
Translated Text:
I've finally collected all the orbs, meow!
I'm heading back to my original
world right away, meow!

Original Text: そうズラね！\nきっと　みんな【心配：しんぱい】してるズラ！
Translated Text:
That's right!
I'm sure everyone's worried!

Original Text: でも…　いざ【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【使：つか】うとなると\nなんか　ちょっと…
Translated Text: But… when it actually comes to\nusing the jewel, I’m kind of…

Original Text: いや～　ついにお【帰：かえ】りですね？\n【悲：かな】しくて…　【悲：かな】しくて…
Translated Text:
Wow... You're finally
coming home, aren't you?
I'm so sad... so sad...

Original Text: 【笑：わら】いが【止：と】まりましぇーん！
Translated Text: I just can't stop laughing!

Original Text: テメー…　【最後：さいご】まで～！
Translated Text: You... all the way to the end!

Original Text: ですが　アナタほどのケンカ【相手：あいて】は\nもう　【見：み】つけられないかもしれませんね…
Translated Text: But I might never find another\nsparring partner quite like you…

Original Text: ごきげんよう\n【我：わ】がライバル　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達殿：ちゅうたつどの】！
Translated Text: Hello there, my rival, Mr.\nPyon Nakata of the USA!

Original Text: ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…
Translated Text: Whisper Kongming…

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！\n【体：からだ】には　【気：き】をつけるのだ！
Translated Text:
Hey, Pyong Nakata in the USA!
Take care of yourself!

Original Text: さよならは【言：い】わないっス！\nきっと　また【会：あ】えるっスから！
Translated Text:
I'm not saying goodbye!
I'm sure we'll meet again!

Original Text: うん…　そうダニね！
Translated Text: Uh-huh… Yeah, mites!

Original Text: ミー…　あっちでも\nかしこくて【強：つよ】い【男：おとこ】になるダニ！
Translated Text: Me... I'm going to become a smart\nand strong guy over there, too, Dani!

Original Text: メラメラ…　メラメラ！\n（どこに【行：い】っても…　ともだちだ！）
Translated Text:
Blaze... Blaze!
(No matter where I go... you're my friend!)

Original Text: ブラザー！\nオレたちのこと　【忘：わす】れんなよ！
Translated Text:
Bro!
Don't forget about us!

Original Text: わかってるダニ！\n【三人：さんにん】の【誓：ちか】いは　えいえんダニ！
Translated Text:
We know, Dani!
Our trio's vow is eternal, Dani!

Original Text: 【結局：けっきょく】　お【主：ぬし】への【借：か】り\n【返：かえ】すことができなんだな…
Translated Text: So, in the end, I wasn't\nable to pay you back...

Original Text: もうケンカしねえから\nそれで【勘弁：かんべん】してくれ
Translated Text: I won't fight anymore, so\nplease cut me some slack.

Original Text: ＯＫダニ！
Translated Text: OK, Danni!

Original Text: まんじゅうは　つぶあんも\nこしあんも　どっちでも　でりしゃすダニ！
Translated Text: Manju—whether it's with coarse-grained\nred bean paste or smooth red bean\npaste—is delicious either way!

Original Text: じゃあ…みんな！\nミーたち　そろそろ【行：い】くダニ！
Translated Text:
Well then… everyone!
We're about to head out!

Original Text: ジバニャン！　コマさん！
Translated Text: Jibanyan! Komasan!

Original Text: ズラ！　いよいよ\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】にお【祈：いの】りをするズラね！
Translated Text: Zura! It's finally time to\npray to the jewel, Zura!

Original Text: ふたりとも　どうやって【祈：いの】るか　\nちゃんと　おぼえてるニャン？
Translated Text: Do you two still remember\nhow to pray properly, meow?

Original Text: えーっと…\nいでよ　【神様：かみさま】！
Translated Text:
Um... Come
forth, God!

Original Text: オレっちたちの【願：ねが】い…
Translated Text: Our wish…

Original Text: かなえたまえ！　ズラーー！！
Translated Text: Make it happen! Zuuuuu!!

Original Text: も　もんげー…
Translated Text: Wow...

Original Text: そ　【空：そら】に【島：しま】が…\n【浮：う】かんでるニャン……！
Translated Text:
Wha—there's an island...
floating in the sky, meow...!

Original Text: あははははは！
Translated Text: Hahahahahaha!

Original Text: 【見：み】るダニ！\nあいつら　【戻：もど】ってきたダニッ
Translated Text:
Look at those ticks!
They're back, man!

Original Text: キミたち　ぽかーんとしてるね…\nま　ムリもないか…
Translated Text:
You guys look kind of dumbfounded…
Well, I guess I can’t blame you…

Original Text: 【説明：せつめい】してやるしかないっしょ\nよーく【聞：き】いておけよ！
Translated Text: I guess I'll just have to explain\nit to you. Listen carefully!

Original Text: この『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』は\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】が【作：つく】り【出：だ】した【本：ほん】！
Translated Text: This *Yo-kai Sangokushi* is a\nbook created by King Enma!

Original Text: もんげー！！！
Translated Text: Whoa!!!

Original Text: 【強大：きょうだい】な【力：ちから】を【持：も】ちすぎた　ボクら【兄弟：きょうだい】を\n【封：ふう】じ【込：こ】めるためにね
Translated Text: To seal away us brothers, who\nhad become far too powerful...

Original Text: 【自力：じりき】で【出：で】たいと【思：おも】ってたんだけど　さすがは\nエンマ【大王：だいおう】の【本：ほん】　そう【簡単：かんたん】にはいかなかった
Translated Text: I was hoping to get out on my own,\nbut—as you’d expect from a book\nby King Enma—it wasn’t that easy.

Original Text: でもよ　【長：なが】～い【時間：じかん】がたったせいか\n【最近：さいきん】　【封印：ふういん】の【力：ちから】が【弱：よわ】まってるんだ！
Translated Text: But you know what? Maybe because so\nmuch time has passed, the power of the\nseal has been getting weaker lately!

Original Text: その【証拠：しょうこ】に…\nオレたちの【妖気：ようき】　【本：ほん】の【外：そと】に【出：で】てたっしょ？
Translated Text:
As proof of that…
our demonic energy was
leaking out of the book, right?

Original Text: まさか…　それで\nイナホが　【変：へん】になったダニか…？
Translated Text: No way... So that's the tick\nthat made Inaho go crazy...?

Original Text: ご【名答：めいとう】！
Translated Text: That's the right answer!

Original Text: もう　この【本：ほん】に\nボクらを【抑：おさ】え【続：つづ】ける【力：ちから】はないんだ
Translated Text: This book no longer has\nthe power to hold us back.

Original Text: そんな【今：いま】なら…\n【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めて【祈：いの】れば…
Translated Text:
If I do it now… if I gather the
orbs and pray…

Original Text: 【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】に\n【出：で】られると【思：おも】ってね
Translated Text: I thought I'd be able to go\nout into the world, you see

Original Text: ニャニャニャ…\nそうなったら　【大変：たいへん】ニャン…！
Translated Text:
Meow, meow, meow…
If that happens, it’ll be
a real mess, meow…!

Original Text: なんとか１【個集：こあつ】めたんだけど\nだれかさんに　ジャマされてねえ…
Translated Text: I managed to collect one, but\nsomeone got in the way...

Original Text: イカカモネ【議長董卓：ぎちょうとうたく】…\n【知：し】ってるっしょ？
Translated Text:
Chairman Dong Zhuo of the Ikakamone...
You know who he is, right?

Original Text: あいつに【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めてもらおうと\n【思：おも】ったのに…　くそっ…
Translated Text: I was counting on him to collect\nthe orbs for me... Damn it...

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【時：とき】も\nやってくれたね…
Translated Text: They did that for Li Ru in\n"Dondoro" too, didn't they…

Original Text: どんどろ【李儒：りじゅ】の【妖気：ようき】で【宝珠：ほうじゅ】の【力：ちから】が\n【弱：よわ】まって　いけると【思：おも】ったら…
Translated Text: Li Ru's demonic aura was gradually\nweakening the power of the jewel, and\njust when I thought I was about to make it...

Original Text: 【宝珠：ほうじゅ】をかっさらわれた…
Translated Text: The jewel was stolen...

Original Text: だから　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…
Translated Text: So, you guys in the USA...

Original Text: キミたちが【宝珠：ほうじゅ】を【集：あつ】めるのを【待：ま】って\nまとめてうばおうと【思：おも】ってさ
Translated Text: I was planning to wait for you\nguys to collect the orbs so I\ncould steal them all at once.

Original Text: さあ　のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nもちろん　するっしょ？
Translated Text:
Alright, it's a do-or-die showdown!
Of course you're in, right?

Original Text: なんで　そうなるダニーー！？
Translated Text: Why does it turn out like that, Danii!?

Original Text: やっぱり　そうだよね…　でも…\nこの【勝負：しょうぶ】…
Translated Text:
I guess that’s how it is… But…
this match…

Original Text: へへっ\n【強制的：きょうせいてき】に　【受：う】けてもらうからな
Translated Text: Heh heh... I'm going to\nmake you take it, you know.

Original Text: じゃあ　おたがい　がんばろう\nはあ…　【早：はや】く【終：お】わるといいな…
Translated Text: Well then, let's both do our best.\nSigh... I hope this ends soon...

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】にビッグボスが【出現：しゅつげん】し\n【暴：あば】れまわっているようです！
Translated Text: It looks like Big Bosses are appearing\nall over the place and running amok!

Original Text: ノルカ【軍：ぐん】がさくら【住宅街：じゅうたくがい】と【団々坂：だんだんざか】を\n【攻：せ】めており…
Translated Text: The Norka Army is attacking the Sakura\nResidential District and Dandan-zaka…

Original Text: ソルカ【軍：ぐん】がおつかい【横丁：よこちょう】と\nさくら【中央：ちゅうおう】シティをこうげき【中：ちゅう】です
Translated Text: The Solka Army is currently attacking\nOtsukai Yokocho and Sakura Central City.

Original Text: まず　そいつらを【倒：たお】すダニ！
Translated Text: First, let's take down those guys, Dani!

Original Text: せっかくここまで\nみんなで【戦：たたか】ってきたダニ！
Translated Text: We've all fought so hard\nto get this far, Dani!

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】の【最後：さいご】に　この【国：くに】を\n【見捨：みす】てるわけにはいかないダニよ！
Translated Text: At the very last moment, I can't\njust abandon this country, Dani!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…
Translated Text: Usapyon Zhongda…

Original Text: ミーはエーユー！\nみんなのために【戦：たたか】うダニ！
Translated Text:
"I'm AU! I'm a tick fighting for
everyone!"

Original Text: ノルカやソルカが【外：そと】に【出：で】る【前：まえ】に\nやっつけてやるダニ！
Translated Text: I'm gonna take care of those ticks\nbefore Norka and Solka go outside!

Original Text: さあ　もう【一回：いっかい】\nさくら【国：こく】の【平和：へいわ】を【取：と】りもどすダニ！
Translated Text: Come on, let's restore peace to\nSakura Country once again, Dani!

Original Text: なんダニ？\nもう【戦：たたか】いは【始：はじ】まってるダニよ！
Translated Text:
What's up, Mite? The battle's
already started, Mite!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】…\n【今度：こんど】の【相手：あいて】はヤバすぎるニャン…
Translated Text:
Usapyon Zhongda… Our
next opponent is way too tough, meow…

Original Text: オラも　おっかねぇズラ…\n【戦：たたか】う【勇気：ゆうき】が【出：で】ないズラ…
Translated Text:
Man, this is scary... I just
can't find the courage to
fight...

Original Text: ふたりとも…\nなに【言：い】ってるダニ！！
Translated Text:
You
two… What the heck
are you talking about?!

Original Text: オレっちたちは\nこの【世界：せかい】の【妖怪：ようかい】じゃないニャン
Translated Text: We're not Yo-kai from this world, meow.

Original Text: そこまで　がんばる【必要：ひつよう】\nあるのかニャン？
Translated Text: Do I really have to try that hard, meow?

Original Text: たしかに【最初：さいしょ】は　ミーも\nどーでもいいと【思：おも】ったダニ
Translated Text: It's true—at first, even I\ndidn't care about that tick.

Original Text: あの【時：とき】は　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】にもどることで\n【頭：あたま】が　いっぱいだったからダニ…
Translated Text: Back then, my mind was completely\nfocused on getting back to my\noriginal world, so, Dani…

Original Text: でも…
Translated Text: But…

Original Text: この【世界：せかい】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】にいっぱい【会：あ】って\nいっぱい【助：たす】けられて…
Translated Text: I've met so many military\ncommanders and Yo-kai in this world,\nand they've helped me so much...

Original Text: ミー…　この【国：くに】のみんなのこと\n【大好：だいす】きになったダニ！
Translated Text: Me... I've come to love\neveryone in this country, Dani!

Original Text: そして　この【国：くに】のエーユーになりたいと\n【本気：ほんき】で【思：おも】ったダニ！
Translated Text: And then, Dani seriously decided she\nwanted to become an AU in this country!

Original Text: でも…　ここでオラたちが\n【倒：たお】れちまったら…
Translated Text: But… if we were to go down right here…

Original Text: 【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】のともだちには\n【会：あ】えなくなるズラよ？
Translated Text: I guess I won't be able to see my friends\nfrom my old world anymore, huh?

Original Text: イナホ…
Translated Text: Inaho…

Original Text: でも…！　きっとイナホも\nミーと【同：おな】じことをするはずダニ！
Translated Text: But…! I'm sure Inaho would do\nthe same thing as Mee, too!

Original Text: イナホは　ブッとんでるけど…\nまっすぐで【強：つよ】い【心：こころ】を【持：も】ってるダニ！
Translated Text:
Inaho might be a little crazy... but
she's a tough kid with a strong,
honest heart!

Original Text: わかったニャン\nオレっちも【一緒：いっしょ】に【戦：たたか】うニャン！
Translated Text: Got it, meow! I'll fight\nalongside you, meow!

Original Text: オレっち　いつも\n【修行：しゅぎょう】でトラックと【戦：たたか】ってるニャン！
Translated Text: I'm always battling trucks as\npart of my training, meow!

Original Text: よく【考：かんが】えたら　アイツら【怖：こわ】くないニャン！\nトラックのほうが　よっぽど【怖：こわ】いニャン！
Translated Text:
Come to think of it, those
guys aren't scary at all, meow!
Trucks are way scarier, meow!

Original Text: オラも…\nせいいっぱい　やるズラ！
Translated Text:
I'm gonna... give it my all
, too!

Original Text: コマじろうもきっと…
Translated Text: Komajiro must surely...

Original Text: 「【兄：にい】ちゃん　もんげー！」って\nよろこんでくれるズラよ！
Translated Text: "Big bro, this is awesome!"—that's\nthe kind of reaction I get!

Original Text: みんな！　【行：い】くダニよ！
Translated Text: Hey, everyone! Let's go!

Original Text: オレっちたちのすごさ　ノルカとソルカに\nわからせてやるニャン！
Translated Text: We're gonna show Noruka and Solka\njust how awesome we are, meow!

Original Text: ズラズラー！
Translated Text: Whoosh!

Original Text: ビッグボス【全員：ぜんいん】　やっつけたダニ！
Translated Text: I took down all the Big Bosses, Danni!

Original Text: みなさん　お【見事：みごと】です！
Translated Text: Way to go, everyone!

Original Text: ノルカの【島：しま】とソルカの【島：しま】への【道：みち】が\n【開：ひら】けましたよー！
Translated Text: The path to Norka Island and\nSolka Island is now open!

Original Text: ダニー！\n【今：いま】こそ【突：つ】っこむダニー！
Translated Text:
Danny!
Now's the time to go for it, Danny!

Original Text: あいつら\nふっかつしてるダニよ！？
Translated Text: Those guys are back—seriously!?

Original Text: ええ！\nノルカとソルカは【双子：ふたご】…
Translated Text:
Really!
Norka and Solka are twins…

Original Text: 【一方：いっぽう】だけを【倒：たお】しても\n【片方：かたほう】さえ【無事：ぶじ】なら　ふっかつするのです！
Translated Text: Even if you defeat just one of\nthem, as long as the other\none is still alive, it will revive!

Original Text: テメー！\nそういうことは【早：はや】く【言：い】うダニー！
Translated Text:
Hey, you! You should've said
that sooner, Danny!

Original Text: （ベイダーモード！）
Translated Text: (Vader Mode!)

Original Text: わー！　タンマタンマ！\nちゃんと　さくせんを【教：おし】えますからー！
Translated Text:
Whoa! Hold on a sec!
I'll definitely teach you the strategy!

Original Text: ヤツらは【倒：たお】された【日：ひ】の\n【二日後：ふつかご】にふっかつします
Translated Text: They'll come back to life two\ndays after they're defeated.

Original Text: つまり！　【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】した【次：つぎ】の【日：ひ】に\nもう【一方：いっぽう】を【倒：たお】せば…
Translated Text: In other words! If you defeat one and\nthen defeat the other the very next day…

Original Text: …ふっかつしないダニね？
Translated Text: …So, these mites don't come back, right?

Original Text: そのとおりでうぃすー！
Translated Text: That's right, y'all!

Original Text: のるかそるかの【大勝負：おおしょうぶ】！\nミーたちの【勝：か】ちダニ！
Translated Text:
It's a do-or-die showdown!
We're gonna win, Mii and friends!

Original Text: やったニャン！\n【今度：こんど】こそ【本当：ほんとう】に【終：お】わりニャン！
Translated Text:
Yay, meow!
This time it's really over, meow!

Original Text: これで　【元：もと】の【世界：せかい】に【帰：かえ】れるズラね～！
Translated Text: So I guess I can go back to my original world now~!

Original Text: ん…？\nダ　ダ　ダ　ダ　ダニー！？
Translated Text:
Huh...?
Da... Da... Da... Da... Danny!?

Original Text: じ　【地震：じしん】ニャーン！
Translated Text: Oh no—an earthquake, meow!

Original Text: もんげー！\nし　【島：しま】がー　【島：しま】がー！
Translated Text:
Whoa!
The island—the island!

Original Text: お　【驚：おどろ】いてるヒマはないダニ！\nヤツらが【逃：に】げてしまうダニー！
Translated Text:
"No time to be surprised, Danni!
They'll get away, Danni!"

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: どうやら　ふたりは【合体：がったい】し\nノルカソルカとなったようです！
Translated Text: It looks like the two of them have\nmerged to become Norukasoruka!

Original Text: どんなヤツが【相手：あいて】でも\nオレっちたちは【怖：こわ】くないニャン！
Translated Text: No matter who we're up against,\nwe're not scared, meow!

Original Text: そうダニ！　ミーたちには\n【頼：たよ】れる【仲間：なかま】がいっぱいいるダニ！
Translated Text: That's right, Dani! We've got lots\nof friends we can count on, Dani!

Original Text: チーム『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』ズラ！
Translated Text: Team "Yo-kai Sangokushi"—Here We Go!

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】こそ　【最後：さいご】の【戦：たたか】いダニ！\nみんな　【気合：きあい】いれていくダニよ！
Translated Text:
This time for sure—it's
the final battle, guys!
Let's all give it our all, guys!

Original Text: まかせるニャーン！
Translated Text: Leave it to me, meow!

Original Text: いくズラよ～！
Translated Text: Let's go!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンめ～　こんな【超絶：ちょうぜつ】おもしろ【展開：てんかい】\nひとりで【楽：たの】しむなんて　ずるい　ずるい！
Translated Text: Usapyon~! It's so unfair to enjoy such\nan insanely funny plot twist all by\nyourself—that's so unfair, so unfair!

Original Text: そんなことを\n【言：い】っている【場合：ばあい】じゃないですよ！
Translated Text: This isn't the time to be\nsaying things like that!

Original Text: このままじゃ　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンさん\n【本：ほん】の【中：なか】から　【出：で】られません…
Translated Text: At this rate, I won't be able to\nget out of Usapyon's book...

Original Text: つまり【ＳＦ：エスエフ】【的：てき】に【言：い】えば…　\nこの【状態：じょうたい】は「タイムパラドックス」！
Translated Text:
In other words, in sci-fi terms… this
situation is a “time paradox”!

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンが　はるか【昔：むかし】の【中国：ちゅうごく】の\n【英雄：えいゆう】となったことにより…
Translated Text: Because USA Pyeong became\na Chinese hero from long ago…

Original Text: 【現代：げんだい】の【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョンの【存在：そんざい】が\n【消：き】えてしまう…　ということかしら？
Translated Text: Does that mean the modern-day\n"Usapyon" will cease to exist...?

Original Text: 【当：あ】たっているような　ちがうような…\nでも　そんな【感：かん】じかもしれません
Translated Text:
It feels like it might be
right... or maybe not... but
that might be the general idea.

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】！
Translated Text: Pas de panique !

Original Text: ワタシには\nこの【妖怪：ようかい】ウォッチがありまーす！
Translated Text: I have this Yo-kai Watch!

Original Text: それで　【呼：よ】び【出：だ】すつもりですか？\nはたして　うまくいくかどうか…
Translated Text:
So, are you planning to summon it?
I wonder if it'll actually work...

Original Text: 【遠：とお】くにいる【妖怪：ようかい】を【呼：よ】び【出：だ】すことができる\nということは…
Translated Text: The fact that you can summon\na Yo-kai from far away means...

Original Text: 【距離：きょり】だけでなく　【時空：じくう】を【越：こ】えられる【可能性：かのうせい】が\nないこともないのでは　と【考：かんが】えられるわけで
Translated Text: It’s reasonable to think that it might not\nbe entirely impossible to transcend not\nonly distance but also space and time,

Original Text: はあ…
Translated Text: Sigh…

Original Text: のるかそるか！
Translated Text: All or nothing!

Original Text: 【悩：なや】むより　やるべし！
Translated Text: Instead of worrying, just do it!

Original Text: ワタシのともだち！\n【出：で】てきて　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン！
Translated Text:
My friend!
Come on out, USA-pyon!

Original Text: 【妖怪：ようかい】メダル　セットオン！
Translated Text: Yo-kai Medals: Set On!
…!! A tick!?

Original Text: イ　イナホ…
Translated Text: I... Inaho...

Original Text: 【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン…
Translated Text: Usapyon…

Original Text: イナホー！　ありがとうダニー！
Translated Text: Inaho! Thanks, Danny!

Original Text: さっそくだが　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【君：くん】…\nワタシの【質問：しつもん】に【答：こた】えてもらおう
Translated Text:
Let's get right to it, Usapyon-kun...
I'd like you to answer
my question.

Original Text: へっ…？
Translated Text: Huh…?

Original Text: どうやって【本：ほん】に【入：はい】ったの？\nやっぱり　【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】のパワーとか？
Translated Text:
How did you get inside the book?
Was it some kind of alien power, after all?

Original Text: はっ…？
Translated Text: Huh…?

Original Text: ていうか　【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】に【会：あ】った？\n【目：め】は【大：おお】きかった？　ツヤツヤしてた？
Translated Text:
Wait, did you meet an alien? Did it have big
eyes? Was its skin shiny?

Original Text: すみずみまで　カイボウされた？\n【宇宙船：うちゅうせん】は？　やっぱアダムスキー【型：がた】？
Translated Text:
Was it thoroughly
examined? What about the
spaceship? Is it an Adamski-type after all?

Original Text: テメー…\n【少：すこ】しはミーのことを【心配：しんぱい】しろダニー！
Translated Text:
You... Show a little concern for
me, Danny!

Original Text: （ベイダーモード！）
Translated Text: (Vader Mode!)

Original Text: わわわわわ！\nごめんなさーい！
Translated Text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! I'm sooo
sorry!

Original Text: ゆるさんダニー！
Translated Text: I won't forgive you, Danny!

Original Text: やれやれ　【日常：にちじょう】がもどってきた\nって【感：かん】じですね…
Translated Text: Well, well... It feels like\neveryday life is back to normal...

Original Text: ふ～　【新：しん】ハンドメイドロケット…\nここまで　できたダニ
Translated Text:
Phew... My new handmade
rocket... I've gotten
this far, Dani.

Original Text: 【三国志：さんごくし】の【世界：せかい】を【冒険：ぼうけん】して…\nミーは　ひとかわむけた【気：き】がするダニ！
Translated Text:
After adventuring through the world of
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*…
I feel like I’ve really grown up a bit, Dani!

Original Text: なんでもトライする\n【勇気：ゆうき】をもらったダニ！
Translated Text: Dani gave me the courage to try anything!

Original Text: いつか　このロケットで【宇宙：うちゅう】に【行：い】って\n【三国志以上：さんごくしいじょう】の【冒険：ぼうけん】をしてみせるダニ！
Translated Text:
Someday, I'm going to go to space
in this rocket and have an
adventure even greater than
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*!

Original Text: さあ　【今日：きょう】はもう【少：すこ】し【進：すす】めるダニ…
Translated Text: Okay, let's make a little more progress today, Dani…

Original Text: がんばっているな
Translated Text: You're really giving it your all.

Original Text: ダニ！？　ゆ　【夢：ゆめ】の【声：こえ】ー！\nいや　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】！？
Translated Text:
A tick!? Yuu... the voice of a dream!
No, Orochi Zhou Yu!?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】に【礼：れい】を【言：い】いにきた
Translated Text: I came to thank you.

Original Text: なんダニ…\n【気：き】にしなくてダニ！
Translated Text:
What's a tick...
Don't worry about it!

Original Text: なんだかんだで…\nミーも　【楽：たの】しかったし！
Translated Text:
All things considered…
I had fun, too!

Original Text: …お【前：まえ】のために　とくべつな【本：ほん】を\n【図書室：としょしつ】に【用意：ようい】した
Translated Text: …I’ve set aside a special\nbook for you in the library.

Original Text: その【本：ほん】の【中：なか】に\nお【前：まえ】を【入：い】れてやろう
Translated Text: I'll put you in that book.

Original Text: もう【本：ほん】の【中：なか】はいいダニ…\nミーは　ロケット【作：づく】りでいそが…
Translated Text:
I'm done with books for now... Mii
is busy building a rocket...

Original Text: （でも　もし【宇宙：うちゅう】の【本：ほん】だったら…\nちょっと【入：はい】ってみたいような…）
Translated Text:
(But if it were a book about space…
I kind of feel like taking a peek inside…)

Original Text: 【気：き】が【変：か】わったようだな？
Translated Text: Looks like you've changed your mind, huh?

Original Text: ならば　【図書室：としょしつ】へ【急：いそ】ぐことだ…
Translated Text: In that case, I'd better hurry to the library…

Original Text: まあ…　【入：はい】るか【入：はい】らないかは\nその【本：ほん】を【見：み】て　【決：き】めるダニ！
Translated Text: Well... I'll decide whether to buy it or\nnot after I take a look at the book!

Original Text: ダニ！？　ふたりとも！\nどうして【図書室：としょしつ】に！？
Translated Text:
Mites!? Both of you!
What are you doing in the library!?

Original Text: なんとなく【気：き】になったニャン…
Translated Text: I don't know why, but it caught my attention, meow...

Original Text: オラもズラ！\nあの【本：ほん】を　また【読：よ】みたくなったズラよ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I’m itching to read that book again!

Original Text: （みんなはきっと…\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』を【見：み】にきたダニね）
Translated Text:
(I bet everyone...
came here to see *Yo-kai Sangokushi*.)

Original Text: （オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】の【言：い】ってた【本：ほん】って\nもしかして『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』…！？）
Translated Text: (Could the book Zhou Yu from Orochi was\ntalking about be *Yo-kai Sangokushi*…!?)

Original Text: （まさか…　【考：かんが】え【過：す】ぎダニね）
Translated Text: (No way... I'm just overthinking this, aren't I?)

Original Text: じゃあ　みんなで【読：よ】もうダニ！
Translated Text: Well then, let's all read it, guys!

Original Text: あったダニ！\n『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』！
Translated Text:
I found it!
"Yo-kai Sangokushi"!

Original Text: やっぱ　【面白：おもしろ】いズラね～
Translated Text: That wig really is funny, isn't it?

Original Text: オレっちたち\nこんな【冒険：ぼうけん】をしてきたんだニャン…
Translated Text: We've been on all kinds\nof adventures, meow...

Original Text: （きほん\nみんないい【妖怪：ようかい】だったダニが…）
Translated Text: (Even though most Yo-kai\nwere actually nice, the mites...)

Original Text: （やっぱ　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】だけは\n【文字：もじ】で【見：み】ても　【腹：はら】が【立：た】つダニ！）
Translated Text: (Man, even just seeing the name "Whisper\nKongming" in writing really pisses me off!)

Original Text: …【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン\nなんでそんな【怖：こわ】い【顔：かお】してるニャン？
Translated Text: …USA-Pyon, why are you making\nsuch a scary face, meow?

Original Text: もうすぐ【最後：さいご】の【場面：ばめん】ニャン！\n【感動：かんどう】のフィナーレ　【笑顔：えがお】で【見：み】ようニャン
Translated Text:
The final scene is coming up, meow! A
moving finale—let's watch
it with a smile, meow!

Original Text: 「かしこくて【強：つよ】い\nウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】とゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たちは」
Translated Text: "The Clever and Powerful Whisper\nKongming and His Fun-Loving Friends"

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】を【救：すく】って\nどこかへ【旅立：たびだ】っていった」
Translated Text: "He saved the Land of Sakura and then\nset off on a journey to someplace else."

Original Text: 「ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】とゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たちは\nさくら【国：こく】の【真：しん】の【英雄：えいゆう】であった…」
Translated Text: "Whisper Kongming and his\nmerry band were the true\nheroes of the Land of Sakura..."

Original Text: （ひどいダニ！\nミーたち　オマケあつかいダニ！！）
Translated Text:
(Those awful mites!
They treat us like we're
just some kind of bonus!!)

Original Text: （あああ～　【今：いま】すぐ　あいつを\nぶんなぐって　やりたいダニ！）
Translated Text: (Aaaah~ I just want to punch\nthat guy right now, you jerk!)

Original Text: まだ【続：つづ】きがあるみたいズラ\n【読：よ】んでみるズラね
Translated Text: Looks like there's more\nto come. I'll give it a read.

Original Text: 「だが…ゆかいな【仲間：なかま】たちは\n【再：ふたた】び【帰：かえ】ってきた」
Translated Text: "But... our merry band has\nreturned once again."

Original Text: 「さくら【国：こく】の\nもうひとつの【危機：きき】を【救：すく】うために」
Translated Text: "To Save Sakura Country\nfrom Yet Another Crisis"

Original Text: えっ！？
Translated Text: Huh!?

Original Text: も　もんげー！！
Translated Text: Wow, that's crazy!!

Original Text: ま　また『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に\n【吸：す】いこまれていくニャーンッ！
Translated Text: Oh no—I'm getting sucked back into\n*Yo-kai Sangokushi* again, meow!

Original Text: た　たしかに【今：いま】　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】を\nなぐりたいとは【思：おも】ったけどもー！
Translated Text: Well... I'll admit, I did just think I wanted\nto punch Whisper Kongming right now—!

Original Text: ミーの【願：ねが】いは　あいつに\n【会：あ】うことじゃないダニーッ！
Translated Text: "My wish isn't to see him, Danny!"

Original Text: う　【宇宙：うちゅう】～…！
Translated Text: Wow... the universe~...!

Original Text: やあ　みなさん\nまたお【会：あ】いしましたね…
Translated Text: Hey, everyone—nice to see you all again…

Original Text: ほかでもない　【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したのは\nこの　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】…
Translated Text: None other than this very\nWhisper Kongming was the\none who summoned him…

Original Text: テメー！！
Translated Text: You!!

Original Text: （ベイダーモード！）
Translated Text: (Vader Mode!)

Original Text: ひょえええええええ！
Translated Text: Whoa!

Original Text: ミーは【宇宙：うちゅう】に【行：い】きたかったダニ！\nテメーなんかに【会：あ】いたくなかったダニー！
Translated Text:
"I wanted to go to space,
you jerk! I didn't want to see you, Danny!"

Original Text: ジバニャン…\n【止：と】めねえでいいズラか？
Translated Text:
Jibanyan… You don't have to
stop me, do you?

Original Text: ま　【仲：なか】よくケンカしてるみたいだし\nほうっておいて【問題：もんだい】ないニャン
Translated Text: Well, it looks like they're having\na friendly fight, so it's fine to\njust leave them be, meow.

Original Text: ところで　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】\nなんでまた　オレっちたちを【呼：よ】んだニャン？
Translated Text: By the way, Whisper Kongming,\nwhy'd you call us again, meow?

Original Text: はあはあ…　みなさんのおかげで\n【確：たし】かにさくら【国：こく】に【平和：へいわ】が【訪：おとず】れたのですが…
Translated Text: Phew, phew… Thanks to all of you, peace\nhas indeed come to Sakura Country, but…

Original Text: 【各地：かくち】で　こまっている【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちの【姿：すがた】が\nいまだに【目撃：もくげき】されているのでうぃす！
Translated Text: There are still reports of troubled\nYo-kai being spotted all over the place!

Original Text: 【g】たのみごと【e】をしてくる\n【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】たちのことズラね
Translated Text: 【g】I'm talking about those military commander【e】\n【g】Yo-kai who come asking for favors【e】, right?

Original Text: もしやそれを\n【全部：ぜんぶ】ミーたちで【解決：かいけつ】しろと…
Translated Text: Are you seriously telling us to\nhandle all of that ourselves…?

Original Text: え～～～！！\nそれでわざわざ【呼：よ】び【出：だ】したニャン！？
Translated Text:
Whaaaat!! Is that
why you went out of your
way to call me over, Nyan!?

Original Text: 【仕方：しかた】ないダニ\n【天才軍師一人：てんさいぐんしひとり】じゃ　【何：なん】にも【解決：かいけつ】できないダニ
Translated Text: It can't be helped—Dani, the\ngenius strategist, can't solve\nanything on his own, Dani.

Original Text: シャラーップ！！！！\n【話：はなし】を【最後：さいご】まで【聞：き】く！！！！
Translated Text:
SHUT UP!!!!
Listen to me until I'm done!!!!

Original Text: その【数：かず】たるや　【日：ひ】を【追：お】うごとに【増：ふ】えてまして\n【中：なか】には　【不穏：ふおん】な【香：かお】りのする【事件：じけん】も…
Translated Text: The number of such incidents is\ngrowing day by day, and some of them\nhave a rather ominous feel to them…

Original Text: もしやその【裏：うら】にはあのノルカソルカをしのぐ\n【妖怪：ようかい】の【陰謀：いんぼう】が　【隠：かく】されているのではないか！
Translated Text: Could it be that behind all this lies\na conspiracy by a Yo-kai even\nmore sinister than Norukasoruka?!

Original Text: …と　この【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】のカンが\n【告：つ】げているのでうぃす！！
Translated Text: …That’s what my gut—as the genius\nstrategist Whisper Kongming—is\ntelling me, so there you go!!

Original Text: それで\nオラたちの【力：ちから】が【必要：ひつよう】なんズラね？
Translated Text: So that’s why you need our help, huh?

Original Text: ふわあ～\n【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】のカンは【常：つね】に【当：あ】てにならないニャン
Translated Text: Whew~ You can never count on the\ngenius strategist's instincts, meow.

Original Text: 【要：よう】はたのみごとが【多：おお】すぎて【大変：たいへん】って【話：はなし】ダニ\n【素直：すなお】に【助：たす】けてくださいって【言：い】えばいいダニ
Translated Text:
Basically, it's just that there are
too many requests and it's getting
overwhelming. You should just be
honest and ask for help.

Original Text: あのねーアナタたち！\nちょっとは　【私：わたくし】を【信用：しんよう】しなさいよっ！
Translated Text:
Hey, you guys!
You've got to trust me a little, okay?!

Original Text: ま　どっちでもいいニャン
Translated Text: Well... either way is fine, meow.

Original Text: 【困：こま】ってる【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【放：ほう】っておけないダニ！
Translated Text: I just can't leave a military\ncommander-Yo-kai in trouble alone, Dani!

Original Text: オラも！\nこの【世界：せかい】のみんなに　また【会：あ】いてぇズラ！
Translated Text:
Me too!
I wanna see everyone in this world again!

Original Text: そうそう　そう【来：こ】なくっちゃ！！\nさすがは　【我：われ】らが【英雄：えいゆう】たちでうぃす！！
Translated Text:
That's right! That's
exactly how it should be!!
As expected of our heroes!!

Original Text: あ！\nそれから【g】たのみごと【e】の【他：ほか】にも…
Translated Text:
Oh!
And besides that request, there's also...

Original Text: 【g】くにとりバトル【e】や　【g】チャレンジバトル【e】も\nいっそう　【盛：も】り【上：あ】がってるみたいですよ！
Translated Text: 【g】It looks like the Country Conquest【e】\n【g】Battles【e】 and Challenge【g】 Battles【e】 are\ngetting even more exciting!

Original Text: さあ！\nまだまだ【一緒：いっしょ】にさくら【国：こく】を【冒険：ぼうけん】しましょう！
Translated Text:
Come on! Let's
keep exploring Sakura Country together!

Original Text: はい　ここまでー！
Translated Text: Okay, that's it for now!

Original Text: 【続：つづ】きが【気：き】になりますねえ！\nあっ　【私：わたくし】たちのこの【格好：かっこう】も【気：き】になります？
Translated Text:
I can't wait to see what happens next!
Oh—are you curious about
what we're wearing, too?

Original Text: すべては【発売：はつばい】してからの\nお【楽：たの】しみでうぃす！
Translated Text: You'll just have to wait and\nsee once it's released!

Original Text: 【何：なに】をひとりでニヤニヤしながら\n【言：い】ってるニャン？
Translated Text: What are you saying while\ngrinning to yourself, meow?

Original Text: オホン！　【気：き】を【取：と】り【直：なお】して…
Translated Text: Ahem! Let's get back on track...

Original Text: ワールドホビーフェアへようこそ！\nそして『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』のブースへようこそ！
Translated Text:
Welcome to the World Hobby Fair!
And welcome to the
"Yo-kai Sangokushi" booth!

Original Text: あなたには【今：いま】から２つのバトルを\n【体験：たいけん】していただきます！
Translated Text: You're about to experience two battles!

Original Text: まず１つめは…　チームバトル！\nチームで【戦：たたか】って　【敵：てき】を【全員倒：ぜんいんたお】せば【勝利：しょうり】です！
Translated Text:
First up is... Team Battle! Fight
as a team, and if you defeat
all the enemies, you win!

Original Text: はじめてでも【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】！\nちゃぁ～んと【遊：あそ】び【方：かた】を【教：おし】えてさしあげます！
Translated Text:
It's okay if it's your first time!
We'll make sure to show
you exactly how to play!

Original Text: で　オレっちは\nだれとチームを【組：く】めばいいニャン？
Translated Text: So... who should I team up with, meow?

Original Text: フフフ　では【紹介：しょうかい】しましょう…
Translated Text: Hehehe... Well, let me introduce it...

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！
Translated Text: Komasan, Sun Ce!

Original Text: ズラー！\nオラがんばるズラ！
Translated Text:
Yeehaw!
I'm gonna do my best!

Original Text: そして…　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン【仲達：ちゅうたつ】！
Translated Text: And… USA, Pyong and friends!

Original Text: まかせるダニ！
Translated Text: Leave it to me, Danni!

Original Text: 『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』の【主人公：しゅじんこう】たちニャンね～♪\nよろしくたのむニャン！
Translated Text: Here are the main characters from *Yo-kai\nSangokushi*~♪ Nice to meet you, meow!

Original Text: チッチッチッ\nもうひとり　お【忘：わす】れではないですか？
Translated Text: Tick-tick-tick... Haven't you\nforgotten one more person?

Original Text: 【世界最強：せかいさいきょう】にして【最高：さいこう】の【天才軍師：てんさいぐんし】…\nその【名：な】も…
Translated Text:
The world's strongest and greatest
military strategist... whose
name is...

Original Text: ってあれ？\nちょっとー！　おいてかないでー！
Translated Text:
Wait, what?
Hey! Don't leave me behind!

Original Text: どうでした？\nはじめてのバトルは？
Translated Text:
So, how was it? How was your
first battle?

Original Text: 【妖怪：ようかい】を【順番：じゅんばん】に【動：うご】かして【戦：たたか】うのにも\nだんだん【慣：な】れてきたみたいですね！
Translated Text: It looks like you're gradually getting used\nto moving your Yo-kai one by one to fight!

Original Text: 【続：つづ】いて２つめのバトルは…\nボスバトル！
Translated Text:
Next up is the second battle… a
boss battle!

Original Text: 【私：わたくし】たちよりちょっと…　いや\nだいぶ【大：おお】きいボス【妖怪：ようかい】を【倒：たお】せば【勝利：しょうり】です！
Translated Text: If we defeat a boss Yo-kai\nthat's a little... no, actually quite\na bit bigger than us, we'll win!

Original Text: 【今回：こんかい】は【特別：とくべつ】に\n【助：すけ】っ【人：と】が【来：き】てくれてますよ～！
Translated Text: We’ve got a special guest\nhelping us out this time!

Original Text: 【助：すけ】っ【人：と】？\nだれニャン
Translated Text:
A helper?
Who's that, meow?

Original Text: ええっと…\nほらほらアレですってアレ
Translated Text:
Um
... you know, that thing—you
know what I mean?

Original Text: そう！\nメラメライオン【張飛：ちょうひ】！
Translated Text:
That's right!
Melamelion Zhang Fei!

Original Text: メラメ～ラ！\n（オレに　まかせろ！）
Translated Text:
Let's go!
(Leave it to me!)

Original Text: どっかのへっぽこ【軍師：ぐんし】よりは\nだいぶ【頼：たよ】りになりそうニャンね！
Translated Text: He seems a lot more reliable than some\nlousy military strategist, doesn't he, meow!

Original Text: ちょ…\nだれのことですかそれ！
Translated Text:
Wait...
who are you talking about?!

Original Text: いやーお【疲：つか】れさまでした！\nあの【赤鬼呂布：あかおにりょふ】を【倒：たお】すなんて　さすがです！
Translated Text:
Wow, great job!
Beating that Red Ogre Lu
Bu—that's just like you!

Original Text: 【今回遊：こんかいあそ】べるのはここまでです！
Translated Text: That's all for this time!

Original Text: 『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』を【遊：あそ】んでいただき\nありがとうございました！
Translated Text: Thank you for playing\n*Yo-kai Sangokushi*!

Original Text: また【発売後：はつばいご】にお【会：あ】いできるのを\n【楽：たの】しみにしていますよ！
Translated Text: I'm looking forward to seeing\nyou again after the release!

Original Text: それにしても…\n「【g】ようじゅつ【e】」を【使：つか】うと【疲：つか】れるっス…
Translated Text: Still… using“magic” really wears me out…

Original Text: 「【g】とりつき【e】」も\n【疲：つか】れが　たまってしまうのだ…
Translated Text: "Even 'attachment' can take its toll..."

Original Text: そんな【時：とき】は　アレを【飲：の】むといいわ！
Translated Text: When that happens, you should drink *that*!

Original Text: この【勝負：しょうぶ】は　【力：ちから】と【力：ちから】のぶつかりあい！\n【細：こま】かいことは【気：き】にせず　ただ【勝：か】つべし！
Translated Text:
This battle is a clash of
power against power!
Don't worry about the details—just win!

Original Text: 【勝：か】てば　フユニャン【曹操殿：そうそうどの】が【仲間：なかま】になる！\n…かもしれませんよ
Translated Text:
If you win, Lord Cao Cao from
Fu Nyang might join your party!
…Maybe.

Translated Text: Meow? Isn't this the Kingin\nParty's hideout, "Kobuta Bank"?!

Original Text: ズラ？　ここはキンギン【党：とう】のアジト\n「こぶた【銀行：ぎんこう】」じゃないズラ？
Translated Text: Huh? Isn't this the Kingin\nParty's hideout, "Kobuta Bank"?

Translated Text:
Why are we at the factory…? Could
this be… an illusion…!

Original Text: そのとおり\nここは【夕陽ヶ丘工場：ゆうひがおかこうじょう】…
Translated Text: That's right, this is the\nYuhigaoka Factory…

Original Text: 【我：われ】らの【幻術：げんじゅつ】で【作：つく】りだした【戦場：せんじょう】は…\nすべて【我：われ】らの【思：おも】いのままよ…
Translated Text:
The battlefield we've created with
our illusions... is entirely under
our control...

Original Text: お【前：まえ】たちはドウすることもできずに\n【負：ま】けるのじゃー！
Translated Text: You lot will lose without being\nable to do a thing about it!

Translated Text: Dou-ari Beam: It’s great that it’s so sturdy,\nbut isn’t it sticking out a little too far?

Translated Text: It's no big deal.

My water bottle's empty again.

Translated Text:
Yeah, yeah... You're
planning to make me work
again, aren't you, meow?

Translated Text:
Ugh... You're such a slave-driver, Dani!
There won't be a third time, Dani!

Translated Text:
That's a real bummer! I'll go find it

Ahh... my plate's getting full! I'm so
grateful!

Translated Text:
So that's where you were!
Princess Motohime, the Rain Queen!

Translated Text: Sima Zhao, the "sunny guy"...

Original Text: さあ　【行：い】こう！\nボクには　きみが【必要：ひつよう】なんだ！
Translated Text:
Come on, let's go!
I need you!

Original Text: でも…　あっ…
Translated Text: But… Oh…

Translated Text:
Our future is looking bright!
Just like the weather
today! Hahaha!

Original Text: うるおいが【消：き】えたっス…
Translated Text: My skin's lost its moisture...

Original Text: それどころか…\nこんな【快晴：かいせい】で…　【皿：さら】もかわいて…
Translated Text:
On the contrary… with
such a beautiful, sunny day…
and the dishes are dry…

Translated Text:
Ah, I can see a river that
looks so refreshing… I'm
sure if I cross that river…

Translated Text:
Stay strong, kitty!
That must be a river you're
not supposed to cross, kitty!

Translated Text:
Once you cross that river, there's no
turning back, Danny! Pull yourself
together, Danny!

Original Text: それは　さんずの【川：かわ】ズラ！\n【渡：わた】っちゃ　だめズラよ～！
Translated Text:
That's the Sanzu River, you know!
You're not allowed to cross it, okay~!

Everyone's turning into illusions
instead of me... What should I do,
Whisper Kōmei!

popularity poll is... Whisper Kongming
...

Original Text: なんでも【口：くち】からでまかせ【言：い】うて\nワイの【悪評：あくひょう】を　ふりまいとるらしいんや
Translated Text: Apparently, he's just spouting\nwhatever comes to mind and\nspreading bad rumors about me.

Original Text: まったく…　ぺらぺらうるさい【女：おんな】なんて\nワイは【一番：いちばん】　【好：す】かんっちゅうねん！
Translated Text: Seriously... I hate nothing more\nthan a chatty, noisy woman!

Original Text: え？　「お【前：まえ】が【言：い】うな」？\nがはは！　【兄：にい】ちゃん　おもろいこと【言：い】うな！
Translated Text:
Huh? “You’re one to talk”?
Hahaha! Dude, that’s funny!

Translated Text: Oh, right—speaking of which…

Original Text: その【女：おんな】には【r】【Ｕ．Ｓ．Ｏ．：ユーエスオー】【李厳：りげん】【e】っちゅう\n【相方：あいかた】もいるらしいんや

Translated Text: This guy is such a jerk again…

Translated Text:
"There's no rice at my store!
"—apparently, he's been
spreading that lie around.

Translated Text:
That's just rude! We have rice at
my shop!

Original Text: …【金：かね】はないけどな！
Translated Text: …But I don't have any money!

Original Text: ま　【何：なに】が【言：い】いたいかというとな…\nそいつらを【退治：たいじ】してほしいねん
Translated Text:
Well, what I'm trying to say
is... I want you to take care of
those guys.

Original Text: 【説明：せつめい】が【長：なが】すぎニャン…
Translated Text: That explanation's way too long, meow...

Original Text: 【最後：さいご】の【一行：いちぎょう】だけでいいダニ…
Translated Text: Just the last line is enough, Dani…

Original Text: もんげー　おしゃべりさんズラね…\nこれが【都会人：とかいじん】ってもんズラか？
Translated Text:
Wow, they sure are chatty... Is this
what city folks are like?

Original Text: おおきに！\nおかげでワイのショップの【人気：にんき】は【回復：かいふく】や！
Translated Text:
Thanks a lot!
Thanks to you, my shop's
popularity is back on the rise!

Original Text: そや！　【買：か】い【物：もの】でも　どや？\n【恩人：おんじん】やから　【特別：とくべつ】にまけたるわ！
Translated Text:
"That's right! How about we go shopping?
Since you're a good friend, I'll
give you a special discount!"

Original Text: そういえば…　まけるといえバナ…
Translated Text: Come to think of it… Even if I say I’ll lose, still…

Original Text: 【長話：ながばなし】は　もういいニャン！\nバイバイ　ニャーン！
Translated Text:
Enough with the long talk, meow!
Bye-bye, meow!

Original Text: 【長話：ながばなし】は　もうこりごりダニ！\nグッバイ　ダニー！
Translated Text:
I'm done with long conversations, Danny!
Goodbye, Danny!

Original Text: 【長話：ながばなし】は　また【今度：こんどき】にお【願：ねが】いするズラ！\nそんじゃ　バイズラー！
Translated Text:
I'll save the long chat for another time!
Well then, bye-bye!

I'm not going to stop!

why do I have to be

Original Text: 【戦：たたか】いのワンダーランドへ\nようこそでうぃす！
Translated Text: Welcome to the Wonderland of Battle!

Original Text: ただいまから　スペシャルマッチ！\n６０【分一本勝負：ぷんいっぽんしょうぶ】を【行：おこな】います！
Translated Text:
It's time for the special match!
We'll be holding a single 60-minute bout!

Original Text: 【青：あお】コーナー！\nまぶしい【頭：あたま】に【相手：あいて】はクラクラ…
Translated Text:
Blue Corner! His
dazzling head is making
his opponent dizzy…

Original Text: ノガッパ【姜維：きょうい】＆【河童夏侯惇：かっぱかこうとん】！\n「チームかっぱ」ー！
Translated Text:
Walkappa Jiang Wei & Kappa Xiahou Dun!
“Team Kappa”!!

Original Text: 【気合：きあい】じゅうぶんっス！
Translated Text: I'm totally pumped!

Original Text: 【今日：きょう】もかわいてるぜ！
Translated Text: I'm still feeling it today!

Original Text: 【赤：あか】コーナー！\n【正体不明：しょうたいふめい】　【顔：かお】の【見：み】えないナゾのふたり！
Translated Text:
The Red Corner!
Two mysterious figures whose
identities are unknown and
whose faces remain hidden!

Original Text: さかさっ【傘王累：かさおうるい】＆から【傘：かさ】おばけ【李典：りてん】！\n「ザ・かさブランカ」ー！
Translated Text:
Rui, the Upside-Down Umbrella
King, & Li Dian, the Umbrella Ghost!
“The Kasablanca”!

Original Text: …「ザ・かさブランカ」ーっ？
Translated Text: …“The Casablanca”?!

Original Text: …ヤツら　いないぜ？
Translated Text: …They're not here, are they?

Original Text: うぃす！　いま【情報：じょうほう】が【入：はい】ってきました！
Translated Text: Hey! I just got some news!

Original Text: え～「ザ・かさブランカ」は【前日：ぜんじつ】の【嵐：あらし】で\nボロボロになり　ドクターストップ…！？
Translated Text: Wait—"The Casablanca" was completely\nwrecked by the storm the day before,\nso the doctor said no more…!?

Original Text: おいおい【対戦相手：たいせんあいて】がいないのかよ？\n【今日：きょう】はやる【気：き】で【来：き】てんのに…
Translated Text:
Hey, wait a minute—are there no
opponents? I came here all fired up
today, and...

Original Text: オレもっス　【河童先輩：かっぱせんぱい】！
Translated Text: Me too, Kappa-senpai!

Original Text: おーっと！　【突然：とつぜん】\n「チームかっぱ」の【前：まえ】にナゾのチームが！
Translated Text: Whoa! A mysterious team has suddenly\nappeared in front of "Team Kappa"!

Original Text: これは【乱入：らんにゅう】！　【乱入：らんにゅう】です！\nそのチームの【名：な】は…
Translated Text:
This is an unannounced appearance!
An unannounced appearance!
The name of that team is…

Original Text: 【地獄：じごく】からの【使者：ししゃ】！\n「エーユー・ウォーリアーズ」！
Translated Text:
Messengers from Hell!
"AY Warriors"!

Original Text: ニャニー！？
Translated Text: What the...!?

Original Text: えええっ！？
Translated Text: What?!

Original Text: もんげー！？
Translated Text: No way!?

Original Text: スペシャルマッチは\n「エーユー・ウォーリアーズ」の【勝：か】ちです！
Translated Text: The "AU Warriors" won the special match!

Original Text: …くやしいっス！
Translated Text: …That really sucks!

Original Text: やれやれ…\nこいつぁ　【完敗：かんぱい】ってヤツだな…
Translated Text:
Oh well…
I guess this is what you'd
call a total defeat…

Original Text: だが　いい【勝負：しょうぶ】だった\nお【互：たが】いの【健闘：けんとう】をたたえ　【握手：あくしゅ】をしよう
Translated Text: But it was a close match. Let's shake\nhands to commend each other's efforts.

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】つのじゃー！
Translated Text: Wait a sec!

Original Text: おーっと　ここで\n「ザ・かさブランカ」が【突然：とつぜん】　【乱入：らんにゅう】ー！
Translated Text: Whoa! "The Casablanca"\nsuddenly bursts in here!

Original Text: オレたちを【倒：たお】してから【勝者：しょうしゃ】を【名乗：なの】りやがれ！\nてやんでぇ　ちくしょうめ！
Translated Text:
"Beat us first before you
call yourself the winner!
Take that, you bastard!"

Original Text: た　【大変：たいへん】なことになってまいりました！
Translated Text: Oh, this is getting really serious!

Original Text: この【乱入：らんにゅう】が「エーユー・ウォーリアーズ」\n【包囲網：ほういもう】へ【発展：はってん】していくのでありましょうか！
Translated Text:
Could this interruption be the beginning
of a siege against the “AU Warriors”
?

Original Text: リング【上：じょう】では　いまだ【三組：さんくみ】のにらみ【合：あ】いが\n【続：つづ】いておりますが…　お【時間：じかん】となりました
Translated Text: Although the three pairs are still locked in\na standoff in the ring... it's time to wrap up.

Original Text: 【次回：じかい】のワールド【妖怪：ようかい】プロレスリングを\nお【楽：たの】しみに！
Translated Text: Stay tuned for the next episode\nof World Yo-kai Pro-Wrestling!

Original Text: こいつが【一番：いちばん】　【楽：たの】しそうニャン…
Translated Text: This one looks like it's having the most fun, meow...

Original Text: なんでいきなり\nプロレス【番組：ばんぐみ】になるダニ！？
Translated Text: Why is this suddenly turning into\na pro-wrestling show, Dani!?

Original Text: 「エーユー・ウォーリアーズ」は\nどうなるズラ？　【来週：らいしゅう】も【見逃：みのが】せないズラ！
Translated Text: What's going to happen with the\n"AU Warriors"? You won't want\nto miss next week's episode!

You lot… won’t you grant
this old woman’s wish?

Translated Text:
Before I die, I’d like to reminisce about
those days just once…

Translated Text: So please... could you bring me Diao\n【b】Chan【e】, who's famous for her beauty...?

Original Text: まあ　いいダニが…\nそんなの　むなしくなるだけダニよ…？
Translated Text:
Well, that's nice...
but that's just going to leave
you feeling empty, isn't it...?

Leave it to me!
I'll definitely make your wish come true!

(So you've come strolling right up
here... I'm going to wrinkle that
face of yours to pieces!)

! My hands are shaking—I can't aim...!)

Translated Text: (Oh no—a sudden back spasm at a\ntime like this! I just... can't go on...)

Translated Text:
Oh no!
That old lady just collapsed!

Translated Text: Thanks, meow. Thanks to you, it looks like\nit went to heaven all satisfied, meow…

Original Text: ありがとうダニ\nきっと【幸：しあわ】せな【人生：じんせい】だったダニ…
Translated Text: Thank you, Dani. I'm sure\nyou had a happy life, Dani...

Translated Text: Thanks, man! Thanks to you, I got to\nsee something great right at the end...

Original Text: ばかもん！　まだ【死：し】んどらんわーっ！
Translated Text: You idiot! I'm not dead yet!

Original Text: はあ…　【最近：さいきん】…\n【私：わたし】ツイてないの…
Translated Text:
Sigh... Lately...
I've just been having a run of bad luck...

Original Text: ガルちゃんたち「アツい【系：けい】」のみんなとは\n【全然：ぜんぜん】　【会：あ】えないし…
Translated Text: I never get to hang out with the "hot"\ngirls from Garu-chan's group at all...

Original Text: それ　さけられてるだけニャン…
Translated Text: That's just me being ignored, meow...

Original Text: それ　きっとみんな\nエスケープしてるダニよ…
Translated Text: That's definitely just a bunch\nof mites trying to escape...

Original Text: それは　さびしいズラね…
Translated Text: That's a lonely look...

Original Text: …そうだ！
Translated Text: …That's right!

Original Text: 【b】ツチノコ【劉禅：りゅうぜん】【e】ちゃんを【仲間：なかま】にして\n【連：つ】れてきてくれないかしら？
Translated Text: 【b】Could you please recruit Tsuchinoko【e】\n【b】Liu【e】 Chan and bring her along?

Original Text: 【幸運：こううん】を【呼：よ】ぶツチノコ【劉禅：りゅうぜん】ちゃんなら\n【私：わたし】のツキをもどしてくれるわよね？
Translated Text: If Liu Chan, the Tsuchinoko who\nbrings good luck, is here, she’ll\nbring my luck back, right?

Original Text: もどしてくれるわよねって\n【言：い】われてもニャン…
Translated Text: Even if you say, “You’ll give\nit back, right?”… Meow…

Original Text: もどしてくれるわよねって…\nこのガールもなかなか【強引：ごういん】ダニ…
Translated Text:
"You'll give it back, right?"... This
girl is pretty pushy, too...

Original Text: もどしてくれるわよねって…\nオラ　【約束：やくそく】はできないズラよ？
Translated Text:
"You'll give it back, right?"... Well
, I can't promise anything, you know?

Original Text: あー【楽：たの】しみ！　【早：はや】く\nツチノコ【劉禅：りゅうぜん】ちゃんを【連：つ】れてきてね！
Translated Text: Oh, I can't wait! Please bring\nTsuchinoko Liu Chan here soon!

Translated Text:
Ting! Who wants to get
lucky~?

Original Text: あそんでくれたら\n【幸：しあわ】せにしてあげる！
Translated Text: If you play with me, I'll make you happy!

Original Text: ほっほっほ　ワシが\nもっと【輝：カガヤ】かせてみせるぞい！
Translated Text: Ho ho ho! I'll make it shine even brighter!

Original Text: なんか…\n【変：へん】なのがまじってるニャン…？
Translated Text:
Hmm... Is there something
weird mixed in here, meow...
?

Original Text: あれ？\nいつの【間：ま】にか【増：ふ】えてるダニ…？
Translated Text:
Huh?
When did all these ticks show up...?

Original Text: もんげー！\n【知：し】らない【妖怪：ようかい】が　まざってるズラ！
Translated Text:
Whoa! There's a Yo-kai I've
never seen before mixed in here!

Original Text: あら　うれしい！\n【私：わたし】　にぎやかなの【大好：だいす】きなの！
Translated Text:
Oh, I'm so happy!
I just love it when things are lively!

Original Text: みんな【幸運：こううん】を【呼：よ】んでくれるから\n「ラッキー【系：けい】」【妖怪：ようかい】…って【感：かん】じかしら？
Translated Text: Since they all bring good luck, I guess you\ncould call them “lucky-type” Yo-kai…?

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】　さくら【国一：こくいち】の【美女：びじょ】を【決：き】める\n【戦：たたか】いがあるみたいなんだけど…
Translated Text: It looks like there's going to be a\ncontest soon to decide who's the\nmost beautiful girl in Sakura Country...

Translated Text: If everyone’s there to cheer\nme on, I’m sure to win!

Translated Text: Ting!

It's fine, I guess... but just from the
name alone, I have a feeling

Translated Text:
【r】King Yun, who’s always beating【e】
【r】around the bush… I bet he’ll tell us 【e】
something, won’t he?

Translated Text:
Inspector!
They're both tight-lipped!

Original Text: 【口：くち】で【言：い】ってわからなければ\n【体：からだ】に【聞：き】けばいいのです！
Translated Text: If they don't get it when you tell them,\njust let their bodies do the talking!

Original Text: ふたりをボコボコにして\n【口：くち】を【割：わ】らせましょう！
Translated Text: Let's beat the crap out of\nthem and make them talk!

All right, spill it! Who the hell attacked
you guys!?

Translated Text:
If anything, right now… it’s like
we just attacked them…

Original Text: シーッ！\n【被害者：ひがいしゃ】の【話：はなし】が【聞：き】こえないでしょうが！
Translated Text:
Shh! You can't hear what
the victim is saying!

Original Text: た　たしか【犯人：はんにん】はふたり【組：ぐみ】…
Translated Text: W-Wait, I'm pretty sure there were two of them...

Original Text: み　【見：み】た【目：め】もすごく【似：に】ていたような…
Translated Text: Hmm... They looked really similar, too...

Original Text: う～ん　ウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】\n【犯人：はんにん】の【目星：めぼし】は　ついたニャンか？

We must proceed with the investigation
with the utmost caution! We need to gather
more information.

【r】 Semi-Maru Yujin—he's been arrested【e】!

What the heck!? You said

A pair of them are up to no good…
and they’re even armed!

100 percent!
There's no doubt he's the culprit, right?

Translated Text: So, what do you mean, "how did\nthe warlord attack the Yo-kai"?!

Translated Text: …That is…

Translated Text: A tick that was completely wrong…

Translated Text:
I'm so mad!
I'm gonna take down that lousy
detective with my friends!

Translated Text:
Eeeeeek!
Assistants, help me! Do something!

Original Text: やれやれ…だニャン
Translated Text: Oh, well... meow

Original Text: まことに…　まことに…\n【申：もう】し【訳：わけ】ありませんでした！
Translated Text:
Truly... truly...
I'm so sorry!
