Translated Text: It was Inspector Hebo's lousy\ndeduction, meow. Please laugh\nit off and forgive me, meow.

Original Text: ヘボ【警部：けいぶ】のヘボ【頭：あたま】では【仕方：しかた】ないミーン\nそのヘボさにめんじて　ゆるすミーン
Translated Text: Inspector Hebo’s brain isn’t\nexactly the sharpest—but I’ll let\nit slide because he’s so clueless.

Original Text: ヘボ…
Translated Text: Lame…

Original Text: ただ　【捜査：そうさ】はふりだしにもどったダニ\nふたりは【何：なに】か【知：し】らないダニ？
Translated Text: But the investigation is back to square\none. Do those two know anything?

Original Text: 【聞：き】いた【話：はなし】だと　【犯人：はんにん】のシルエットに\n【羽：はね】のようなものが【見：み】えたとか…
Translated Text: I heard that something that\nlooked like wings was visible in\nthe silhouette of the perpetrator…

Original Text: …やっぱり　アナタたちでは…？
Translated Text: …I guess it really is you guys…?

Original Text: 【警部：けいぶ】！\nその【線：せん】は　もうあきらめるズラ！
Translated Text:
Inspector! You'd better give up on
that lead!

Original Text: うぃす…
Translated Text: Hey...

Translated Text:
A pair that look exactly alike… Something
like wings… That mite has shriveled up
quite a bit…

Original Text: …あっ！　もしかして…！
Translated Text: …Oh! Could it be…!

Original Text: ジバニャン！\n【犯人：はんにん】が　わかったズラか！？
Translated Text:
Jibanyan!
Do you think you've figured
out who the culprit is!?

Translated Text: I'm not quite sure yet, but I can\nthink of a few suspects, meow.

Original Text: でも　まだ【言：い】うのは　やめておくニャン\nヘボ【警部：けいぶ】みたいに　まちがえたら【大変：たいへん】ニャン
Translated Text: But I'd better not say anything yet. If I\nmake a mistake like Inspector\nNyanhebo, it'll be a big problem, meow.

Original Text: とほほ…
Translated Text: Oh dear…

Translated Text: I brought the witness to that incident\nwhere the warrior-Yo-kai attacked!

Original Text: 【事件解決：じけんかいけつ】の【時：とき】は【近：ちか】いですね…
Translated Text: The time when this case will be solved is drawing near...

Original Text: 【今：いま】までの【私：わたくし】の【推理：すいり】と【目撃談：もくげきだん】を【合：あ】わせれば…\n【犯人：はんにん】が【必：かなら】ず【浮：う】かびあがるはず！
Translated Text:
If I combine my deductions so far
with the eyewitness accounts…
the culprit is bound to emerge!

Original Text: この【前：まえ】　【無実：むじつ】の【妖怪：ようかい】を【逮捕：たいほ】したのに\n【全然：ぜんぜん】　こりてないダニ…
Translated Text: That jerk hasn't learned his lesson\nat all, even after arresting an\ninnocent Yo-kai the other day...

Original Text: 【打：う】たれ【強：づよ】さだけは　【一流：いちりゅう】ニャン…
Translated Text: If there's one thing this cat excels at, it's resilience...

Original Text: さ　モレゾウ【黄蓋：こうがい】さん\n【話：はな】してほしいズラ！
Translated Text: Hey, Moretsu Huang Gai, I\nwant you to tell us the story!

Original Text: う…　も…　もれそう…
Translated Text: Ugh... I... I'm about to...

Original Text: 【羽：はね】の【生：は】えた【馬：うま】の【妖怪：ようかい】が【他：ほか】の【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】を\n【襲：おそ】っているところを【見：み】ました…
Translated Text: I saw a winged horse Yo-kai\nattacking other warrior Yo-kai…

Original Text: い　いきなり【犯人確定：はんにんかくてい】ー！
Translated Text: Wow—they've already pinpointed the culprit!

Original Text: コマさん【孫策：そんさく】！\n【魔：ま】ガサス【公孫⑧：こうそんさん】【一味：いちみ】の【逮捕状：たいほじょう】を！
Translated Text:
Komasan, Sun Ce!
Issue an arrest warrant for the
"Demon Gassus Gongsun 8" gang!

Original Text: はいズラ！
Translated Text: Yeah, Zura!

Original Text: さあ　みなさん！\n【私：わたくし】と【一緒：いっしょ】に【犯人確保：はんにんかくほ】に【向：む】かいましょう！
Translated Text:
All right, everyone!
Let's go catch the culprit together!

Original Text: …？　ジバニャン　どうしたダニ？\n【考：かんが】えこんでるダニ
Translated Text:
…? Jibanyan, what's up, Danni?
You look like you're
deep in thought, Danni.

Translated Text:
Well... it wasn't the culprit
I had in mind, meow.

Original Text: あせって【言：い】ってたら\n【大：おお】はじを　かくところだったニャン！
Translated Text: If I'd spoken too hastily, I would've\nmade a huge blunder, meow!

A pair who looked exactly alike… Wings…

Translated Text:
Clap, clap! That was some brilliant
detective work, wasn't it? Inspector
Whisper Kongming!

Original Text: ダニー！？
Translated Text: Danny!?

Original Text: な　ななななーっ！
Translated Text: W-w-w-waaah!

Original Text: も　もんげーー！

Translated Text: On top of that, people started\ncalling me by some weird name…

Original Text: へ～　\nそれって　どんな【名前：なまえ】ニャン？
Translated Text: Huh... What kind of name is that, meow?

Original Text: ほうほう　\nいったい　どんな【名前：なまえ】ダニ？
Translated Text: Oh, really? What kind of\nname is that, exactly?

Original Text: みょうな【名前：なまえ】って　どんなのズラ？\nもんげー【気：き】になるズラ～！
Translated Text:
What kind of names are "weird" names? I'm
super curious!

Original Text: 「エーユーおつきのキリン【児：じ】」っス
Translated Text: "The Giraffe Kid with AU"

Original Text: …【正直：しょうじき】　【納得：なっとく】いってないっス
Translated Text: …To be honest, I'm not really convinced.

Original Text: 「おつき」って　ひどいっス\nそれに【河童：かっぱ】なのに　キリンってなんスか…
Translated Text: "Otsuki" is so mean. And even though he's\na kappa, what's with the "giraffe" thing...

Original Text: でも　この【変：へん】な【名前：なまえ】を【変：か】える【方法：ほうほう】が\nひとつだけあるっス！
Translated Text: But there's only one way\nto change this weird name!

Original Text: エーユーと【互角：ごかく】に【戦：たたか】い\n【勝利：しょうり】を【得：え】ることっス！
Translated Text: We're gonna go toe-to-toe\nwith AU and come out on top!

Translated Text: Hey, I found this awesome moisturizer\nthe other day, and now my skin’s been\nhydrated 24 hours a day, 365 days a year!

Translated Text:
Alright, let's see who wins—
me, now that I've powered up, or you!

…!! No, well, that’s…
Nyahaha…

Translated Text: …Whatever your reason, come\nat it with everything you've got.

Translated Text:
"W-Well, that's what I
was going to say, meow!
Let's go, meow~!"

We're so confident... Do you think

Well... I don't think I'll lose
to someone like you who

Translated Text: I think if you guys just go along with\nme, things will definitely work out.

Translated Text: It's all thanks to everyone's hard\nwork and the treasure orbs, isn't it!

Translated Text: Jibanyan, USA-Pyon, Komasan—I’m\ntruly grateful to all of you.

Translated Text:
As always… aren't we forgetting someone
here!?

Original Text: …だれかな？
Translated Text: …Who could it be?

Original Text: こいつ…　わざとトボけてんな…
Translated Text: This guy... he's playing dumb on purpose...

Original Text: まあまあ　【平和：へいわ】になったんだし\nケンカもやめるズラ
Translated Text: Well, things have calmed down\na bit, so I guess I'll stop fighting.

Original Text: …おほん！　そういえば　【宝珠：ほうじゅ】に【祈：いの】っても\n【龍：りゅう】とか【出：で】てませんでしたねぇ？
Translated Text: …Ahem! Come to think of it,\neven when I prayed to the jewel,\nno dragons appeared, did they?

Original Text: オレっちも【神様：かみさま】といえば【龍：りゅう】！\nそんなイメージだったニャン！
Translated Text:
For me, too, when I think of
a god, I think of a dragon!
That’s the image I had, meow!

Original Text: まったく…\nみんなマンガの【見：み】すぎダニ！
Translated Text:
Seriously... You
guys read way too many manga!

Original Text: ニャハハハハ…
Translated Text: Meow ha ha ha ha…

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】たちよ…\nまだ【戦：たたか】いは【終：お】わっていない
Translated Text:
Heroes... the battle is not over yet
.

Original Text: …オ　オロチ【周瑜：しゅうゆ】\nおどかすのは　なしズラよ…
Translated Text: …O—O, Orochi, you shouldn't\nscare Zhou Yu like that…

Original Text: 【私：わたし】の【声：こえ】ではない…！
Translated Text: That's not my voice…!

Original Text: じゃ　じゃあ…\nこの【天：てん】の【声：こえ】はいったい…！？
Translated Text:
W-well then… what on earth is
this voice from heaven…!?

Original Text: この【国：くに】の【争：あらそ】いは　【終：お】わらせぬ…\n【行：ゆ】け　【我：わ】がしもべたちよ！
Translated Text:
I will not let the strife in this land end…
Go, my servants!

Original Text: ケーン！\n【英雄：えいゆう】ども　【覚悟：かくご】しろ！
Translated Text:
Kane!
Heroes, brace yourselves!

Original Text: ドケチーング！
Translated Text: What a cheapskate!

Original Text: うぃすー！\nいきなり　こうげきしてきましたー！
Translated Text:
Hey there!
They attacked me out of the blue!

Original Text: さすが【英雄：えいゆう】\nなかなかやりおるな
Translated Text: As expected of a hero—he's\nreally pulling it off.

Original Text: だが　【次：つぎ】はこうはいかぬ\n【我輩：わがはい】の【腹心：ふくしん】もだまってはおらぬぞ…
Translated Text: But things won’t go this smoothly\nnext time—my closest confidant won’t\njust stand by and do nothing either…

Original Text: いったい　だれニャン…？
Translated Text: Who on earth is that... meow?

Original Text: さくら【国：こく】には\nまだ【悪党：あくとう】がいるってことダニ！？
Translated Text: So there are still villains\nin Sakura Country, huh!?

Original Text: 【私：わたし】にも　わからない…
Translated Text: I don't know either...

Original Text: だが…　ヤツがかなりの【力：ちから】を\n【持：も】っていることは【確：たし】かだ
Translated Text: But… there’s no doubt\nthat he’s quite powerful.

Original Text: また　【戦：たたか】うことになるズラ…？
Translated Text: So... I'm going to have to fight again...?

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】です！\nどんなに【強大：きょうだい】な【敵：てき】であろうと…
Translated Text:
It'll be okay!
No matter how powerful
the enemy may be...

Original Text: こちらには　さくら【国：こく】の【英雄：えいゆう】と\nこのウィスパー【孔明：こうめい】がいるのですから！
Translated Text: After all, we have the hero of\nSakura Country and this\nWhisper Kongming right here!

Original Text: 【私：わたし】も　できる【限：かぎ】り【協力：きょうりょく】しよう\nだから【頼：たの】むぞ　【英雄：えいゆう】たち…！
Translated Text: I'll do my best to help, too,\nso count on me, heroes…!

Original Text: だから！　【私：わたくし】をムシすんなってのー！
Translated Text: So! Don't ignore me, okay?!

Original Text: 【平和：へいわ】っていいズラねぇ…
Translated Text: Peace is such a nice word, isn't it…

Original Text: そうダニ！　ダンスに【夢中：むちゅう】になっても\nおそわれる【心配：しんぱい】はないダニ！
Translated Text: That's right, Dani! Even if you\nget totally absorbed in dancing,\nthere's no need to worry, Dani!

Original Text: サンバでマンボでダンシング！　いぇい！
Translated Text: Dancing to samba and mambo! Yay!

Original Text: このリズム！　このビート！\nああ…　なんか【私：わたくし】　ノッてきましたよ！
Translated Text:
This rhythm! This beat!
Oh... I'm really getting into it!

Original Text: やんちゃな【昔：むかし】を【思：おも】いだしてしまいそうです！\n【私：わたくし】も　ポゥッ！　しちゃおうかな？
Translated Text:
It makes me think back
to my mischievous days!
Maybe I'll go ahead and do a "Poo!" too?

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】つニャン！\nなんか【様子：ようす】がおかしいニャン？
Translated Text:
Wait a sec, meow!
Something seems off, meow?

Original Text: そう…　なの…！　いぇい！　いぇい！
Translated Text: That's... right...! Yay! Yay!

Original Text: ボクたち　【踊：おど】っているんじゃなくて…
Translated Text: We're not really dancing...

Original Text: 【踊：おど】らされてる…　フォー！
Translated Text: I'm being led around by the nose... Four!

Original Text: もんげー！　た　【大変：たいへん】ズラ！
Translated Text: Whoa! That's... that's a real mess!

Original Text: オーケー！\nもっとテンションあげてコーイ！
Translated Text:
Okay! Let's get even
more pumped up!

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】のみ・な・さ・ん！\n【極楽：ごくらく】に【連：つ】れていってあげるー！
Translated Text:
To all you heroes! I'll take you
to paradise!

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】たちも【百鬼夜行：ひゃっきやぎょう】に【参加：さんか】するのじゃ！
Translated Text: You lot are joining the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, too!

Original Text: て　【敵：てき】が【来：く】るダニ！
Translated Text: Oh no, here come the enemies!

Original Text: では　レッツダンシング！\nじゃなくて　【撃退：げきたい】しましょう！
Translated Text:
Well then, let's dance!
—No, let's fight them off!

Original Text: NULL
Translated Text: NULL

Original Text: 【英雄：えいゆう】…　やるじゃん\nでも　【俺：おれ】のジャマしないでくれる？
Translated Text: Hero… You're pretty good, but could\nyou please stop getting in my way?

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】　ジャマしたら…\nやっつけるよ？
Translated Text:
If you get in my way again…
I'll take you out, okay?

Original Text: なんか…　【前：まえ】に【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】をあやつってた\n【天：てん】の【声：こえ】に【似：に】てるニャン　【仲間：なかま】かニャン？
Translated Text:
Hmm... This kind of sounds like the
"Voice from Heaven" that used to
control those warrior Yo-kai before.
Is it one of our allies, meow?

Original Text: 【悪：わる】い【予感：よかん】がするダニ…
Translated Text: I have a bad feeling about this tick…

Original Text: でも…　とにかく【踊：おど】ってた【人：ひと】は\nみんな【正気：しょうき】にもどったズラ！
Translated Text: But… Anyway, everyone who was\ndancing came to their senses!

Original Text: 【待：ま】って！　あそこにまだ\nずっと【踊：おど】り【続：つづ】けてる【人：ひと】がいるの！
Translated Text: Wait! There's still someone over\nthere who hasn't stopped dancing!

Original Text: ポゥ！　ポゥ！　ポゥ！\nこ…　こしが【止：と】まらないでうぃす！
Translated Text:
Poo! Poo! Poo!
My... my hips just won't stop!

Original Text: …ま　そのうち　【止：と】まるニャン
Translated Text: …Well, it'll stop eventually, meow.

Original Text: そんなぁ！　【早：はや】く【止：と】めてぇ！\nポゥ！　ポゥ！　ポゥ！　ポーゥ！
Translated Text:
No way! Stop it, quick!
Poo! Poo! Poo! Poo!

Original Text: ヘーイ！　パーリー！\nもっと　【楽：たの】しんでコーイ！
Translated Text:
Hey! Let's party!
Have even more fun!

Original Text: あーっ！　この【声：こえ】はまさか！
Translated Text: Ah! That voice—it can't be...!

Original Text: パーリー…　かっこいいひびきズラ！\nきっと　【大都会：だいとかい】の【妖怪：ようかい】ズラね！？
Translated Text:
Parry… That name sounds so cool!
It must be a Yo-kai from
the big city, right!?

Original Text: ちがうダニ！\nみんなを【躍：おど】らせていた【声：こえ】ダニ！
Translated Text:
It's a different kind of mite!
The voice mite that had
everyone dancing!

Original Text: もんげーーっ！？
Translated Text: Whoa!!?

Original Text: なんだよ～\nもっと【楽：たの】しまなきゃ　ダメだよ～
Translated Text: Come on~ You've gotta have more fun~

Original Text: うるさいニャン！\nさくら【国：こく】の【平和：へいわ】を【乱：みだ】すのはお【前：まえ】ニャン？
Translated Text:
Shut up, meow!
Are you the one disrupting the
peace of Sakura Country, meow?

Original Text: ふーん…\n【俺：おれ】のジャマするっていうの？
Translated Text:
Hmm... You're saying I'm getting in your
way?

Original Text: じゃあ…　かかってコイ！\n【俺：おれ】は【魔王：まおう】…　コイ！
Translated Text:
Well then… Bring it on!
I am the Demon King… Bring it on!

Original Text: あ～【負：ま】けちゃった…\n【昨日：きのう】　はしゃぎ【過：す】ぎちゃったからかなぁ…
Translated Text:
Ahh... I lost... Maybe I got a little
too carried away yesterday
...

Original Text: 【別次元：べつじげん】から　のりこんでおいて\nやられちゃうなんて【情：なさ】けないなぁ…
Translated Text: It's so pathetic to come all the way from\nanother dimension only to get beaten...

Original Text: き　【消：き】えたニャン…
Translated Text: It... disappeared, meow...

Original Text: 【別次元：べつじげん】から【来：き】たって【言：い】ってたダニ\nこの【国：くに】の【妖怪：ようかい】ではないダニ？
Translated Text: That tick said it came from\nanother dimension—so it’s not\na Yo-kai from this country, is it?

Original Text: とにかく　やっつけたズラ\nこれで【平和：へいわ】になったズラ？
Translated Text: Anyway, I took care of it. So,\nis everything peaceful now?

Original Text: まだ…　もうひとつの\nナゾの【声：こえ】の【主：ぬし】が【残：のこ】っています
Translated Text: There's still... one more mystery voice left.

Original Text: 【我：われわれ】々の【戦：たたか】いは…\nこれからでうぃす！
Translated Text:
Our battle... is just
getting started!

Original Text: 【魔王：まおう】コイを　やっつけるとは…\nさくら【国：こく】の【英雄：えいゆう】も　なかなかやる
Translated Text:
To think they actually defeated
the Maou Koi… The heroes of
Sakura Country are quite something.

Original Text: ならば…　【我輩：わがはい】…\n【大魔王：だいまおう】シブ【自：みずか】らが【相手：あいて】となろう！
Translated Text:
In that case… I, the Great
Demon King Shibu, will face you
myself!

Original Text: ちょっと【待：ま】つニャン！\n【戦：たたか】う【前：まえ】に【聞：き】きたいことがあるニャン！
Translated Text:
Wait a sec, meow! I've got
something I want to ask before we
fight, meow!

Original Text: ユーたちはいったい\nなんのために　ここへ【来：き】たダニ！？
Translated Text: What on earth did you guys\ncome here for, you little pests!?

Original Text: 【我輩：わがはい】とコイは【三国志：さんごくし】が【大好：だいす】きなのだ
Translated Text: Koi and I both love *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*.

Original Text: 【戦：たたか】いを【通：つう】じて【友情：ゆうじょう】や【忠義：ちゅうぎ】が【生：う】まれ\n【戦：たたか】いの【中：なか】で【裏切：うらぎ】りや【別：わか】れがある…
Translated Text: Friendship and loyalty are forged\nthrough battle, while betrayal and\npartings occur in the midst of battle…

Original Text: そんな【三国志：さんごくし】が【大好：だいす】きなのだ！\nだが　この『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』ときたら…
Translated Text:
I absolutely love *Romance
of the Three Kingdoms*!
But as for this *Yo-kai Romance
of the Three Kingdoms*...

Original Text: のほほんと\nみんなが【平和：へいわ】に【暮：く】らしておる！
Translated Text: Everyone's living a carefree, peaceful life!

Original Text: 【平和：へいわ】なのは　いいことズラ！
Translated Text: Peace is a good thing, isn't it!

Original Text: それではスペクタクルロマンにならぬ！\n【我輩：わがはい】が【再：ふたた】び　【戦乱：せんらん】の【世：よ】に【変：か】えてやろう！
Translated Text:
Well then, this won’t turn
into a romantic spectacle!
I’ll turn this world back into
one of war once again!

Original Text: そんなわがままは【許：ゆる】さないニャン！\n【行：い】くニャン！　【ＵＳＡ：うさ】ピョン　コマさん！
Translated Text:
I won't put up with that
kind of selfishness, meow!
Let's go, meow! USA-pyon, Komasan!

Original Text: ラジャー　ダニ！
Translated Text: Roger that, Dani!

Original Text: 【負：ま】けないズラー！
Translated Text: We won't lose, Zura!

Original Text: 【貴様：きさま】たち…\nいい【戦：たたか】いぶりだったぞ
Translated Text:
You guys... that was a
good fight.

Original Text: 【初：はじ】めて【三国志：さんごくし】を【読：よ】んだ【時：とき】のロマンを\nまた【味：あじ】わうことができた…
Translated Text: I was able to relive the sense of\nwonder I felt when I first read\n*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*…

Original Text: いったい【何：なに】を【言：い】ってるニャン…
Translated Text: What on earth are you talking about, meow…

Original Text: おっと　【日：ひ】ノ【神：しん】との【約束：やくそく】の【時間：じかん】だ\nコイと３【人：にん】で【三国志：さんごくし】のロマンを【語：かた】らねば…
Translated Text:
Oh, it's time for my date with
Hinogami. Koi, the three of us have
to talk about the romance of
*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*...

Original Text: 【貴様：きさま】たちの【話：はなし】もするとしよう\nロマンを【感：かん】じさせる【英雄：えいゆう】だった…とな
Translated Text: Let's talk about you guys, too. He\nwas a hero who inspired a sense\nof romance... or so they say.

Original Text: では　さらばだ！\nチャレンジバトルで【会：あ】おう！
Translated Text:
Well then, see you later! Let's meet in the
Challenge Battle!

Original Text: 【消：き】えちゃったズラ…
Translated Text: My wig's gone...

Original Text: なんか　まだ【余裕：よゆう】があったダニね…
Translated Text: Man, Dani still had some energy left, didn't she...

Original Text: でも　まあ…\nさくら【国：こく】に【再：ふたた】び【平和：へいわ】がもどりました！
Translated Text:
But, well... peace has returned to
Sakura Country!

Original Text: めでたし　めでたし　でうぃす！
Translated Text: Hooray! Hooray! Dewis!

Original Text: あれ？　キミたち　もしかして…\nロマンな【英雄：えいゆう】？
Translated Text:
Huh? You guys... are you
by any chance... romantic
heroes?

Original Text: ロマン…　あーっ！\nたしか【大魔王：だいまおう】シブってヤツが【言：い】ってた…
Translated Text:
Romance… Ah!
I'm pretty sure that Great Demon
King Shibu guy said that…

Original Text: そうそう　シブから【聞：き】いたんだ\nキミたち　すごいんだってね
Translated Text: Oh, right—I heard from Shibu that\nyou guys are really something.

Original Text: いやあ　それほどでもないズラ…
Translated Text: Nah, it's not that bad, you know...

Original Text: じゃあ　シブやコイを【倒：たお】した【力：ちから】…\n【見：み】せてもらおうかな？
Translated Text:
Well then, maybe I'll have you
show me the power you used
to defeat Shibu and Koi...

Original Text: ノ　ノリが【軽：かる】いダニ…\nって　いきなりバトルするダニ！？
Translated Text:
A tick that's a bit of a joker...
Wait, a tick that just
suddenly starts a fight!?

Original Text: うん　そういうこと！\nじゃあ　よろしく～！！
Translated Text:
Yeah, that's it!
Well then, see you later!!

Original Text: キミたち　やっぱりすごいね！
Translated Text: You guys are really amazing!

Original Text: いったい　お【前：まえ】たちの【目的：もくてき】はなんニャン！？
Translated Text: What on earth is your goal, you guys!?

Original Text: 【目的：もくてき】？　そんなのキミたちとの【戦：たたか】いを\n【楽：たの】しみたいだけに【決：き】まってるじゃないか
Translated Text: My purpose? It's obvious—I just\nwant to enjoy fighting you guys.

Original Text: でも…　【魔王：まおう】コイも【大魔王：だいまおう】シブも\nめちゃくちゃ【悪：わる】そうだったダニ！
Translated Text: But… both the Maou Koi and\nthe Great Demon King Shibu\nlooked super evil, didn't they?!

Original Text: あれは【演技：えんぎ】さ　【演技：えんぎ】！
Translated Text: That was just an act—an act!

Original Text: そうしないと\nみんな【真剣：しんけん】に【戦：たたか】わないでしょ？
Translated Text: If we don't do that, nobody will\ntake the fight seriously, right?

Original Text: コイもシブもみんな【楽：たの】しかったってさ\nもちろん　オレもね！
Translated Text: They said everyone—Koi and\nShibu included—had a great\ntime. Of course, so did I!

Original Text: じゃあ　また　【遊：あそ】んでね～！
Translated Text: Well then, let's hang out again sometime!

Original Text: 【行：い】っちゃったズラ…\nみんな　もんげー【強：つよ】かったズラね…
Translated Text:
They're gone... Man, they were all
crazy strong...

Original Text: でも…　そんな【妖怪：ようかい】たちを【倒：たお】せたダニ！\nもうだれにも【負：ま】けないダニ！
Translated Text:
But… I beat those Yo-kai! I’m unbeatable
now!

Original Text: そうニャン！　これからも\nさくら【国：こく】の【平和：へいわ】はオレっちが【守：まも】るニャン！
Translated Text: That's right, meow! I'll keep\nprotecting the peace of Sakura\nCountry from now on, meow!

Original Text: あーーーーっ！
Translated Text: Aaaah!

Original Text: な　なんニャン？　いきなり…
Translated Text: W-What's up, Meow? Out of the blue...

Original Text: 【彼：かれ】らは【演技：えんぎ】をしているといいましたね！\nこれが【本当：ほんとう】の…
Translated Text:
They said they were acting, didn't they!
This is the real thing…

Original Text: 『【三国志演技：さんごくしえんぎ】』！
Translated Text: « Roman théâtral des Trois Royaumes » !

Original Text: いや…　【中国：ちゅうごく】の【三国志：さんごくし】の【小説：しょうせつ】に\n『【三国志演義：さんごくしえんぎ】』というものがありまして…
Translated Text: Well... there's a novel about China's\nThree Kingdoms era called\n*Romance of the Three Kingdoms*...

Original Text: 【演義：えんぎ】と【演技：えんぎ】をかけたわけで…\nあまりに【高度：こうど】なダジャレでしたね　アハハ
Translated Text:
I was playing on the words
"romance" and "acting"... That was a
pretty sophisticated
pun, wasn't it? Hahaha

Original Text: せっかくの…　【勝利：しょうり】の【感動：かんどう】を…
Translated Text: Since we’ve come this far… let’s savor the thrill of victory…

Original Text: 【変：へん】なダジャレで…
Translated Text: With a weird pun...

Original Text: だいなしにするなダニ！
Translated Text: Don't let the mites ruin it!

Original Text: いてえええええ！\nご　ごめんなさーーい！
Translated Text:
Owwwwww!
S-s-sorryyyyy!

Translated Text: A wonderful gift has arrived for all the\nheroes fighting for Sakura Country.

I'm so happy, meow!

Translated Text:
Our achievements… I guess there
really are people out there
who are paying attention…

Original Text: 【次：つぎ】は　チョコボー【多：おお】めでお【願：ねが】いニャン♪\n…とのことです
Translated Text: "Next time, please give me extra Chocobo,\nmeow♪"... that's what they said.

Translated Text: That concludes our Yo-kai News report.

Translated Text: It's time for "Yo-kai News"!

Translated Text: It seems there's a food\nshortage nationwide this year.

Original Text: 【g】【Str1】【軍：ぐん】【e】にも\nその【影響：えいきょう】が【出：で】ているようです
Translated Text: 【g】【Str1】It seems the【e】\nmilitary is also feeling the effects.

Original Text: ボクたち　ぜっこう【蝶蒋⑥：ちょうしょうえん】！
Translated Text: We're the Zekkou Butterfly Gang, Part 6!

Original Text: ボクたちがいれば\n【毎日：まいにち】　【絶好調：ぜっこうちょう】！
Translated Text: With us around, every day is a blast!

Original Text: この【現象：げんしょう】との【関係性：かんけいせい】は【不明：ふめい】ですが…\n【身長：しんちょう】が２ｃｍ【伸：の】びた　【彼女：かのじょ】ができた　など…
Translated Text:
It's unclear how this is related to
that phenomenon, but... I grew 2
cm taller, I got a girlfriend, and so on...

Original Text: 【続々：ぞくぞく】とハッピーなニュースが【届：とど】いています。\n【私：わたし】も【今朝：けさ】　【茶柱：ちゃばしら】が【二本：にほん】　【立：た】っていました
Translated Text:
Happy news keeps coming
in one after another.
I even had two tea sticks
standing upright this morning.

Original Text: 【以上：いじょう】　【妖怪：ようかい】ニュースをお【伝：つた】えしました
Translated Text: That concludes our Yo-kai News report.

Original Text: 【妖怪：ようかい】ニュースのお【時間：じかん】です
Translated Text: It's time for "Yo-kai News"!

Original Text: 【人気：にんき】アイドルユニットの【登場：とうじょう】に\n【国中：くにじゅう】がわいています
Translated Text: The whole country is buzzing\nwith excitement over the\narrival of a popular idol group.

Original Text: 【g】【Str1】【軍：ぐん】【e】にも\nその【影響：えいきょう】が【出：で】ているようです
Translated Text: 【g】【Str1】It seems the【e】\nmilitary is also feeling the effects.

Original Text: わたしたち…\nイケメン【犬霍去病：けんかくきょへい】×えんらえんら【甄氏：しんし】
Translated Text:
We... Handsome
Dog Huo Qubing × Enra Enra Zhen

Original Text: どこに【行：い】っても　ファンが【集：あつ】まっちゃうね。\nまあ　イケてるから　【仕方：しかた】ないけど…
Translated Text:
No matter where he goes,
fans just flock to him.
Well, he’s so cool, so I
guess it can’t be helped…

Original Text: デビューＣＤ「【犬：いぬ】とけむりのラブゲーム」は\nなんと１００【万枚：まんまい】を【突破：とっぱ】したそうです
Translated Text: I hear that their debut CD, "Inu\nto Kemuri no Love Game," has\nsold over 1 million copies.

Original Text: ちなみに　【女性：じょせい】ボーカルはフゥミン【貂蝉：ちょうせん】の\nほうがいいという【声：こえ】も【根強：ねづよ】いとか…
Translated Text: By the way, there’s apparently a\npersistent opinion that Fumin Diao\nChan is the better female vocalist…

Original Text: 【以上：いじょう】　【妖怪：ようかい】ニュースをお【伝：つた】えしました
Translated Text: That concludes our Yo-kai News report.
